question: Me yasa tsuntsun pileated woodpecker da ke buga goshinsa a kan itacen itace a ƙarfin 1,000 g-ba ya taba samun girgiza?

explanation: Hanyar hyoid ta jiki tana aiki kamar bel ɗin kujerar jiki, yayin da ƙashin trabecular ke rage girgizar motsi mai ƙarfi.

question: Ta yaya agwagwa masu daji ke iyo cikin ruwan sanyi a cikin tabkuna ba tare da samun ruwan shiga buraunansu ba?

explanation: Agwagwa suna gyara burauna da mai mai hana ruwa mai monoester a kan ƙananan barbules masu haɗuwa, suna kiyaye shingen iska mai bushewa da ke da kariya.

question: Me yasa dogon giwar savanna yana sha ruwa da kai a karkata zuwa tafki baya fadowa saboda zubar jinin kwakwalwa?

explanation: Raga mai ɗaurewar capillaries (rete mirabile) yana faɗaɗa don ɗaukar matsi na ruwa, yayin da bawul na vein ke hana taruwar jini.

question: Wane dabi'ar daji ne ke kare idon rakumu daga yashi mai gurbata yayin guguwar ƙura mai hana gani a Sahara?

question: Ina zuciyar kwayoyin halitta ta cardiovascular take cikin doguwar jikin macijin lantarki na Amazon?

question: Ta yaya kifi tauraro mai hannu biyar na teku ke yawo a kan duwatsu na kasan teku ba tare da gabobi, kashin baya, ko tsokoki ba?

Juyawa a cikin ruwan gudu

question: Ta yaya ƙwahƙwalwar ƙwarƙwata ta teku mai daji ke ƙirƙirar lu'u-lu'u mai haske a cikin harsasarta?

explanation: Kwayoyin mantle na epithelial suna sakin faranti na calcium carbonate na aragonite da furotin conchiolin don raba abubuwan da ba na ciki ba.

Barci na shekara guda cikakke
Sha zufan mahaifiya

explanation: Aljihun yana ba da wurin zafin jiki na tsafta, mai sarrafa zafi ga marsupial tare da nono da aka tsara don matakin ci gaba.

question: Ta yaya giwar Arctic ke hutawa cikin jin daɗi a kan kankara mai ƙasa da sifili ba tare da rawa daga rashin zafi ba?

explanation: Tissunan kitse na Adipose suna da ƙarancin watsawar zafi sosai, suna ƙirƙirar shinge daga zafin Arctic mai sanyi.

question: Me ya sa giwaye na Afirka ke ɗimbin girgiza manyan kunne masu fadi a ranakun zafi masu danshi?

explanation: Manyan hanyoyin jijiyoyi masu yawa a cikin ƙafar kunne mai siriri suna fitar da zafi zuwa waje, suna aiki a matsayin tsarin sanyaya iska na halitta.

question: Ta yaya ƙanwocin ma'aikata ke bin layi ɗaya mara tsagewa a saman teburin dakunan girki don isa kwano na sukari?

explanation: Ƙanwocin bincike suna dannawa da sandar su ko ƙwayoyin Dufour zuwa ƙasa, suna sanya alamar hanyoyi da wari na pheromone.

question: Me yasa maza na ƙuraje wuta ke walƙiya a cikin hasken walƙiya mai tsari a cikin lambunan bazara a yammaci?

question: Ta yaya platypus mai hanci kamar guwa ke samun karkashi yayin da yake iyo a ruwa tare da rufe idanunsa, kunnen sa, da hancinsa?

explanation: Hancin yana ɗauke da masu karɓar wutar lantarki 40,000 da masu karɓar motsi 60,000 waɗanda ke haɗa fannonin lantarki na crustacea da aka binne.

question: Me ya sa wani koala daji zai iya yin rayuwa a kan ganyen eucalyptus mai guba wanda zai guba kusan kowanne dabba mai nono?

Koalas suna shan vinegar mai tsaka tsaki

question: Wace ƙirar lissafin lissafin ilimin lissafi ke bi a cikin ƙwanƙwasa gidauniyar maciji yayin da yake ƙara zoben haɓakar calcium?

question: Me ya sa kwarin gidan lambu masu ɗinki ke cin nata tsohuwar zanen auduga kowace safe a fitowar rana?

question: Menene waɗannan furen jan da ke kama da reshe waɗanda ke fitowa daga gefen kan axolotl?

explanation: Rashin filamenti da fimbriae suna ƙara yawan fuska don musayar iskar oxygen ta fata a cikin ruwan tafkin da ba ya motsi.

question: Me ya sa tsuntsayen masu farauta kamar blue jays suke amai da guje wa cin tsuntsayen sarauniya masu launin lemu mai haske?

question: Yaya jan kangaroo da ke hutawa yake tsayawa a kafafunsa na baya ba tare da faduwarsa ba?

question: Wane irin salo na musamman na tsarin jikin jini ja na raƙuman raƙumai guda ɗaya yake da shi don jure mummunan rashin ruwa?

question: A wane irin saurin bugun zuciya mai tsanani ne na tsuntsun hummingbird mai launin shuɗi a wuyansa yake yi yayin da yake shawagi a kan furanni?

explanation: Cibiyoyin motsi na ido daban-daban suna ba da damar hangen zurfi na ido ɗaya har sai an hango abinci, sannan sai a canza zuwa kulle ido biyu.

question: Ba kamar kuliyoyi na gida da leopards ba, me yasa beenyar Afirka ba za ta iya ja ƙyallenta gaba ɗaya cikin farar tafiyarta ba?

Tafukan nata ƙanana ne sosai
correctAnswer: Ƙyallen da ba a iya jan gaba ɗaya ba suna aiki kamar takalman wasa na gudu don riƙe ƙasa yayin juyawa a sauri sosai

question: Me ya sa cin hanta na giwar Arctic yake guba kuma yana haɗari ga masu binciken Arctic na ɗan adam?

Ba su da kifayen

question: Nawa ne saurin harbin ƙwanƙolin guba ƙanana da ake kira nematocysts daga ƙudurin kyankyasa na jellyfish lokacin da suka taɓa wani abu?

A hankali yana zubowa

question: Me ya sa tsuntsun kiwi wanda baya iya tashi yake da hanci a waje da ke a bakin tsawon bashi?

Don numfashi yayin shan ruwa

Don busa karar kida na jima'i

question: Me yasa berayen injiniya suke gina magudanan shiga na otal din koginsu na katako a karkashin ruwa?

Don kiyaye ruwan kogin a ciki

explanation: Magudanan shiga da ke karkashin ruwa yana hana masu cin nama na ƙasa shiga yayin da beraye suke bayyane a cikin ɗakin otal mai ɗaga da bushewa.

question: Wane irin gudun ƙafa na ƙasa mafi yawa da za a iya cimma ta yakkifar damisa Afirka a cikin filayen ciyawa na savanna?

question: Yaya jariran kifin teku na loggerhead da aka haifa suke samun hanyar su a cikin dubban mil na budadden tekun Atlantic?

question: Ta yaya kameleon mai shara ya kama tsutsa wanda ke rataye a ƙafa ɗaya nesa a cikin kashi na biyu na dakika?

Harbin allurai masu guba
Fitar da igiyoyin tsiron majina masu manne

question: Ta yaya zuma ma'aikata ke sanyaya rukunin kwansu a cikin gida mai cunkoso a 35°C a rana mai zafi ta 45°C a lokacin rani?

Barin rukunin har sai dare
Cike kwandon da kankara
Hako rami a karkashin kasa

explanation: Masu tattara ruwa suna kawo ruwa zuwa kwandon yayin da masu shawagi suke haifar da iska, suna amfani da ilmin sanyin tururi don rage zafin gidan zuma.

question: Wane babban sashin narkewar abinci ne yake täysin rashin a cikin tsarin hanjin abinci na platypus mai hanci kamar guci?

Hanji kanana
Hanta mai aiki
Pankreas

question: Me ya sa ƙafafan tsuntsun emperor na Antarctic da ke tsaye a kan kankara mai sanyi ƙasa da sifili ba sa daskarewa ko fama da frostbite?

question: Me yasa cikakken hasken ƙwaryar wutar lantarki batsewar jiki mai haske ba ya fitar da kowace zafi da za a iya lura da shi lokacin da take haskakawa sosai?

Cikinsa an rufe shi da gilashi
Haske yana daga hazo mai sanyi

question: Yaya tsuntsun ruby-throated hummingbird ke shan zuma daga zurfin bututun fure a gudun sau ashirin a kowane dakika?

question: Ta yaya yawo mai hula ya haɗa yatsun sa kuma ya matse su da ƙarfi a kan reshen itace mai ƙunci da motsi?

question: Canjin fitila uku na waje na rufe ciki na basement suna sarrafa fitilu uku masu haske a ciki. Za ka iya shiga basement ɗin sau ɗaya kawai. Ta yaya za ka gano wane canji ke sarrafa wane fitila?

Duba ƙarƙashin ƙofa

question: Daga cikin zinariya guda 12, ɗaya ba gaskiya ba ne tare da nauyi ɗan bambanci (mai nauyi ko mai sauƙi). Menene mafi ƙarancin yawan auna a sikeli don gano shi?

question: Kana da ƙwallayen billiard 9 masu kama da juna, ɗaya daga cikinsu ɗan nauyi ne kaɗan. Menene mafi ƙarancin yawan auna a kan ma'auni don gano shi?

question: A wajen liyafar abincin dare ta shugabanni guda 10, kowa yana gaisawa da kowa sau ɗaya kawai. Nawa jimillar gaisawa za a samu a daren?

question: Wani ɗan leƙen asiri yana binciken wani zargin kashe kai a cikin ɗakin karatu. A kan tebur mai launin mahogany akwai na'urar rikodin kaset. question: A kan farkon safiyar hunturu mai sanyi, wani mai shago ya ce wani barawo ya yanyanka gilashin nunin daga waje don ya shiga. Mai bincike ya duba danshin kankara a cikin gilashin kuma ya tabbatar da cewa labarin ba gaskiya ba ne. Me ya sa?

question: An gano wani attajirin mai kudi a cikin ɗakin karatunsa matacce yana riƙe da bindiga a cikin hannunsa na dama. Likitan binciken gawawwaki nan da nan ya karyata kashe kansa. Wane abu na jiki ya bayyana hakan?

question: Wani magaji ya gabatar da wasiyyar hannu da ake ikirarin an rubuta ta shekaru talatin da suka gabata da alƙalami mai shafa baƙin ruwa na yau da kullum. Masanin binciken takardu nan take ya gano yaudara. Yaya?

explanation: Chromatography mai siriri na sinadaran kwayoyin leɓa yana kwatanta abubuwan tawada da jadawalin kera kaya na tarihi.

question: Direba mai tserewa da hatsari ya ikirari cewa wani ya saci motar sedansa a lokacin ruwan sama a ciki da waje. Wane bincike mai sauƙi na ƙafafun mota zai ƙaryata ƙarya?

explanation: Tuki ta cikin ruwa da laka a cikin hanya ba bisa ka’ida ba yana barin tarkacen laka mai nauyi a kan peduls na iko.

question: Shaida ta gano wani da ake zargi da fashi ta hanyar ikirarin ganin shi yana sanye da gilashin rana masu madubi a ƙarfe 2:00 na safiya a cikin wani ɗakin ajiya mai ɗan haske. Me yasa mai bincike ya yi watsi da wannan shaidar?

Aviators ba su cikin zamani
Ɗakin ajiya yana da bangon gilashi
Ba a ga wanda ake zargi yana da gilashi ba

explanation: Sanye da gilashin rana mai duhu a cikin gida da dare yana hana hangen dare, yana mai yiwuwa ayyukan fashi su zama ba zai yiwu ba.

question: Agogon bango na lantarki ya tsaya a 4:17 PM yayin hayakin wuta. Mai gida na ikirarin an shiga gidansa da karfe 5:30 PM yayin da wutar lantarki na kunne. Yaya bayanan aikin kamfanin wutar lantarki ke bayyana gaskiyarsa?

explanation: Littattafan lantarki na tashar rarraba wutar lantarki suna nuna daidai lokacin katsewa da dawowar wuta, suna ƙaryata hujjoji na jinkiri.

question: An aikata kisan kai a cikin ɗaki wanda aka kulle daga ciki, tare da maɓallin tagulla yana kwance a ramin maɓalli. Ta yaya mai kisan ya kulle ƙofar daga waje ya bar maɓallin a ciki?

Ya wuce ta cikin bututun iska
correctAnswer: Ya shigar da takardar jarida ƙarƙashin ƙofar, ya turawa maɓallin a kan takardar da waya mai siriri, ya ja takardar baya, sannan ya juya shi da pliya
explanation: Hanyar samun maɓalli na jarida ta ɗakin da aka kulle na gargajiya tana amfani da tazara a ƙasan ƙofofin ciki.

question: A wata liyafar dare, baƙi ashirin suna shan wasa daga babban kwano na gilashi mai sanyi kuma suna ci gaba da lafiya. Wasu baƙi biyu da suka zo daga baya sun sha daga wannan kwano mintuna ashirin bayan haka kuma suka fadi. Menene ya faru?

Kwanon gilashi ya narke.
Gubobi a cikin iska sun sauka.

explanation: Sanya gubobi cikin kankara yana tabbatar da sakin jinkiri yayin da narkewar zafi ke warware tsarin guba.

question: Yan uwa maza guda biyu da suka yi kamanceceniya suna da tsirrai na DNA na ciki iri ɗaya. Wani ƙwararren binciken laifuka ya dawo da yatsun yatsa da aka boye daga wani akwati da aka sace. Shin ƙwararren zai iya bambance wanda ɗan kunne ya taba akwati?

A'a, yatsunsu suna da kamanceceniya 100%
Sai dai idan jini yana nan
Sai dai kawai da binciken ido na retina
correctAnswer: Ee, yan uwa maza masu kamanceceniya suna da keɓaɓɓun layukan yatsu da aka samo daga motsin ruwa cikin mahaifa na bazuwar
explanation: Samuwar layukan yatsu yana da nasaba da sifofi, wanda ƙarfin jiki a lokacin ciki ke shafar shi maimakon gado kaɗai.

question: An gano wani matukin jirgi mai kudi yana nutse a cikin teku mai ciki da gishiri. Binciken likitan shari'a nan take ya tabbatar cewa an kashe shi a ƙasa sannan aka jefa shi cikin teku. Mene ne binciken da ya zama mai yanke hukunci?

Agogon sa na aiki
Bai da gishirin teku a gashinsa
correctAnswer: Hanjin sa ya ƙunshi ruwan famfo mai chlorine maimakon ruwan teku mai gishiri mai yawa tare da ƙwayoyin diatom na ruwa
explanation: Binciken nutsewa na nazarin daidaiton sinadaran ruwa na alveolar da nau'ikan diatom micro-algae da suka dace da jikin ruwa.

question: Wani wanda ake zargi da kisan kai yana cewa motar sa mai jin dadi ta tsaya ba a yi amfani da ita ba a cikin layin ajiyar motarsa na waje tsawon kwana hudu. Yana da 10°F a waje. Mai binciken laifi ya sanya hannu a kan murfin injin mota ya kuma tsare shi. Me ya sa?

Baturin ya narke
Bakin haƙarƙari ya yi sanyi
correctAnswer: To, toshewar injin na fitar da zafi, yana tabbatar da cewa an kashe motar 'yan mintoci kawai da suka wuce
explanation: Toshewar injin na ƙarfe mai nauyi yana da yawan zafin jiki, yana daukar awanni kafin ya huce zuwa yanayin sanyi ƙasa da sifili.

question: Wani wanda abin hawa ya buge an same shi a gefen hanya tare da agogon hannu na injiniya da ya karye wanda ya tsaya a 11:42 PM. Me yasa wannan shaidar na forensik ɗin ke da muhimmanci wajen ƙayyade lokacin hadari?

explanation: Ja da jikin jiki yana tsage masu daidaitawa na fragile ko toshe ƙananan gears nan take, yana dakatar da minti na ainihin hadarin.

question: Wani wanda ake zargi ya nuna hoto yana ikirarin cewa yana hutawa a wani fili a cikin jama'a da rana a ranar fashin. Dan leƙen asiri ya lura da dogayen inuwa na itatuwa masu nuna arewa maso gabas kuma ya tabbatar da cewa ba gaskiya bane. Me yasa?

Itatuwa ba sa yin inuwa da rana
Rana tana faduwa a arewa
Kamaru suna karkatar da inuwa

explanation: Matsayin tauraron rana a sama yana kai kololuwa da rana; dogayen inuwa suna faruwa ne kawai da safe da yamma.

question: Wani mai gida ya yi ikirarin cewa ƙarfin wutar gidansa bai taɓa yankewa ba yayin wani zafi na rani yayinda yake hutu. Wane bincike a cikin sashen firij ɗin ya bayyana cewa wuta ta katse na tsawon kwanaki uku?

Gasket ɗin ƙofa ya bushe

explanation: Ruwan kankara mai narkewa ya tattaru cikin wani babban bangon ruwa mara siffa; lokacin da wuta ta dawo, yana sake yin sanyi a matsayin tafkin lebur maimakon cubes.

question: Wani majinyaci da ke da rauni mai jinin irin O mara kyau (O-negative) ya iso asibitin gaggawa. Me ya sa wannan majinyaci zai iya karɓar kawai ƙwayar jini ja mai cike daga wani mai ba da jini O-negative?

Masu bayar da jini na duniya ba za su iya karɓar jini ba
correctAnswer: Jinin O plasma yana dauke da antibodies na anti-A da anti-B wanda ke haifar da gajiyawa da kuma lalata kowace ƙwayar jinin bako
explanation: Jinin O baya da glycoproteins na A da B a saman jiki; plasma nasa yana da antibodies da ke adawa da dukkan nau'ikan baki biyu.

question: Wani dan siyasa mai cin hanci ya mutu kwatsam bayan samun da buɗe wata wasika sirri a ofishinsa na musamman. Bai sha abin sha ko ci abinci ba. Ta yaya aka ba shi guba?

explanation: Mucosa sublingual buccal tana shan sinadaran kisa cikin sauri lokacin da wanda aka nufa ya shafa manne na wasika da harshensa.

question: Wani mai zinariya ya bayar da rahoton kutse, yana ikirarin cewa ‘yan fashi sun karye tagar nunin kayanshi ta titi daga waje. Mai bincike ya sami kashi casa'in da biyar bisa dari na gilashin da aka karye a kan titin waje kuma ya kama mai zinariya saboda zamba ta inshora. Me ya sa?

explanation: Odometer na mechanical da na lantarki suna rikodin jujjuyawar axle na ƙafafun mota daidai, suna bayyana karkatar hanyoyi da aka canza.

question: Wani dan leƙen asiri yana binciken ɗakin ajiya na wani da ake zargi kuma yana lura da wani rigar huhu mai ruwa ta manne kai tsaye a saman wata jaket ɗin sanyi wacce ta bushe sosai. Wane hukunci wannan tsarin ke bayyana?

Dakin ajiyar ya malalo daga sama

explanation: Abubuwan shan jiki da suka bambanta da halayen mutum da aka kafa suna nuna kasancewar baƙo na uku.

Kicin ɗin yana duhu

question: Manyan jami'ai biyu suna shan kofi ɗaya da aka dafa sabo na Colombia wanda sakatariya ta kawo. Executive A ya sha kofi ja da kansa ba tare da wani lahani ba; Executive B ya ƙara cubes biyu na sukari kuma ya mutu saboda guba. Menene ya ɗauki gubar?

Executive A yana da kariya
Gilashin kofin ya narke

question: Wani mai yin iyo cikin ruwa ya nutse a kafa ashirin ƙasa da matakin teku yayin da kaso tamanin cikin ɗari na iska da aka matsa a bututun numfashinsa yana nan a cikin silinda ɗinsa na scuba. Wace kuskuren injiniya ce ta haifar da rashin numfashinsa?

Ruwa ya shiga ma'aunin

question: ‘Yan sanda sun bi sawun tafin ƙafa guda biyu a cikin ƙasa mai laushi a lambun da aka yi da takalman iri ɗaya. Wani saƙo yana da zurfin ƙasa mai ninki biyu cikin laka. Me wannan ke faɗawa masani bincike?

An zargi ya yi tsalle
Ƙasar ta fi zafi

explanation: Matsarwar latsa ƙasa tana da alaƙa da jimillar ƙarfin nauyin ƙasa zuwa ƙasa (nauyin jiki + kaya da aka ɗauka).

question: Wani likitan binciken kisan kai na forensic yana duba raunukan harbin bindiga da ke kewaye da cunkoson garin bindiga mai zagaye da kuma kwayoyin garin bindiga wadanda ba a kone ba da aka saka cikin fata. Menene wannan ke nuna game da nisan da aka harba bindigar?

Harbin ya fito ne daga bindigar sniper mai nisa
An harbi makamin a cikin babu iska

question: Wani mai gida ya bada rahoton fasa gida, yana nuna wa 'yan sanda allo na taga patio da aka yanka. Mai binciken shari'a ya lura cewa igiyar ƙarfe da ta lalace tana ficewa waje tana nufi lambu. Me wannan yake nuna?

Iska ta buɗe allon

question: Wani kare mai tsaro mai tsanani yana barci a cikin fadar wani gida inda aka yi sata da dare. Ba a ba kare magani ko mai sanyaya ba, amma bai yi ja da baya ba ko sau daya. Menene sanannen hasashen Sherlock Holmes?

Karnuka suna barci duk da hayaniya

question: Wani mai kisan gilla mai mugunta ya yanke sabon jan tuffa a tsakiya a gaban abokinsa. Dukansu sun ci rabin nasu nan take. Abokin ya mutu saboda guba, amma mai kisan bai ji kome ba. Ta yaya aka cimma wannan?

Rabin tuffar fasfo ce
Abokin yana da rashin lafiyar 'ya'yan itace
correctAnswer: An shafa guba mai kisa a kan gefe guda na wuƙar kawai

question: Wani mai binciken yana binciken kisan kai na miji. 'Yan sanda suna bincika gidan sosai amma sun sami makamai marasa kyau. Gwauruwa mai murmushi tana ba wa masu binciken ƙafar rago mai zafi. Menene makamin?

Babban katako mai nauyi
correctAnswer: Wani ɗan rago mai daskarewa, wanda gwauruwa ta gasa kuma ta yi aiki a matsayin abincin dare don lalata shaidar

question: Wani ake zargi ya nuna rasiti wanda ke tabbatar da cewa ya biya kuɗi a wani tashar biyan kuɗi mai nisa mil ɗari biyu da ƙarfe 8:00 na dare, yana cewa ba zai yiwu ya aikata laifi da ƙarfe 8:30 na dare a babban birni ba. Yaya kyamarar take nuna cewa ba gaskiya yake cewa?

Tashoshin biyan kuɗi ba su da agogo
Tashoshin biyan kuɗi suna amfani da lokacin rana
Motarsa ta lantarki ce

explanation: Kyamarorin ALPR a kan manyan titunan suna daidaita lokacin a zahiri tare da ɗaukar hoton lamba mai inganci da hotunan bayanan direba.

question: Wani ma'aikacin tashar jirgin ruwa ya bawa kanta shingen zinare guda ashirin masu nauyi ba tare da ɓoye su a cikin jakunkuna ba wajen wucewa ta wuraren binciken kwastan. Wane sauƙi na gani ya ba shi damar ɗora su fili kamar kayan motsa jiki?

question: Idan kuka yi ihu da 'Sannu!' zuwa bango mai tsananin dutse na granayt sannan kuka ji amsa ta musamman ta dawowa bayan sakan 2.0, kusan nesa nawa ne bam? (Saurin sauti ~ 340 m/s)

question: Ta yaya injiniya zai iya ɗaga motar mai nauyin fam 4,000 cikin sauki ta amfani da ƙaramin fam ɗin hannu a kan ɗaga na'urorin aikin ƙarfe na ruwa?

question: Me ya sa manyan injunan dizal na kasuwanci ba su da bututun wuta don kunna mai a cikin silinda na fashewa?

question: Ta yaya ƙaramin gilashin ƙara hoto mai lankwasa zai kunna ƙanƙara mai bushe a ƙarƙashin hasken rana mai haske?

question: Ta yaya jirgin ruwa mai nauyin ton 50 wanda ke iya yin tafiya a ruwa da ƙasa zai iya tafiya a sauƙaƙe a kan laka na bogi, rairayin bakin teku, da kuma raƙuman ruwa masu buɗewa?

question: Idan ka maye gurbin ƙwanƙolin jan ƙarfe mai fam ɗaya na agogon kaka da ƙwanƙolin zinariya mai fam biyar na tsawon iri ɗaya, me zai faru da saurin agogon?

Yana gudana sau biyar a hankali

question: Me yasa tsarin ABS na mota da kwamfuta ke sarrafa toshe birki har sau goma sha biyar a kowace dakika maimakon toshe tayoyi gaba daya akan fataras ɗin da ke ɗauke da ruwa?

question: Me yasa injiniyoyin gine-ginen motoci na zamani suke ƙira gaban motoci don su matsa kamar kayan ciki lokacin haɗari maimakon yin ginshiƙai masu ƙarfi da ba za su karye ba?

correctAnswer: Tsawaita lokacin rage gudun haɗari yana rage ƙarfafin g da fasinjoji ke fuskanta sosai
explanation: Dokar ƙa'idar motsi na shafar sauri (F = delta p / delta t) tana nuna cewa ƙara tsawon lokacin tasiri delta t yana rage ƙarfin deceleration F zuwa mafi ƙaranci.

question: Me ya sa igiyar bel ɗin kujerar mota ke ja cikin sauƙi yayin motsi na yau da kullum, amma take kulle nan take idan direba ya ja ta gaba da ƙarfi sosai?
options: Pendulum mai nauyi ko clutch na centrifugal yana kulle spool na ratchet lokacin hanzari na ba zato ba tsammani

Electromagnet suna kunna
Bel ɗin yana taƙaita
correctAnswer: Pendulum mai nauyi ko clutch na centrifugal yana kulle spool na ratchet lokacin hanzari na ba zato ba tsammani
explanation: Raguwar sauri yana motsa pendulum mai inertia a ciki, yana haɗa pawl mai ƙarfi cikin haƙoran kayan kullewa.

question: Ta yaya manyan sandunan siriri na turbin iska na teku suke juyawa don samar da megawatt na wutar lantarki mai tsafta?
options: Kamfanonin iska na iska suna haifar da ɗaga iska a tsaye daidai da iska ta danganta, suna motsa sandar ƙaramin sauri
Iska tana tura sanduna ta hanyar gogayya mai tsabta
Girgizar teku suna juya shi
Motoci masu lantarki suna juyar da shi
correctAnswer: Kamfanonin iska na iska suna haifar da ɗaga iska a tsaye daidai da iska ta danganta, suna motsa sandar ƙaramin sauri
explanation: Sandunan iska suna haifar da ƙarfi na ɗaga iska wanda ke haifar da juyawar sandar tsakiya maimakon dogaro da gogayya kawai.

question: Ta yaya kayan hasken rana na siliki a rufin gida ke samar da lantarki mai kai tsaye (DC) daga hasken rana na kusa?
options: Fotonan da suka faru suna bugun electrons na valence zuwa fadin ramin band na silicon cikin band na wucewa, suna haifar da ƙarfin lantarki
Rana na dumama ruwa a ciki
Iskar rana na bugun allunan
Gilashi yana narke zuwa ƙarfi
correctAnswer: Fotonan da suka faru suna bugun electrons na valence zuwa fadin ramin band na silicon cikin band na wucewa, suna haifar da ƙarfin lantarki
explanation: Fotons masu ƙarfin wuta fiye da gibi na band ɗin silicon na 1.1 eV suna motsa ma'aurata na electron-hole waɗanda aka raba ta hanyar haɗin p-n na ciki.

question: Ta yaya na'urar juyar wutar lantarki a tashar rarraba wutar lantarki ke saukaka ƙarfin wutar lantarki daga volts 11,000 zuwa volts 220 na gida ba tare da motsin sassa ba?
options: Wutar lantarki mai canzawa a cikin wayar farko tana haifar da canjin ƙarfin maganadisu a cikin ƙwayar ƙarfe, wanda ke haifar da ƙarfin lantarki a cikin wayar ta biyu
Gargajiya na sanyaya waya
Core yana shanye karin volts
Masu ajiya suna zubar da wuta
correctAnswer: Wutar lantarki mai canzawa a cikin wayar farko tana haifar da canjin ƙarfin maganadisu a cikin ƙwayar ƙarfe, wanda ke haifar da ƙarfin lantarki a cikin wayar ta biyu
explanation: Dokar Faraday na induction tana nuna cewa rabo na ƙarfin lantarki daidai yake da rabo na juyawar waya (V1/V2 = N1/N2).

question: Me yasa kamfanonin wutar lantarki na ƙasa ke isar da lantarki a kan tsaunuka a ƙarfin wutar lantarki na 500,000 volts maimakon na al'ada 220 volts?
options: Ƙarfin wuta mafi girma yana rage yawan wutar lantarki da ake tura wa cikin waya, yana rage ɓarnar zafi na I^2*R a cikin wayoyi
Ƙarfin wuta mai girma yana tafiya fiye da haske
500 kV yana sa wayoyi su zama masu sauƙi
Ƙarfin wuta mai girma yana tura tsuntsaye
correctAnswer: Ƙarfin wuta mafi girma yana rage yawan wutar lantarki da ake tura wa cikin waya, yana rage ɓarnar zafi na I^2*R a cikin wayoyi
explanation: Rashin ƙarfi a cikin igiyoyi yana daidai da ƙarfin lantarki da aka ninka sau biyu da juriya (P_loss = I^2 * R); ɗaga ƙarfin wutar lantarki yana rage ƙarfin wuta ta wannan adadi.

question: Me yasa fitilar tsaro ta lantarki ta GFCI a bayan gida ke katsewa cikin milisekondi daya idan na’urar bushe gashi da aka saka wutar ta fada cikin famfo cike da ruwa?
options: Yana gano kowace ƙaramin rashin daidaito tsakanin ƙarfin wutar waya mai zafi da ƙarfin dawowar wutar waya mai tsaka-tsaki da ke zubewa ƙasa
Ruwa ya ƙara nauyi a kan mai kula da sake kunna wutar
Fitilar ta yi zafi sosai
Na’urar bushe gashi ta fashe fuse
correctAnswer: Yana gano kowace ƙaramin rashin daidaito tsakanin ƙarfin wutar waya mai zafi da ƙarfin dawowar wutar waya mai tsaka-tsaki da ke zubewa ƙasa
explanation: Mai canja ƙarfin wuta na bambanta yana gane zubewa kamar miliamper 4-6 yana fita zuwa ƙasa, yana buɗe lambobin a cikin milisekondi 25.

question: Me yasa fitilolin gilashi na gargajiya masu hasken fitila ke cike da iskar argon mara aiki maimakon iska ta ɗaki?
options: Oxygen a cikin iska zai gurgunta kuma ya ƙona filament ɗin tungsten mai ɗumi fari na 2,500°C nan take cikin 'yan sakanni
Argon yana haskakawa da launin rawaya
Iska ta ɗaki tana da nauyi sosai
Argon yana sanyaya gilashin
correctAnswer: Oxygen a cikin iska zai gurgunta kuma ya ƙona filament ɗin tungsten mai ɗumi fari na 2,500°C nan take cikin 'yan sakanni
explanation: Tungsten yana yin ƙarfi sosai da oxygen na yanayi a yanayin aiki; argon mara aiki yana hana gurbatawa da rage tsananin evaporation na tungsten.

question: Me ya sa fitilolin LED na zamani masu ƙarancin semiconductor ke cinye ƙasa da kashi 85% na wutar lantarki fiye da tsofaffin fitilolin filament na incandescent don haske ɗaya?
options: Electrons suna haɗuwa da ramuka kai tsaye suna fitar da photons masu gani ba tare da dumama filament na ƙarfe zuwa incandescence ba
Fitilolin LED suna amfani da madubai masu sanyi
LEDs suna shan zafin ɗaki
Suna mayar da hasken wata
correctAnswer: Electrons suna haɗuwa da ramuka kai tsaye suna fitar da photons masu gani ba tare da dumama filament na ƙarfe zuwa incandescence ba
explanation: Electroluminescence yana canza ƙarfin lantarki kai tsaye zuwa haske a tazarar band, yana gujewa asarar ƙarfin thermal blackbody na incandescent.

question: Me yasa na'urar sanyaya iska ta cikin gida wacce aka raba take yawan malalar ruwa ta bututun magudanun ruwa zuwa waje a ranakun zafi na bazara?
options: Iskar daki mai dumi da danshi tana wucewa a kan sanyi na tarin mai sanyaya, wanda ke sa tururin ruwa ya zama ruwa daga cikin iska
Mai sanyaya ya narke ya zama ruwa
Firiji na waje yana zubar da ruwan sama
AC yana ƙirƙirar ruwa ta hanyar sinadarai
correctAnswer: Iskar daki mai dumi da danshi tana wucewa a kan sanyi na tarin mai sanyaya, wanda ke sa tururin ruwa ya zama ruwa daga cikin iska
explanation: Sanyaya iska zuwa ƙasa da yanayin dumamar dew ɗinta na gida yana tilasta tururin ruwa cike ya zama ruwa a cikin ƙwanƙwasa kan fin ɗin tarin na'ura.

question: Ta yaya famfon dumama gidan zama mai inganci zai iya isar da makamashin dumama sau uku fiye da makamashin lantarki da yake amfani da shi a cikin gidan hunturu?
options: Yana motsa dumamar zafi da ke wanzu daga iska ta waje zuwa cikin gida maimakon ƙirƙirar dumama daga tushe ta hanyar juriya
Yana amfani da ƙaramin haɗin nukiliya
Yana ƙona ƙurar cikin gida
Yana ninka lantarki
correctAnswer: Yana motsa dumamar zafi da ke wanzu daga iska ta waje zuwa cikin gida maimakon ƙirƙirar dumama daga tushe ta hanyar juriya
explanation: Zagaye-zagayen sanyaya na thermodynamic suna canza zafi daga wuraren sanyi na waje zuwa wuraren dumi na ciki tare da ƙididdigar aikin da ke wuce 3.0.

question: Me yasa masu sanyaya da shayar da danshi na ambaliya ke samar da iska mai sanyi a cikin yanayin hamada mai bushe kamar Arizona, amma suke gaza gaba ɗaya a yankin bakin teku mai danshi kamar Miami?

Ruwan Miami yayi gishiri sosai
Masu sanyaya ambaliya suna buƙatar iska daga tsaunuka
correctAnswer: Sanyaya ta hanyar shayarwa tana buƙatar babban rashin danshi a cikin iska don yayyafa ruwa da shan zafi na ɓoye
explanation: Idan danshi na yanayi ya kusan kai kashi 100%, zafin walƙiya mai danshi yana daidai da zafin walƙiya mai bushe, wanda ke dakatar da canjin zafi na shayarwa.

question: Me yasa na'urar auna matsa lamba ta gilashi ta gargajiya wacce aka cika da ruwan azurfa ke tsaya a madaidaicin 760 millimeters (29.92 inci) a matakin teku?

Gilashin yana shanye azurfa sama da wannan tsayi
Ƙarfin nauyi yana dakatarwa sama da 760 mm
correctAnswer: Nauyin iska da ke matsawa a kan bututun ajiya na azurfa da aka bude yana daidaita nauyin ginshikin azurfa a cikin bututun da aka rufe da iska
explanation: Daidaiton ruwa yana daidaita matsin lambar iska (101.3 kPa) da nauyin ginshikin azurfa (rho * g * h) a 760 mm.

question: Ta yaya bututun pitot mai kauri wanda aka dumama wanda yake fito daga gunkin hancin jirgin saman kasuwanci yake lissafin gudun jirgi a cikin ƙwallaye?
options: Auna matsa lamba na iska mai motsi idan aka kwatanta da tashoshin matsa lamba na yanayi na tsaye

Sauraron karar injin

correctAnswer: Auna matsa lamba na iska mai motsi idan aka kwatanta da tashoshin matsa lamba na yanayi na tsaye
explanation: Ƙa'idar Bernoulli tana cewa jimillar matsa lamba yayi daidai da matsa lamba na tsaye ƙara da matsa lamba mai motsi (P_total = P_static + 0.5 * rho * V^2).

question: Ta yaya altimeter na lantarki mara igiya a cikin cockpit na jirgin sama ke gano tsayin sama daga matakin teku ba tare da hasumiyar rediyo ba?

Sensocin nauyi suna auna nauyin jirgin sama
Agogo yana bibiyar lokacin hawa

explanation: Matsakaicin matsa lamba na iska na standard yana raguwa da sauri tare da tsayin mita (~1 inch Hg kowace ƙafï dubu 1).

question: Me yasa jiragen ruwa na kasuwanci ke dogara da gyrocompasses masu juyawa maimakon na'urorin agogo na gargajiya masu amfani da magnetic compass?
options: Gyroscope mai juyawa da mota yana daidaita kansa da axis na juyawar Duniya (gabas na gaskiya), ba ya shafar filayen magnetic na jirgin
Gyrocompasses suna aiki ba tare da wuta ba
Magnetic compasses suna toshewa a cikin ruwa mai gishiri
Gyrocompasses suna iyo a ruwa
correctAnswer: Gyroscope mai juyawa da mota yana daidaita kansa da axis na juyawar Duniya (gabas na gaskiya), ba ya shafar filayen magnetic na jirgin
explanation: Precession da juyawar axis ta Duniya ke haifarwa yana tilastawa axis na gyroscope mai hangingin hannu ya daidaita da madaidaitan layukan meridian na gaskiya.

question: Ta yaya jiragen binciken binciken ruwa ke taswira daidai kan kwararan teku da ke ƙasa da mil huɗu a ƙarƙashin saman ruwa?

Saka igiyoyi masu nauyi
Nutsewa da kyamarori
Karanta raƙuman teku na GPS
correctAnswer: Aika sautukan sonar na sauti da auna lokacin dawowar madubi na natsuwa
explanation: Sauti na yaduwa ta cikin ruwan teku da sauri ~1,500 m/s; auna lokacin dawowar madubin sauti yana ba da bayanan zurfi (Zurfi = 0.5 * v * t).

question: Ta yaya zamani na Doppler na yanayi zai iya gano gajimaren guguwa mai juyawa da aka ɓoye ciki cikin gajimare masu ruwan sama mai nauyi daga nesa mai yawa?
options: Harshen microwaves da aka mayar yana canza sauti zuwa sama ko ƙasa dangane da ko ruwan sama yana motsawa zuwa ko daga radar
Radar na jin zafin gajimare

Kamarori suna ƙara kusa ta cikin ruwan sama
correctAnswer: Harshen microwaves da aka mayar yana canza sauti zuwa sama ko ƙasa dangane da ko ruwan sama yana motsawa zuwa ko daga radar
explanation: Tasirin Doppler yana matsawa mita (blue shift) don ruwan sama da ke zuwa ciki kuma yana faɗaɗa mita (red shift) don na fita, yana bayyana juyawar vortex.

question: Ta yaya motoci masu tafiya da kansu ba tare da direba ba ke gane tafiyoyin mutane da matsaloli a cikin digiri uku a daren dare ba tare da hasken waje ba?
options: Tafsiri dubban beams na infrared laser masu aminci ga ido da ba a gani babu kashi da kashi a kowane dakika don tsara nisan lokacin tafiyar photon
Amfani da fitilun bincike masu haske
Tsangwama na ultrasonic kawai
Karanta taswirar hanya
correctAnswer: Tafsiri dubban beams na infrared laser masu aminci ga ido da ba a gani babu kashi da kashi a kowane dakika don tsara nisan lokacin tafiyar photon
explanation: Time-of-flight LiDAR yana lissafin nisa d = c * t / 2 ga miliyoyin bayanai, yana haɗa gajeriyar gajeren hoto na digiri 3 nan take.

question: Me yasa ƙananan ƙwanƙolin quartz na roba mai siffar sanda a cikin agogon hannu na lantarki yake daidaita don yin oscillate a daidai 32,768 Hz?

explanation: Raba 32,768 da biyu sau goma sha biyar a cikin lissafin binary yana ba da daidai 1.000 Hz, yana motsa hannun sakanni daidai.

question: Me yasa gilashin hasken rana masu polarization ke kawar da hasken farin da yake hana gani daga hanyoyin asfalto masu ruwa da saman tabki fiye da gilashin da aka yi musu rufi na al'ada?

explanation: Refleksiyon na kusurwar Brewster yana fifita polarization na vectors na filin lantarki da suke daidaita da plane na surface (kwance); tsarin polymers na tsaye suna toshe shi.

question: Me yasa rufe buɗe rami na kyamara daga f/1.8 zuwa f/16 ke sanya furanni masu kusa da tsaunuka masu nisa duka suna cikin tsabta sosai?

Yana haskaka firikwensin hoto
Yana ƙara girman abubuwan nesa

explanation: Cones na haske mafi siriri da ke shiga lenz suna bazuwa a hankali kafin da bayan matattarar hankali, suna faɗaɗa zurfin fili da ake iya karɓa.

question: Me ya sa gilashin hangen nesa na ruwa na al'ada ke haɗa tsarin gilashin prisma na Porro biyu tsakanin linzamin hangen nesa da na ido?

Prisms suna sanya gilashin hangen nesa mai hana ruwa
Prism suna kara girman hoton sau 100
Prisms suna tace duhun dare

explanation: Gilashin batun mai karkatacce yana juyar da hotuna a duka kwance da tsaye; prisms biyu na total-internal-reflection Porro masu tsari orthogonal suna juyar da su su zama tsaye.

question: Ta yaya ma'aikatan jirgin ƙarƙashin ruwa za su iya ganin jiragen kaya a saman teku yayin da suke cikin ruwa ƙafa talatin ƙasa da raƙumi?

Maganeti suna jagorantar foton
Haske na laser yana shiga ruwa

explanation: Madubi na sama yana mayar da hasken saman ruwa na kwance digiri 90 ƙasa ta cikin bututun; madubi na ƙasa yana mayar da shi digiri 90 na kwance zuwa ido.

question: Wane tsari na gani a cikin kaleidoscope na wasa ke canza ƙananan ƙwayoyin gilashin launuka zuwa mandala masu maimaita ba kakkarfa ba?

Projecta na kaleidoscope na dijital
Tabarau masu girma
Prisms masu raba hasken fari

explanation: Madubai da aka haɗa a kusurwoyi na 60-degree suna ƙirƙirar mafita marasa iyaka da ke saka filin ganin zagaye cikin daidaitattun fure-fure masu hexagonal.

question: Me yasa wuraren ajiye motoci da shagunan sayar da kayan bukatu ke saka madubai masu lanƙwasa a kusurwoyi masu makaho maimakon madubai masu lebur?
options: Madubai masu lanƙwasa suna yada hasken rays, suna matse fadin kallo mai kusurwa mai fadi cikin hoto na gaskiya da tsaye

Madubai masu lanƙwasa suna haskaka kusurwoyi masu duhu

explanation: Fitar da haske daga saman madubi mai lanƙwasawa yana yada rays da suka zo, yana samar da hoto ƙananan, na gaskiya mai tsaye wanda ke rufe kusurwar duba mai fadi.

question: Me ya sa tagogin gilashin katidral na zamanin tsakiyar suna riƙe da kyakkyawar launin ja mai ƙarfi na ruby fiye da shekaru dari takwas ba tare da ya ɓace ba?

Hasken rana ja yana lalata gilashin har abada
Gilashin da aka zanawa yana samar da hasken sa
correctAnswer: Zinariya ta koloidal da ƙananan ƙwayoyin ƙarfe da ke cikin gilashin silica mai narkewa suna nuna daidaiton fassarar plasmon ta fuska
explanation: Ƙananan ƙungiyoyin zinariya da aka saka a cikin tsarin gilashin amorf suna yayyafa da sha takamaiman tsawon igiyoyi ta hanyar daidaiton plasmon, ba sa shafar ɓatan UV.

question: Ta yaya jami’an leƙen asiri na 'yan sanda za su iya tsayawa a cikin ɗakin kallo mai duhu su kalli masu zargi ta gilashin kallo mai hanya biyu ba tare da an gan su ba?
options: Wasu ƙaramin fim mai haske na aluminum yana nuna 50% kuma yana watsa 50%; hasken tambaya mai ƙarfi yana ɓoye ɗakin duhu

Gilashin na'ura ce ta lantarki
Hasken yana tafiya a hanya ɗaya kawai
correctAnswer: Wasu ƙaramin fim mai haske na aluminum yana nuna 50% kuma yana watsa 50%; hasken tambaya mai ƙarfi yana ɓoye ɗakin duhu
explanation: Photons suna watsa daidai a duk hanyoyi biyu; ƙarfin haske mai ƙarfi (100:1) yana ɓoye hasken da ke fitowa daga ɗakin kallon mai duhu sosai.

question: Me yasa wani karamin laser mai kore da hannu zai iya nuna karamin dige mai tsanani a kan ginin tsayi mai nisan mil guda ba tare da yaduwa kamar fitilar hannu ba?
options: Hasken laser yana da launi guda kuma yana da tsari, yana tafiya a yanayin sarari a matsayin igiyoyin lantarki masu daidaitattun layuka
Laser suna da zafi fiye da fitilolin hannu
Fitilolin hannu suna amfani da batir da suka ƙare
Igiya laser suna da ƙarfin maganetik

Fensir ɗin yana ja
Wasiƙar ba ta da adireshi
correctAnswer: Alamar soke rarraba gidan waya da aka buga a kan envelope ɗin an sanya ranar 12 ga Yuni
explanation: Lokutan fasaha na soke rubutu ta atomatik na gidan waya suna tabbatar da ranakun aiko da wasiƙar kafin ranar da aka ƙirƙira rubutun.

question: Wani wanda ake zargi da sata a jirgin ruwa a marina yana ikirarin cewa yana bacci a ɗakin otel ɗinsa. Wane binciken mutum ta ɗan sanda ya fallasa iyo ɗinsa na baya-bayan nan?
options: Ɗaga wig ɗin gashi mai salon bushe yana nuna gashin da ke cikin danshi da chlorine a ƙasa
Fingernails ɗinsa suna da tsabta
Takalmin sa sun yi sheki
Yana ɗanƙon turare
correctAnswer: Ɗaga wig ɗin gashi mai salon bushe yana nuna gashin da ke cikin danshi da chlorine a ƙasa
explanation: Sanya fasalin gashi na roba yana ɗaure ruwa da sinadaran tafkin iyo a fuskar gashin kai, yana rage saurin kurɓaƙuwa.

question: Wani direba ya bayyana cewa ya kasance yana tukin a kan babbar hanya na tsawon awanni biyu kai tsaye. Ɗan leƙen asiri ya taɓa murfin radiator ɗin gaba kuma ya gano yana sanyi sosai. Me ya faru?
options: Fuskantar famfon ruwa ya gaza ko ruwan sanyaya ya zuba gaba ɗaya, ya bar radiator babu ruwan zafi na injin
Motar ta samu wutar lantarki ne daga hasken rana
Direban yana amfani da na'urar sanyaya iska
Iska ta lokacin hunturu ta sanyaya jikin injin
correctAnswer: Fuskantar famfon ruwa ya gaza ko ruwan sanyaya ya zuba gaba ɗaya, ya bar radiator babu ruwan zafi na injin
explanation: Rashin zagayowar ruwa yana hanawa zafin jikin injin isa ga musayar zafi na gaba, yana barin kofunan radiator suna sanyi duk da cewa jikin injin yana tafasa.

question: Canjin fitila uku na waje na ɗakin da aka rufe suna sarrafa fitilu masu haske uku a ciki. Kuna iya shiga ɗakin sau ɗaya kawai. Ta yaya za ku gane wanne canji ke sarrafa wacce fitila?
options: Kunna canji na 1 na mintuna 10, kashe shi, kunna canji na 2, sannan ku shiga: fitilar da ke haske ita ce 2, fitilar da ke ɗumi ita ce 1, fitilar da ba ta da zafi ita ce 3
Kunna duka guda uku
Juyawa canji na 1 sau da yawa
Duba ƙarƙashin ƙofa
correctAnswer: Kunna canji na 1 na mintuna 10, kashe shi, kunna canji na 2, sannan ku shiga: fitilar da ke haske ita ce 2, fitilar da ke ɗumi ita ce 1, fitilar da ba ta da zafi ita ce 3
explanation: Fitilun haske suna fitar da zafi; jin fitilar da ba ta haske amma ɗumi yana nuna canji na farko.

question: A cikin ɗakin makaranta mai dakunan ajiye kaya 100 waɗanda aka rufe, ɗalibai 100 sun wuce ta wurin. Dalibi na 1 ya buɗe dukansu. Dalibi na 2 ya rufe kowanne na biyu. Dalibi na 3 ya canza matsayin kowanne na uku, har zuwa ɗalibi na 100. Waɗanne dakunan ajiye kaya za su zauna a buɗe?
options: Duk dakunan ajiye kayan da lambarsu cikakken murabba'i ne kawai (1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100)
Duk dakunan ajiye kayan da lambarsu firimi ne kawai
Duk dakunan ajiye kayan da lambarsu ma'auni ne kawai
Duk dakunan ajiye kayan da lambarsu babu ma'auni daidai ba ne kawai
correctAnswer: Duk dakunan ajiye kayan da lambarsu cikakken murabba'i ne kawai (1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100)
explanation: Cikakken murabba'i kawai ne ke da adadi mai banbanci na abubuwan rarrabawa; duk sauran lambobi suna da haɗaɗɗen abubuwan rarrabawa wanda ke haifar da kasancewar su a rufe.

question: Akwai akwati uku da aka sanya musu lakabi Apples, Oranges, da Mixed (Apples & Oranges). An tabbatar cewa dukkan lakabi uku ba daidai ba ne. Za ka iya ɗaukar ɗaya daga cikin ’ya’yan itace daga cikin akwatin ɗaya ba tare da kallon ciki ba. Daga wacce akwatin za ka ɗauka don sanya duk daidai?
options: Ɗauki daga akwatin da aka sanya lakabi Mixed
Ɗauki daga akwatin da aka sanya lakabi Apples
Ɗauki daga akwatin da aka sanya lakabi Oranges
Ba za a iya warwarewa da ɗauka guda ɗaya ba
correctAnswer: Ɗauki daga akwatin da aka sanya lakabi Mixed
explanation: Tun da lakabin Mixed ba daidai ba ne, ɗaukar ’ya’yan itace guda ɗaya zai bayyana duk akwatin nan; sauran akwatunan biyu da aka yi musu kuskuren lakabi za a gano su ta musamman.

question: A cikin gasar tsinke ɗaya-daɗa mai ɗaukar 'yan wasa 64, nawa jimillar wasannin ne za a buga don ƙayyade zakaran?
options: Wasanni 63
Wasanni 64
Wasanni 32
Wasanni 128
correctAnswer: Wasanni 63
explanation: Kowane wasa yana cire mai rashin nasara ɗaya kawai; don cire 'yan wasa 63 yana buƙatar wasanni 63 daidai.

question: A wani liyafar diflomasiyya na mutane 10, kowa yana gaisawa da kowa daidai sau ɗaya. Nawa jimillar gaisuwa suke?
options: Gaisuwa 45
Gaisuwa 90
Gaisuwa 50
Gaisuwa 100
correctAnswer: Gaisuwa 45
explanation: Haɗuwar mutane 10 ana ɗaukar 2 a lokaci guda: n*(n-1)/2 = 10 * 9 / 2 = 45.

question: A cikin shirin wasa, ka zaɓi Ƙofa ta 1 daga cikin 3. Mai gabatarwar ya buɗe Ƙofa ta 3, yana bayyana akuya, sannan yana ba ka Ƙofa ta 2. Wane zai baka mafi girman damar samun motar bisa lissafi?
options: Canjawa zuwa Ƙofa ta 2 (damar 2/3 na cin nasara)
Zama da Ƙofa ta 1 (damar 2/3)
Babu bambanci, kashi 50/50 kawai
Jefar da tsabar kudi
correctAnswer: Canjawa zuwa Ƙofa ta 2 (damar 2/3 na cin nasara)
explanation: Zaɓin farko naka yana da damar 1/3; ƙofar da ba a buɗe ba ta rage tana ɗaukar duk damar 2/3 na sauran ƙofofi biyu.

question: Wani mutum yana zaune a bene na 15. Kowace safiya yana hawa ɗaga lif zuwa ƙasa. Lokacin dawowa gida, yana hawa lif zuwa bene na 10 sannan ya hau matakala 5, sai dai idan ruwan sama ya sauka. Me ya sa?
options: Yana da gajeren tsawo don ya kai ga maballin bene na 15, amma yana amfani da umbrella wajen danna shi a ranakun da ruwan sama ya sauka
Yana son yin motsa jiki a ranakun da ba ruwan sama
Lif ɗin yana da matsala a sama da bene na 10
Yana ziyartar aboki a bene na 10
correctAnswer: Yana da gajeren tsawo don ya kai ga maballin bene na 15, amma yana amfani da umbrella wajen danna shi a ranakun da ruwan sama ya sauka
explanation: Tsayin maballin bene na 10 shi ne iyakar tsawon hannu; umbrella yana ba shi karin tsawo.

question: Wani mutum yana turawa motarsa zuwa wani katafaren otal kuma nan take ya gane cewa ya yi banki gaba ɗaya. Me yake yi?
options: Yin wasan allo na Monopoly da alamar mota
Injin motarsa na gaske ya fashe
Ya rasa ajiyar otal ɗinsa
An sace shi daga masu kula da motoci
correctAnswer: Yin wasan allo na Monopoly da alamar mota
explanation: A cikin Monopoly, sanya ƙaramin alamar mota a filin otal ɗin abokin gasa na jawo tara mai tsanani.

question: Maza biyu masu kishirwa sun yi oda gilashin shayin kankara iri daya a wani saloon na hamada. Mark ya sha gilashi biyar cikin sauri a minti biyu; Dan ya sha gilashi daya cikin jinkiri a cikin awa guda. Dan ya mutu saboda guba, amma Mark ya tsira. Me ya sa?
options: Gubar ta kasance a cikin kankara, wadda ta narke a gilashin Dan amma ba a na cikin gilashin Mark ba
Mark ya samu juriya ga guba
Busasshen lemun Dan ya hade da guba
Mark ya samu wani tukunya daban
correctAnswer: Gubar ta kasance a cikin kankara, wadda ta narke a gilashin Dan amma ba a na cikin gilashin Mark ba
explanation: Sha da sauri kafin kankara ta narke ya hana Mark shan gubar da ta saki lokacin narkewa.

question: Wani ɗan leƙen asiri yana binciken abin da ake zaton kisan kai ne. A kan tebur akwai na'urar rikodin kaset. Da ya latsa maɓallin kunna, sai ya ji: 'Ba zan iya ci gaba da rayuwa ba', sannan aka ji harbin bindiga. Ɗan leƙen asirin nan da nan ya hukunta cewa kisan kai ne. Me ya sa?
options: An mayar da faifan kaset zuwa farkon sa, abin da marigayi ba zai iya yi ba
Harbin bindiga ya yi ƙanƙan mai ƙarfi sosai
An haɗa murya
Teburin ya kasance babu komai
correctAnswer: An mayar da faifan kaset zuwa farkon sa, abin da marigayi ba zai iya yi ba
explanation: Bayan harbin kansa, mutum mai mutuwa ba zai iya latsa maɓallin juyawa baya a kan na'urar kunna kaset na inji ba.

question: A safiyar hunturu mai sanyi, wani mai gida ya ce wani barawo ya sassaka gilashin taga daga waje don shiga. Mai binciken laifuka ya lura da ɗan hazo na frosts a cikin gilashi na ciki kuma ya ƙaryata labarin. Me ya sa?
options: Sassaken sun kasance a saman frost, wanda ke nuna sassan sun faru daga cikin ɗakin
Frost ba ta taɓa samuwa a tagogi ba
Tagar tana da gilashi biyu
Barawo ba sa barin sassan
correctAnswer: Sassaken sun kasance a saman frost, wanda ke nuna sassan sun faru daga cikin ɗakin
explanation: Frost yana taruwa a saman mai ɗumi na ciki; sababbin alamomin sassakewa sun tarwatsa layer ɗin frost na ciki.

question: Wani wanda ake zargi ya ce yana barci a gado yayin wani fashi da makami a lokacin wata guguwar wasa a yamma. Mai bincike ya duba kabad ɗin hular jaket ɗin gaban gida kuma ya kama shi. Menene alamar?
options: Umbrella ɗinsa da rigar sama mai danshi suna kwance a ciki kabad ɗin
Gadonsa bai a gyara ba
Agogon sa na gudu da sauri
Lemo a rufi
correctAnswer: Umbrella ɗinsa da rigar sama mai danshi suna kwance a ciki kabad ɗin
explanation: Rigunan ruwa da ke malala suna tabbatar da cewa wanda ake zargi ya kasance a waje kwanan nan cikin guguwar wasan duk da hujjar sa.

question: Wani ɗakin gidan tsauni yana da sawun ƙafafu na sabo a cikin ƙanƙara wanda ke kaiwa zuwa daji, amma babu wanda ya dawo. Duk da haka, mazaunin yana cikin gida. Yaya bai bar sawun dawowa ba?
options: Ya yi tafiya a baya a cikin sawun kansa na fita
Ya tashi da jirgin sama
Ya sa takalmin ƙanƙara a baya
Ya yi slede a kan igiya
correctAnswer: Ya yi tafiya a baya a cikin sawun kansa na fita
explanation: Tafiya a hankali a baya cikin sawun da aka riga aka yi yana ɓoye hanyar isa.

question: An gano wani babban dan kasuwa matacce yana rike da bindiga a hannunsa ta dama. Likitan binciken mutuwa nan take ya yi zargin kisan kai maimakon kashe kansa. Wane abu ne mai sauki ya bayyana hakan?
options: Raunin harbin da ya shiga a goshin sa na hagu, wanda bai dace da harbin hannun dama ba
Bindigar tana da yatsu a kanta
Dan kasuwar yana sanye da agogo
Dakin yana da dumi
correctAnswer: Raunin harbin da ya shiga a goshin sa na hagu, wanda bai dace da harbin hannun dama ba
explanation: Harbin kai a goshin da ba na dabi'a ba tare da daidaitaccen lankwasar hannu yana nuna an shirya kisan.

question: Me ya sa kunna fitilun mota zuwa hasken babban haske a cikin hazo mai yawa ke rage hangen nesa na direba gaba sosai?
options: Haske mai ƙarfi yana dawowa daga ƙwayoyin ruwa kai tsaye zuwa idanun direba, yana haifar da haske mai ɗaukar ido
Hazo na sha dukkan haske
Fitilun suna yin zafi sosai a cikin hazo
Hazo yana karkatar da haske ƙasa
correctAnswer: Haske mai ƙarfi yana dawowa daga ƙwayoyin ruwa kai tsaye zuwa idanun direba, yana haifar da haske mai ɗaukar ido
explanation: Mie scattering yana komawa photons na babban haske kai tsaye cikin layin gani na direba; hasken ƙasa yana haskaka titin a ƙasa.

question: Me yasa dakunan hasken fim na gargajiya ke haskaka wuraren aiki da fitilun aminci ja masu rauni maimakon fitilar kore ko farin haske?
options: Fina-finan hoto na baƙi-da-fari na silver halide ba sa jin tsawon raƙuman ja masu tsawo
Haske ja ya fi rahusa
Masu daukar hoto suna son launin ja
Haske ja yana kiyaye takarda daga sanyi
correctAnswer: Fina-finan hoto na baƙi-da-fari na silver halide ba sa jin tsawon raƙuman ja masu tsawo
explanation: Gelatin emulsions masu orthocromatic ba sa jin hasken photons ja masu ƙarancin kuzari, wanda ke hana kumburin sinadari.

question: Bayan wata babbar gobara a cikin dutse, masu kashe gobara sun gano gawar mutum da yake sanye da cikakken kayan iyo a cikin reshen itacen da aka ƙone. Wace mummunar hatsari ta faru?
options: An ɗauke shi daga tafki ta jirgin ruwa mai ɗaukar ruwa don kashe gobara kuma aka zubar da shi a kan wutar
Ya tsalle daga jirgin sama mai saukar ungulu
Ya hau itacen don yin iyo
Wannan fim ne da aka shirya
correctAnswer: An ɗauke shi daga tafki ta jirgin ruwa mai ɗaukar ruwa don kashe gobara kuma aka zubar da shi a kan wutar
explanation: Jiragen ruwa masu ɗaukar manyan ruwa da ke tashi kusa da madatsun ruwa na iya samun masu iyo cikin akwati na kaya ba da gangan ba.

question: Wani sandar baseball da ƙwallo sun kai dala 1.10 gaba ɗaya. Sandar tana da tsada dala 1.00 fiye da ƙwallon. Nawa ƙwallon ke kashewa?
explanation: Sandar + Ƙwallo = 1.10; Sandar = Ƙwallo + 1.00; saboda haka 2*Ƙwallo + 1.00 = 1.10, don haka Ƙwallo = $0.05 kuma Sandar = $1.05.

question: Wani wurin ganyayen lily a cikin tafki yana ninka fadin saman ruwa kowace rana. Idan ya cika tafkin gaba ɗaya a cikin kwanaki 48, a wane rana ne ya cika rabin tafkin daidai?
options: Rana ta 47
Rana ta 24
Rana ta 12
Rana ta 40
correctAnswer: Rana ta 47
explanation: Tun da yake ninka kowace rana, tafkin ya kasance rabin cike a ranar da ta biyo nan take kafin cikakken cika (Rana ta 48 - 1 = Rana ta 47).

question: Idan ɗan aikin katako zai ɗauki mintuna 6 don yankar itacen katako zuwa guda 3 daidai, nawa mintuna zai ɗauke shi don yankar itacen iri ɗaya zuwa guda 6?
options: 15 mintuna
12 mintuna
18 mintuna
10 mintuna
correctAnswer: 15 mintuna
explanation: Yankewa zuwa guda 3 yana buƙatar yanke sau 2 (6 min / 2 = 3 min kowane yankan). Yankewa zuwa guda 6 yana buƙatar yanke sau 5 (5 * 3 = 15 mintuna).

question: Wata tsuntsuwa a ƙasan rijiyar dutse mai ƙafa 30 tana hawa ƙafa 3 a kowace rana, amma tana zamewa ƙafa 2 a kowace dare. A wace rana tsuntsuwar zata kai saman?
options: Rana ta 28
Rana ta 30
Rana ta 29
Rana ta 27
correctAnswer: Rana ta 28
explanation: A ƙarshen rana ta 27, ta kai ƙafa 27. A rana ta 28, ta hau ƙafa 3 ta kai ƙafa 30 sannan ta fita kafin ta zame.

question: Wani makiyayi yana da tunƙufa 17 suna ciyarwa a cikin fili. Cutar bazuwar ta faru kuma duk sai 9 tunƙufa suka mutu. Nawa ne tunƙufan da makiyayin ya rage?
options: Tunƙufa 9
Tunƙufa 8
Tunƙufa 0
Tunƙufa 17
correctAnswer: Tunƙufa 9
explanation: 'All but 9' yana nufin a sarari cewa tunƙufa guda 9 kawai ne suka tsira daga cutar.

question: Kana gudu a cikin tseren marathon kuma ka wuce mai gudu da ke matsayin na biyu a halin yanzu. Yanzu a wane matsayi kake?
options: Matsayi na biyu
Matsayi na farko
Matsayi na uku
Matsayi na hudu
correctAnswer: Matsayi na biyu
explanation: Ta wuce mai gudu da ke matsayin na biyu, kai zaka maye gurbin wurinsu a matsayin na biyu, yayin da shugaba ke ci gaba da kasancewa gaba.

question: Likita ya ba ka ƙwayoyi uku na magani kuma ya umarce ka da ka sha ƙwaya ɗaya kowane minti 30. Nawa minti ne ƙwayoyin zasu wuce?
options: Minti 60 (awanni 1)
Minti 90
Minti 30
Minti 120
correctAnswer: Minti 60 (awanni 1)
explanation: Ka sha ƙwaya ta 1 a minti 0, ƙwaya ta 2 a minti 30, da ƙwaya ta 3 a minti 60; jimillar lokaci da aka wuce minti 60 ne.

question: Agogon kakanni mai tsaye yana daukar dakika 5 don yin kirari 6 na karfe 6 (bugu 6). Nawa ne zai dauka don yin kirari na karfe 12 (bugu 12)?
options: dakika 11
dakika 10
dakika 12
dakika 9
correctAnswer: dakika 11
explanation: Bugun 6 suna da tazara 5 a tsakaninsu (dakika 5 / 5 = dakika 1 kowane tazara). Bugun 12 suna da tazara 11 (11 * 1 = dakika 11).

question: Jiragen ƙasa biyu da ke nisan mil 100 suna tuki zuwa ga juna da gudun mil 50 kowanne. Zuma na tashi tsakanin su da gudun mil 75 har sai sun haɗu. Nawa ne mil ɗin da zuma za ta tashi?
options: Mil 75
Mil 100
Mil 50
Mil 150
correctAnswer: Mil 75
explanation: Gudun haduwa na juna shine mil 100 a kowace awa, don haka jiragen suna haɗuwa cikin awa 1 (100 / 100). Cikin awa 1, zuma za ta tashi mil 75 (75 mph * 1 awa).

question: Ta yaya 'yan uwa biyu za su raba kek ɗin haihuwa mai ƙanshi da adalci don kada kowanne ya yi tunanin ɗayan ya samu babban yanki?
options: Ɗaya daga cikin 'yan uwa zai yanke kek ɗin zuwa sassa biyu, ɗayan kuma zai zaɓi nasa yanki da farko ('Ni na yanke, kai ka zaɓi')
Auna kowane yanki a kan sikeli na gidan wasiku
A bar mahaifi ya yanke shi da idanunsa a rufe
Cin duka kek ɗin tare
correctAnswer: Ɗaya daga cikin 'yan uwa zai yanke kek ɗin zuwa sassa biyu, ɗayan kuma zai zaɓi nasa yanki da farko ('Ni na yanke, kai ka zaɓi')
explanation: Mai yanka yana da sha'awar sanya kowane rabin ya yi kama da ɗayan, yayin da mai zaɓi yake tabbatar da yanki da yake so.

question: A cikin wasan Russian roulette da bindiga mai dakuna 6 da aka cika da harsashi 2 masu jere, dan wasa na 1 ya danna trigger a kan dakin da babu harsashi. Shin dan wasa na 2 ya kamata ya juyar da silinda ko ya danna trigger kai tsaye?
options: Danna trigger kai tsaye ba tare da juyawa ba (dama 1/4 na harbi idan aka kwatanta da 2/6 = 1/3 idan an juyar)
Juyar da silinda don gauraya dakuna
Bai yi wani bambanci na lissafi ba
Cire harsashun
correctAnswer: Danna trigger kai tsaye ba tare da juyawa ba (dama 1/4 na harbi idan aka kwatanta da 2/6 = 1/3 idan an juyar)
explanation: Dakuna hudu babu harsashi suna nan a jere; daga cikin dakuna 4 bayan banharsashi, daya kacal ne ke kai ga harsashi (25% vs 33%).

question: Yaya bututun siphon na roba mai sassauci yake zubar da ruwa daga cikin akwatin kifi zuwa waje ba tare da injin lantarki ba?
options: Matsin lamba na yanayi da juriya tsakanin ruwa suna ja ruwan ta saman bututun zuwa bakin fitarwa na ƙasa
Aiki na capillary
Ruwa yana tafasa a cikin bututun
Ƙwayoyin iska suna turawa
correctAnswer: Matsin lamba na yanayi da juriya tsakanin ruwa suna ja ruwan ta saman bututun zuwa bakin fitarwa na ƙasa
explanation: Nauyin ruwa a cikin dogon reshen fitarwa yana haifar da rashi mai matsin lamba a saman dutse, yana jan ruwa ba tare da tsayawa ba.

question: Me yasa igiyoyin gadar dakatawa ke rataye a cikin lankwasar parabola maimakon layi madaidaici?
options: Igiya tana goyan bayan kaya mai rarrabuwa daidai a kwance a kan dandamali
Ƙarfin nauyi yana jan tsakiyar ƙasa kawai
ƙarfin juriya na iska ne ke samar da wannan siffa
Faɗaɗa zafi yana shimfiɗa ƙarfe
correctAnswer: Igiya tana goyan bayan kaya mai rarrabuwa daidai a kwance a kan dandamali
explanation: Igiya da ke tallafawa dandamali mai nauyi mai daidaita a kowane tsawon kwance dabi'ance tana ɗaukar siffar parabola.

question: Me ya sa gadar katako mai lankwasa ta kara ƙarfi yayin da aka sanya ƙari na nauyi kai tsaye a saman keystone na tsakiyarta?
options: Nauyin da ke sauka yana tilasta duwatsun rufin karkacewa cikin matsewa sosai
Siminti yana faɗaɗa ƙarƙashin matsi
Tushen suna matsowa kusa da juna
Gargajiya tana komawa manne
correctAnswer: Nauyin da ke sauka yana tilasta duwatsun rufin karkacewa cikin matsewa sosai
explanation: Girgijen giciye suna jagorantar nauyin tsaye zuwa ƙarfin matsawa na gefe, suna matse tubalan dutse kusa da juna.

question: A cikin tattalin arziki, me yasa Dokar Gresham ta ce 'mugun kudi yana fitar da kyakkyawan kudi'?
options: Mutane suna kashe kudin da aka ɗaukaka darajarsa ba bisa ka’ida ba kuma suna tara kudin da ke da ainihin daraja
Kudin karya na lalata bankuna
Kudin takarda yana lalacewa da sauri fiye da azurfa
Ana rasa ƙaramin kuɗi cikin sauƙi
correctAnswer: Mutane suna kashe kudin da aka ɗaukaka darajarsa ba bisa ka’ida ba kuma suna tara kudin da ke da ainihin daraja
explanation: Lokacin da kudade biyu suna da matsayin doka iri ɗaya, mutane suna tara kuɗaɗen da ke da ainihin ƙarfe mai daraja.

question: A cikin nazarin wasan kwaikwayo, menene babban matsala a cikin shahararren Dilemma na Fursuna?
options: Sha'awar kai tsaye mai hankali tana sa 'yan wasa biyu su yi jayayya, wanda hakan ke haifar da sakamakon da ya fi muni fiye da hadin kai
Babu ɗan wasa da ya sani doka
Wani ɗan wasa kullum mai laifi ne
