Ruwa yana matsa jirgin kasa daidai
Ruwan ballast yana daskarewa yayin ambaliyar ruwa
correctAnswer: Cibiyar ɗaukaka ruwa tana motsawa zuwa waje yayin da jirgin ke jujjuyawa, tana haifar da lokacin daidaitawa wanda ke mayar da jirgin a tsaye
explanation: Lokacin da jikin jirgin ya karkata, siffar yawan ruwa da aka nutse tana motsawa zuwa bangaren kasa, tana canza cibiyar metacenter sama da cibiyar nauyi.

question: Me ya sa mutum da ke jin rashin lafiya a mota yake warkewa cikin sauƙi idan yana zaune a kusa da kujerar gaba fiye da kujerar baya?
options: Gilashin gaba yana ba da damar ganin gaba ba tare da shinge ba, yana daidaita abin da ido ke gani da siginar daidaiton kunne na ciki
Kujerar gaba na da ƙarancin matsa lamba na iska a cikin ɗaki
Baya kujerun baya ba su da bel ɗin kujeru
Injina suna jan kujerun gaba gaba
correctAnswer: Gilashin gaba yana ba da damar ganin gaba ba tare da shinge ba, yana daidaita abin da ido ke gani da siginar daidaiton kunne na ciki
explanation: Kallon motsin hanya yana rage rashin daidaito na jin kai tsakanin na’urar vestibular (wadda ke gano juyawa) da kwakwalwar gani.

question: Me yasa harshen fitilar yau da kullum ke nuna kai tsaye sama zuwa rufin ɗaki a ƙarƙashin nauyi na Duniya?
options: Hayaki mai zafi yana faɗaɗa, yana zama ba mai nauyi kamar iska mai sanyi a kewaye ba, kuma ana ɗagawa kai tsaye sama ta hanyar motsi na convection
Zaren fitilar yana jan harshen sama
Kwayoyin carbon suna ƙin nauyi
Rufin ɗaki yana jan zafi ta hanyar maganadisu
correctAnswer: Hayaki mai zafi yana faɗaɗa, yana zama ba mai nauyi kamar iska mai sanyi a kewaye ba, kuma ana ɗagawa kai tsaye sama ta hanyar motsi na convection
explanation: Buoyancy na convection yana tura iskar gas mai haske da zafi sama, yana jan iska mai sanyi da yawa a ƙasa don samar da oxygen cikin harshen da ke da siffar hawaye.

question: Me yasa ƙwallon ƙafa da aka cika iska ke tsalle mafi girma a rana mai zafi ta bazara fiye da safiyar hunturu mai sanyi?
options: Iska mai dumi a ciki na ƙara matsin lamba na kwayoyin, yana sa ƙwallon ta fi kauri tare da babbar coefficient na dawowa
Ciyawa a lokacin bazara ya fi laushi fiye da dusar ƙanƙara a lokacin hunturu
Ƙarfin nauyi na hunturu yana jan kayan wasanni fiye
Fatar ƙwallo na shan kwayoyin iska mai sanyi
correctAnswer: Iska mai dumi a ciki na ƙara matsin lamba na kwayoyin, yana sa ƙwallon ta fi kauri tare da babbar coefficient na dawowa
explanation: Matsakaicin zafi mafi girma yana ƙara matsin lamba na ciki bisa ga Dokar Gay-Lussac; matsin lamba mafi girma yana rage asarar makamashin nakasawa.

question: Me yasa mai nutsuwa a cikin zurfin teku ke jin sauti daga dukkanin hanyoyi a lokaci guda ba tare da iya gano tushen sautin ba?
options: Sauti yana tafiya ninki huɗu cikin sauri a cikin ruwa, wanda ke sanya bambancin lokaci tsakanin kunnuwa biyu ya zama gajere sosai don kwakwalwar ɗan adam ta sarrafa
Ruwa yana cike bututun kunne na ɗan adam
Sautukan ruwa suna tafiya cikin sake-sake kadai
Gashin kunne yana makale da ƙarfi ƙarƙashin matsa lamba na ruwa
correctAnswer: Sauti yana tafiya ninki huɗu cikin sauri a cikin ruwa, wanda ke sanya bambancin lokaci tsakanin kunnuwa biyu ya zama gajere sosai don kwakwalwar ɗan adam ta sarrafa
explanation: Gudun sauti a cikin ruwa kimanin ~1,500 m/s ne. Jinkirin lokaci tsakanin isa kunnuwan hagu da dama yana raguwa zuwa microseconds, wanda ke hana gano inda sautin ya fito.

question: Me yasa janareta na lantarki ke samar da wutar lantarki lokacin da aka juya igiyar waya ta ƙarfe a cikin filin maganadisu?
options: Canjin yanayin maganadisu ta hanyar juyawar igiyar waya yana haifar da karfin lantarki (Dokar Faraday na Induction Electromagnetic)
Maganadisun na dumama wayar har sai wutar lantarki ta tashi
Friction tsakanin tagulla da baƙin ƙarfe yana samar da wutar lantarki
Ionization na iska yana ba da ƙarfin lantarki a cikin kewayawa
correctAnswer: Canjin yanayin maganadisu ta hanyar juyawar igiyar waya yana haifar da karfin lantarki (Dokar Faraday na Induction Electromagnetic)
explanation: Dokar Faraday ta tanadi cewa filin maganadisu mai canzawa lokaci-lokaci yana yin tasiri ga electrons masu motsi, yana samar da ƙarfin lantarki.

question: Me ya sa takardar tissue mai siriri ke sha ruwa da aka zuba da sauri, yayin da takardar roba ke barin ruwa ya taru ba tare da sha ko ɗan ruwa ba?
options: Zaren takarda na ɗauke da cellulose mai ɗaukar ruwa tare da ƙananan hanyoyi na capillary da ke jan ruwa ta hanyar manne
Roba na narke a cikin ruwan
Takarda na haifar da jan hankali na lantarki ga ruwa
Roba tana da ramuka gaba ɗaya
correctAnswer: Zaren takarda na ɗauke da cellulose mai ɗaukar ruwa tare da ƙananan hanyoyi na capillary da ke jan ruwa ta hanyar manne
explanation: Rukunonin hydroxyl na cellulose suna samar da haɗin gwiwar hydrogen da ruwan, suna haifar da aikin capillary na ɗabi'a ta hanyar zaruruwa masu ramuka.

question: Me ya sa cokali na ƙarfe yake jin sanyi sosai lokacin da aka cire shi daga ƙwai na ice cream, yayin da cokali na itace a daidai wannan zafin jiki yake jin daɗi?
options: Ƙarfafa ƙarfe yana da babban ƙwarewar zafi, yana ɗaukar zafi daga yatsun hannunka sau ɗaruruwan fiye da itace.
Cokali na ƙarfe yana da sanyi a auna digiri.
Itace yana samar da zafi a ciki ta hanyar gogayya.
Ƙarfe yana ɗaukar mai na fata na mutum.
correctAnswer: Ƙarfafa ƙarfe yana da babban ƙwarewar zafi, yana ɗaukar zafi daga yatsun hannunka sau ɗaruruwan fiye da itace.
explanation: Masu saka idanu na yanayin zafin jikin mutum suna jin saurin fita zafi daga fata (d Q/d t), ba da ainihin zafin jiki ba.

question: Me yasa injin mota na yau da kullum yake yin zafi cikin sauri idan bel ɗin famfon ruwan radiator ya karye yayin tuƙi?
options: Ba tare da tilas na zagayowar sanyaya ba, zafi da konewa ta cikin ciki ke haifarwa yana taruwa a bangon silinda na injin ba tare da yin fitarwa ba
Man fetur na injin yana kama da wuta nan take
Fan ɗin radiator yana juyawa a akasin hanya
Matsin iska a cikin bututun mai sauka zuwa sifili
correctAnswer: Ba tare da tilas na zagayowar sanyaya ba, zafi da konewa ta cikin ciki ke haifarwa yana taruwa a bangon silinda na injin ba tare da yin fitarwa ba
explanation: Famfon ruwa yana turawa ruwan sanyaya tsakanin sassan injin mai zafi sosai da kuma fin din radiator na sanyaya; dakatar da zagayawa na kama zafin sosai.

question: Me yasa jirgin ƙarfe ke nutsewa cikin sassauci a kan ruwan teku, alhali ƙaramin ƙwallon ƙarfe mai ɗanɗano iri ɗaya ke nutsewa nan take zuwa ƙasan teku?
options: Gidan ciki mai rami yana ɗauke da manyan jakunan iska, wanda ke rage matsakaicin nauyin jirgin kasa da nauyin ruwan teku.
Ruwan teku yana korar siffofin ƙarfe marasa cike.
Injinan jirgin suna tura sama.
Ana zanen jiragen da rufi mai ɗaukar ruwa.
correctAnswer: Gidan ciki mai rami yana ɗauke da manyan jakunan iska, wanda ke rage matsakaicin nauyin jirgin kasa da nauyin ruwan teku.
explanation: Ka'idar Archimedes ta ce matsakaicin nauyi yana tantance iya nutsewa. Girman iskar ciki mai yawa yana ba jirgin ƙaramin nauyin duka.

question: Me yasa hasumiyar haske ta teku take bayyana kamar tsawo lokacin da aka kalli ta kai tsaye ta cikin hazo ko kumfa mai kauri na bakin teku?
options: Raguwar bambanci da iyakoki masu ja da baya na yaudarar tsarin gani na dan Adam wajen kuskuren kimanta nisan da girman abin da ake gani.
Hazo yana girman hasken kamar gilashin hangen nesa
Hazo yana daga hasumiyar haske a zahiri
Danshi yana lanƙwasa kornean mai kallo
correctAnswer: Raguwar bambanci da iyakoki masu ja da baya na yaudarar tsarin gani na dan Adam wajen kuskuren kimanta nisan da girman abin da ake gani.
explanation: Yanayin sama yana amfani da bambanci don kimanta nisa; abubuwa masu low-contrast masu hazo suna bayyana kamar suna nesa, wanda ke sa kwakwalwa ta kimanta girman su fiye da yadda yake.

question: Me yasa busar gashi na lantarki ke fitar da iska mai zafi sosai a bakin bututunsa yayin da yake kiyaye murfin roba na waje lafiya don riƙewa?
options: An sanya kayan zafin ciki a kan masu keɓewar mica yayin da babban fan mai gudu yana haifar da rarrabe yanayin zafi na iska
Ana sanyaya robobi da nitrogen mai ruwa
Mica coils na sha dukkan zafin lantarki
Roba na fitar da yanayin sanyaya
correctAnswer: An sanya kayan zafin ciki a kan masu keɓewar mica yayin da babban fan mai gudu yana haifar da rarrabe yanayin zafi na iska
explanation: Matsakaitan rike-mica masu juriya ga zafi suna rataye zoben da ke haskakawa a tsakiyar iska, yayin da shigar iska mai sauri ke hana canjin zafin wuta zuwa murfin waje.

question: Me yasa mai shafawa gilashin mota na yau da kullum ke barin gilashi mara tabo sai dai lokacin da roba mai laushi da sassauci?
options: Roba mai laushi tana lankwasawa a matakin kwayoyin don ta ci gaba da samun hulɗa mai daidaito da gilashin da aka ninka, tana shafa ruwa cikin tsabta
Roba mai tauri tana sha ruwa ta hanyar sinadarai
Masafin gilashi yana shafawa gilashin har ya zama kamar lu'u-lu'u
Ruwan sama yana narkar da roba mai laushi
correctAnswer: Roba mai laushi tana lankwasawa a matakin kwayoyin don ta ci gaba da samun hulɗa mai daidaito da gilashin da aka ninka, tana shafa ruwa cikin tsabta
explanation: Gefen roba mai sassauci yana canza kusurwarsa a kowace gogewa don shafa ruwa ba tare da tsallake ƙananan nakasasshen gilashin motar ba.

question: Me yasa karamin tsinken ƙarfe na yau da kullum ke samar da tsantsar sauti guda ɗaya lokacin da aka buge shi a kan pad na roba?
options: Tsarinsa mai ramuka biyu masu daidaito yana girgiza a yanayin asali mai daidaito wanda ke rage karin sautuka cikin sauri
Roba tana haifar da echo na sauti
Ramukan ƙarfe suna ɗauke da ƙwayoyin lantarki da aka saita
Sauti ba zai iya lanƙwasa ta hannayen ƙarfe ba
correctAnswer: Tsarinsa mai ramuka biyu masu daidaito yana girgiza a yanayin asali mai daidaito wanda ke rage karin sautuka cikin sauri
explanation: Ramukan da ke gaba da juna suna motsawa a akasin juna, suna soke ƙarfi na fassara kuma cikin sauri suna gusar da dukkan yanayin kara na sauti mai ƙarfi.

question: Me yasa mutum da ke jin rashin lafiya na motsi a jirgi ke jin mafi muni lokacin da yake karanta littafi a cikin kabin mara tagogi?
options: Karatu yana mai da hankali ga idanu a shafuka masu tsayuwa yayin da kunnuwan ciki ke jin motsi mai tsanani na juyawa da ninkawa, wanda ke kara rikicewar hankali na ji
Littattafai suna shan iskar oxygen na kabin
Fentin takarda yana fitar da hayaki mai guba wanda ke haifar da amai
Karatu yana kulle ruwan ciki na vestibular
correctAnswer: Karatu yana mai da hankali ga idanu a shafuka masu tsayuwa yayin da kunnuwan ciki ke jin motsi mai tsanani na juyawa da ninkawa, wanda ke kara rikicewar hankali na ji
explanation: Tsarin gani yana fadawa kwakwalwa cewa muhalli ba ya motsi kwata-kwata, yayin da hanyoyin vestibular ke nuna motsi mai nauyi, wanda ke haifar da amai.

question: Me ya sa jirgin sama ke bukatar tsawon tudu na tashin jirgi idan yana aiki daga filin jirgin sama da ke cikin tsaunuka masu tsawo?
options: Rashin yawa na iska a sama a tsayin wuri yana haifar da ƙarancin ɗaga iska da rage ƙarfin injin
Ƙarfin nauyi a tsaunuka ya fi ƙarfi
Hanyoyin tashi suna karkata sama
Taya jirgin suna canzawa fiye da kima
correctAnswer: Rashin yawa na iska a sama a tsayin wuri yana haifar da ƙarancin ɗaga iska da rage ƙarfin injin
explanation: Yawan iska yana raguwa da tsayi; jirgin dole ne ya samu saurin gaskiya mafi girma don samar da ɗaga iska na tashin jirgi da ake bukata.

question: Me yasa mutum da ke amfani da famfon hannu na yau da kullum ke jin ya fi wuya matsawa kasa yayin da tayar babur ta cika iska sosai?
options: Matsin iska mai yawa a cikin tayar yana turawa baya kan fuskar famfon da ƙarfi mai ƙarfi na iska da ke tawaye (F = P * A)
Karfen famfon yana faɗaɗa daga zafi
Rubber ɗin taya yana sha mai famfo
Iska ta koma zama gogayya mai ƙarfi
correctAnswer: Matsin iska mai yawa a cikin tayar yana turawa baya kan fuskar famfon da ƙarfi mai ƙarfi na iska da ke tawaye (F = P * A)
explanation: Don buɗe bawul ɗin taya, dole ne matsin famfon silinda ya wuce matsin taya; turawa a kan babban matsin baya yana buƙatar ƙarfi mai yawa.

question: Wani ‘dan leƙen asiri ya shiga wani gidan manyan mutane inda aka sami wani attajiri harbe a kan teburinsa. Rikodin mai ɗaukar murya a kan tebur ya yi wasa: 'Ba zan iya ci gaba ba, sai anjima,' sannan ya biyo da harbi. ‘Dan leƙen asirin nan da nan ya bayyana shi a matsayin kisan kai. Me ya sa?
options: Wanene ya juyar da rikodin bayan an harbe?
Teburin ya yi tsabta sosai
Tagar ta bude
Attajirin ba shi da bashi
correctAnswer: Wanene ya juyar da rikodin bayan an harbe?
explanation: Idan wanda abin ya shafa ya harbi kansa yayin da yake rikodi, rikodin zai ci gaba da gudana har zuwa ƙarshen. Mutum mai mutuwa ba zai iya dannawa don juyar da shi ba.

question: An sami mutumin da ya mutu a cikin fili mai dusar ƙanƙara ba tare da tabo a kusa da jikin sa ba, sai waɗanda suka fito daga ƙafafunsa. Akwai jakar baya da aka rufe, ba a bude ba a kan bayansa. Ta yaya ya mutu?
options: Parashut ɗinsa bai buɗe ba a lokacin tsalle daga sama
Ya mutu saboda sanyi yayin da yake tafiya
Wani dutse mai ƙarfi ne ya buge shi
An binne shi a cikin ambaliyar dusar ƙanƙara
correctAnswer: Parashut ɗinsa bai buɗe ba a lokacin tsalle daga sama
explanation: Jakar da ba a buɗe ba ita ce kayan parashut ɗin da bai yi nasara ba; ya faɗi daga jirgin sama zuwa kan dusar ƙanƙara.

question: Mata biyu sun yi oda shayin sanyi a wani kafe. Alice ta sha gilashi biyar cikin sauri a mintuna biyu. Beatrice ta dan sha gilashi daya a hankali cikin awa guda. Beatrice ta mutu saboda guba; Alice kuwa ta tsira ba tare da wata illa ba. Ta yaya?
options: Guban ta kasance a cikin kankara, wanda bai narke ba lokacin da Alice ta sha
Alice ta kasance da kariya daga guba
Beatrice ta sha daga gilashi mai tsagewa
Mai hidima ya sanya guba a cikin straw
correctAnswer: Guban ta kasance a cikin kankara, wanda bai narke ba lokacin da Alice ta sha
explanation: Alice ta sha da sauri sosai har kankarar ta kasance mai daskararre; shan Beatrice a hankali ya bar kankarar guba ta narke gaba daya a cikin shayinta.

question: An sace mai sana'ar zinariya. Barawon ya shiga ta taga a bene na biyu ba tare da ya karya ba kuma ya fita ta ƙofar gaba, ba tare da ya bari yatsa ba, ya dauki kawai lu'u-lu'u kuma bai kula da sandunan zinariya ba. Me ya sa bai kula da nau'ikan sandunan zinariya masu nauyi ba?
options: Zinariya tana da nauyi sosai don ɗauka yayin tserewa da ƙafa
An kulle zinariya a cikin akwati mai aminci
Zinariya karya ce
Barawon yana da rashin lafiyar ƙarfe
correctAnswer: Zinariya tana da nauyi sosai don ɗauka yayin tserewa da ƙafa
explanation: Zinariya tana da yawa 19.3 g/cm^3; sandunan zinariya masu daraja ɗaya za su yi nauyin ɗaruruwan fam, abin da ba zai yiwu a tserewa cikin shiru ba.

question: An dakatar da direba a kan babbar hanya a tsakar dare tare da duk fitilun waje suna aiki. Jami’in 'yan sanda ya lura cewa ma’aunin gudun yana nuna 0 mph duk da mota na tafiya a 60 mph. Menene matsalarsa?
options: An jawo motar a kan babur ɗin flatbed
An yanke igiyar ma’aunin gudu
Direban na tuki a baya
Mota na zamewa a kan kankara baki
correctAnswer: An jawo motar a kan babur ɗin flatbed
explanation: Mota kanta na cikin tsayuwa a kan saman babur ɗin flatbed da ke motsi.

question: Wani mutum ya sayi sabbin takalma, ya tafi aiki, kuma ya mutu bayan sa'o'i uku. Menene sana'arsa?
options: Mataimakin mai jefa wuƙa a cikin circus ko mai tafiya akan igiya mai kyau
Mai hakar ƙasa mai kullum
Ɗan wasa mai nutsar da ruwa na sana'a
Fataha ɗan kasuwa
correctAnswer: Mataimakin mai jefa wuƙa a cikin circus ko mai tafiya akan igiya mai kyau
explanation: Sabbin takalma da ke da tsayin ɗan daban ko ƙafafun da suke lumshe, sun sa ya yi kuskuren sanya ƙafa a yayin wani aikin motsa jiki mai haɗari.

question: Wata mata ta sayi tsuntsu mai magana wanda mai shagon dabbobi ya tabbatar zai iya maimaita kowace kalma da ya ji. Bayan sati guda, tsuntsun bai furta kalma ɗaya ba, amma mai shagon bai yi ƙarya ba. Ta yaya?
options: Tsuntsun yana jin ƙasa da komai
Matar ba ta taɓa yin magana da shi ba
Tsuntsun yana magana ne kawai da Faransanci
Tsuntsun yana barci
correctAnswer: Tsuntsun yana jin ƙasa da komai
explanation: Tsuntsu mai jin ƙasa yana maimaita kowace kalma da ya ji—wannan kuma shi ne sifili kalmomi.

question: Sarki ya so ya hukunta wani masani da kisa. Ya ba wa masani damar yin karin magana na karshe: 'Idan ka fada gaskiya, za a rataye ka; idan ka fada karya, za a nutsar da kai.' Wace magana ce ta ceci rayuwar masani?
options: 'Za a nutsar da ni'
'Ni mutum ne mai gaskiya'
'Sarki mai jin kai ne'
'Gobe zai riga ruwa'
correctAnswer: 'Za a nutsar da ni'
explanation: Idan sarki ya nutsar da shi, maganar gaskiya ce, ma'ana ya kamata a rataye shi. Idan ya rataye shi, maganar karya ce, ma'ana ya kamata a nutsar da shi. Matsala ce ta tunani.

question: Wani mutum yana tura keken sa a fadin iyaka a kowane mako yana ɗaukar jakunkuna biyu na yashi. 'Yan tsaron iyaka suna tsirara yashin sosai amma ba su sami wani abu haram ba. Bayan shekaru goma, menene a hakikanin gaskiya yake safarar?
options: Kekuna
Yashi
Gawayi na zinariya
Takardun kudi
correctAnswer: Kekuna
explanation: Jakunkunan yashi dai wata hanyar rudani ce; kayan daraja da ake safarawa shine sabon keke a kowane tafiya.

question: Akwatin karfe mai kulle yana dauke da fitilu guda uku na yau da kullum a ciki: ja, shuɗi, kore. Daga waje akwatin, za ka iya gani ta ƙwayar gilashi guda ɗaya wadda ke nuna haɗin launi. Idan ƙwayar ta nuna hasken rawaya, waɗanne fitilu ne ke aiki?
options: Fitilun ja da kore kawai
Fitilun shuɗi da kore kawai
Fitilun ja da shuɗi kawai
Duk fitilu uku
correctAnswer: Fitilun ja da kore kawai
explanation: A cikin hadewar launuka na haske, haɗakar hasken ja da kore yana samar da hasken rawaya.

question: Wani mai kera agogo yana gina agogo wanda ba shi da lambobi, babu alamar tick, kuma hannaye na awa da minti iri ɗaya ne. Sau nawa tsakanin 12:00 zuwa 1:00 ne ba zai yiwu a gano lokaci ba?
options: Sai a lokacin da duka hannaye suka daidaita daidai a 12:00 ne kawai lokacin da ba a rikita ba, amma akwai wurare da dama a cikin ranar da canjin hannaye ke haifar da rikitarwa.
Ba a rikita ba ko da yaushe
Kowane minti
Sau 12 ne kawai
correctAnswer: Sai a lokacin da duka hannaye suka daidaita daidai a 12:00 ne kawai lokacin da ba a rikita ba, amma akwai wurare da dama a cikin ranar da canjin hannaye ke haifar da rikitarwa.
explanation: Lokacin da canjin hannaye guda biyu daidai ke haifar da wani karatun agogo mai inganci, lokacin yana rikitarwa. Akwai irin wannan matsayi na lissafi 132 a cikin awanni 12.

question: Jirgin ruwa yana barin tashar jiragen ruwa a Japan a safiyar Talata kuma yana tashi kai tsaye zuwa gabas a fadin Tekun Pasifik na tsawon awanni 24. Lokacin da ya isa inda yake nufi, wane rana ce a kan kalandar gida?
options: Safiyar Talata (ko Litinin)
Safiyar Laraba
Safiyar Alhamis
Safiyar Juma'a
correctAnswer: Safiyar Talata (ko Litinin)
explanation: Ketare Layin Kwanakin Duniya zuwa gabas yana rage duk rana guda ta kalandar (awanni 24), wanda ke sa jirgin ya maimaita ranar kalandar guda.

question: Akwatin kuɗi yana da kulle haɗin namba 3, kowanne dial yana da lambobi daga 0 zuwa 9. Ɗan fashi ya san cewa jimillar lambobin haɗin da ta dace ita ce 25 kuma duk lambobi uku suna da lamba marasa kyau. Nawa ne haɗin da zai iya gwadawa?
options: Haɗin 10
Haɗin 27
Haɗin 1
explanation: Lambobin marasa kyau na single-digit sune 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. Mafi girman jimillar lambobi uku marasa kyau na single-digit shine 9+9+9=27. Hanya ɗaya kawai da za a sami lambobi uku marasa kyau na single-digit su kai 25 shine {9, 9, 7} a cikin permutations guda uku.

question: A cikin wani shahararren gwaji, mutanen da ke kallo bidiyon 'yan wasan kwallon kwando suna buga kwallo sun kasa ganin mutum a ciki rigar gorilla yana tafiya a fadin allo. Menene ake kira wannan al'amari na ilimin halayyar ɗan adam?
options: Rashin lura
Bangaren tabbatarwa
Prosopagnosia
Tasirin Stroop
correctAnswer: Rashin lura
explanation: Mayar da hankali sosai kan wani aikin takamaimai (kirga bugun kwallo) yana sa ƙwayar gani ta ɗan adam ta tace abubuwan da ba a zata ba, wadanda suka fito fili.

question: Me yasa karanta kalmar 'BLUE' da aka buga da ja mai haske ke sa mutane su yi jinkiri sosai kafin su fada launin tawada da suka gani?
options: Hankalin yana sarrafa karatun kalma ta atomatik cikin sauri fiye da fahimtar launi, wanda ke haifar da katsewar hankali (Tasirin Stroop)
Ja da shuɗi su ne launuka masu cike juna
Hanyoyin gani suna juyar da hasken ja
Cibiyoyin motsa baki na ɗan adam suna jinkirta da launuka
correctAnswer: Hankalin yana sarrafa karatun kalma ta atomatik cikin sauri fiye da fahimtar launi, wanda ke haifar da katsewar hankali (Tasirin Stroop)
explanation: Sarrafa ma'anar rubutu ta atomatik yana katsalandan da aikin fahimtar launi mai jinkiri, yana rage saurin amsawa.

question: Wani ɗan leƙen asiri ya gano agogon hannu da ya karye a wurin aikata laifi. Hannun sa'a ya karye gaba ɗaya, amma hannun minti na nuna daidai mintuna 48 bayan sa'a. Menene daidai matsayin hannun sa'a da ya ɓace?
options: Hudu bisa biyar na hanya tsakanin lambobi biyu (daidai da digiri 288 na zagayowar sa'a)
Kai tsaye a kan lambar 9
Tsakiyar hanya tsakanin lambobi biyu
Kai tsaye a kan lambar 10
correctAnswer: Hudu bisa biyar na hanya tsakanin lambobi biyu (daidai da digiri 288 na zagayowar sa'a)
explanation: Mintuna 48 suna wakiltar 48/60 = 4/5 (0.8) na cikakken sa'a; hannun sa'a yana motsawa daidai da 4/5 na nisan kusurwa zuwa sa'a ta gaba.

question: Gadar tana da iyakar nauyi na ton 10. Wani babur mai nauyin ton 10 daidai ya fara ketarawa. Tsakiyar gadar, wani tsuntsu mai suna sparrow ya zauna a saman rufin babur. Me ya sa gadar bata rushe ba?
options: Babur ya ƙone isasshen man fetur yayin da yake ketarawa kan gadar don daidaita nauyin sparrow
Sparrows suna da ƙasusuwan da ke da ramuka wanda ba su da nauyi
Iskar da ke tashi ta tallafa wa tsuntsun
Gadar tana da wani ƙaramin ƙimar aminci na sifili
correctAnswer: Babur ya ƙone isasshen man fetur yayin da yake ketarawa kan gadar don daidaita nauyin sparrow
explanation: Manyan injinan diesel suna cinye ɗaruruwan gram na man fetur a kowace minti, suna rasa nauyi fiye da yadda sparrow mai gram 30 ke ƙara.

question: Ana gabatar da ɗan gidan yari da kwandon guda biyu daidai da kuma ƙwallo 50 farare da 50 baki. Mai aiwatarwa zai zaɓi kwandon ɗaya a bazuwar, sannan ya ja ƙwallo ɗaya a bazuwar. Idan fari, ɗan gidan yari zai sami 'yanci; idan baki, a yi masa hukunci. Ta yaya ɗan gidan yari ya kamata ya rarraba ƙwallon don ƙara yuwuwar tsira?
options: Sanya ɗaya farin duwatsu a cikin Kwandon A, sannan duk sauran duwatsun 99 (49 fari, 50 baki) a cikin Kwandon B
Sanya farare 25 da baki 25 a cikin kowace tukunya
Sanya duk fari 50 a cikin Tukunya A da duk baki 50 a cikin Tukunya B
Saka baki 50 a cikin Tukunya A da fari 50 a cikin Tukunya B
correctAnswer: Sanya ɗaya farin duwatsu a cikin Kwandon A, sannan duk sauran duwatsun 99 (49 fari, 50 baki) a cikin Kwandon B
explanation: Wannan yana bada: 0.5 * (1/1) + 0.5 * (49/99) = 0.5 + 0.247 = ~74.7% yuwuwar tsira, idan aka kwatanta da 50% don raba daidai.

question: Me ya sa tsofaffin bututun ruwa na Romawa da aka gina da kankare mara ƙarfi har yanzu suka tsaya lafiya bayan shekaru dubu biyu, yayin da gadajin ƙarfe na zamani ke bukatar a ci gaba da fenti da kula da tsatsa?
options: Kankare yana ci gaba da matsewa koyaushe kuma baya lalacewa, yayin da ƙarfe ke tsatsa kuma yana fuskantar gajiya ta ƙarfafawa
Mortar na Romawa yana dauke da radioactive
Kankare yana shakar nitrogen na iska
Ana gina gadajin zamani da gangan suna da rauni
correctAnswer: Kankare yana ci gaba da matsewa koyaushe kuma baya lalacewa, yayin da ƙarfe ke tsatsa kuma yana fuskantar gajiya ta ƙarfafawa
explanation: Gine-ginen kankare mai matsewa baya fuskantar lalacewar tsatsa, kuma simintin Romawa na duwatsu mai fasahar pozzolanic yana gyara kananan tsagewa a hankali cikin shekaru.

question: Wani masani a fannin binciken mutuwa ya lura cewa wani mutum da aka samu a cikin ɗaki mara zafi a lokacin sanyi ba shi da taurin jiki bayan mutu (rigor mortis), amma zafin jikin ciki yana 18°C (zafin dakin). Shin mutumin ya mutu awa 2 da suka gabata ko kwana 3 da suka wuce?
options: Kimanin kwana 3 da suka wuce, saboda rigor mortis yana bayyana cikin 'yan awanni, yana kai kololuwa a cikin awanni 12, kuma ya gushe gaba ɗaya bayan awanni 36-72.
Awa 2 da suka wuce
Cikin mintuna 30 da suka wuce
Ba za a iya fassara lokacin mutuwa ba
correctAnswer: Kimanin kwana 3 da suka wuce, saboda rigor mortis yana bayyana cikin 'yan awanni, yana kai kololuwa a cikin awanni 12, kuma ya gushe gaba ɗaya bayan awanni 36-72.
explanation: Rigor mortis yanayi ne na wucin gadi na jiki wanda rashin ATP ke haifarwa. Bayan awanni 36-48, lalacewar kwayoyin autolytic yana karya haɗin actin-myosin, yana mayar da sassaucin jiki.

question: Wani fashi ya maye gurbin zanen mai daraja a gidan kayan gargajiya da hoton kwaikwayo na hoto. Mai tsaron gidan kayan gargajiya ya lura da kwaikwayon nan take daga nisan ƙafa 20 ƙarƙashin hasken yanayi ba tare da amfani da gilashin haɓaka ba. Menene ya nuna hakan?
options: Haske mai kyalli a saman fentin mai, zarurrukan burushi sun kasance tsaye kuma iri ɗaya a hoton da aka buga
Hoton yana da sunan mai zanen da ba daidai ba
Firam ɗin hoton yana roba
Zanen yana a juye
correctAnswer: Haske mai kyalli a saman fentin mai, zarurrukan burushi sun kasance tsaye kuma iri ɗaya a hoton da aka buga
explanation: Zanen mai mai gaske yana da tsayayyen ɗorawa na uku wanda ke haskakawa da motsi; hotuna masu lebur suna nuna haskaka da aka zana kai tsaye.

question: Wani mai iyo ya zubar da gilashin murɗaɗɗen gwangwani cike da iska cikin zurfin tafki. A zurfin mita 10 (kimanin matsin lamba na yanayi 2), menene ke faruwa ga matsin iskar da ke cikin gilashin mai ƙarfi da aka rufe?
options: Yana nan daidai da yanayin 1, saboda gilashin mai ƙarfi baya lankwasawa ko matsawa ƙarƙashin matsa lamba na ruwa
Yana ninki biyu zuwa yanayi 2
Yana sauka zuwa sifili
Yana ninka huɗu zuwa yanayi 4
correctAnswer: Yana nan daidai da yanayin 1, saboda gilashin mai ƙarfi baya lankwasawa ko matsawa ƙarƙashin matsa lamba na ruwa
explanation: Sai dai in gilashin mai ƙarfi ya lankwasa ko ya fashe, adadin iskar da ke ciki da yawa yana nan ɗaya, yana kula da matsin lamba na 1 atm a ciki.

question: Ana juyar da tsabar kudi sau 9 kuma tana faduwa a kan fuskar gaba a kowane lokaci. Menene cikakken yuwuwar lissafi cewa juyar ta 10 za ta fadi a kan fuskar gaba, idan aka dauki tsabar kudin gaskiya ce da adalci?
options: Cikakken kashi 50 cikin 100 (1 a cikin 2)
Kasa da kashi 1 cikin 100
Kashi 90 cikin 100
Kashi 75 cikin 100
correctAnswer: Cikakken kashi 50 cikin 100 (1 a cikin 2)
explanation: Kuskuren Masanin Caca yana sa mutane su yi imani cewa fuskar baya tana 'nabawa'. Gwaje-gwajen bazuwar masu zaman kansu ba su da tuna; kowane juyawa yana da kashi 50/50.

question: Me yasa tsofaffin tukwane masu yin Soyayyar Karfe (cast-iron) suke zama ba sa manne kuma suna zama baki masu haske na dabi'a bayan shekaru na yin amfani da su yadda ya kamata a girke-girke?
options: Kitse da mai na girki suna undergo high-temperature thermal polymerization, suna samar da rufi mai haɗin gwiwa na polymer mai hanawa ruwa wanda aka haɗa da ƙarfe
Ƙarfe yana yin tsatsa zuwa carbon baki
Ana tara manyan ƙwayoyin abinci masu ƙonewa
Ƙarfe yana shan ma'adinai bakar yanayi
correctAnswer: Kitse da mai na girki suna undergo high-temperature thermal polymerization, suna samar da rufi mai haɗin gwiwa na polymer mai hanawa ruwa wanda aka haɗa da ƙarfe
explanation: Fatty acids waɗanda ba a gamsu da su ba suna oxidize kuma suna haɗuwa idan an dafa su bayan sun kai matsakaicin zafi, suna polymerize zuwa rufi mai ɗorewa, mai santsi kamar roba.

question: Agogo a cikin burtalai yana bugun karfe 6 a cikin daidai da sakan 15 (daga farkon karar na farko har zuwa ƙarshen karar ta shida). Nawa ne sakan zai dauka don bugun karfe 12?
options: 33 sakan
30 sakan
36 sakan
24 sakan
correctAnswer: 33 sakan
explanation: Bugun 6 yana nufin akwai tazara 5 tsakanin karar shida: 15 / 5 = sakan 3 a kowace tazara. Bugun 12 yana nufin akwai tazara 11: 11 * 3 = sakan 33.

question: Me yasa mutum dake kallon allon kwamfuta mai haske a cikin ɗaki baƙi baki yake fuskantar gajiya mai tsanani ga idanu idan aka kwatanta da kasancewar fitila mai ɗumi a bango?
options: Dutse-dutse na ido dole ne su daidaita kan matakan haske masu tsanani, wanda ke gajiya ga tsokoki na ciliary da pupillary
Allon kwamfuta na fitar da photons masu guba masu radiation
Darkness na busar da bututun hawaye har abada
Retina tana daina samar da rhodopsin
correctAnswer: Dutse-dutse na ido dole ne su daidaita kan matakan haske masu tsanani, wanda ke gajiya ga tsokoki na ciliary da pupillary
explanation: Bambancin haske mai tsanani tsakanin hasken allo da duhun muhalli na haifar da gajiya ga ido da rashin jin daɗin haske.

question: Wani mai binciken laifuka yana yin tambayoyi ga shaidu uku game da hatsarin mota da aka ja da baya. Shaida A ya ce motar tana da launin shudi; Shaida B ya ce launin toka mai duhu ce; Shaida C ya ce launin shudi mai duhu ce. Hatsarin ya faru da karfe 2:00 na dare a ƙarƙashin fitilun titin sulfur mai ƙarancin matsa lamba da ke da launin rawaya. Mene ne launin gaske na motar?
options: Shudi (fitilun sulfur mai haske guda ɗaya suna mayar da shudi na gaske ya kasance mai duhu sosai ko launin toka)
Ruwan rawaya mai haske
Fari
Ja mai haske
correctAnswer: Shudi (fitilun sulfur mai haske guda ɗaya suna mayar da shudi na gaske ya kasance mai duhu sosai ko launin toka)
explanation: Fitilun iskar sulfur mai ƙarancin matsa lamba suna fitar da haske guda ɗaya da ke kusan 589 nm; pigments na shudi ba sa bayyana hasken rawaya, suna bayyana kusan baki ko toka mai duhu.

question: Me yasa tsuntsaye da ke zaune a kan layukan wutar lantarki ke tashi tare da juna seconds kafin girgizar ƙasa ta ji ga mutane a ƙasa?
options: Masu karɓar motsi na ƙafar tsuntsaye (Herbst corpuscles) suna gane saurin gajeren gajeren igiyoyin P-waves tun kafin igiyoyin S-waves masu lalacewa su iso
Tsuntsaye suna ganowa radiasiyon lantarki daga raunin ƙasa
Tsuntsaye suna jin warin ozone da ƙasa mai fashewa ke fitarwa
Tsuntsaye suna jin sautin infrasound daga tsakiyar duniya
correctAnswer: Masu karɓar motsi na ƙafar tsuntsaye (Herbst corpuscles) suna gane saurin gajeren gajeren igiyoyin P-waves tun kafin igiyoyin S-waves masu lalacewa su iso
explanation: Igiyoyin P-waves na latsawa suna tafiya kusan ninki biyu fiye da igiyoyin S-waves masu gogayya, suna haifar da ɗabi'un farkawa a masu ji na dabbobin da ke da hankali.

question: An ɗan isar da sako an ɗora masa aikin kai fakiti a cikin hamada cikin kwanaki 4. Wani mutum guda zai iya ɗaukar ruwa na kwana 3 kawai. Ƙarancin mutane nawa ake buƙata don isar da fakitin lafiya tare da dawowar kowa da rai?
options: mutane 2 (mai taimako yana tafiya 1 rana, yana miƙa ruwan kwana 1 ga ɗan isarwa, yana riƙe 1 don dawowa)
mutane 3
mutum 1
mutane 4
correctAnswer: mutane 2 (mai taimako yana tafiya 1 rana, yana miƙa ruwan kwana 1 ga ɗan isarwa, yana riƙe 1 don dawowa)
explanation: Rana ta 1: Dukkanin suna shan ruwa na 1 rana. Mai taimako yana miƙa ruwa 1 ga ɗan isarwa (ɗan isarwa yana cikakke da ruwan kwanaki 3). Mai taimako yana amfani da sauran 1 don dawowa. Ɗan isarwa yana ketare sauran kwanaki 3.

question: Me yasa alƙalami na jagora na yau da kullum ke barin alamar duhu mai goge a kan takarda ba tare da buƙatar tawada mai ruwa ba?
options: Graphite yana ƙunshe da takardu masu ɗaurewar ƙwayoyin carbon wadanda ke da rauni ta hanyar ƙarfin van der Waals, suna yanke akan zaren takarda
Jagora yana narke daga gogayyar rubutu
Sinadarin acid na takarda yana narkar da graphite
Alƙaluman suna ɗauke da gautar laka na charcoal
correctAnswer: Graphite yana ƙunshe da takardu masu ɗaurewar ƙwayoyin carbon wadanda ke da rauni ta hanyar ƙarfin van der Waals, suna yanke akan zaren takarda
explanation: Layukan carbon na sp2 suna jujjuya saman juna cikin sauƙi; gogayya na injiniya tana rarraba ƙananan flake na graphene zuwa cellulose.

question: Wani mai gida ya lura cewa ƙofar ƙasa tana manne sosai a cikin firam ɗin ƙofa a lokacin watannin rani masu ɗumi, amma tana juyawa cikin sauƙi da sassauci a lokacin sanyi. Me yasa?
options: Itace tana ɗaukar danshi daga iska mai ɗumi ta rani, tana kumbura a tsaye akan tsarin ƙwayoyin itace
Tushe yana tashi a lokacin rani
Ƙwanƙwasa ƙarfe suna faɗaɗa fiye da itace
Ƙarfin nauyi na rani yana matsawa firam ɗin
correctAnswer: Itace tana ɗaukar danshi daga iska mai ɗumi ta rani, tana kumbura a tsaye akan tsarin ƙwayoyin itace
explanation: Zaren cellulose a itace suna ɗaukar ruwa, suna ɗaukar ƙwanƙwasar ruwa daga iska mai ɗumi kuma suna faɗaɗawa a tsaye da tsarin zaren itacen.

question: Me yasa ƙafar keke ke jin nauyi sosai kuma taƙaita wajen canza shugabanci idan ka riƙe axel a hannunka yayin da take juyawa da sauri?
options: Tsarewar motsi na kusurwa na nuna juriya na gyroscope ga kowace ƙarfi da ke ƙoƙarin canza axis ɗin juyawarsa
Ƙafar tana samun nauyi na zahiri daga juyawa
Ƙarfi na centrifugal yana ƙara nauyi
Taurin iska yana turawa hannaye
correctAnswer: Tsarewar motsi na kusurwa na nuna juriya na gyroscope ga kowace ƙarfi da ke ƙoƙarin canza axis ɗin juyawarsa
explanation: Ƙarfi daidai da saurin canjin motsi na kusurwa (tau = dL/dt); juyar da axis mai juyawa na buƙatar babban ƙarfi na tsoka a tsaye.

question: Wani masanin kimiyya ya saka kwalban diet cola da ba'a bude ba da kwalban cola mai sukari na yau da kullum da ba'a bude ba cikin tulu na ruwa. Diet cola yana iyo, yayin da regular cola ya nutse zuwa kasan tulu. Me ya sa?
options: Regular cola yana dauke da syrup mai nauyi na high-fructose da aka narke (kimanin gram 39 na sukari), wanda yana kara yawan nauyin kwalban fiye da na ruwa
Diet cola yana dauke da iskar helium
Kwalban regular cola yana amfani da aluminum mai kauri
Kwalban diet yana dauke da karancin ruwa
correctAnswer: Regular cola yana dauke da syrup mai nauyi na high-fructose da aka narke (kimanin gram 39 na sukari), wanda yana kara yawan nauyin kwalban fiye da na ruwa
explanation: Sukari yana kara kimanin gram 39 na nauyi ba tare da fadada girman kwalban ba, wanda yake sa nauyin duka na regular cola ya fi 1.0 g/cm^3.

question: Me yasa kumfa a cikin gilashin Guinness stout mai duhu da aka zuba kwanan nan ke bayyana kamar suna nutsewa ƙasa tare da bangon gilashin maimakon hawa sama?
options: Gudanar da ruwa mai tashi sama a tsakiyar fadada yana ja ruwa da kumfa ƙasa tare da sanyi, bangon gilashin da ke jan hankali
Kumfan Guinness suna da nauyi fiye da ruwa
Iskar nitrogen tana da ƙananan buoyancy
Tarin saman ruwa yana tura kumfa ƙasa
correctAnswer: Gudanar da ruwa mai tashi sama a tsakiyar fadada yana ja ruwa da kumfa ƙasa tare da sanyi, bangon gilashin da ke jan hankali
explanation: Jawo bangon gilashi yana rage saurin kumfa kusa da gefen yayin da kumfa a tsakiya ke tashi da sauri, yana kafa zagayowar juyawar da ke ɗaukar kumfa na gefen ƙasa.

question: Wani mai tafiya a daji da ya bace a rana mai ruwan gajimare yana tantance arewa daidai ba tare da amfani da compass ko ganin rana ba. Ya duba ciyawar moss a kan trunk na itace kuma ya ga tana yaduwa daidai, amma ya lura reshen itatuwa suna girma kauri a gefe daya. Wane gefe?
options: Kudu (a Arewa Hemisphere, itatuwa suna samun karin hasken rana kai tsaye daga kudu, yana karfafa girman ganyayyaki)
Arewa
Gabas
Yamma
correctAnswer: Kudu (a Arewa Hemisphere, itatuwa suna samun karin hasken rana kai tsaye daga kudu, yana karfafa girman ganyayyaki)
explanation: Heliotropism na photosynthetic yana motsa reshe da yawan ganye zuwa inda hasken rana ke tafiya, wanda yake kudu a yankunan arewacin yanayi masu matsakaici.

question: Me yasa mutum da ya kasance yana juyawa a kan abin nishadi na filin wasa ke jin kewaye da shi na ci gaba da juyawa a akasin shugabarsa lokacin da ya tsaya kwatsam?
options: Inertia yana sa ruwan endolymph a cikin bututun semi-circular na kunnuwan ciki ya ci gaba da motsi, yana lanƙwasa cupulae na ƙwayar gashi a akasin hanya
Hanyar optic tana ci gaba da juyawa
Matsin jini na kwakwalwa yana raguwa
Tsokokin ido suna yin spasms ba tare da tsari ba
correctAnswer: Inertia yana sa ruwan endolymph a cikin bututun semi-circular na kunnuwan ciki ya ci gaba da motsi, yana lanƙwasa cupulae na ƙwayar gashi a akasin hanya
explanation: Juyawar ruwa a cikin bututun vestibular yana ci gaba da gudana bayan kai ya tsaya, yana karkatar da stereocilia kuma yana aika sigina na motsi mai zagaye a akasin hanya.

question: Me yasa maganadiso na firiji na yau da kullum yake manne sosai ga ƙofar firiji ta karfe, amma yana zamewa a hankali idan aka sanya takardar katako mai nauyi tsakanin su?
options: Ƙarfin filin maganadiso yana raguwa sosai da nisa (yana raguwa kimanin karfinsa da kusan lamba ta uku ko ta huɗu na nisan)
Katako yana kawar da maganadiso
Katako yana samar da kariya ta lantarki
Ƙarfin nauyi yana ƙaruwa akan katako
correctAnswer: Ƙarfin filin maganadiso yana raguwa sosai da nisa (yana raguwa kimanin karfinsa da kusan lamba ta uku ko ta huɗu na nisan)
explanation: Ƙarfin jan hankali na maganadiso dipolu yana raguwa cikin sauri da nisa (F ~ 1/r^4); ƙara kaurin tazarar iska yana rage ƙarfi sosai na riƙe maganadiso.

question: Me ya sa ma'aikatan jirgin sama ke umartar fasinjoji su daga labulen taga yayin tashin jirgi da saukar jirgi?
options: Don ba fasinjoji damar daidaita idanun su da hasken waje da kuma taimaka wa ma’aikatan gano wutar injin na waje ko hadurran tsarin nan da nan
Don samar da haske a ciki da adana baturi
Don daidaita matsa lamba a cikin jirgi
Don isar da sigina ga masu kula da zirga-zirgar jiragen sama
correctAnswer: Don ba fasinjoji damar daidaita idanun su da hasken waje da kuma taimaka wa ma’aikatan gano wutar injin na waje ko hadurran tsarin nan da nan
explanation: Sanin yanayi yayin muhimman matakan tashi jirgi yana tabbatar da shirin gaggawa na fasinjoji da bincike na gani na saman fikafikai.

question: Jirgin ruwa mai nutsewa yana sauka cikin zurfin gangaren teku. Me yasa ake ƙera kayan ciki na jiragen ruwa na zamani da siffar zagaye ta silinda maimakon siffar kwance ko murabba'i?
options: Zagaye yana rarraba matsin lamba na ruwa gaba ɗaya ba tare da matakin damuwa na musamman ko wuraren raunana ba
Zagaye suna da sauƙin fenti
Kayan ciki na murabba'i suna juyawa cikin sauƙi
Kifi suna guje wa siffofi zagaye
correctAnswer: Zagaye yana rarraba matsin lamba na ruwa gaba ɗaya ba tare da matakin damuwa na musamman ko wuraren raunana ba
explanation: Daidaiton radial ƙarƙashin matsin lamba na ruwa na waje yana tabbatar da damuwar membrane mai matuƙar matsa, yana hana rushewar tsarin gini.

question: Me ya sa sauti da aka yi a cikin tafkin wasa yake sauti sosai kuma kusan ba za a iya ji ba ga wanda ke tsaye a bakin tafkin a cikin iska?
options: Babban bambanci tsakanin yawan juriya na sauti na ruwa da iska yana mayar da sama da kashi 99.9 na kuzarin raƙuman sauti cikin ruwa

question: Me yasa mutum da ke jin rashin lafiya na motsi ke fuskantar amai sosai idan ya zauna baya yana kallon gefen da baya ga hanyar tafiya a jirgin ƙasa?

Zaunannan baya yana rage shakar oxygen.
Taya jirgin ƙasa na girgiza baya.
Zaunannan baya yana juyar da narkewar abinci.
correctAnswer: Haɗin hankalin jin motsi yana ƙaruwa lokacin da siginar motsi na gani ke tafiya baya yayin da jiki ke jin hanzarin motsi a gaba.
explanation: Samfurin motsi na kwakwalwa yana tsammanin motsi a layin ido; kallon ƙasa mai nesa yayin hanzarta na saba wa amsoshin vestibulospinal.

question: Me ya sa kankara mai girma a tekun teku take iyo da kusan kashi 90 na girman ta yana ɓoye a ƙarƙashin layin ruwa?
options: Matsakaicin nauyin kankara mai tsafta daga glacier (0.917 g/cm^3) kusan kashi tara bisa goma ne na nauyin ruwan teku mai sanyi (1.025 g/cm^3)
Ana jan kankara zuwa kasan teku ta hanyar maganadisu
Ruwan karkashin ruwa yana ja kankara ƙasa
Sama tana tafasa a cikin iska mai sanyi
correctAnswer: Matsakaicin nauyin kankara mai tsafta daga glacier (0.917 g/cm^3) kusan kashi tara bisa goma ne na nauyin ruwan teku mai sanyi (1.025 g/cm^3)
explanation: Ka'idar Archimedes: kashi na ɓoyayyen yanki yana daidai da rabo tsakanin nauyin kankara da nauyin ruwan teku (0.917 / 1.025 = ~89.5%).

question: Me yasa batirin mota na lead-acid na yau da kullum ke samar da foda fari mai karasawa a kusa da tashoshin lead dinsa bayan lokaci?
options: Hayakin electrolyte na sulfuric acid da ke fita yana amsawa da igiyoyin jan karfe da tashoshin lead don samar da kristal na lead sulfate da copper sulfate
Gishirin hanya yana taruwa a saman batir
Lead yana yin oxidize kai tsaye zuwa fenti fari
Acid yana komawa zuwa solid baking soda
correctAnswer: Hayakin electrolyte na sulfuric acid da ke fita yana amsawa da igiyoyin jan karfe da tashoshin lead don samar da kristal na lead sulfate da copper sulfate
explanation: Hayakin iskar hydrogen da ke fita yana ɗauke da ƙananan aerosols na sulfuric acid; amsawa da tashoshin batirin lead da tashoshin tagulla/baƙin jan karfe yana haifar da gishirin sulfate da ba ya narkewa.

question: Me ya sa wani yanki na foda bushe ke rubutu a sauƙaƙe a kan allon dutse mai kauri, amma yana zamewa ba tare da barin alama a kan gilashi mai mai ba?
options: Rubutun foda yana dogara ne da gogewar inji akan ƙananan tsage-tsage masu kauri don nika flakes na calcium carbonate
Gilashi yana kore foda ta hanyar sinadarai
Foda tana narkewa a cikin man gilashi
Dutse yana fitar da ƙarfin lantarki na rubutu
correctAnswer: Rubutun foda yana dogara ne da gogewar inji akan ƙananan tsage-tsage masu kauri don nika flakes na calcium carbonate
explanation: Gogewar abrasive tana buƙatar tsage-tsage na saman da ke da ƙarfin lanƙwasa fiye da haɗin foda; gilashi mai santsi baya da tsage-tsage don lanƙwasa ƙwayoyin.

question: Me ya sa maƙarin ruwa a cikin zurfin teku yake jin yunwa sosai kuma yana sha'awar abincin da ke da yawa carbohydrates bayan kammala iyo a ƙarƙashin ruwa?
options: Jikin ɗan adam na kashe babban adadin kuzarin metabolism wajen sarrafa yanayin zafi bisa ruwa, wanda ke watsar da zafin jiki sau 24 cikin sauri fiye da iska
Ruwan teku yana fitar da kuzarin ciki
Shakar iskar oxygen mai matsewa yana kona sukari
Zurfin ƙarƙashin teku yana rage insulin na jiki
correctAnswer: Jikin ɗan adam na kashe babban adadin kuzarin metabolism wajen sarrafa yanayin zafi bisa ruwa, wanda ke watsar da zafin jiki sau 24 cikin sauri fiye da iska
explanation: Babban ƙarfin ɗaukar zafi na ruwa da babban yanayin ƙarfin isar zafi suna saurin ɗaukar kuzarin zafi na jiki; hanta tana amfani da ajiyar glycogen don kiyaye yanayin zafin jiki na jiki.

question: Me yasa ma'aikatan jirgin sama ke rage hasken ciki yayin tashin ko saukar dare?
options: Don baiwa idanuwan fasinja da ma'aikata damar daidaitawa da duhu (daidaituwar rod na rhodopsin) idan akwai gaggawa wajen fitarwa a duhu
Don adana ƙarfin batir ɗin jirgin sama
Don taimakawa fasinja su yi barci
Don hana gano jirgin daga tauraron dan adam na ƙasa
correctAnswer: Don baiwa idanuwan fasinja da ma'aikata damar daidaitawa da duhu (daidaituwar rod na rhodopsin) idan akwai gaggawa wajen fitarwa a duhu
explanation: Daidaituwar duhu na ɗaukar kusan mintuna 20-30; rage hasken cikin jirgi yana tabbatar da ganin dare nan take idan haske ya ƙare yayin hatsarin saukar dare mai sauri.

question: Me ya sa kankara a cikin Tekun Arctic ke samar da ruwan sha lokacin da ta narke, ko da yake an ƙirƙe ta a cikin ruwan teku mai gishiri?
options: Kankara na glaciers yana samuwa daga tarin dusar ƙanƙara daga sama a ƙasa, ba daga ruwan teku da aka narke ba
Gishiri yana tafasa a ƙarƙashin digiri sifili
Bears masu kankara suna tace kankara
Gishiri yana nutsewa zuwa ƙasan teku kafin ya daskare
correctAnswer: Kankara na glaciers yana samuwa daga tarin dusar ƙanƙara daga sama a ƙasa, ba daga ruwan teku da aka narke ba
explanation: Kankara na teku na faruwa daga glaciers na ƙasa waɗanda aka tara su daga dusar ƙanƙara mai ruwan sha, wanda kusan babu gishiri a cikinsa.

question: Me yasa wani yanki na busasshen spaghetti yake lankwasawa kaɗan ba tare da karyewa ba idan ka lankwasa shi a hankali, amma ya tsageshi ba tare da gargadi ba idan an lankwasa shi fiye da wani matakin mahimmanci?
options: Ƙarfi na jan jiki a gefen waje mai lankwasawa ya wuce ƙarfin tensile mai rauni na busasshen pasta
Kwayoyin ruwa suna ɓacewa yayin lankwasawa
Tsakiyar yana yin zafi fiye da maki tafasa
Spaghetti yana da fiber na ƙarfe a ciki
correctAnswer: Ƙarfi na jan jiki a gefen waje mai lankwasawa ya wuce ƙarfin tensile mai rauni na busasshen pasta
explanation: Yayin da lankwasawa ke ƙaruwa, damuwar tensile na saman waje ta kai ga iyakar karyewar brittle, wanda ke haifar da yaduwar tsagewa mai muni.

question: Me yasa allon compass ke nuna zuwa Kogin Arewa na duniya maimakon Kudu na gaske?
options: Kogin geomagnetic na Kudu na Duniya yana kusa da Kogin Arewa na duniya, yana jan karfin arewacin gilashin allon
Ana tura allon ta hanyar iska ta rana
Kogin Arewa yana da ƙarfin nauyi kaɗan
Kankara na polar yana jan ƙarfe mai magnet
correctAnswer: Kogin geomagnetic na Kudu na Duniya yana kusa da Kogin Arewa na duniya, yana jan karfin arewacin gilashin allon
explanation: Abubuwan da suka saba suna jan juna a maganadisu: kogin da ke neman arewa na maganadisu ana jan shi zuwa kogin geomagnetic na kudu na Duniya da ke Arctic.

question: Me yasa tsuntsaye masu zaune a kan tsaunuka masu tsawo ke fuskantar iska kai tsaye lokacin da suke tashi zuwa cikin jirgi?
options: Fuskantar iska daga gaba nan take yana samar da mafi girman saurin iska dangane da fikafikan su, yana haifar da ɗaga iska nan take
Fuskantar iska daga baya yana hura gashin su
Tsuntsaye ba za su iya juyar da kansu ba
Iska daga baya tana jan tsuntsaye kasa
correctAnswer: Fuskantar iska daga gaba nan take yana samar da mafi girman saurin iska dangane da fikafikan su, yana haifar da ɗaga iska nan take
explanation: Ɗaga iska yana da alaƙa da murabba'in saurin iska (v^2). Gudun ko tsalle cikin iska daga gaba yana bayar da saurin iska kyauta don tashi cikin sauƙi.

question: Me ya sa yin magana ta hanyar megafon ɗin sauti ko ƙaho mai faɗaɗa ke sa murya ta mutum ta ƙara ƙarfi sosai kuma ta kai nesa fiye da yadda ake iya fahimta a sarari?
options: Ƙahon da ke faɗaɗa yana daidaita ƙarfin sauti tsakanin hanyoyin murya da iska ta waje, yana haɓaka ƙarfin sauti da ake yadawa
ƙahon yana mai da hankali ga girgizar sararin samaniya
Iska a cikin ƙahon tana dumama da sauri
ƙahon yana kawar da tsinkayar sauti
correctAnswer: Ƙahon da ke faɗaɗa yana daidaita ƙarfin sauti tsakanin hanyoyin murya da iska ta waje, yana haɓaka ƙarfin sauti da ake yadawa
explanation: Megafon yana aiki a matsayin mai canza ƙarfin sauti. Ba tare da ƙahon ba, faɗaɗawar gaggawa zai sanya mafi yawan ƙarfin sauti ya dawo cikin baki. Ƙahon da ke faɗaɗa a hankali yana daidaita ƙarfin, yana yaduwa da ƙarfin da ya ninka sau 10.

question: Wani waje mai karfi na ƙarfe tare da rami na zagaye a tsakiya yana samun dumama daidai a cikin tanda na masana'antu. Menene zai faru da diamita na ramin tsakiya?
options: Yana faɗaɗa kuma ya zama mafi girma
Yana ja da baya kuma ya zama mafi ƙanana
Yana kasancewa daidai kamar yadda yake
Yana juya zuwa siffar kwance
correctAnswer: Yana faɗaɗa kuma ya zama mafi girma
explanation: Faɗaɗa zafi yana aiki kamar haɓakar hoto; kowanne girman layi yana faɗaɗa zuwa waje, yana ƙara diamita na rami.

question: Dutse mai girma yana kwance a cikin ƙaramin jirgin ruwa da ke iyo a cikin ƙaramin tafkin iyo. Idan mutum ya jefa dutse daga jirgin ruwa ya nutse zuwa ƙasa, menene zai faru da matakin ruwan tafkin?
options: Matakin ruwan tafkin zai ragu kaɗan
Matakin ruwan tafkin zai tashi kaɗan
Matakin ruwa zai kasance daidai daidai
Tafkin zai malalo nan take
correctAnswer: Matakin ruwan tafkin zai ragu kaɗan
explanation: A cikin jirgin, dutse ya maye gurbin nauyinsa a cikin ruwa. Idan ya nutse zuwa ƙasa, yana maye gurbin kawai ƙarar sa, wadda ta fi ƙanƙanta saboda dutse yana da nauyi fiye da ruwa.

question: Balo mai cike da helium yana iyo a cikin mota da aka rufe da tagogi. Lokacin da direba ya matsa accelerator kuma motar ta tashi gaba, a wane bangare balon yana motsawa?
options: Yana karkata gaba zuwa ga gilashin gaba
Yana ja baya zuwa kujera ta baya
Yana tsaya cikakke ba motsi
Yana nutsewa kai tsaye zuwa kasa
correctAnswer: Yana karkata gaba zuwa ga gilashin gaba
explanation: Iskar cikin mota mai nauyi tana motsawa baya saboda inertia, tana ƙirƙirar bambanci a matsa lamba wanda ke tura balon helium mai sauƙi gaba.

question: Kwai biyu marasa dafa suna kan benchi: ɗaya dai-dai ne dafa, ɗaya kuma bai dafa ba. Ka juya duka biyun, ka taɓa kowanne da yatsa na tsawon rabin dakika don dakata da su, sannan ka saki nan da nan. Wane ƙwai zai fara juyawa sake?
options: Ƙwai mara dafa zai ci gaba da juyawa
Ƙwai da aka dafa zai ci gaba da juyawa
Duka biyun za su ci gaba da juyawa daidai
Babu wani ƙwai da zai sake juyawa
correctAnswer: Ƙwai mara dafa zai ci gaba da juyawa
explanation: Dakatar da ƙwayar ba ta dakatar da ruwan yolk na ciki ba; bayan an saki, motsin juyawa na ruwan da ke cikin zai sa ƙwayar ta sake juyawa.

question: A cikin rikicin Monty Hall, ka zaɓi Ƙofa ta 1 daga cikin ƙofofi 3. Mai masaukin yana buɗe Ƙofa ta 3, yana nuna akuya. Ya kamata ka canza zuwa Ƙofa ta 2 don ƙara damar samun nasarar motar?
options: Eh, canzawa yana ninka damar nasararka zuwa 2/3
A'a, yiwuwar ka tana nan daidai 1/2 ko ta yaya
Bai kawo wani bambanci na lissafi ba
Sai dai idan da farko ka fi son Ƙofa ta 2
correctAnswer: Eh, canzawa yana ninka damar nasararka zuwa 2/3
explanation: Zaɓin ka na farko yana da damar 1/3 na kasancewa daidai. Ragowar damar 2/3 zai mayar da hankali gabaɗaya akan Ƙofa ta 2 da zarar mai masaukin ya nuna akuya.

question: A cikin wani kauye mai nisa, mai aski yana aske dukkan maza, kuma sai waɗancan maza ne kawai, waɗanda ba sa aske kansu. To, wa zai aske mai askin?
options: Wannan matsala ce da ba za a iya warwarewa ba (Russell's Paradox)
Mai askin yana aske kansa
Baban gari yana aske shi
Ɗalibinsa yana aske shi
correctAnswer: Wannan matsala ce da ba za a iya warwarewa ba (Russell's Paradox)
explanation: Idan ya aske kansa, yana karya ƙa'idar ta hanyar aske mutum wanda ke aske kansa. Idan kuma bai yi ba, dole ne ya aske kansa. Asalin magana tana da cin karo da kanta.

question: Igiyar lif ɗin ta yage a bene na 40. Shin fasinja zai iya tsira daga tashin hankali na ƙarshe ta hanyar tsalle sama daidai lokacin da kabin ya buga bene na ƙasa?
options: A'a, gudun tsalle na ɗan adam (2-3 m/s) yana da ƙarancin daidaita gudun haɗarin da ke faɗowa ƙasa (30+ m/s)
Ee, tsalle yana soke momentum gaba ɗaya
Sai dai idan lif ɗin an rufe shi da kumfa
Ee, idan sun yi tsalle a tsaye
correctAnswer: A'a, gudun tsalle na ɗan adam (2-3 m/s) yana da ƙarancin daidaita gudun haɗarin da ke faɗowa ƙasa (30+ m/s)
explanation: Faɗuwar kyauta daga bene na 40 tana hanzarta kabin da fasinja zuwa ~35 m/s. Tsalle sama na 3 m/s yana barin gudun haɗari mai mutuwa na 32 m/s.

question: Shin akwati na ruwan dumi zai iya yin kankara zuwa daskararre da sauri fiye da akwati ɗaya na ruwan sanyi a ƙarƙashin wasu yanayi na musamman?
options: Eh, ana sanin wannan kimiyya da sunan Tasirin Mpemba
A'a, yana karya Dokar Farko ta Thermodynamics
Sai dai idan an ƙara gishiri mai nauyi
Sai dai a cikin sararin samaniya mara iska
correctAnswer: Eh, ana sanin wannan kimiyya da sunan Tasirin Mpemba
explanation: Tasirin Mpemba yana faruwa ne saboda saurin zufar ruwa daga saman, sakin iskar gas da cikin ruwa, da kuma bambancin zafin jiki ta hanyar kwarara a cikin ruwan dumi.

question: Me ya sa jiragen sama na kasuwanci ke tashi a manyan tsayin shekaru na ƙafa 33,000 zuwa 40,000 maimakon ƙasa kusa da ƙasa?
options: Ruwan iska mai laushi a sama yana rage ƙarfi mai yawa na shingen iska, yana ƙara amfani da fetur na jirgin sama
Ƙarfin nauyi yana da ƙarfi sosai a babban tsayi
Don kasancewa da dumi a sama da gajimare
Injin jirgi yana buƙatar iskar carbon dioxide mai yawa
correctAnswer: Ruwan iska mai laushi a sama yana rage ƙarfi mai yawa na shingen iska, yana ƙara amfani da fetur na jirgin sama
explanation: Ƙarfin iska a ƙafa 35,000 kusan ɗaya bisa uku ne na ƙarfin iska a matakin teku. Rage shingen iska yana baiwa jiragen sama damar yin tashi da 550 mph tare da ƙarancin ƙarfi.

question: Idan ka bar firinji na gida na yau da kullum yana aiki ba tare da tsayawa ba tare da ƙofofinsa a buɗe a ciki ɗaki mai rufe sosai, mai kyau kuma mai kyakyawan rufi, me zai faru da yanayin zafin ɗakin?
options: Yanayin zafin ɗakin zai ƙaru gaba ɗaya
Yanayin zafin ɗakin zai ragu gaba ɗaya
Yanayin zafin ɗakin zai kasance ba tare da canzawa ba gaba ɗaya
Ɗakin zai koma cikin firiji mai cikin tafiya
correctAnswer: Yanayin zafin ɗakin zai ƙaru gaba ɗaya
explanation: Kwampreso na firinji yana maida ƙarfin lantarki zuwa zafi. Ta hanyar thermodynamics, zafin da aka sallama a condenser ya fi zafin da aka ɗauka a evaporator.

question: Idan saurin juyawar Duniya ya ninka nan take, menene zai faru da auna nauyin jikin mutum a ma'aunin a daidai layin daidai da layin kasaita?
options: Za a ga nauyi ya ragu kadan saboda ƙarin saurin centrifugal na fita
Za a ga nauyi ya ninka
Za a ga nauyi ya kasance ɗaya
Nauyi zai sauka zuwa sifili gaba ɗaya
correctAnswer: Za a ga nauyi ya ragu kadan saboda ƙarin saurin centrifugal na fita
explanation: Auna nauyi W = m(g - omega^2 * R). Ninka saurin angular omega yana ninka hudu saurin centrifugal, yana rage ƙarfin kasa na ma'auni.

question: Me ya sa ruwan kofi mai zafi ke hucewa cikin sauri idan ka shaka a hankali a saman ruwan?
options: Yana share kayan tururin zafi da danshi, yana hanzarta hucewar tafasa
Numfashinka yana da sanyi kamar kankara
Yana tilasta ruwan sanyi zuwa saman
Yana haddasa oxidization na wake kofi a kimiyance
correctAnswer: Yana share kayan tururin zafi da danshi, yana hanzarta hucewar tafasa
explanation: Shakar iska tana tura layer mai danshi da ke saman kofi, tana rage matsi na tururin a wuri kuma tana ba da damar kwayoyin da ke da kuzarin motsi mai yawa su tafasa cikin sauri.

question: A cikin cikakkiyar ɗakin komai babu iska, an saki ƙwallon ƙarfe da gashin tsuntsu mai haske a lokaci guda daga tsayin da yake daidai. Wanne zai fara girgiza ƙasa?
options: Dukansu suna girgiza ƙasa a daidai wannan lokaci
Ƙwallon ƙarfe ce ta fara girgiza ƙasa
Gashin tsuntsu ne ya fara girgiza ƙasa
Wannan da aka saki da sauri mafi girma
correctAnswer: Dukansu suna girgiza ƙasa a daidai wannan lokaci
explanation: A cikin komai babu iska da babu juriya, hanzarin nauyi g = GM/R^2 gaba ɗaya baya dogara da nauyin abin da yake fadowa.

question: Me yasa hanyar mota mai shinge ta asfafti ke kama da tafki mai haske mai nuna ruwa a rana mai zafi (duhun ƙarya)?
options: Iskar mai zafi da ƙarancin yawa a kusa da bene tana karkatar da hasken rana daga sama zuwa idon direba
Ruwa tana tsirewa daga matattarar asfafti mai zafi
Tagogin mota suna nuna madubin haske
Girgizar zafi tana lalata retinan ido
correctAnswer: Iskar mai zafi da ƙarancin yawa a kusa da bene tana karkatar da hasken rana daga sama zuwa idon direba
explanation: Zafin ƙasa yana haifar da tsari akasin tsayin iska mai yawa. Rays daga sararin samaniya mai shuɗi suna lankwasawa sama zuwa iskar da ta fi sanyi da yawa, suna kwaikwayon madubin ruwa.

question: Me ya sa lu'ulu'u ke bayyana gaba ɗaya ga hasken da ake gani, yayin da gilashin graphite—da aka ƙera shi daga ƙwayoyin carbon na gaske na wannan sinadari ɗaya—ya kasance baki gaba ɗaya kuma ba a gani through?
options: Ragar lantarki ta sp3 hybridized na lu'ulu'u tana da fadi sosai don ɗaukar photons masu gani, yayin da graphite yana da electrons pi da aka 'yantar da su.
Lu'ulu'u an yi shi da gilashi na kristal.
Graphite yana ɗaukar haske saboda nauyi mai yawa.
Lu'ulu'u yana haskakawa 100 bisa dari na haske.
correctAnswer: Ragar lantarki ta sp3 hybridized na lu'ulu'u tana da fadi sosai don ɗaukar photons masu gani, yayin da graphite yana da electrons pi da aka 'yantar da su.
explanation: Lu'ulu'u yana da ban gap na 5.5 eV, wanda ya wuce karfin photons masu gani (1.8-3.1 eV). Takardun electrons pi na graphite suna ɗaukar haske a dukkan waɗannan mitar masu gani.

question: Lokacin da hasken gani ya shiga prism ɗin gilashi daga iska, saurin sa yana raguwa da kusan kashi 33 cikin ɗari. Shin mitar igiyar hasken tana canzawa?
options: A'a, mitar tana nan daram yayin da tsawon igiyar ya ragu daidai gwargwado
I, mitar tana raguwa da kashi 33 cikin ɗari
I, mitar tana ƙaruwa da kashi 33 cikin ɗari
Mitar tana faɗuwa zuwa sifili gaba ɗaya
correctAnswer: A'a, mitar tana nan daram yayin da tsawon igiyar ya ragu daidai gwargwado
explanation: Mitar ana tantance ta ne daidai gwargwado daga injin samar da igiyar mai girgiza. A cikin kafofin gani, saurin v da tsawon igiyar lambda suna canzawa (v = f * lambda).

question: Idan ka haskaka fitilar lantarki gaba daga gaban bango na jirgin sama mai tafiya da kashi 99 cikin ɗari na saurin haske, a wane sauri ne hasken zai tafi?
options: A saurin haske (c) a cikin dukkanin tsarin tunanin inertial
A sau 1.99 na saurin haske
A sau 0.99 na saurin haske
A ninka saurin sauti
correctAnswer: A saurin haske (c) a cikin dukkanin tsarin tunanin inertial
explanation: Ka'idar Musamman ta Einstein ta Dangantakar: saurin haske a cikin sarari mara nauyi c (300,000 km/s) yana da daidaito a dukkanin tsarin tunanin inertial.

question: Me yasa mutum dake kallo agogo dinsa a cikin jirgin sama mai tafiya kusa da saurin haske ke jin lokaci yadda ya saba, yayin da masu kallo a Duniya ke ganin agogon dinsa yana tafiya a hankali sosai?
options: Ragin lokaci na musamman na relativistic yana faruwa tsakanin majalisun da ke da dangantaka; lokacin da ya dace baya canzawa a cikin majalisar hutun mutum
Girgizar kayan aikin agogo na inji daga nauyi
Sararin yana da sanyi sosai ga agogo
Haske yana lanƙwasa a cikin agogo
correctAnswer: Ragin lokaci na musamman na relativistic yana faruwa tsakanin majalisun da ke da dangantaka; lokacin da ya dace baya canzawa a cikin majalisar hutun mutum
explanation: Lokaci na danganta ga majalisar mai kallo: dt' = gamma * dt. A cikin hutun ka na kanka, lokacin da ya dace yana tafiya yadda ya saba; agogon da ke motsi suna tafiya a hankali ga masu kallo daga waje.

question: Me yasa babban tsarin nukiliya ke haskakawa da hasken shuɗi mai ban mamaki a ƙarƙashin ruwa (radiyan Cherenkov)?
options: Ƙwayoyin beta masu caji suna tafiya ta cikin ruwa cikin sauri fiye da saurin yanayin haske a wannan matsakaici (c / 1.33)
Uranium yana fitar da hasken laser mai shuɗi
Ruwa tana zama mai radiyoaktifu kuma tana haskakawa
Garkuwar gubar tana yin wutar lantarki a ƙarƙashin ruwa
correctAnswer: Ƙwayoyin beta masu caji suna tafiya ta cikin ruwa cikin sauri fiye da saurin yanayin haske a wannan matsakaici (c / 1.33)
explanation: A cikin ruwa, haske yana tafiya a saurin 0.75c (~225,000 km/s). Lantarki masu sauri wadanda suka wuce wannan saurin na gida suna haifar da wata girgizar gani mai kama da karar banwo.

question: Me yasa taurarin dan sama a ciki na Tsarin Sararin Samaniya na Duniya suke shawagi a yanayin rashin nauyi, kodayake ja da baya na Duniya a tsayin su (km 400) kusan kashi 90 cikin 100 ne na nauyin saman duniya?
options: Tsarin sararin samaniya da taurarin dan sama suna ci gaba da fadawa kyauta zuwa Duniya yayin da suke tafiya a gefe cikin saurin zagaye (mph 17,500).
Ja da baya na Duniya yana dakatawa a km 100.
Motocin roket suna ci gaba da turawa akasin ja da baya.
Karin kariya na tsarin sararin samaniya yana hana ja da baya.
correctAnswer: Tsarin sararin samaniya da taurarin dan sama suna ci gaba da fadawa kyauta zuwa Duniya yayin da suke tafiya a gefe cikin saurin zagaye (mph 17,500).
explanation: Hanzari na tsakiya yayi daidai da hanzarin nauyi na gida (v^2 / R = g). Jirgin sama yana ci gaba da fadawa a kusa da Duniya, yana haifar da kamar rashin nauyi (zero-G).

question: Me yasa rike mai siffar T ko raket ɗin tennis ke juyawa yana canza matsayin sa lokaci-lokaci idan aka juyashi a kusa da tsakiyar babban juyi a yanayin rashin nauyi (tasirin Dzhanibekov)?
options: Juyawa a kusa da tsakiyar babban juzu'i na juyi a lissafi ba ta da tsayayye bisa ga ka'idodin Euler
Rashin nauyi yana haifar da matsin juyi
Friction na iska yana juyar da rike
Poles na magnetic suna jujjuya abu
correctAnswer: Juyawa a kusa da tsakiyar babban juzu'i na juyi a lissafi ba ta da tsayayye bisa ga ka'idodin Euler
explanation: Ka'idar raket ɗin tennis tana tabbatar da cewa juyawa a kan ƙaƙƙarfan ko mafi ƙarancin juzu'i na juyi yana da tsayayye, yayin da tsakiyar juzu'i yana nuna jujjuyawar rikicewa.

question: Ta yaya ƙaramin mantis shrimp zai iya bugawa da isasshen saurin fashewa a ƙarƙashin ruwa don karya manyan bangarorin gilashin akwatin kifi?
options: Ƙungiyarta ta ninka sauri fiye da harsashin bindiga (10,000 Gs), tana samar da kumfa na cavitation wanda faɗuwarsa ke haifar da mummunan tashin hankali na sauti da zazzabi na 4,000°C
Yana da ƙwayoyin lantarki masu tsoratarwa kamar kifi eel
Yana harba allurai na guba da matsin lamba
Yana yanka gilashi da haƙoran lu'u-lu'u
correctAnswer: Ƙungiyarta ta ninka sauri fiye da harsashin bindiga (10,000 Gs), tana samar da kumfa na cavitation wanda faɗuwarsa ke haifar da mummunan tashin hankali na sauti da zazzabi na 4,000°C
explanation: Kungiyoyin dactyl masu lanƙwashe da aka ɗora a spring suna sakin adadin kuzarin tauri da aka adana a cikin ɗan dakikoki; faɗuwar kumfar vacuum mai cavitation na ruwa yana ƙirƙirar wasu tashin hankali masu lalatawa.

question: Me yasa cokali mai lanƙwasa idan an sanya gefenta ƙarƙashin layin ruwa mai laushi daga famfo ke jan cikin ruwan sosai maimakon a turarashi?
options: Ruwa na manne wa saman da ke kumbura, kuma ruwan da aka karkatar yana ƙirƙirar wurin ƙarancin lamba wanda ke jan cokali (tasirin Coandă)
Ruwa na jan ƙarfe mara tsatsa
Ƙarfin saman yana turawa cokali
Matsin iska yana turawa ruwa
correctAnswer: Ruwa na manne wa saman da ke kumbura, kuma ruwan da aka karkatar yana ƙirƙirar wurin ƙarancin lamba wanda ke jan cokali (tasirin Coandă)
explanation: Tasirin Coandă yana bayyana mannewar ruwa ga saman lanƙwasacce; ta Dokar Na uku ta Newton, karkatar da ruwa zuwa waje yana haifar da ƙarfin daidai zuwa ciki a kan cokali.

question: Me yasa kwallon baseball na mai jefa kwallo ke juyawa kwatsam a tsaye a cikin iska idan aka jefa ta da babban juyi sama ko gefe?
options: Iska tana tafiya da sauri fiye da bangaren da ke juyawa a cikin hanyar tafiya, wanda ke rage matsi kuma yana haifar da karfin iska na gefe (tasirin Magnus)
Fingocin mai jefa kwallo suna shafawa kwallon
Iskar da ke tashi tana biye da ɗinki
Ƙarfin nauyin ƙasa yana lanƙwasa kwallon gefe
correctAnswer: Iska tana tafiya da sauri fiye da bangaren da ke juyawa a cikin hanyar tafiya, wanda ke rage matsi kuma yana haifar da karfin iska na gefe (tasirin Magnus)
explanation: Tasirin Magnus: saman da ke juyawa yana jan siririn layin iska, yana hanzarta kwararar iska a gefe guda kuma yana ragewa a ɗayan, yana haifar da rashin daidaiton matsi na gefe.

question: Me ya sa gaurayawar garin masara da ruwa (Oobleck) ke aiki kamar ruwa mai laushi idan an motsa shi a hankali, amma ya koma saman dutse lokacin da aka buga shi da murfi?
options: Karfi mai girma na gogayya yana tilasta garin masara ya makale a juna cikin tsarin crystalline mai tsauri (ruwan dilatant mai kauri da gogayya)
Ruwa yana bushewa nan take a ƙarƙashin matsa lamba
Gogayya tana dumama garin masara ya zama liƙa
Ƙwayoyin iska suna faɗaɗa a ƙarƙashin bugun
correctAnswer: Karfi mai girma na gogayya yana tilasta garin masara ya makale a juna cikin tsarin crystalline mai tsauri (ruwan dilatant mai kauri da gogayya)
explanation: A cikin ruwan dilatant marar-Newton, saurin matsa lamba mai girma yana tilasta fitar da ruwan dake shimfiɗa tsakanin ƙananan barbashi da ke shawagi, wanda ke haifar da makalewar barbashi na zahiri.

question: Me yasa bututun siphon na roba mai sassauci na yau da kullum ke ci gaba da canja ruwa sama da shinge mai tsayi ko a cikin dakin vakum da aka fitar da iska?
options: Hadin gwiwar kwayoyin ruwa (ƙarfi mai jure ruwa) yana jan ruwan sama a cikin bututun kamar sarkar da ke motsi ci gaba
Matsi na iska yana tura ruwan sama
Ƙarfi nauyi yana jan ma'ajiyar kasa
Aiki na capillary shi kadai ne ke motsa siphon
correctAnswer: Hadin gwiwar kwayoyin ruwa (ƙarfi mai jure ruwa) yana jan ruwan sama a cikin bututun kamar sarkar da ke motsi ci gaba
explanation: Duk da yake matsi na iska yana taimaka wa siphons a iska, gwaje-gwaje sun tabbatar cewa siphons na aiki a cikin babban vakum ta hanyar haɗin ruwa da rashin daidaiton nauyi.

question: Me yasa zoben hayaki ko bindigar vortex ke riƙe siffar donut ɗin ta mai taushi kuma ke tafiya cikin kwanciyar hankali a cikin daki ba tare da bazuwa ba?
options: Juyawar toroidal poloidal na ƙirƙirar iyakar vortex mai ɗauke da matsa lamba wanda ke rage rikice-rikicen gaurayawar da iska ta waje
Hayaki ya fi nauyi fiye da iskar da ke cikin daki
Ƙarfin thermal na samar da ƙirji mai wuya
Ƙarfin nauyi na manne zoben a kwance
correctAnswer: Juyawar toroidal poloidal na ƙirƙirar iyakar vortex mai ɗauke da matsa lamba wanda ke rage rikice-rikicen gaurayawar da iska ta waje
explanation: Gudanarwar ruwa a kusa da ƙwayar zoben na haifar da filin saurin ciki wanda ke tura vortex gaba yayin da laminar shear ke ware shi daga gogayyar daki.

question: Me yasa harsasai mai nauyi na jagora da aka harba cikin toshe injin a gwajin shari'a yake fashe zuwa ƙurar ƙasa maimakon ya riƙe sifar iskaɗaɗɗensa?
options: Saurin raƙuman bugun tasiri ya zarce saurin sauti a cikin jagora, yana canza makamashin kewayawa zuwa canjin matakin ruwa da nika na inji
Jagoran yana narke daga gogewar iska kafin tasiri
Toshe injin yana jan ƙarfe
Fasalin harsashi yana kunna ƙarin lokacin tasiri
correctAnswer: Saurin raƙuman bugun tasiri ya zarce saurin sauti a cikin jagora, yana canza makamashin kewayawa zuwa canjin matakin ruwa da nika na inji
explanation: Tasirin saurin gaske yana haifar da matsin lamba na giga-pascal wanda ya wuce ƙarfin ƙarfe na jagora; ƙarfen yana aiki kamar ruwa marar matsawa da karyewa.

question: Me yasa shakar iskar helium daga kullun taro ke sa murya ta mutum ta yi ƙara mai tsawo da kamar ta zanen kwaikwayo, kodayake igiyoyin murya suna vibrating a ainihin yanayin maƙasudin sautin daidai?
options: Sauti yana tafiya kusan sau uku da sauri a helium mai raɗaɗi ƙasa, yana motsa sautin raɗaɗi na hanyar murya zuwa manyan lokuta masu yawa
Helium yana matse tsokokin igiyoyin murya
Helium yana toshe jijiyoyin larynx
Helium iskar gas ne mai acidic
correctAnswer: Sauti yana tafiya kusan sau uku da sauri a helium mai raɗaɗi ƙasa, yana motsa sautin raɗaɗi na hanyar murya zuwa manyan lokuta masu yawa
explanation: Asalin maƙasudin igiyar murya bai canza ba; duk da haka, sautin raɗaɗi na rami a cikin makogwaron murya yana daidaita da saurin sauti: v_He = 965 m/s vs v_air = 343 m/s.

question: Me ya sa shakar iskar sulfur hexafluoride mai nauyi (SF6) ke sa muryar mutum ta yi sauti mai zurfi sosai, kamar baritone, kuma mai kama da aljannu?
options: Sauti yana tafiya a hankali sosai a cikin iskar SF6 mai nauyi (kimanin 150 m/s), wanda ke sauya muryar resonant cikin zurfin bass
SF6 yana shafar igiyar murya ta yadda take a buɗe
SF6 yana sanyaya larynx har zuwa matakin kankara
SF6 yana dauke da enzymes masu rage sauti
correctAnswer: Sauti yana tafiya a hankali sosai a cikin iskar SF6 mai nauyi (kimanin 150 m/s), wanda ke sauya muryar resonant cikin zurfin bass
explanation: SF6 ya fi iska nauyi sau biyar; raguwar saurin sauti yana matsa tsawon igiyar sauti, yana rage sauyin mitoci na resonant fiye da octave ɗaya.

question: Wanne yanayin thermodynamic na musamman ne ke ba ruwa mai tsarki damar kasancewa a lokaci guda a cikin daidaiton jiki a matsayin kankara mai ƙarfi, ruwa mai ruwa, da tururin ruwa a cikin gilashi ɗaya?
options: Mahimmancin Triple na ruwa (0.01°C a 611.65 Pa)
Mahimmancin Critical na ruwa
Zazzabin sifili na cikakke
Matsakaicin Leidenfrost
correctAnswer: Mahimmancin Triple na ruwa (0.01°C a 611.65 Pa)
explanation: Ta hanyar ƙa'idar matakin Gibbs, ana iya samun matakai uku na wani sinadari mai tsabta a cikin daidaito daidai a sifili darajan 'yanci: 273.16 K da 0.006 atm.

question: Me ya sa ruwan helium-4 da aka sanyaya zuwa ƙasa da 2.17 Kelvin (matakin superfluid) ke hawa kai tsaye sama da saman gilashi na akwati kuma ya zube?
options: Babu kaurin ruwa da haɗin kai na macroscopic na Quantum suna ba da damar ƙananan fim ɗin Rollin ya tsallaka saman bango yana tuka ta ƙarfin yanayin saman
Ruwan helium yana tafasa ya zama iskar gas mai yawa wanda ke taruwa a waje
Helium yana jan gilashi ta ƙarfin nukiliya
Ƙarfin nauyi yana juya alama ƙasa da 2 Kelvin
correctAnswer: Babu kaurin ruwa da haɗin kai na macroscopic na Quantum suna ba da damar ƙananan fim ɗin Rollin ya tsallaka saman bango yana tuka ta ƙarfin yanayin saman
explanation: A ƙasa da lambda point, He-4 yana samar da superfluid kamar Bose-Einstein tare da rashin nuna kaurin ja; shigar van der Waals yana tuka fim ɗin Rollin mai tsawon 30-nm zuwa saman bangon akwati.

question: Me yasa superconductor mai zafin jiki mai yawa ke fitar da dukkan layukan filin maganadisu daga cikin sa kuma yana ja da baya a saman maganadisu na dindindin (tasirin Meissner)?
options: Ana samar da supercurrents na kariya a fuskar sa mara juriya, suna haifar da filin maganadisu na ciki daidai kuma akasin sa
Masu superconductors suna zama manyan maganadisu na dindindin
Maganadisu yana narke saman superconductor
Zazzabi mai ƙasa yana lalata tubalan maganadisu
correctAnswer: Ana samar da supercurrents na kariya a fuskar sa mara juriya, suna haifar da filin maganadisu na ciki daidai kuma akasin sa
explanation: Tasirin Meissner cikakken diamagnetism ne: kwararar wutar lantarki a fuska mara rasa tana haifar da filin B na ciki na sifili, ta kulle layukan flux a sarari.

question: Me yasa niƙa kyankyaso na wintergreen Lifesaver ko ƙwayar sukari mai bushe da pliyar a cikakken duhu ke haifar da haske mai ƙayatarwa na shuɗi-da-kore?
options: Karyewar ƙwayoyin da ba su da daidaito yana raba caji na lantarki wanda ke ionize nitrogen a cikin iska, yana haifar da hasken fluorescence (triboluminescence)
Girgiza yana kunna ƙaramin fashewar sukari
Pliyaren suna haifar da tsananin wutar lantarki daga induction na tsaye
Sukari yana komawa phosphorus mai radiation
correctAnswer: Karyewar ƙwayoyin da ba su da daidaito yana raba caji na lantarki wanda ke ionize nitrogen a cikin iska, yana haifar da hasken fluorescence (triboluminescence)
explanation: Triboluminescence yana faruwa lokacin da fashewar injiniya ta yanke faranti na ƙwayoyin da ba su da daidaito, yana haifar da manyan ƙarar wutar lantarki waɗanda ke sakin kamar ƙaramin walƙiya, suna tayar da fitar da nitrogen.

question: Me yasa na'urar kunna gas mai amfani da piezo-electric ke samar da ƙarfi mai ƙarfi na wutar lantarki kawai lokacin da ja da baya na injin mai ɗorawa ya buge ƙwanƙolin seramik?
options: Matsin lamba na injiniya yana lalata tsarin lattice na ƙwanƙolin seramik mai rashin daidaiton tsakiya, yana ƙirƙirar kilovolt na wutar lantarki piezoelectric
Gudun ja yana buge flint da ƙarfe
Ja da juna yana ƙona biredin seramik
Gudun ja yana samar da canjin lantarki na electromagnetic
correctAnswer: Matsin lamba na injiniya yana lalata tsarin lattice na ƙwanƙolin seramik mai rashin daidaiton tsakiya, yana ƙirƙirar kilovolt na wutar lantarki piezoelectric
explanation: Crystals na Lead zirconate titanate (PZT) suna rashin daidaiton juyawa; bugun matsin lamba na gaggawa yana motsa dipole na ciki, yana samar da 10,000-volt yanayin wutar lantarki

question: Me ya sa Albert Einstein ya lashe Kyautar Nobel a fannin Physics ta shekarar 1921 don bayyana Tasirin Hasken Lantarki maimakon don shahararren Ka'idar Dangantaka?
options: Ya tabbatar da cewa haske yana isar da makamashi a cikin fakitin quantized da aka riga aka ware (photons), wanda ya kaddamar da kimiyyar quantum ta zamani
Kwamitin Nobel sun yi tunanin Dangantaka wani kallo ne kawai
Tasirin Hasken Lantarki ya haifar da bama-bamai na atomic
Dangantaka ta riga ta ci nasara a baya
correctAnswer: Ya tabbatar da cewa haske yana isar da makamashi a cikin fakitin quantized da aka riga aka ware (photons), wanda ya kaddamar da kimiyyar quantum ta zamani
explanation: Einstein ya nuna cewa sakin electron na dogara ne da yawan photon da ke faruwa (E = hf), ba karfin raƙuman ruwa ba, wanda ya kafa duality na raƙuman ruwa-da-particle.

question: A cikin shahararren gwajin rami biyu na quantum, har yanzu harbin kowane electron daya bayan daya ta cikin ramuka biyu masu jere yana haifar da tsarin tsangwama kamar igiyar ruwa a kan allo mai gano abubuwa. Me yasa?
options: Kowane aikin igiyar electron guda yana wucewa ta cikin dukkan ramukan a lokaci guda a cikin haɗin quantum, yana tsangwama da kansa
Electrons suna karo da kwayoyin iska
Allon ganowa yana da maganadisu
Electrons suna rabuwa zuwa rabin jiki
correctAnswer: Kowane aikin igiyar electron guda yana wucewa ta cikin dukkan ramukan a lokaci guda a cikin haɗin quantum, yana tsangwama da kansa
explanation: Hanyoyin quantum suna bada umarni cewa kwayoyin suna yaduwa a matsayin igiyoyin yiwuwar yaduwa (psi); electron daya yana tsangwama da kansa sai dai idan auna ya rushe yanayin.

question: Me ke faruwa a gwajin rami-biyu na quantum idan masu bincike sun sanya na'urar gano abu a ɗaya daga cikin ramukan don gano wane rami electron ɗin ke wucewa ta ciki?
options: Tsarin rukuni-rukuni na igiyar ruwa yana ɓacewa nan da nan, yana maye gurbin sa da sanduna biyu masu sauƙi na harbin kwayar zarra
Electron ɗin sun daina motsi gaba ɗaya
Electron ɗin suna juyawa baya cikin bindiga
Tsarin rukuni-rukuni yana yin haske sau biyu
correctAnswer: Tsarin rukuni-rukuni na igiyar ruwa yana ɓacewa nan da nan, yana maye gurbin sa da sanduna biyu masu sauƙi na harbin kwayar zarra
explanation: Aikin aunawa yana tilastawa rugujewar aikin igiyar ruwa, yana hallaka daidaiton yanayin quantum kuma yana kawar da katsalandan haɗin quantum.

question: Me yasa Albert Einstein ya ƙi amincewa da shahararren tasirin falsafa na haɗin wutar lantarki, yana kiran shi 'aiki mai ban al'ajabi a nesa'?
options: Auna ɗaya daga cikin tarin kwayoyin dake haɗuwa nan da nan yana tantance matsayin ɗayan a duniya mai nisa sama da haske, wanda a fili yake saba ka'idar yanayi mai gida
Ya tabbatar da cewa haɗin wutar lantarki yana saba ka'idar ajiyar kuzari
Kwayoyin da aka haɗa suna haifar da zafi mai yawa
Haɗin wutar lantarki ana haifar da shi ta igiyoyin nauyi
correctAnswer: Auna ɗaya daga cikin tarin kwayoyin dake haɗuwa nan da nan yana tantance matsayin ɗayan a duniya mai nisa sama da haske, wanda a fili yake saba ka'idar yanayi mai gida
explanation: Einstein ya yi imani da gaskiya ta gida; ka'idar Bell da gwaje-gwajen da suka biyo baya sun tabbatar cewa yanayi a asali baya nan gida, suna tabbatar da haɗin wutar lantarki.

question: Dalilin da yasa Ka'idojin Rashin Tabbas na Werner Heisenberg ke cewa ba za ka taɓa sanin duka madaidaicin matsayi da madaidaicin motsi na ƙwayar ƙarama ba a lokaci guda ba shi ne?
options: Matsayi da motsi su ne canje-canje masu haɗi na Fourier da ake sarrafa su ta hanyar masu aiki na quantum da ba sa haɗawa (Delta x * Delta p >= h-bar / 2)
Ba a gina mikroskop ba tukuna da kaifi isasshe
Hasken zafi yana tura ƙwayar mai nisa
Kwayoyin ƙarami suna lalata kayan aunawa
correctAnswer: Matsayi da motsi su ne canje-canje masu haɗi na Fourier da ake sarrafa su ta hanyar masu aiki na quantum da ba sa haɗawa (Delta x * Delta p >= h-bar / 2)
explanation: Ka'idar rashin tabbas ba iyaka ce ga kayan aunawa ba, amma wata dabi'ar raƙuman ruwa ta zahiri na abu ce: guntuwar raƙuman ruwa da aka tanadar tana ɗauke da faɗin tsararren tsawon raƙuman ruwa.

question: Ta yaya na'urorin ajiyar ƙwaƙwalwar kwamfuta na zamani da na'urorin ajiyar wutar lantarki mai ɗorewa (SSDs) ke adana bayanan lantarki a fadin shingen oxide wanda ba zai iya wucewa ba?
options: Electrons suna wuce shingen ta hanyar tunneling na quantum duk da cewa basu da isasshen kuzarin gargajiya don shawo kan tsaunin ƙarfin da ke gabansu
Babban wutar lantarki yana narke ƙananan ramuka cikin oxide
Insulator yana gudanar da wutar lantarki lokacin da akwai zafi
Filayen ƙarfin maganadisu masu tsaye suna jan electrons
correctAnswer: Electrons suna wuce shingen ta hanyar tunneling na quantum duk da cewa basu da isasshen kuzarin gargajiya don shawo kan tsaunin ƙarfin da ke gabansu
explanation: Fowler-Nordheim tunneling yana ba da damar rarraba yiwuwar electrons kamar raƙuman ruwa su shiga cikin laka mai siriri (~10 nm) na oxide silicon.

question: Me yasa faranti biyu na ƙarfe masu madubai, waɗanda ba su da caji, kuma aka goge su sosai da aka sa a jere da nisan nanometer a cikin cikakken fanko suke jan juna da ƙarfin zahiri da za a iya auna (tasirin Casimir)?
options: Ƙananan girgizar komai na quantum mai kama da karye ba za su iya shiga tsakanin faranti masu ƙanƙanci ba kamar yadda suke cikin sararin da ke kewaye, wanda ke haifar da matsa lamba ta ciki na haske.
Filayen maganadisu masu saura a cikin ƙarfen da aka goge sosai.
Lantarki mai tsaye yana jan abubuwan rufin madubi.
Jirgin ƙasa yana ƙara karfi tsakanin madubai masu kusa.
correctAnswer: Ƙananan girgizar komai na quantum mai kama da karye ba za su iya shiga tsakanin faranti masu ƙanƙanci ba kamar yadda suke cikin sararin da ke kewaye, wanda ke haifar da matsa lamba ta ciki na haske.
explanation: Tasirin Casimir yana tabbatar da cewa fanko ba komai bane; sharuɗɗan iyaka suna rage yanayin electromagnetic na zero-point tsakanin farantukan, suna haifar da ƙarfin ciki F ~ 1/d^4.

question: Me ya sa Stephen Hawking ya hango cewa ramukan baƙar fata ba su da cikakkiyar baƙi, amma a hankali suna rasa tarin su kuma a ƙarshe suna ɓacewa a hankali kan lokaci na sararin samaniya (Hawking radiation)?
options: Ma'auratan kwayoyin ƙarfi da rashin ƙarfi kusa da iyakar lokaci suna rabuwa, ɗaya yana faɗuwa cikin rami ɗaya kuma ɗayan yana tserewa a matsayin hasken thermal na gaske
Ramukan baƙar fata suna fitar da ƙwayoyin nucléa ta hanyar bututu
Photons suna tsallaka daga singularity
Iska ta rana tana tura abubuwan ramukan baƙar fata
correctAnswer: Ma'auratan kwayoyin ƙarfi da rashin ƙarfi kusa da iyakar lokaci suna rabuwa, ɗaya yana faɗuwa cikin rami ɗaya kuma ɗayan yana tserewa a matsayin hasken thermal na gaske
explanation: Ka'idar filin quantum a cikin sararin lokaci mai lankwasa ta nuna cewa rabuwa tsakanin ma'auratan vacuum da suke haɗe a cikin iyaka yana saƙa makamashi mara kyau cikin ramin, yana watsa makamashi mai kyau zuwa waje.

question: Wane irin canjin jiki mai ban mamaki zai faru ga ɗan tauraro ɗan adam da ya faɗi ƙafa-da-ƙafa zuwa ga rami mai nauyin tauraro (spaghettification)?
options: Ƙarfin jan hankali mai tsanani zai shimfida ɗan tauraron sama a tsaye ya zama dogon siriri yayin da yake matsawa a kwance
Zai daskare ya zama mutum-mutumi na dindindin
Zai tashi daga fuskar taron abubuwan da suka faru
Zai tarwatse nan take ya zama haske
correctAnswer: Ƙarfin jan hankali mai tsanani zai shimfida ɗan tauraron sama a tsaye ya zama dogon siriri yayin da yake matsawa a kwance
explanation: Ƙimar rarrabewar ruwa d F/d r ~ 1/r^3. Jan hankali a ƙafafu ya fi na kai girma sosai, yana shimfiɗa jiki a tsayin axis radial.

question: Me ya sa babban tarin taurari yake aiki kamar babban gilashin wuce haddi na sararin samaniya, yana lanƙwasa da girman hasken taurarin da ke nesa a bayansa (lanƙwasa nauyi)?
options: Kyakkyawan abu yana lanƙwasa tsarin sararin lokaci da kansa, yana tilasta fitilun haske su bi dogayen hanyoyi masu lanƙwasa
Taurari suna dauke da gilashi manya na maganadisu
Kurar taurari na cikin sararin samaniya tana mayar da haske ciki
Kayan duhu na fitar da igiyoyin laser na mayar da hankali
correctAnswer: Kyakkyawan abu yana lanƙwasa tsarin sararin lokaci da kansa, yana tilasta fitilun haske su bi dogayen hanyoyi masu lanƙwasa
