explanation: Doka ta Gabaɗaya ta Relativity ta bayyana cewa nauyi shi ne lanƙwasa sararin lokaci (G_uv = 8*pi*T_uv). Hasken yana bin hanyoyin geodesic marasa ganewa da suka lanƙwasa a kusa da tarin manyan abubuwa.

question: Me ya sa saman dare yake duhu maimakon ya yi haske kamar fuskar Rana, duk da cewa akwai taurari tiriliyan a kowane bangare (Matsalar Olbers)?
options: Duniya tana da shekaru iyakantacce (biliyan 13.8) kuma tana fadada, tana ja haske da kuma iyakance hangen nesa da za a iya gani
Gurbataccen ƙura yana toshe kashi 100 na hasken taurari
Taurari suna haskakawa ne kawai a lokacin rana
Kayan duhu yana sha duk wani haske mai nisa
correctAnswer: Duniya tana da shekaru iyakantacce (biliyan 13.8) kuma tana fadada, tana ja haske da kuma iyakance hangen nesa da za a iya gani
explanation: Idan duniya ta daina motsi, tana da shekaru marasa iyaka, kuma ba ta da iyaka, kowace layin hangen nesa zai tsaya a kan tauraro. Ƙarfin shekaru da ja hasken sararin samaniya suna warware wannan matsala.

question: Masanin kimiyyar lissafi Enrico Fermi ya shahara da tambaya: 'Idan rayuwar bakar fata mai hankali tana yiwuwa a lissafi a cikin taurari biliyoyi, to ina kowa yake?' Menene ake kira wannan matsalar?
options: Rikicin Fermi
Matsalar Drake
Titin Hubble
Makircin Anthropic
correctAnswer: Rikicin Fermi
explanation: Farma Paradox yana bayyana rashin jituwa tsakanin yawan hasashen yiyuwar kasancewar al'ummomin waje da cikakken rashin shaidar gwaji.

question: Me yasa galaksi masu nisa ke bayyana kamar suna nufin nesa daga Duniya tare da hasken ja a duk hanyoyi, ba tare da Duniya ta zama cibiyar sararin samaniya ba?
options: Sararin samaniya da kansa yana fadada daidai a ko'ina kamar raisins a cikin burodi da yake tashi
Duniya na kore wasu galaksi ta hanyar nauyi
Galaksinmu na motsi da saurin haske
Galaksi suna faɗawa cikin ramin baki
correctAnswer: Sararin samaniya da kansa yana fadada daidai a ko'ina kamar raisins a cikin burodi da yake tashi
explanation: Fadadawar ma'aunin kimiyyar sararin samaniya yana tsawaita sarari da kansa tsakanin abubuwan da ba a ɗaure da nauyi ba; kowane mai kallo na ganin duk galaksi masu nisa suna ja da baya daga wurin da suke duba.

question: Me yasa taurarin da ke cikin gefen waje na tauraron Dan Adam na zagaye suke juyawa da sauri iri ɗaya kamar taurari kusa da tsakiyar galaxy, suna saba wa ka'idar motsi ta Kepler?
options: Galaxies suna da manyan hulunan zagaye na Dark Matter da ba a gani suna samar da ƙarin haɗin ƙarfi
Rami baki a tsakiyar suna juyar da hannu na galaxy
Farfaganda na galaxy yana jan taurari tare
Taurari suna da igiyoyin ƙarfe masu jan su
correctAnswer: Galaxies suna da manyan hulunan zagaye na Dark Matter da ba a gani suna samar da ƙarin haɗin ƙarfi
explanation: Lissafin zagayowar galaxy mai faɗi (gano ta Vera Rubin) yana nuna cewa saurin zagaye ba ya raguwa da nisa (v != 1/sqrt(r)), yana nuna manyan hulunan banbanci na dark matter da ba su haske.

question: Me yasa fuskar Wata ɗaya kawai ke fuskantar Ƙasa koyaushe, tana barin gefen nesa a ɓoye daga masu kallo na duniya?
options: Ƙarfafan juyawar nauyi ya ɓatar da ƙarfin juyawa har sai lokacin juyawar Wata ya yi daidai da lokacin zagayowarsa (rufe da nauyi)
Gefen nesa yana da nauyi sosai don juyawa
Tutar ƙarfe ta Ƙasa ta riƙe Wata
Wata ba ya juyawa a kan axinsa gaba ɗaya
correctAnswer: Ƙarfafan juyawar nauyi ya ɓatar da ƙarfin juyawa har sai lokacin juyawar Wata ya yi daidai da lokacin zagayowarsa (rufe da nauyi)
explanation: Ƙauruwan ruwa na Ƙasa sun yi tasiri ta hanyar jawo nauyi kan Wata tsawon biliyoyin shekaru, suna rage juyawarsa har lokacin zagayowarsa ya yi daidai da juyawar axinsa (1:1 daidaituwa).

question: Me yasa tauraron dan Adam na sarari kamar James Webb Space Telescope ke a matsayi na Lagrange Point L2 (kimanin kilomita miliyan 1.5 daga Duniya) maimakon a zagaye na kasa mai karancin tazara?
options: Karfin nauyi na Duniya da Rana yana daidaita da karfin juyawa, yana ba jirgin sararin samaniya damar kula da madaidaicin zagaye mai kariya daga rana a cikin duhu mai dindindin
L2 ba shi da wani jan hankali daga kowace duniya
Alamomin rediyo suna tafiya nan take daga L2
L2 yana da kariya daga yanayin Duniya
correctAnswer: Karfin nauyi na Duniya da Rana yana daidaita da karfin juyawa, yana ba jirgin sararin samaniya damar kula da madaidaicin zagaye mai kariya daga rana a cikin duhu mai dindindin
explanation: A L2, karfin nauyi na rana da na Duniya suna hade don daidaita gudun zagaye, suna sanya tauraron dan Adam cikin inuwa ta Duniya har abada don kula da sanyaya zurfin cryogenic na infrared.

question: Me yasa hasken gurɓataccen ƙura da wutsiyar ions na cometi ke nunawa kai tsaye daga rana, ko da cometi na tafiya daga rana zuwa sararin samaniya mai nisa?
options: Matsi daga hasken rana da ci gaba da iska mai zafin rana suna tura ƙura da iskar da aka ionize daga cikin rana kai tsaye zuwa waje
Ƙarfi na nauyi yana jan wutsiyar baya
Cometi na barin tarkacen roka a bayansu
Friction da gurɓataccen sarari yana turawa wutsiyar
correctAnswer: Matsi daga hasken rana da ci gaba da iska mai zafin rana suna tura ƙura da iskar da aka ionize daga cikin rana kai tsaye zuwa waje
explanation: Matsi daga photon na rana (matsi daga radiation) da proton na iska mai sauri daga rana suna tura ƙananan abubuwa masu saurin laka kai tsaye, ba tare da la’akari da tsarin saurin cometi ba.

question: Menene ke hana tauraron burtuddan fari mai ƙarfi sosai daga rushewa gaba ɗaya zuwa rami baki ƙarƙashin nauyin jan zarra mai murƙushe kansa?
options: Matsin lamba na karkatar electron da ka'idojin Pauli Exclusion Principle ke haifarwa wanda ke hana fermions iri ɗaya raba halayen quantum
Fashewar haɗin nukiliya a tsakiyar tauraro
Ƙarfafa jan nauyi na ƙarfe mai ƙarfe
Guda na rana da ke busowa daga sararin samaniya
correctAnswer: Matsin lamba na karkatar electron da ka'idojin Pauli Exclusion Principle ke haifarwa wanda ke hana fermions iri ɗaya raba halayen quantum
explanation: Ka'idar lissafin quantum tana ƙayyade cewa electrons ba za su iya zama a cikin wuri ɗaya na phase space daidai ba; matsin su yana samar da babban matsin lamba mara zafi har zuwa iyakar nauyin tauraron rana 1.4.

question: Me ya sa murhun induction ke dumama tukunya ƙarfe zuwa yanayin soyawa cikin 'yan sakanni, yayin da saman gilashi a ƙasa ke ci gaba da sanyi har za a iya taɓa shi lafiya?
options: Filayen maganadisu masu sauyin yanayi masu sauri suna haifar da yanzu-gyarawa da asarar hysteresis na maganadisu kai tsaye a cikin tukunya ƙarfe
Murhun yana fitar da raƙuman microwaves cikin ƙarfe
Gilashin yana jagorantar zafi zuwa ƙasa
ƙarfe yana haifar da abubuwan fashewa na sinadarai
correctAnswer: Filayen maganadisu masu sauyin yanayi masu sauri suna haifar da yanzu-gyarawa da asarar hysteresis na maganadisu kai tsaye a cikin tukunya ƙarfe
explanation: Wani wayar tagulla yana haifar da flux na maganadisu mai sauri (24 kHz); induction na lantarki yana haifar da dumama Joule mai ƙarfi (I^2 * R) kai tsaye a cikin kayan girki masu ƙarfe ferromagnetic.

question: Me yasa tsuntsu zai iya tashi lafiya yana wucewa kusa da hasumiyar gilashi ba tare da wata matsala ba, amma sau da yawa yana bugawa cikin gilashin taga mai tsabta da ke nuna haske sosai?
options: Gilashin da ke nuna haske yana bayyana sararin sama da ganyayyaki a kewaye, yana ƙirƙirar hanyar tashi mai ci gaba wanda ido mai tsuntsaye ba zai iya bambancewa ba
Tsuntsaye ba sa ganin launin haske na gilashi
Gilashin na fitar da nau'ikan amo da ke dagula hankalin tsuntsaye
Tsuntsaye na tashi da idanunsu a rufe
correctAnswer: Gilashin da ke nuna haske yana bayyana sararin sama da ganyayyaki a kewaye, yana ƙirƙirar hanyar tashi mai ci gaba wanda ido mai tsuntsaye ba zai iya bambancewa ba
explanation: Tsuntsaye na fahimtar ganyayyaki da sararin sama da ke cikin gilashi a matsayin fili na gaske a sama, ba su da alamomin tunani don gane shingen filo mai bayyana

question: Me ya sa gaba ɗaya al'umma tana ƙoƙarin adana kuɗi fiye da kima a lokacin koma bayan tattalin arziki a cikin abin mamaki ke haifar da faduwar adadin jimillar ajiyar ƙasa da samun kuɗi (Paradox of Thrift)?
options: Ƙara adanawa yana rage buƙatun masu amfani gabaɗaya, wanda ke rage kuɗaɗen shiga na kasuwanci kuma yana rage jimillar samun kuɗi da ajiyar ƙasa
Bankuna suna kwace ajiyar da ta wuce kima a lokacin koma bayan tattalin arziki
Takardar kuɗi tana narkewa a cikin ma'ajiyar banki
Lokutan koma baya suna canza ajiyar kuɗi zuwa hauhawar farashi
correctAnswer: Ƙara adanawa yana rage buƙatun masu amfani gabaɗaya, wanda ke rage kuɗaɗen shiga na kasuwanci kuma yana rage jimillar samun kuɗi da ajiyar ƙasa
explanation: John Maynard Keynes ya nuna cewa yayin da adanawa yana da hankali ga mutum ɗaya, iftikar tattalin arzikin gabaɗaya yana rage yawan amfani, yana haifar da raguwar samar da tattalin arziki da jimillar ajiyar da aka samu.

question: Me yasa yin zaɓen rinjaye na haɗin gwiwa zai iya haifar da sakamako mai juyayi, mara juyawa inda Dan takara A ya ci B, B ya ci C, amma C ya ci A (Paradox ɗin Condorcet)?
options: Ba lallai ba ne tsarin fifikon mutum ɗaya-ɗaya mai juyawa ya haɗu cikin fifikon rukunin jama'a mai hankali kuma mai juyawa ƙarƙashin ka'idar rinjaye
Masu jefa ƙuri'a suna canza zaɓi a asirce
Injinan zaɓe suna zagaye ƙididdigar kashi
Yan takara suna cin hanci ga masu jefa ƙuri'a a zagaye
correctAnswer: Ba lallai ba ne tsarin fifikon mutum ɗaya-ɗaya mai juyawa ya haɗu cikin fifikon rukunin jama'a mai hankali kuma mai juyawa ƙarƙashin ka'idar rinjaye
explanation: Marquis de Condorcet ya nuna a shekara ta 1785 cewa ko da duk mai jefa ƙuri'a yana da fifiko mai ma'ana da tsari, yin zaɓen rinjaye na kowanne zai iya juyawa ba tare da ƙarewa ba (duƙi-da-duki, takobi-goma), baya da cin nasara mai ɗorewa.

question: Menene Ka'idar Gibbard-Satterthwaite ke tabbatarwa game da kowanne tsarin zabe mai tabbaci da ke da 'yan takara uku ko fiye da bambanci?
options: Dukkan ka'idojin zabe waɗanda ba mulki ɗaya ba suna iya fuskantar dabarun zabe ta hanyar dabarun, inda masu zaɓe ke samun fa'ida ta hanyar bayyana ƙa'idojinsu na gaskiya ba daidai ba
Dukkan zaɓe yana buƙatar zagaye biyu
Takardun jefa ƙuri'a suna hana zabe ta dabarun
Su shugabanni koyaushe suna cin nasara a zaɓen gaskiya
correctAnswer: Dukkan ka'idojin zabe waɗanda ba mulki ɗaya ba suna iya fuskantar dabarun zabe ta hanyar dabarun, inda masu zaɓe ke samun fa'ida ta hanyar bayyana ƙa'idojinsu na gaskiya ba daidai ba
explanation: Ka'idar tana tabbatar da cewa sai dai idan zaɓe shugabanci ne, koyaushe akwai aƙalla yanayi guda ɗaya inda wani mai zaɓe zai iya samun sakamakon da ya fi so ta hanyar jeri mara gaskiya na ɗan takara da bai fi so ba a sama.

question: A cikin hanyar layin bazara ta injiniya da aka shirya a cikin siffar lu'u-lu'u, me ya sa yanke WADNA TSAYE a zahiri wanda ke haɗa bazara biyu ke sa wani nauyi mai nauyi da aka rataya ya ƊAGA maimakon ya fadi (Braess's Spring Paradox)?
options: Yanke igiyar tsakiya yana canza bazarori daga tsarin jerin laushi zuwa tsarin madaidaicin madaidaicin tsauri sosai
Igiyar tana yanke juriya iska
Almakashi na bayar da ƙarfin motsi sama
Bazara tana rasa nauyin nauyi
correctAnswer: Yanke igiyar tsakiya yana canza bazarori daga tsarin jerin laushi zuwa tsarin madaidaicin madaidaicin tsauri sosai
explanation: Wannan shi ne daidaitaccen na’ura na paradox na Braess. Igiyar tana haɗa hanyar a cikin jerin (ta fi karfi wajen miƙewa). Yanke haɗin yana tilasta dukkan rassan bazara biyu cikin ƙarfin madaidaicin madaidaici, yana ninka ƙarfi kuma yana ɗaga nauyin.

question: Me yasa masu sayar da ice cream guda biyu masu fafatawa a bakin teku mai nisan kilomita 1 suke ƙarshe suna kafa kayan sayarwarsu a juna a daidai tsakiyar (Dokar Hotelling)?
options: Matsakaicin Nash na fafatawar wurare: matsawa zuwa tsakiyar yana haɓaka kashi na kasuwa na kowane mai sayarwa a kan yankin abokin fafatawa
Tsakiyar bakin teku tana da yashi mai sanyi
Dokokin yankin suna buƙatar izini na tsakiya
Abokan ciniki suna iyo a tsakiyar kawai
correctAnswer: Matsakaicin Nash na fafatawar wurare: matsawa zuwa tsakiyar yana haɓaka kashi na kasuwa na kowane mai sayarwa a kan yankin abokin fafatawa
explanation: Harold Hotelling ya nuna cewa kamfanoni suna rage bambanci a samfur ko wurare. Idan Mai Sayar A ya kafa a kashi 25%, Mai Sayar B yana kafa a kashi 26% don kama kashi 74% na bakin teku, yana jan duka zuwa tsakiyar kashi 50% Nash equilibrium.

question: Me yasa wani ƙarya na sauti na acoustic da ake kira 'Shepard Tone' ke yin kama da ma'aunin kiɗa wanda ke ci gaba da hauhawa a cikin sautin har abada ba tare da ta taɓa yin ƙasa daidai ba?
options: Wani madauwari na sauti mai ɗaukar lokaci na octave inda sautunan masu ƙarfi ke ɓacewa yayin da sautunan ƙasa ke bayyana ba tare da tsangwama ba
Kunnen ɗan adam yana ƙarewa da sautunan bass
Mai magana yana kunna sautunan supersonic
Ma'aunin acoustic yana amfani da sifili decibels
correctAnswer: Wani madauwari na sauti mai ɗaukar lokaci na octave inda sautunan masu ƙarfi ke ɓacewa yayin da sautunan ƙasa ke bayyana ba tare da tsangwama ba
explanation: Ma'aunin Shepard ya ƙunshi sinusoids da ke rabuwa ta octave waɗanda aka tsara ta hanyar envelope na bell-shaped na dindindin, wanda ke ƙirƙirar ƙarya na sauti kamar barberpole.

question: Me yasa mutum da yake tsaye a cikin ɗakin Ames yake bayyana a matsayin babban mutum a ɗaya kusurwa sannan ya ragu zuwa ƙaramin bawan ƙasa a kusurwar da ke gaba?
options: An gina ɗakin a matsayin trapezoid mara daidaito tare da bene da rufin da suka yi lankwasa, yayin da kallo ta ramin ido ke tilasta kusurwar da ba daidai ba ta murabba'i
ɗakin yana amfani da madubai masu ƙara girma
Kusurwar tana ɗauke da iska mai kauri
Gurbi yana matse mutane a kusurwar
correctAnswer: An gina ɗakin a matsayin trapezoid mara daidaito tare da bene da rufin da suka yi lankwasa, yayin da kallo ta ramin ido ke tilasta kusurwar da ba daidai ba ta murabba'i
explanation: Ɗakin Ames ya lalace a zurfi da tsawo; kallon ramin ido guda yana cire bambancin ido biyu, yana tilasta kwakwalwar yin amfani da ɗakin murabba'i na baya don rikitar da girman ɗan wasan da ake gani.

question: A cikin Illusion na Checker Shadow na Edward Adelson, me ya sa murabba'i A da B ke da haske iri ɗaya, duk da haka masu kallo na ɗan adam suna gani murabba'i A da duhu kuma murabba'i B kusan fari ne?
options: Hankalin kwakwalwa yana gyara atomatik don inuwa da bambancin checkerboard na gida, yana kau da hankali daga haske don kiyaye hasken abu da ake gani
An saita kyamara ba daidai ba
Murabba'i B yana fitar da haske na ciki
Korin ido yana duhu murabba'i A
correctAnswer: Hankalin kwakwalwa yana gyara atomatik don inuwa da bambancin checkerboard na gida, yana kau da hankali daga haske don kiyaye hasken abu da ake gani
explanation: Hanyoyin tsayayyen haske suna cire inuwa na silinda kore da aka gani kuma suna kwatanta murabba'i B da makwabtansa masu inuwa, suna tilasta sanya hasken da ake gani ya yi yawa.

question: A cikin Illolin McGurk, kallo bidiyon wani wanda leɓɓunsa ke motsi da cewa 'ga-ga' yayin da sautin sautin ke kunnawa 'ba-ba' yana sa masu sauraro na ɗan adam jin sabon syllable gaba ɗaya: 'da-da'. Me ya sa?
options: Hankali yana haɗa jayayya sauti da gani na harshe cikin ɗaya mafi dacewa kwarewar phonological mai abubuwa da yawa
Kunne na ɗan adam na yin matsala ƙarƙashin hasken bidiyo
Motsi na baki yana kashe sauti
Matsakaicin sautin murya yana juyawa
correctAnswer: Hankali yana haɗa jayayya sauti da gani na harshe cikin ɗaya mafi dacewa kwarewar phonological mai abubuwa da yawa
explanation: Fahimtar magana tana da hanyoyi da dama; tsagin saman lokaci mai kyau yana haɗa motsin leɓɓan gani da alamu na sauti, yana kirkiro wata matsakaiciyar yarjejeniya ta fonetik ('da').

question: A cikin Illusion na Hermann Grid, me ya sa wuraren duhu masu launin toka suka bayyana a haduwar layuka fari, amma su bace gaba daya idan ka kalli su kai tsaye?
options: Hana aiki na hanyoyin ganglion a gefen retina yana haifar da ragin bambanci a wuraren haduwar hanyoyi hudu.
Hankali baya da ƙwaƙwalwar gefen ido.
Layukan fari suna nuna hasken shuɗi.
Ganin fovea ba shi da launi.
correctAnswer: Hana aiki na hanyoyin ganglion a gefen retina yana haifar da ragin bambanci a wuraren haduwar hanyoyi hudu.
explanation: Filayen da ke karɓar sigina a gefen ido suna da tsarin concentric on-center/off-surround. Haduwar yana da kara wutar layuka fari a kewaye, yana haifar da karin hana aiki da duhun wurin da ake gani.

question: Me yasa kallon wani ƙaramin dige ja da kewaye shi da wani zagaye mai launin shuɗi mara kyau zai sa zagaye shuɗin ya ɓace gaba ɗaya bayan sakan 20 (Rashin bayyana na Troxler)?
options: Matsakaicin abubuwan da ba sa motsi a fadin fagen karɓar hasken ido suna ƙarƙashin daidaituwar jijiyoyin kwakwalwa, suna ɓacewa cikin cike na fahimtar baya
Launin shuɗi yana narke a cikin ruwan ido
Ido yana daina karɓar photons
Hasken ja yana raunana sandunan gani na ido
correctAnswer: Matsakaicin abubuwan da ba sa motsi a fadin fagen karɓar hasken ido suna ƙarƙashin daidaituwar jijiyoyin kwakwalwa, suna ɓacewa cikin cike na fahimtar baya
explanation: Masu karɓar haske suna daidaita ga abubuwan da ba su canza ba a wurin; ƙananan motsi na ido yawanci suna sabunta iyakoki, amma launuka masu laushi ba su da kan iyaka, wanda ke haifar da cikakken saba wa jijiyoyin kwakwalwa.

question: Me yasa kallon saurin agogon analog da hannu na biyu ke motsi yake ba ka wannan tabbacin cewa hannun na biyu ya tsaya cak na tsawon lokaci fiye da dakika daya (Chronostasis)?
options: Saccadic masking yana hana shigar gani yayin motsin ido, kuma kwakwalwa tana dawo da hoton bayan motsin ido don cike gibi na lokaci
Agogo yana dakata yayin da ake kallo
Hanyar hangen nesa tana dakatar da isar da haske
Retina tana fadada yayin motsin ido
correctAnswer: Saccadic masking yana hana shigar gani yayin motsin ido, kuma kwakwalwa tana dawo da hoton bayan motsin ido don cike gibi na lokaci
explanation: Yayin saurin motsin ido (saccades), kwakwalwa tana toshe gani mara kyau; tana mayar da hoton farkon abun da aka gani a baya a cikin lokacin da mutum ke ji.

question: Me yasa ƙaramin ɗigon gilashin narkakke da aka zubar cikin ruwa mai sanyi (ƙãfifen Prince Rupert) ke jure buga zakka mai nauyi a kan bulb ɗinsa, amma ya fashe ya zama foda lokacin da aka yanke ƙaramin wutsiya mai siriri?
options: Matsalolin matsa lamba masu matuƙar ƙarfi suna kewaye babban jiki mai tsananin tensiyon; karyewar wutsiya na sakin wani rauni wanda ke yaduwa a 1.5 km/s
Fitilar an yi ta da titanium mai ƙarfi
Kuwan yana dauke da guba mai fashewa
Ruwan sanyi ya cika cikin gilashin
correctAnswer: Matsalolin matsa lamba masu matuƙar ƙarfi suna kewaye babban jiki mai tsananin tensiyon; karyewar wutsiya na sakin wani rauni wanda ke yaduwa a 1.5 km/s
explanation: Fashewar waje cikin sauri yana kulle gilashin waje cikin matsin lamba na gigapascal yayin da ciki mai laushi ke raguwa cikin matsi mai tsanani; yanke wutsiya yana sakin fashewar tsagewa mai ƙarfi.

question: Me yasa waya da aka lanƙwasa wacce aka yi da Nitinol (hadin gubar-nikiliyum) ke dawo wa cikin tsayayyen tsarin siffa mai rikitarwa na asali lokacin da aka nutsar da shi cikin ruwan zafi?
options: Canjin yanayin kristal mai juyewa daga martensite zuwa austenite mai ɗumi yana dawo da tsarin lattice na kwayoyin asali
Karfe yana narke kuma yana sake tauri
Ruwan zafi yana yin nickel mai jan hankali
Ƙarfin saman ruwa yana gyara wayar
correctAnswer: Canjin yanayin kristal mai juyewa daga martensite zuwa austenite mai ɗumi yana dawo da tsarin lattice na kwayoyin asali
explanation: Nitinol yana fuskantar canjin iyaka na twin mara warwarewa: martensite da aka yi twin a ƙarancin zafi yana canzawa zuwa austenite mai symmetry mai girma sama da yanayin sauyawa.

question: Ta yaya macijin gecko zai iya gudu a ƙasa sama a kan rufi mai gilashi mai sheƙi, mara rami ba tare da amfani da manne mai danshi, kofin jan hankali, ko farce ba?
options: Miliyoyin ƙananan spatulae na keratin a cikin kundin yatsunsa suna haifar da haɗin ƙarfin intermolecular na van der Waals tare da gilashi
Yatsunsu suna haifar da ƙarfin lantarki mai yawa
Kananan ƙyalli suna zurfafa cikin kwayoyin gilashi
Glandolin zufa suna fitar da manne na halitta
correctAnswer: Miliyoyin ƙananan spatulae na keratin a cikin kundin yatsunsa suna haifar da haɗin ƙarfin intermolecular na van der Waals tare da gilashi
explanation: Rassa na setae suna rarrabawa zuwa ɗaruruwan spatulae masu girman nanometer; kusanci na musamman yana kawo biliyoyin kwayoyin halitta cikin nanometers daga gilashi, yana haifar da ɗimbin manne mai ƙarfi na bushe.

question: Me yasa ruwa ke zamewa daga ganyen fure lotus cikin ƙwallaye masu cikakken zagaye, yana ɗauke datti kuma yana kasancewa tsaf ba tare da tabo ba (Tasirin Lotus)?
options: Ƙananan fatar epidermal da aka rufe da ƙwayoyin ƙarfe na epicuticular masu hana ruwa suna rage yawan haɗin kai, suna ƙirƙirar kusurwar haɗin sama da 150°
Ganyen lotus yana fitar da zafi wanda ke tafasa ruwa
Ganyen an rufe shi da mai na fetur
Ƙwayoyin ruwa suna narkar da ma’adanai na ganye
correctAnswer: Ƙananan fatar epidermal da aka rufe da ƙwayoyin ƙarfe na epicuticular masu hana ruwa suna rage yawan haɗin kai, suna ƙirƙirar kusurwar haɗin sama da 150°
explanation: Hali na superhydrophobic na Cassie-Baxter: raƙuman ruwa suna zaune a saman ƙaramin pockets na iska da aka ƙulle tsakanin ƙwayoyin wax, suna zamewa cikin sauƙi kuma suna tattara abubuwa masu ƙazanta.

question: Me ya sa Aerogel (hayaki mai daskarewa)—wanda ya ƙunshi fiye da kashi 99 cikin ɗari na iska marar komai—ke iya kare fata daga wutar kai tsaye ta blowtorch ba tare da yin zafi ba?
options: Cibiyar rami mai ƙananan silica da ke da manyan lanƙwasawa tana hana watsar da zafi, yayin da diamita na ramukan (20 nm) suka fi gajarta fiye da tsawon tafiyar iska (tasirin Knudsen).
Aerogel an yi shi ne da kankara mai ƙarfi.
Blowtorch yana yin gangara daga aerogel.
Iska a cikin aerogel tana juya zuwa ruwan helium.
correctAnswer: Cibiyar rami mai ƙananan silica da ke da manyan lanƙwasawa tana hana watsar da zafi, yayin da diamita na ramukan (20 nm) suka fi gajarta fiye da tsawon tafiyar iska (tasirin Knudsen).
explanation: Tasirin Knudsen: ƙwayoyin gas a cikin ramuka masu 20-nm suna karo da bangarorin ramin maimakon junansu, wanda ke hana dukkan nau'in watsar da zafi ta gas.

question: Me yasa ƙara sabon babbar hanyar mota mai sauri zuwa hanyar birni da tafi cunkoso akai-akai ke sa lokutan tafiyar maziyartan yau da kullum su tsawaita ga kowa (Paradox na Braess)?
options: Zaɓuɓɓukan tuki na son kai zuwa sabon hanya suna kaiwa ga daidaiton Nash da ba na inganci ba wanda ke cika wuraren cunkoso a kusa
Sabon hanyar mota yana rage iyakokin saurin tuƙi
Ana samar da ƙarin motoci nan da nan
Satelayit na GPS suna yin lahani
correctAnswer: Zaɓuɓɓukan tuki na son kai zuwa sabon hanya suna kaiwa ga daidaiton Nash da ba na inganci ba wanda ke cika wuraren cunkoso a kusa
explanation: Lokacin da kowanne direba ya zaɓi mafi gajeren hanyar su ba tare da haɗin kai ba, daidaiton Nash da aka samu yana haifar da jinkirin hanyar sadarwa gaba ɗaya da ya fi wanda yake a baya.

question: Me yasa inganta amfani da makamashi (kamar gina motoci masu amfani da mai cikin inganci) a tarihi ke haifar da karin yawan amfani da mai a kasa baki daya maimakon ragewa (Paradox na Jevons)?
options: Karin inganci yana rage tasirin farashin hidimar, yana haifar da karuwar bukata da amfani gaba daya
Motoci masu amfani da mai cikin inganci suna kone mai da datti
Masu motoci suna mantawa da kashe injina
Kamfanonin mai suna rage karfin man fetur
correctAnswer: Karin inganci yana rage tasirin farashin hidimar, yana haifar da karuwar bukata da amfani gaba daya
explanation: W.S. Jevons ya lura cewa ingancin injin tururi ya rage farashin kwal, wanda ya sa masana’antu suka rungumi amfani da shi, kuma ya ninka yawan kona kwal gaba daya.

question: Me ya sa gwamnatin mulkin mallaka da ta bayar da ladan kudi ga kowace maciji cobra da 'yan kasa suka kawo ta mutu a ƙarshe ta haifar da babban tashin ƙimar yawan macijin cobra a daji (Tasirin Cobra)?
options: ‘Yan kasuwa masu hazaka sun fara kiwon macijin dodanni a gida don tattara ladan; lokacin da shirin ya ƙare, sun saki su a cikin daji
Macizai sun haifu don neman diyya
Lada ta jawo macizai daga sauran nahiyoyi
Macizai sun sami rigakafi ga tarkuna
correctAnswer: ‘Yan kasuwa masu hazaka sun fara kiwon macijin dodanni a gida don tattara ladan; lokacin da shirin ya ƙare, sun saki su a cikin daji
explanation: Ƙwararrun abubuwan ƙarfafawa suna haifar da sakamako marasa kyau: tattalin arzikin ladabi ya ƙarfafa kiwo macizai. Soke ladabin ya rushe kasuwa, yana jawo sakin yawa.

question: Me ya sa ƙoƙarin wani sanannen mutum na shari'a don hana da kuma goge hoton sama na gidansa a bakin teku ya haifar da mutane miliyoyi suna sauke da kallon hoton a duniya baki ɗaya (Tasirin Streisand)?
options: Ƙoƙarin hana bayanai ga jama'a yana jawo babban sha'awar kafofin watsa labarai, wanda ke ƙara kwarewar gani da yawa sosai
Kotu ta ƙunshi cikakken hoton a cikin fayilolin shari'a
Kebul na intanet sun juya bayanai
Mai ɗaukar hoto ya saya dukkan jaridu
correctAnswer: Ƙoƙarin hana bayanai ga jama'a yana jawo babban sha'awar kafofin watsa labarai, wanda ke ƙara kwarewar gani da yawa sosai
explanation: Tasirin Streisand yana nuna martani na tunani: ƙoƙarin tsaurara takunkumi yana canza wani rikodin da ba a sani ba zuwa babban abin sha'awa na duniya.

question: Idan kowace faranti na itacen Jirgin Theseus aka maye gurbin ta ɗaya bayan ɗaya cikin shekaru har sai babu wani asalinsa da ya rage, har yanzu jirgin ɗaya ne?
options: Wani muhimmin rikicin falsafa na asali da ke magana kan ainihi a cikin lokaci ba tare da wani amsar bincike na kimiyya guda ɗaya ba
I, doka tana ganinsa daidai
A'a, sabon abu ne gaba ɗaya
Sai dai idan kapitan bai canza ba
correctAnswer: Wani muhimmin rikicin falsafa na asali da ke magana kan ainihi a cikin lokaci ba tare da wani amsar bincike na kimiyya guda ɗaya ba
explanation: Jirgin Theseus yana duba mahimmancin ɓangaren abu guda ɗaya da ci gaba a sararin lokaci. Idan ɓangarori aka tattara don gina jirgi na biyu, ainihi yana zama abin rigima.

question: Idan mai tafiya cikin lokaci ya koma baya a cikin tarihi kuma ba da gangan ba ya hana kakansa na haihuwa saduwa da kakarsa, yaya zai yiwu mai tafiya ya kasance domin ya koma baya cikin lokaci?
options: Zagaye mai cin karo da kansa wanda ake kira Matsalar Kaka
Mai tafiya cikin lokaci ya koma fatalwa
Duniya tana sake rubuta DNA na kwayoyin halitta
Kaka ta dauki wani mutum
correctAnswer: Zagaye mai cin karo da kansa wanda ake kira Matsalar Kaka
explanation: Rufaffen hanyoyin lokaci (CTCs) suna kalubalantar daidaiton sanadi. Ka'idar Novikov ta daidaituwar kansa tana nuna cewa yiwuwar baya tana daidaita kanta don hana cin karo.

question: Me yasa One-Time Pad (Vernam cipher) aka tabbatar da lissafi cewa ba za a iya karya shi ba kashi 100 cikin ɗari ko da ga abokin gaba mai ƙarfin kwamfuta marar iyaka?
options: Lokacin amfani da mabuɗin gaske na bazuwar da tsawon sa ya yi daidai da rubutun da ake so a sirrinsa kuma an yi amfani da shi sau ɗaya kawai, rubutun sirri baya bayyana wani bayani na Shannon (sirri cikakke)
Ana rubuta mabuɗin cikin tawada na quantum
Lambar tana lalata kwamfutoci
Yana amfani da lambobin farko masu girma fiye da duniya
correctAnswer: Lokacin amfani da mabuɗin gaske na bazuwar da tsawon sa ya yi daidai da rubutun da ake so a sirrinsa kuma an yi amfani da shi sau ɗaya kawai, rubutun sirri baya bayyana wani bayani na Shannon (sirri cikakke)
explanation: Claude Shannon ya tabbatar da sirrin bayanan-lissafi: H(M | C) = H(M). Domin kowace rubutun bayani da tsawon daidai tana da yiwuwar daidai, gwajin tashin hankali yana samar da duk rubutun yiwuwar da ake da shi.

question: Me yasa zamani na tsarin sirri na jama'a (kamar RSA-2048) za a iya fassara shi cikin 'yan dakikoki da mabuɗin sirri, amma yana ɗaukar biliyoyin shekaru a warware shi ba tare da shi ba?
options: Haɗa manyan lambobin farko biyu abu ne mai sauƙi a lissafi, amma samun waɗannan ƙididdigar farko daga samfurinsu matsala ce mai wuyar shawo kanta
Mabuɗin sirri na ɗauke da lambobin asiri na quantum
Mabuɗin RSA suna lalata kwamfutoci da ba a yarda da su ba
Mabuɗin jama'a suna ɓoye tsawon lambobi
correctAnswer: Haɗa manyan lambobin farko biyu abu ne mai sauƙi a lissafi, amma samun waɗannan ƙididdigar farko daga samfurinsu matsala ce mai wuyar shawo kanta
explanation: RSA yana dogara ne akan rashin daidaito a lissafin kidaya na asali: ninka O(1) a madadin rabon sinadarai na gaba ɗaya na lissafin filayen lambobi.

question: Me ya sa Algorithm ɗin Shor da ke gudana a kan kwamfutar ƙididdigar ƙirƙira ke haifar da barazana mai tsanani ga ɓoyayyen maɓallin jama'a na RSA?
options: Yana gano abubuwan farko na manyan lambobi cikin lokaci polynomial ta amfani da sauyawa na Fourier na quantum
Yana hango kalmomin shiga a saurin haske
Yana haifar da zafi a masu sarrafa quantum
Yana kashe kebul ɗin fiber na intanet
correctAnswer: Yana gano abubuwan farko na manyan lambobi cikin lokaci polynomial ta amfani da sauyawa na Fourier na quantum
explanation: Rarrabe abubuwan farko na al'ada yana haɓaka cikin girma mai yawa, amma algorithm ɗin Shor yana amfani da haɗewar quantum da gano lokaci don magance shi cikin lokaci polynomial O((log N)^3).

question: Ta yaya Algorithm na Quantum na Grover yake hanzarta bincike a cikin bayanai marasa tsari na abubuwa N?
options: Yana samar da hanzari na quadratic, yana nemo burin a kusan murabba'in tushen N matakai
Yana duba duk abubuwa cikin lokaci sifili
Yana tsara bayanan ta amfani da haske
Yana kwafi diskin mai wuya
correctAnswer: Yana samar da hanzari na quadratic, yana nemo burin a kusan murabba'in tushen N matakai
explanation: Yayin da karfin tilas na gargajiya yake buƙatar O(N) bincike a matsakaita, algorithm na Grover yana ƙara ƙarfin yiwuwar quantum na yanayin da ya dace a cikin O(sqrt(N)) maimaitawa.

question: A cikin ilimin yiwuwar, me ya sa ake bukatar mutane 23 kawai a cikin ɗaki don samun yuwuwar sama da kashi 50 cikin ɗari cewa mutane biyu za su yi daidai da ranar haihuwarsu (Abin Mamaki na Haihuwa)?
options: Ana kwatanta ma'auratan mutane (ma'aurata 253 daban-daban) maimakon kwatanta mutane guda da wani ranar guda
Shekaru masu tsalle suna da kwanaki 366
Yawancin mutane ana haihuwa a lokacin rani
Mutane suna manta da ainihin ranar haihuwarsu
correctAnswer: Ana kwatanta ma'auratan mutane (ma'aurata 253 daban-daban) maimakon kwatanta mutane guda da wani ranar guda
explanation: Tare da mutane 23, yawan haɗin ma'aurata daban-daban shine 23*22/2 = 253. Yiwuwar kariya ta rashin samun daidaito ta sauka kasa da 0.5.

question: Wane irin ƙarya ta lissafi ne ke faruwa a cikin Rudanin Simpson, inda wani magani yake bayyana a matsayin mafi kyau a cikin kowane rukuni na mutum amma yake zama mara kyau lokacin da aka haɗa bayanan?
options: Wani canji mai rikitarwa yana karkatar da nauyi da girman samfurin rukunan da ke ƙasa
Kwamfutoci suna kuskuren zagaye lambobin lamba
Binciken yana ɗauke da bayanai na fasadi
Matsakaicin bambanci yana sauka zuwa sifili
correctAnswer: Wani canji mai rikitarwa yana karkatar da nauyi da girman samfurin rukunan da ke ƙasa
explanation: Rudanin Simpson yana faruwa lokacin da wani rashin lura na canji mai rikitarwa ya shafi duka rabon rukuni da sakamakon, yana juya hanyar haɗin kai ta gaba ɗaya.

question: A cewar Dokar Benford (Dokar Lamba Ta Farko), me ya sa lambar '1' ke bayyana a matsayin lamba ta farko a cikin bayanai na halitta (kamar tsawon koguna da lissafin kuwace) fiye da kashi 30 cikin dari na lokaci?
options: Al'amuran halitta suna rufe matakai da yawa na girma tare da rarrabewa ta logarithmic da mai zaman kanta daga sikeli
Lamba 1 tana fitowa sosai a gani
Masu duba lissafi suna fifita lambobi marasa yawa
Ƙananan lambobi suna da ƙananan nauyi
correctAnswer: Al'amuran halitta suna rufe matakai da yawa na girma tare da rarrabewa ta logarithmic da mai zaman kanta daga sikeli
explanation: Bayanan da ba su dogaro da sikeli suna bin rarrabewar logarithmic P(d) = log10(1 + 1/d), ma'ana daga 1 zuwa 2 yana buƙatar haɓaka 100%, yayin da daga 8 zuwa 9 yana buƙatar kawai 12.5%.

question: Me yasa Giɗan Gabriel (Kahon Torricelli)—wanda ake samarwa ta hanyar juyar da y = 1/x don x >= 1 a kusa da x-axis—ake kiran sa da 'Ƙulsar Mai Zane'?
options: Yana da ƙarfin ciki na ainihi na pi cubic, amma yana da saman waje mara iyaka
Ba za a iya riƙe shi da hannu ba
Fentin yana ɓacewa nan take a ciki
Sashin yanki nasa yana da murabba'i
correctAnswer: Yana da ƙarfin ciki na ainihi na pi cubic, amma yana da saman waje mara iyaka
explanation: Babbaƙin lissafi na ƙarar ciki yana haɗuwa zuwa pi, yayin da lissafin yankin saman yana tashi zuwa babu iyaka; a ka'idar za a iya cika shi da laka pi, amma ba za a iya shafa shi a waje ba.

question: Me ya sa Banach-Tarski Paradox ke bayyana cewa za a iya yanke ƙwallon lissafi mai ƙarfi zuwa sassa 5 masu zaman kansu sannan a sake haɗa su zuwa ƙwallaye biyu daidai waɗanda suka yi daidai da asalin ƙwallon a girma?
options: Rarrabuwar tana dogara ne akan saitunan da ba za a iya aunawa ba da aka ƙirƙira ta amfani da Axiom na Zaɓi wanda ba a gina shi ba
Ƙwallaye an yi su ne daga sararin atomatik mara komai
Sassan suna faɗaɗa bayan yankewa
Ƙarfi na jan hankali yana maimaita abu
correctAnswer: Rarrabuwar tana dogara ne akan saitunan da ba za a iya aunawa ba da aka ƙirƙira ta amfani da Axiom na Zaɓi wanda ba a gina shi ba
explanation: Sassan suna da iyakokin laka, saituna da ba za a iya aunawa ba da ba a ƙayyade girman Lebesgue. Juyawa waɗannan saitunan da ba za a iya aunawa ba a cikin 3D yana haifar da ƙwallaye biyu daidai cikakku.

question: A cikin Matsalar Gefen Ruwa, me yasa auna iyakar ƙasa ta Burtaniya ke girma sosai yayin da ƙananan ma'aunin da kake amfani da shi ke ƙanƙanta?
options: Gefen ruwa suna nuna kama da kansu na fractal, ma'ana ƙananan sandunan auna suna kama ƙananan gabar ruwa da ramuka har abada
Ruwan teku yana faɗaɗa ƙasar a kowane awa
Ƙananan sanduna suna shimfiɗa a ƙarƙashin danshi
Masu zanen taswirori suna karkatar da layukan iyaka
correctAnswer: Gefen ruwa suna nuna kama da kansu na fractal, ma'ana ƙananan sandunan auna suna kama ƙananan gabar ruwa da ramuka har abada
explanation: Benoit Mandelbrot ya tabbatar cewa gefen ruwa suna da girman fractal fiye da 1. Yayin da tsawon sandar ma'auni epsilon ke matsawa zuwa sifili, jimillar iyaka tana nufin zuwa marar iyaka.

question: A cikin Rikicin Zeno na Achiles da Gwamba, me ya sa Achiles mai sauri yake cinye gwamba mai jinkiri a lissafi a duniyar zahiri duk da rarrabuwa mara iyaka na nisa?
options: Jerin lambobi na geometric mara iyaka na nisan da lokuta masu raguwa suna hade zuwa adadi mai iyaka
Achiles yana taka kan gwamba
Gwamba na gajiya kuma yana tsayawa
Sarari yana daina wanzuwa a matakan ƙanana
correctAnswer: Jerin lambobi na geometric mara iyaka na nisan da lokuta masu raguwa suna hade zuwa adadi mai iyaka
explanation: Achiles yana rufe tazarar da suke samar da ci gaba na geometric mara iyaka. Saboda sum(1/2^n) yana hade zuwa 1, duka jimlar nisa da jimlar lokacin da ya shude suna kasancewa da iyaka sosai.

question: A cikin Mahadjiyar Kogin Zeno, kibiya a cikin tashi tana tsayaye a kowane lokaci na ɗan lokaci. Me ya sa har yanzu take tafiya a sararin samaniya?
options: Gudun lokaci ɗaya shine banbancin matsayi dangane da lokaci; motsi yana wanzuwa a cikin tazara mai buɗewa, ba a wurare guda ba
Iska na ɗaukar kibiya
Maƙentin yana lanƙwasar sararin jiki
Idon mutum yana ganin kibiyoyi na aljanna
correctAnswer: Gudun lokaci ɗaya shine banbancin matsayi dangane da lokaci; motsi yana wanzuwa a cikin tazara mai buɗewa, ba a wurare guda ba
explanation: Motsi dangantaka ce tsakanin wurare daban-daban a lokuta daban-daban. Kamar yadda lissafin ke tabbatarwa, gudu shine iyaka na Delta x / Delta t yayin da Delta t ke kusantar sifili, ba sifili ta dindindin ba.

question: A cikin Rashin Kama-da-parrondo, yaya canzawa ba a tsammani tsakanin wasanni biyu na caca daban-daban—dukansu waɗanda lissafi ya tabbatar da cewa wasanni ne masu hasara idan an yi su da kansu—zai iya haifar da wasa da yake samun riba koyaushe?
options: Bayar da martani mara layi da canjin yanayi mai dogaro da babban birnin kasuwanci suna gabatar da karkatarwa zuwa ribar net
Kasinon suna yin kuskuren kirga
Kwallon fare ta lalace a lokaci
Gidan yana rage haraji
correctAnswer: Bayar da martani mara layi da canjin yanayi mai dogaro da babban birnin kasuwanci suna gabatar da karkatarwa zuwa ribar net
explanation: Kamar yadda Brownian ratchet yake a cikin lissafi na physics, rarraba yanayin da ke dogaro a Wasan B yana canza rabon yanayin dindindin, yana mayar da rikice-rikice biyu marasa kyau zuwa wani rikice mai kyau.

question: A cikin Matsalar St. Petersburg, ana juyar da tsabar kudi mai adalci har sai da kai ya bayyana a juyawar n, yana biyan dala 2^n. Me yasa mutane masu hankali ba sa son biyan fiye da $20 don yin wasa, duk da cewa kimar da ake tsammani a lissafi ba ta da iyaka?
options: Amfanin ɗan Adam na dukiya yana nuna ragin riba na gefe, kuma bankunan gaske suna da iyakar dukiya
Mutane ba sa son wasannin tsabar kudi
Kai ba ya bayyana bayan juyawar 5
Juyawar na ɗaukan lokaci mara iyaka
correctAnswer: Amfanin ɗan Adam na dukiya yana nuna ragin riba na gefe, kuma bankunan gaske suna da iyakar dukiya
explanation: Daniel Bernoulli ya warware wannan ta amfani da amfani logarithmic: amfanin samun biliyoyi yana kusantar wani matsayi na ƙarshe, kuma babu wani abu na zahiri da ke da dukiya mara iyaka don biyan manyan kuɗaɗe.

question: A Matsalar Newcomb, wani mai hango abubuwa ba tare da kuskure ba ya bar Box A ($1,000) da Box B ($1,000,000 idan an hango zaka dauki B kawai; komai idan an hango zaka dauki duka). Me ya sa ka'idar yanke shawara ke rabuwa tsakanin ɗaukar akwati ɗaya da ɗaukar duka?
options: Ka'idar Yanke Shawara ta Causa tana cewa kudin tuni an sanya shi a ciki, yayin da Ka'idar Yanke Shawara ta Shaida tana cewa zabenka yana da alaƙa da hasashen.
Box B yana da ƙasa mai gani
Mai hasashen yana yin damfara da madubai
Box A yana dauke da kudin jabu
correctAnswer: Ka'idar Yanke Shawara ta Causa tana cewa kudin tuni an sanya shi a ciki, yayin da Ka'idar Yanke Shawara ta Shaida tana cewa zabenka yana da alaƙa da hasashen.
explanation: Masu ka'idar yanke shawara ta causa suna ɗaukar akwatin biyu saboda abubuwan da ke cikin akwatin an sanya su a cikin baya kuma ba za a iya canza su ta hanyar causa ba. Masu ka'idar shaida suna ɗaukar akwatin ɗaya don maksimize ƙimar da ake tsammani.

question: A cikin Matsalar Kyakkyawar Barci, an sanya Kyakkyawa a barci kuma an farke ta a ranar Litinin (kuma har ranar Talata idan tsabar kudi ta nuna Guda, tare da share tunaninta). Bayan farkewa, menene tunanin kanta na yiwuwar cewa tsabar kudin ta nuna Guda?
options: 'Masu Rabin' suna cewa yiwuwar farko har yanzu ita ce 1/2, yayin da 'Masu Uku' ke cewa tana cikin ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan farkewa guda 3 da suka yi yiwuwar daidai (1/3).
Ta kirga daidai 3/4
Yiwuwar ta ta ragu zuwa sifili
Ana hana jefa tsabar kudi
correctAnswer: 'Masu Rabin' suna cewa yiwuwar farko har yanzu ita ce 1/2, yayin da 'Masu Uku' ke cewa tana cikin ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan farkewa guda 3 da suka yi yiwuwar daidai (1/3).
explanation: Masu Uku sun nuna cewa akwai yanayi guda uku na farkewa da ba a iya bambancewa (Litinin/Guda, Litinin/Guda baya, Talata/Guda baya), wanda ke sa Guda ya zama 1/3. Masu Rabin suna cewa ba a samu wani sabon shaida mai mahimmanci ba.

question: A cikin Matsalar Manyan Leffin Biyu, Leffin A yana ɗauke da $X kuma Leffin B yana ɗauke da ko dai $2X ko $X/2. Me ya sa ribar da ake tsammani daga canzawa (1.25 * X) ba ta da tushe?
options: Yana ɗauka kuskure cewa akwai rarraba yiwuwar daidai a dukkanin sararin lambobi masu kyau marasa iyaka
Leffin na biyu koyaushe babu komai
Kudi na raguwa a cikin leffin
Ba za a iya buɗe leffin ba
correctAnswer: Yana ɗauka kuskure cewa akwai rarraba yiwuwar daidai a dukkanin sararin lambobi masu kyau marasa iyaka
explanation: Rarraba yiwuwar daidai a kan dukkanin lambobi masu kyau ba ta dace da lissafi. Duk wata rarraba yiwuwar da za a iya haɗawa ta gaskiya tana kawar da ribar da ake tsammani daga canzawa.

question: A cikin Matsalar Tsuntsun Hempel, me yasa lura da tuffa kore a kan teburin girkin ku yake zama hujjar Bayesian ga zato cewa 'Dukkan tsuntsaye baƙi ne'?
options: 'Dukkan tsuntsaye baƙi ne' ya daidai da ƙaryar sa: 'Duk abubuwan da ba baki ba, ba tsuntsaye ne'
Tuffa da tsuntsaye suna da DNA ɗaya
Tuffa kore suna zama baki lokacin da suka yi balaga
Gidajen girki suna jan hankalin tsuntsaye
correctAnswer: 'Dukkan tsuntsaye baƙi ne' ya daidai da ƙaryar sa: 'Duk abubuwan da ba baki ba, ba tsuntsaye ne'
explanation: Ta hanyar ƙaryar, 'Dukkan tsuntsaye baƙi ne' (R -> B) ya yi dai-daima da (~B -> ~R). Wani abu da ba baki ba kuma ba tsuntsu ba (tuffa kore) yana tabbatar da ƙaryar, kodayake canjin Bayesian na baya baya yana da ƙananan ƙima sosai.

question: A cikin rikicin 'Grue' na Nelson Goodman, me yasa ayyana ma'anar kalma 'grue' (koraye kafin shekarar 2050, shuɗi bayan haka) ke kalubalantar tushen ilimin kimiya?

explanation: Goodman ya nuna cewa induction na buƙatar ƙa'idodi don ma'anoni 'da za a iya hasashen su'. Bayanai na bincike na baya ba za su iya bambance dokoki na har abada da ma'anoni masu sharuɗɗan lokaci ta hanyar lissafi ba.

question: A cikin Matsalar Ratayuwar Ba Zata ba, alkali ya yanke wa ɗan gidan yari hukuncin ratayawa a ranar aiki da rana, amma ya yi alkawarin cewa ranar zai zama mamaki kwata-kwata. Me ya sa amfani da tunanin baya ya kasa ceton ɗan gidan yari?

Alkali ya soke hukuncin kisa
Gidan yari yana da kwanaki 3 kacal

correctAnswer: Mamaki wani yanayi ne na ilimi; shaidar ɗan gidan yari ta rashin yiwuwar hakan faruwa yana sa Juma'a (ko kowace rana) ta zama mamaki na gaske
explanation: Ɗan gidan yari ya gano cewa ba zai iya faruwa a Juma'a ba, sannan Alhamis, da sauransu, har ya kai ga karshe cewa ba zai yiwu ba. Lokacin da aka rataye shi a Laraba, ya kasance cikin mamaki sosai, wanda ya tabbatar da hukuncin alkalin.

question: A cikin Dilemma na Fursuna, me ya sa 'yan wasa masu hankali biyu suke ƙarewa da yin laifi kuma suna samun sakamako mafi muni fiye da idan dukansu sun kasance shiru?

explanation: Babu la'akari da abin da abokin tarayya ya zaɓa, yin laifi na kawo mafi kyawun lada ga kowane mutum. Tunda duka suna tunani a hankali, suna kaiwa ga yin laifi tare, wanda shi ne mafi muni ga dukansu.

question: A cikin wasan dabarun Stag Hunt, me yasa 'yan wasa za su iya zaɓar yin farauta kan ƙanana Hare su kaɗai maimakon su haɗa kai don farauta babban Stag?
options: Yin farauta kan Hare yana da rinjaye na haɗari kuma baya buƙatar amana, yayin da farautar Stag tana da rinjaye na samun lada amma tana da rauni ga sallama.

explanation: Haɗin kai kan farautar stag yana ba da mafi girman lada ga kowa, amma idan abokin ya daina wasa, mai farautar da ya rage yana jin yunwa. Yin farautar hare yana ba da tabbacin rayuwa shi kaɗai ba tare da amincewa ba.

question: Me yasa littafin Garrett Hardin mai suna 'Tragedy of the Commons' ke haifar da amfani da ciyayi na jama'a ko kamun kifi a teku har sai an yi musu amfani fiye da kima kuma aka kare su?

Gwamnati tana umurtar yin amfani fiye da kima

explanation: Duk mai kiwo mai hankali yana samun +1 amfani ga kowanne shanu da aka ƙara, yayin da lalacewar ciyayi ana raba shi ga dukkan masu kiwo, wanda ke ƙarfafa cin amfanin mutum ɗaya ba tare da iyaka ba.

question: A cikin wasan 'Dollar Auction' na Martin Shubik, me ya sa masu tayar da hankali ke yawan yin tayi $2, $3, ko ma $5 don siyan takardar dala $1 guda?

question: A Cikin Wasan Centipede, hasashen juyin baya yana nuni da cewa masu wasa masu hankali za su kawo karshen wasan a juyin farko. Me ya sa?

explanation: Sanin cewa abokin hamayya zai yi yaudara a mataki na 100 don samun riba mafi yawa, ɗan wasa na 1 yana yin yaudara a mataki na 99, wanda hakan yana sa ɗan wasan ɗaya ya yi yaudara a mataki na 98, yana rushe haɗin kai gaba ɗaya zuwa mataki na 1.

question: Wane son zuciyar mutum na fahimta ake bayyana ta hanyar Allais Paradox, inda mutane suka fi son a ba su dalar Amurka miliyan 1 da tabbaci fiye da caca 89 cikin ɗari don fiye da haka, wanda ke keta tsarin tsammanin amfani?

correctAnswer: Tasirin tabbaci: mutane suna ba da muhimmanci sosai ga tabbaci kuma suna nuna nauyin yuwuwar da ba layi ba kusa da cikin ɗari 100
explanation: Maurice Allais ya nuna cewa son haɗarin ɗan adam yana keta ka'idar 'yancin kai. Jin daɗi na kwakwalwa na tabbacin 100% ana sanya masa ƙima sosai fiye da ƙaramin haɗarin 1% na rashin wani abu.

question: A cikin Matsalar Ellsberg, me ya sa mutane suke son yin caca a kan wuri mai kwando da ke dauke da kwallayen ja 50 da baki 50 fiye da wurin da ke dauke da kwallaye 100 wadanda ba a san launin su ba?

explanation: Daniel Ellsberg ya nuna cewa mutane suna bambance haɗari (yiwuwar da aka sani) da rashin tabbas na Knight / rashin tabbas (yiwuwar da ba a sani ba), suna ƙin yin caca a kan abubuwan da ba a sani ba.

question: Me yasa yin imani da cewa gurin roulette da ya tsaya a Ja sau 10 a jere yana 'cika' don ya tsaya a Baki ake kira Kurakuran Mai Caca?
options: Abubuwan da suka faru daban-daban ba su da ƙwaƙwalwa; yiwuwar sauka a Ja ko Baki tana nan daidai 50 cikin dari a kowane juya guda
Gurin roulette yana sake saita maganadisu
Mai siyarwa yana canza ƙwallon

explanation: Kadan ko gurin roulette ba shi da wani tsarin ƙwaƙwalwa na zahiri. Yin imani cewa dogon tsari yana shafar gwaje-gwaje na gaba masu zaman kansu yana cakuda dokar manyan lambobi da daidaitawa na gida.

question: Me ya sa gwajin likita da ke da daidaito na kashi 99 cikin ɗari ga cuta mai wuya da ke shafar mutum 1 cikin 10,000, kawai yake nuna kusan kashi 1 cikin ɗari damar ainihin samun cutar idan sakamakon gwajin ya nuna positivo?
options: Rashin lura da yawan faruwa: mafi yawan gwaje-gwaje masu kyau a cikin mutane lafiya suna nuna sakamakon ƙarya positivo
Gwajin yana amfani da sinadarai da suka ƙare wa'adi
Likitoci suna fassara samfurin jini ba daidai ba
Marar lafiya yana da ƙarfin garkuwar jiki sosai
correctAnswer: Rashin lura da yawan faruwa: mafi yawan gwaje-gwaje masu kyau a cikin mutane lafiya suna nuna sakamakon ƙarya positivo
explanation: A cikin mutane 10,000, 1 na da cuta (gaskiya positivo) yayin da kusan mutane 100 lafiyayyu suka nuna gwaji na ƙarya positivo (1% na 9,999). Saboda haka, P(Mara lafiya | Positivo) = 1 / (1 + 100) ~ 1%.

question: Me yasa masani kan lissafi Abraham Wald ya ba da shawarar ga sojojin Amurka su ƙara manyan kayan kariya a sassan jiragen yakin da ba su lalace ba na dawowar jiragen yaƙi maimakon inda aka sami ramukan harbi?
options: Rashin la'akari da masu rayuwa: jiragen da aka harba a injin da wurin tuƙi sun rushe ba tare da dawo ba; jiragen da suka dawo sun nuna inda harbin bai zama na kisa ba
Sanya kayan kariya a kan fikafikan jirgin ya sanya jiragen su tashi baya
Ramukan harbi sun sa jiragen su zama masu sauƙin tashi a iska
Masu gyara sun sami iyakacin adadin rivets
correctAnswer: Rashin la'akari da masu rayuwa: jiragen da aka harba a injin da wurin tuƙi sun rushe ba tare da dawo ba; jiragen da suka dawo sun nuna inda harbin bai zama na kisa ba
explanation: Wald ya gane cewa jiragen da suka dawo suna wakiltar wani samfurin masu rayuwa da ke da son rai. Wuraren da babu ramukan harbi a kan masu rayuwa (inji, wurin tuƙi) sune wuraren da harbin ke da haɗari sosai.

question: A cikin Aikin Zaɓen Wason, me ya sa fiye da kashi 80 cikin 100 na mutane ke kasa gwada ƙa'idar 'Idan kati yana nuna sauti a gefe ɗaya, dole ne ya nuna lamba mai ma'ana a ɗayan gefe' tare da katuna [A, K, 4, 7]?
options: Son tabbaci: mutane suna juya kati '4' don tabbatar da ƙa'idar maimakon juya '7' don ƙoƙarin ƙaryata ta (modus tollens)
Mutane suna rikita haruffa da lambobi
Katuna suna da baya fanko
Lambobi masu ma'ana suna sa'a
correctAnswer: Son tabbaci: mutane suna juya kati '4' don tabbatar da ƙa'idar maimakon juya '7' don ƙoƙarin ƙaryata ta (modus tollens)
explanation: Ƙa'idar ita ce P -> Q. Don gwada ta, dole ne a duba P (kati 'A') ba -Q (kati '7') ba. Juya '4' (Q) yana aikata tabbatar da sakamakon kuma baya iya ƙaryata ƙa'idar.

question: A cikin Tsarin Hasashe, me ya sa mutane ke fuskantar kusan ninki biyu na radadin tunani daga rasa $100 fiye da jin daɗin samun $100?
options: Rashin so: ayyukan kimanta mutum suna da tsauri a cikin yankin mara kyau fiye da yankin mai kyau
Kudin na ƙonawa a fata
Asarori suna da haraji mafi girma
Bankuna suna cajar kuɗaɗen da aka rasa
correctAnswer: Rashin so: ayyukan kimanta mutum suna da tsauri a cikin yankin mara kyau fiye da yankin mai kyau
explanation: Kahneman da Tversky sun tabbatar cewa ƙima tana bayyana a kan samun da asara dangane da wani wurin tunani. Kaurin rashin so na asara lambda yawanci yana tsakanin 1.5 da 2.5.

question: Me yasa Tasirin Dunning-Kruger ke sanya masu farawa da ƙarancin ƙwarewa a wani fanni su yi ƙididdigar ƙarfi fiye da gaske game da iyawarsu?
options: Rashin ƙwarewar tunani na metacognitive da ake buƙata don yin aiki yadda ya kamata kuma yana hana su gane ƙarancin ƙwarewarsu
Masu farawa suna karanta littattafai da yawa sosai
Kwararru suna yin ƙarya ga masu farawa
An tsara jarrabawa sosai cikin sauƙi
correctAnswer: Rashin ƙwarewar tunani na metacognitive da ake buƙata don yin aiki yadda ya kamata kuma yana hana su gane ƙarancin ƙwarewarsu
explanation: Dunning da Kruger sun gano cewa marasa iyawa suna fama da la'ana biyu: rashin ƙwarewarsu yana haifar da kuskure, kuma ƙarancinsu a ƙwarewa yana hana su tantance inganci daidai.

question: Me yasa bayyana wani lamba na farko ba tare da shiri ba (kamar juyar da dabaran roulette) yake canza ƙididdigar ƙididdiga na masu shari'a da masu sasanta rikici sosai (Alamar Anfani)?
options: Hankali yana ɗaure kan ƙimar farko kuma yana yin gyare-gyare marasa isa a tsawon layin tunani na mutum
Manyan lambobi suna sa bacci
Alamar tana share ƙwaƙwalwar lissafi
Masu shari'a basa son lissafi
correctAnswer: Hankali yana ɗaure kan ƙimar farko kuma yana yin gyare-gyare marasa isa a tsawon layin tunani na mutum
explanation: Tversky da Kahneman sun nuna cewa mutane suna gyara ƙididdigarsu daga alamar har sai sun kai ga iyakar yiyuwar, suna dakatar da gyara a wuri da wuri.

question: Me yasa koyo cewa mutum yana da kyau a jiki ko yana da kirki ke sa mutane su yi tsammani cewa su ma suna da basira, gaskiya, da kwarewa (Tasirin Halo)?
options: Kyakkyawan ra'ayi a wani hali yana haifar da wata dabara ta fahimta gabaɗaya da ke la'akari da duk wasu kimantawa ba tare da alaka ba cikin kyau
Mutane masu kyau suna yin karatu sosai
Kyau yana nuna sahihancin gado kai tsaye
Gaskiya yana inganta daidaiton fuska
correctAnswer: Kyakkyawan ra'ayi a wani hali yana haifar da wata dabara ta fahimta gabaɗaya da ke la'akari da duk wasu kimantawa ba tare da alaka ba cikin kyau
explanation: Edward Thorndike ya gano tasirin halo a matsayin yanayin inda gabaɗayan ra'ayi game da mutum ke shafar yadda muke ji da kuma tunani game da halayensa a fannoni marasa alaka.

question: Me ya sa mutane da dama da ke kallo ba su yi shiga tsakani ko kira ga ayyukan gaggawa ba yayin rikice-rikicen lafiya a bainar jama'a (Tasirin Mai Kallo)?
options: Rarraba alhakin: kasancewar masu kallo da yawa yana rage fahimtar kowanne mutum na wajibi na yin aiki
Masu kallo duk suna da mummunan hali
Lambobin gaggawa sun toshe a cikin taron jama'a
Adrenalin yana kashe dukkan tsokoki
correctAnswer: Rarraba alhakin: kasancewar masu kallo da yawa yana rage fahimtar kowanne mutum na wajibi na yin aiki
explanation: Darley da Latane sun tabbatar cewa rashin shiga tsakani na masu kallo ya samo asali ne daga rarraba alhakin da jahilcin jama'a: ganin wasu suna kwanciyar hankali yana tabbatar da masu kallo cewa abin bai gaggawa ba ne.

question: A cikin gwaje-gwajen biyan kishi na Solomon Asch, me ya sa kashi 75 cikin ɗari na mahalarta suka bi amsar rukuni wadda a bayyane ba daidai ba game da tsayin layuka a kalla sau ɗaya?
options: Tasirin zamantakewa na al'ada da na bayani: ƙarfin motsin zuciya na ƙarfi don gujewa ƙin karɓar jama'a ko shakkar hangen nesa na mutum
Mahalarta sun sami astigmatism kwatsam
'Yan wasan kwaikwayo sun firgita mahalarta ta jiki
Katinan sun kasance a wajen da ba a mai da hankali ba
correctAnswer: Tasirin zamantakewa na al'ada da na bayani: ƙarfin motsin zuciya na ƙarfi don gujewa ƙin karɓar jama'a ko shakkar hangen nesa na mutum
explanation: Asch ya nuna ƙarfin tasirin abokan zama. Mahalarta sun ji tsoron a ɗauke su a matsayin masu ban mamaki, yayin da wasu kuma suka yi shakku da hukuncin hangen nesansu kan rikon amincewa ɗaya.

question: Me yasa kashi 65 na mahalarta na yau da kullum a cikin gwajin Stanley Milgram suka yi abin da suka yi imani yana iya zama haramtacce ta hanyar ba da wutar lantarki mai ƙarfin 450-volt ga mutum marar laifi?
options: Bin umarnin iko: shiga cikin 'halin wakili' inda mutane ke mika alhakin ɗabi'a ga mutumin da ake ganin shi mai iko ne
Masu gwajin sun kasance masu son zuciya na musamman
Wutar lantarkin da aka bayar ta kasance gas din dariya
Dakin gwaji ya biya manyan cin hanci
correctAnswer: Bin umarnin iko: shiga cikin 'halin wakili' inda mutane ke mika alhakin ɗabi'a ga mutumin da ake ganin shi mai iko ne
explanation: Milgram ya nuna cewa a ƙarƙashin umarnin babban mutum mai iko wanda ke sanye da riga na dakin gwaji, alhakin ɗabi'a yana ɓacewa yayin da masu gwajin ke kallon kansu a matsayin kayan aikin iko kawai.

question: A cikin gwajin rashin daidaiton fahimta na Leon Festinger, me yasa masu gwaji da aka biya $1 kawai don yin ƙarya suka bayyana cewa sun fi jin daɗin aikin juyar da kwallo mai ban haushi fiye da masu gwaji da aka biya $20?
options: Don warware rikicin ciki na tunani ba tare da hujjar kuɗi ba, sun canza ra'ayinsu na ciki don su yi dalilin ƙaryar
Takardun dala ɗaya suna ɗauke da turare
Dala ashirin sun sa masu gwaji zama masu shakkar gaskiya
Kwallon ta zama mai laushi
correctAnswer: Don warware rikicin ciki na tunani ba tare da hujjar kuɗi ba, sun canza ra'ayinsu na ciki don su yi dalilin ƙaryar
explanation: Ladabi na dala $20 ya bayar da hujja ta waje mai isa don yin ƙarya. Ladabi na $1 ya haifar da rashin daidaituwa tsakanin hoton kai da ƙaryar, yana tilastawa masu gwaji su tabbata da kansu cewa aikin yana da daɗi.

question: Me yasa fiye da kashi 90 cikin ɗari na direbobi masu lasisi ke kimanta ƙwarewar tuƙinsu a matsayin 'sama da matsakaicin matsakaici' (Tasirin Lake Wobegon)?
options: Babbar tunanin da ba gaskiya ba: mutane suna ayyana ƙa'idodin kimantawa masu rikitarwa ta amfani da ƙarfi na musamman na kansu
Na'urorin sauri suna nuna sama
Direbobin matsakaita suna rasa lasisinsu
An gina manyan tituna a ƙasa
correctAnswer: Babbar tunanin da ba gaskiya ba: mutane suna ayyana ƙa'idodin kimantawa masu rikitarwa ta amfani da ƙarfi na musamman na kansu
explanation: Mutane suna ayyana ƙwarewa daidai gwargwado (mai tuƙi da sauri yana bayyana ƙwarewa a matsayin lokacin mayar da martani; mai tuƙi da hankali yana bayyana ta a matsayin taka tsantsan), wanda ke karkatar da kimantawa na kansu zuwa sama a lissafi.

question: Me yasa mutane ke ci gaba da ba da maki ga bayanan halayyar taurari na gaba ɗaya a matsayin na musamman kuma abin mamaki ga kansu (Tasirin Barnum / Forer)?
options: Mutane suna ɗora ma’anar mutum kan bayanai masu rashin takamaiman da suka shafi kowa, waɗanda suke da babban ƙima a cikin al'umma
Masu hasashen taurari suna lura da nauyin taurari
Tauraruwa suna fitar da siginar rediyo
Ana rubuta hasashen taurari ɗaya-ɗaya
correctAnswer: Mutane suna ɗora ma’anar mutum kan bayanai masu rashin takamaiman da suka shafi kowa, waɗanda suke da babban ƙima a cikin al'umma
explanation: Bertram Forer ya nuna cewa mahalarta sun ba da maki ga rubutun rashin tsayayye ('kana da babban buƙatar wasu mutane su so ka') da 4.3/5 a inganci saboda mutane da kansu suna tabbatar da banbancin yabo na gaba ɗaya.

question: Me yasa manajoji na kamfanoni da gwamnatoci ke ci gaba da zuba biliyoyi cikin ayyuka masu gazawa, maimakon soke su (Ƙarya ta Kudin Da Aka Rasa)?
options: Girmamawa mara hankali ga jarin da ba za a iya mayar da su ba daga baya don kaucewa amincewa da gazawa da fahimtar asarar kwakwalwa
Soke abu na buƙatar sayen ƙarin siminti
Ayyuka masu gazawa koyaushe suna dawowa daga baya
Masu duba lissafi suna hana kawo ƙarshen kwangiloli
correctAnswer: Girmamawa mara hankali ga jarin da ba za a iya mayar da su ba daga baya don kaucewa amincewa da gazawa da fahimtar asarar kwakwalwa
explanation: Ka'idar shawarar tattalin arziki na buƙatar bincike mai zuwa na farashin-benifiti. Kudaden da aka rasa ba za a iya dawo da su ba kuma ya kamata su kasance babu nauyi wajen rabon jarin gaba.

question: A cikin ilimin halayyar ɗalibai, ta yaya faɗa wa malamai ba tare da wata hujja ba cewa wasu ɗalibai na bazuwar su ne 'masu basira' ke sa waɗannan ɗaliban su sami babban haɓakar IQ na gaske (Tasirin Pygmalion)?
options: Fatan malamai suna canza yadda mai koyarwa yake da jiki, yawan amsa, dumi cikin hali, da ƙalubalen tunani
Masu basira suna samun littattafai na musamman asiri
Malamai suna ƙirƙirar maki na ƙarshe na jarrabawa
Gwaje-gwajen IQ suna daidaita da sunayen malamai
correctAnswer: Fatan malamai suna canza yadda mai koyarwa yake da jiki, yawan amsa, dumi cikin hali, da ƙalubalen tunani
explanation: Robert Rosenthal ya nuna annobar da kanta ta cika: malamai da aka ba fata mafi girma suna bai wa ɗalibai ƙarin lokaci don amsawa, bayani mai bayyana, da ƙarfafawa mai yawa.

question: Me yasa ma'aikatan masana'antar Western Electric suka inganta yawan aikin su duk lokacin da aka canza haske—ko hasken ya ƙara ko ya ragu (Tasirin Hawthorne)?
options: Masu bincike sun canza halayensu sakamakon sanin cewa ana kallo kuma suna samun kulawar ƙungiya
Rashin haske yana ƙara kaifi ga hangen nesa na ɗan adam
Zafin fitila yana ba da kuzari ga kayan aikin masana'anta
Masu kula suna maye gurbin ma'aikata a boye
correctAnswer: Masu bincike sun canza halayensu sakamakon sanin cewa ana kallo kuma suna samun kulawar ƙungiya
explanation: Gwaje-gwajen Hawthorne sun nuna cewa yanayin zamantakewa da na tunani—musamman kulawar da masana bincike suka yi—ya fi tasiri ga yawan aiki fiye da abubuwan zahiri na wurin aiki.

question: Me yasa bayar da ƙwayar sukari mara aiki gaba ɗaya a cikin gwaje-gwajen lafiya ke rage ciwo kuma yana haifar da sakin endorphin na gaske a cikin marasa lafiya (Tasirin Placebo)?
options: Fatan hankali da yanayin zamantakewa suna kunna hanyoyin rage ciwo daga ƙasa zuwa sama a cikin kwakwalwa, suna sakin gaske opioids na cikin jiki.
Sukari yana aiki a matsayin sinadarin narkotiki.
Garkuwan jin ciwo suna narkewa cikin glucose.
Likitoci suna amfani da hypnosis yayin bayar da ƙwayoyi.
correctAnswer: Fatan hankali da yanayin zamantakewa suna kunna hanyoyin rage ciwo daga ƙasa zuwa sama a cikin kwakwalwa, suna sakin gaske opioids na cikin jiki.
explanation: Hoton kwakwalwa na tabbatar da cewa rage ciwo na placebo yana kunna prefrontal cortex da rostral anterior cingulate, yana haifar da gaske haɗa mai karɓar mu-opioid a cikin kashin baya.

question: A cikin Illusion na Hannu na Roba, me yasa goge hannu na roba da aka gani da hannu na gaske da aka ɓoye a lokaci guda ke sa masu gwaji su ji jin jiki akan hannun roba?
options: Haɗin abubuwa da yawa: kwakwalwa tana magance daidaiton gani-da-taɓa ta hanyar sabunta tsarin jiki na cikin ƙwaƙwalwa don ɗaukar ƙashin roba
Roba na ɗaukar igiyoyin lantarki na jiki
Wutar lantarki ta tsaye na tsallake iska
Hannu na gaske yana jin sanyi sosai
correctAnswer: Haɗin abubuwa da yawa: kwakwalwa tana magance daidaiton gani-da-taɓa ta hanyar sabunta tsarin jiki na cikin ƙwaƙwalwa don ɗaukar ƙashin roba
explanation: Lokacin da alamun gani da taɓawa suka dace da jin daɗin jiki na lokaci guda, cortex ɗin parietal na kwakwalwa yana shawo kan proprioception, yana sake tsara mallakar jiki akan abin da ake gani.

question: Me yasa mara lafiya da Matsalar Capgras ke jayayya cewa abokin rayuwarsu ko mahaifiyarsu shi ne kwafi ko koyi daidai, duk da cewa suna gane fuskarsu sosai?
options: An lalata hanyar jijiyoyin kwakwalwa da ke haɗa gane fuska da tashin hankali na jin daɗin zuciya, wanda ke haifar da sanin gani ba tare da jin motsin zuciya ba.
Abokin zama ya yi tiyata a sirrance.
Jijiyar gani ta mara lafiya ta juyo.
Ƙwayoyin ido masu koyi sun makance.
correctAnswer: An lalata hanyar jijiyoyin kwakwalwa da ke haɗa gane fuska da tashin hankali na jin daɗin zuciya, wanda ke haifar da sanin gani ba tare da jin motsin zuciya ba.
explanation: V.S. Ramachandran ya nuna cewa yayin da gane fuska na ɓangaren gaba (fusiform gyrus) yana da lafiya, haɗin kai zuwa amygdala ya yanke, wanda ke haifar da rashin jin dumin zuciya.

question: Me yasa mutum mai cutar Cotard yana da tabbas sosai cewa ya mutu gaba ɗaya, yana yin lalacewa, ko kuma ba shi da duk wani sassan jiki a ciki?
options: Sakacin haɗe-haɗe mai tsanani na sarrafa motsin rai na ji tare da kuskuren fahimtar hankali gaba ɗaya da kuma zurfin rashin gaskiyar damuwa
Zuciya tana dakatar da bugun jini
Zafin jiki yana sauka zuwa 0 Celsius
Kwayoyin jini suna zama masu bayyana
correctAnswer: Sakacin haɗe-haɗe mai tsanani na sarrafa motsin rai na ji tare da kuskuren fahimtar hankali gaba ɗaya da kuma zurfin rashin gaskiyar damuwa
explanation: Karya ta Cotard tana wakiltar mafi girman ƙarshen Capgras: dukkan kwarewar ji gaba ɗaya tana rabuwa da muhimmancin motsin rai, wanda ke haifar da ƙarya mai wariyar ballewar wanzuwa.

question: Ta yaya majinyaci da ke fuskantar tsananin ciwon ciki na tsoka a hannun da aka yanka zai sami sauƙin gaggawa ta amfani da akwatin gilashin madubi na V.S. Ramachandran?
options: Bayyanar hangen nesa na hannun da bai lalace ba a cikin madubi yana yaudarar kwakwalwar motsi don ta sassauta tsokoki masu matsewa na ƙarya
Madubin yana mai da hankali ga zafin infrared
Gilashin yana shan siginar ciwon jijiyoyi
Refleksin yana sa idanu su ji sanyi
correctAnswer: Bayyanar hangen nesa na hannun da bai lalace ba a cikin madubi yana yaudarar kwakwalwar motsi don ta sassauta tsokoki masu matsewa na ƙarya
explanation: Taswirar motsi ta kwakwalwa tana ci gaba da aika siginar tsoka zuwa ga limb ɗin da ya ɓace ba tare da samun amsar jin daɗi ba. Ganin refleshin 'ya sassauta' ta hanyar gani yana warware shanyewar da aka koya.

question: Me ya sa mutane masu Synesthesia ke jin launuka na musamman lokacin jin kade-kade ko dandano na musamman lokacin karanta kalmomi?
options: Haɗin aiki da ƙarfi mai yawa tsakanin wuraren sarrafa jin daɗi na kwakwalwa da suke kusa da juna
Kunnuwa suna ɗauke da ƙwayoyin ɗanɗano ɓoye
Rashin tsabtace jini a idanu yana zubowa cikin harshe
Kashin ji yana shafa jijiyoyin gani
correctAnswer: Haɗin aiki da ƙarfi mai yawa tsakanin wuraren sarrafa jin daɗi na kwakwalwa da suke kusa da juna
explanation: Synesthesia yana faruwa ne saboda rashin tsabtace jijiyoyin kwakwalwa gaba ɗaya a lokacin farkon haɓakawa, wanda ke adana sadarwa tsakanin wurare masu kusa (misali yankin launi na V4 da yankin haruffa).

question: Me ya sa marasa lafiya da Kurawar Fuska (Blindsight) za su iya nuna hasken da ke motsi a cikin ɗaki daidai yayin da suke cewa suna ganin cikakken duhu?
options: Hanyoyin gani na ƙasan kwakwalwa (superior colliculus) suna sarrafa wurin sarari ba tare da samun hankalin kwakwalwar gani ta farko (V1) ba
Haske yana wucewa ta fata a goshi
Marasa lafiya suna jin photons na vibrating
Ƙwaƙwalwa tana sake ƙirƙirar hasken
correctAnswer: Hanyoyin gani na ƙasan kwakwalwa (superior colliculus) suna sarrafa wurin sarari ba tare da samun hankalin kwakwalwar gani ta farko (V1) ba
explanation: Raunin V1 yana rushe wayewar ganin da hankalin kai, amma tsohuwar hanyar retinotectal tana kauce wa V1 kai tsaye zuwa tsakiyar kwakwalwa, yana ba da damar motsi ba tare da hankalin kai ba.

question: Me ya sa marar lafiya da Cutar Hannu Ta Waje ke ganin hannun hagu yana rufe maɓallan riga yayin da hannun dama ke buɗe su a sabawa da son sani?
options: Lalacewar corpus callosum ko medial frontal cortex yana ware niyyar motsi tsakanin bangarorin kwakwalwa, yana haifar da aiki mai cin gashin kansa na makamai da aka tsara
Jijiyoyi a cikin hannu suna girma kwakwalwa masu zaman kansu
Clot ɗin jini yana motsa tsokoki
Reflex arcs suna kauce wa ƙashin baya
correctAnswer: Lalacewar corpus callosum ko medial frontal cortex yana ware niyyar motsi tsakanin bangarorin kwakwalwa, yana haifar da aiki mai cin gashin kansa na makamai da aka tsara
explanation: Rashin haɗi tsakanin yankunan motsi na gaba da hana juna na bangaren dayawa yana barin bangare guda ya aiwatar da tsarin motsi da aka koya ba tare da sani na bangaren daya ba.

question: A cikin binciken rabuwa kwakwalwa, idan hoton sanda na dusar ƙanƙara aka nuno kawai ga ɓangaren dama mara magana kuma ƙashin kaza ga ɓangaren hagu, me ya sa hannun hagu na majinyaci ya ɗauki sandar yayin da bakin sa ke cewa ya ɗauke ta 'domin tsaftace murhu na kaji'?
options: Ƙungiyar hagu tana da halayen fassara: tana ƙirƙirar labarai masu yiwuwa na baya-bayan nan don ƙarfafa ayyukan da aka aiwatar ba tare da saninta ba
Ƙungiyar dama tana kula da ƙwayoyin murya
Hanyar gani ta wuce baya
Kaji suna son sanduna
correctAnswer: Ƙungiyar hagu tana da halayen fassara: tana ƙirƙirar labarai masu yiwuwa na baya-bayan nan don ƙarfafa ayyukan da aka aiwatar ba tare da saninta ba
explanation: Michael Gazzaniga ya gano 'fassarar ƙungiyar hagu', wani sashe da ke haɗa dalilai masu ma’ana na baya-bayan nan don halaye da aka samar daga sassan ƙarƙashin ƙwaƙwalwa ko sassan da aka raba.

question: Me yasa marar lafiya mai rashin tunani Clive Wearing zai iya zama a gaban piano ya buga wuraren Bach masu rikitarwa da kwarewa sosai, amma ya manta da tattaunawa da ta faru da sakan 10 da suka wuce?
options: Lalacewar hippocampus yana lalata tunanin bayani na episodic, yayin da tunanin motsi na procedural a cikin basal ganglia da cerebellum yake nan gaba ɗaya ba tare da matsala ba.
Zaren tsoka suna adana notin takardun kiɗa.
Piano suna fitar da igiyoyin rediyo na jin taɓa.
Jiragen kunne suna wucewa kai tsaye zuwa kwakwalwa.
correctAnswer: Lalacewar hippocampus yana lalata tunanin bayani na episodic, yayin da tunanin motsi na procedural a cikin basal ganglia da cerebellum yake nan gaba ɗaya ba tare da matsala ba.
explanation: Tunanin episodic (tunanin abubuwa da gaskiya) yana dogara ne da tsarin bangaren lokaci na tsakiya, yayin da tunanin motsi na procedural (kwarewa kamar buga piano) yana cikin cerebellum da striatum.

question: A lokacin da sandar ƙarfe ta tsallaka kai ɗan aikin layin dogo Phineas Gage gaba ɗaya a shekarar 1848, ya yi tafiya kuma ya yi magana nan take, duk da haka abokansa sun bayyana 'Gage ba shi da Gage yanzu'. Me ya sa?
options: Rushewar ventromedial prefrontal cortex ta lalata ikon sarrafa motsin zuciyarsa, tunanin ɗabi'a, da halayyar gudanar da zamantakewa
Sandar ƙarfe ta bar tsatsa mai guba
Kwayoyin muryarsa sun zama masu kauri
Matsin jinin sa ya sauka
correctAnswer: Rushewar ventromedial prefrontal cortex ta lalata ikon sarrafa motsin zuciyarsa, tunanin ɗabi'a, da halayyar gudanar da zamantakewa
explanation: Gage ya bayar da shaidar farko tabbatacciya cewa prefrontal cortex na da alhakin tsara aikin zamantakewa, dakatar da sha'awar gaggawa, da hukunci mai ɗabi'a ta hanyar ilimi.

question: Me yasa mutum wanda aka yi masa tiyata cire corpus callosum ɗinsa (split-brain) bai iya faɗin sunan wani abu da aka sanya a hannunsa na hagu yayin da aka rufe masa idanu?
options: Shigarwar jin daga hannun hagu tana tafiya zuwa bangaren dama na kwakwalwa, wanda bai da damar kai tsaye zuwa cibiyar magana a bangaren hagu na kwakwalwa
Hannun hagu yana rasa dukkan jin taɓawa
Kunnen dama ya kasance makanta
Rufe ido yana sa magana ta tsaya
correctAnswer: Shigarwar jin daga hannun hagu tana tafiya zuwa bangaren dama na kwakwalwa, wanda bai da damar kai tsaye zuwa cibiyar magana a bangaren hagu na kwakwalwa
explanation: Taɓawa a hannun hagu tana zuwa cortex somatosensory ta dama. Tunda cibiyoyin magana (Broca/Wernicke) suna zaune kawai a bangaren hagu na kwakwalwa, bangaren dama mara iya magana ba zai iya faɗin sunan abu ba.

question: Me ya sa ɗaliban lafiya na tunani da aka naɗa a matsayin masu gadi a cikin Gwajin Fursunonin Stanford suka sauri koma wa halayen zalunci da cin zarafi (Sakamakon Lucifer)?
options: Rashin bambanci da bin rawar da aka sanya: tsammanin tsarin tsanani da alamu na ikon cibiyar suna mamaye kashi na ɗabi'ar mutum
Masu gadi sun kamu da ciwon abinci
Basan ɗakin yana da hayaki mai guba
Fursunoni sun tayar da masu gadi ta hanyar jiki
correctAnswer: Rashin bambanci da bin rawar da aka sanya: tsammanin tsarin tsanani da alamu na ikon cibiyar suna mamaye kashi na ɗabi'ar mutum
explanation: Philip Zimbardo ya nuna cewa yanayi da rawar da aka sanya a cibiyoyi suna haifar da matsin lamba mai girma, suna cire ɗawainiya ta ɗabi'a ta hanyar riguna, tabarau, da cikakken iko mara tantancewa.

question: Me yasa Albert Einstein ya kirkiro Quantum Entanglement da sunan 'aiki mai ban tsoro daga nesa' a cikin EPR Paradox?
options: Auna daya daga cikin kwayoyin da aka ja da baya nan take yana tantance yanayin quantum na kwayarta da aka hade a fadin duniya ba tare da saƙonni na jiki ba
Kwayoyin da aka hade suna haifar da inuwa mai ruhohi
Kwayoyin quantum suna motsawa ta cikin wuraren rami
Kwayoyin suna fitar da murya mai jin kunne
correctAnswer: Auna daya daga cikin kwayoyin da aka ja da baya nan take yana tantance yanayin quantum na kwayarta da aka hade a fadin duniya ba tare da saƙonni na jiki ba
explanation: Einstein, Podolsky, da Rosen sunyi hujja cewa gaskiyar gida dole ta kasance; duk da haka, yanayin zagayawar da aka hade yana nuna haɗin quantum mara gida nan take.

question: Menene ka'idar lissafi ta John Bell da gwaje-gwajen Alain Aspect suka tabbatar game da yanayin ainihin duniyar mu ta jiki?
options: Ba zai yiwu duniya ta kasance lokaci guda gida da gaskiya; canje-canjen ɓoye na gida ba sa sarrafa lissafin quantum
Photons suna daga ruwa
Gudun haske ba shi da iyaka a cikin iska
Gravity ba ta wanzu a matakan micro
correctAnswer: Ba zai yiwu duniya ta kasance lokaci guda gida da gaskiya; canje-canjen ɓoye na gida ba sa sarrafa lissafin quantum
explanation: Matsakaicin rashin daidaito na Bell yana saita iyakar ƙididdiga ga kowace ka'idar canje-canjen ɓoye na gida. Keta gwaji ya tabbatar da cewa yanayi yana nuna sahihan alaƙa na quantum marar gida.

question: Menene Tasirin Quantum Zeno, kuma yaya yake hana ƙwayar radioactive mara ƙarfi daga rushewa?
options: Ci gaba da auna da lura da tsarin quantum yana sake saita aikin raƙuman ruwa, wanda ke sanya shi a cikin halinsa na farko
Haske mai daɗi yana sanyaya ƙwayar zuwa sifili na gaske
Filayen aunawa suna tura radiation
Masu gano suna shanye ƙimar ƙarfin rushewar nukiliya
correctAnswer: Ci gaba da auna da lura da tsarin quantum yana sake saita aikin raƙuman ruwa, wanda ke sanya shi a cikin halinsa na farko
explanation: Saboda yuwuwar canjin lokaci mai gajarta tana daidaita da lokaci (Delta t)^2, yawan aunawa masu tsanani suna mayar da tsarin cikin yanayin da bai rushe ba na eigenstate.

question: A cikin Gwajin Zaɓin-Jinkirin John Archibald Wheeler, ta yaya zaɓin yadda za a auna photon a yanzu ke bayyana yana shafar tarihin sa da shekaru biliyoyi da suka gabata?
options: Photon ba ya samun tabbataccen tarihin baya (hanyar igiya ko kwayar zarra) sai an zaɓi ƙarshe na tsarin aunawa manyan abubuwa
Photon yana tafiya baya ta cikin lokaci a zahiri
Masu gano abubuwan gaba suna fitar da igiyoyin tachyon
Lenses na ajiye photons a cikin rijiyoyin kristal
correctAnswer: Photon ba ya samun tabbataccen tarihin baya (hanyar igiya ko kwayar zarra) sai an zaɓi ƙarshe na tsarin aunawa manyan abubuwa
explanation: Wheeler ya nuna cewa photons daga quasars masu nisa da aka lanƙwasa ta hanyar lakaƙan nauyi suna ci gaba da kasancewa cikin haɗin hanyoyi har sai mai binciken taurari ya zaɓi ko zai saka beam splitter a yau.

question: A cikin gwajin Quantum Eraser, me ke faruwa da tsarin tsoma baki lokacin da masu bincike suka lalata ko suka rikita bayanin hanyar da kowane photon ya bi?
options: Tsarin tsoma bakin igiyar yanayi yana bayyana gabaɗaya, yana nuna cewa duality na igiyar yanayi da kwayar zarra ana sarrafa shi ne ta hanyar samun bayani
Mai gano yana fashewa daga cikon ƙarfi
Photons suna komawa cikin duhun abu
Haske na laser yana daskarewa
correctAnswer: Tsarin tsoma bakin igiyar yanayi yana bayyana gabaɗaya, yana nuna cewa duality na igiyar yanayi da kwayar zarra ana sarrafa shi ne ta hanyar samun bayani
explanation: Lokacin da aka share polarization na alamar 'wacce-hanya' ta hanyar polarizer na diagonal kafin gano, ƙa'idar cikkaken quantum na ba da damar dawo da tsarin tsoma baki na igiyar yanayi ta hanyar alaƙa.

question: Me ya sa yana da wuya a zahiri a gina cikakken injin daukar hoton quantum wanda ke ninka kowace irin yanayin quantum da ba a sani ba (Ka'idar Rashin Ninka)?
options: Layyanin masu aiki na quantum unitary yana hana ninka yanayin superposition ba tare da lalata ko rushe yanayin asali ba
Lackson fuskar na'urar daukar hoto ba su da isasshen ƙuduri
Kwayoyin ink suna da nauyi sosai ga juyin halittar quantum
Yanayin quantum suna buƙatar manyan ƙarfin lantarki
correctAnswer: Layyanin masu aiki na quantum unitary yana hana ninka yanayin superposition ba tare da lalata ko rushe yanayin asali ba
explanation: Wootters, Zurek, da Dieks sun tabbatar cewa mai aiki na unitary U wanda ke bin U(|psi>|0>) = |psi>|psi> ba zai iya zama gaskiya ga kowane superpositions |psi> = a|0> + b|1> saboda daidaiton quantum.

question: Ta yaya Quantum Teleportation ke canja wurin ainihin yanayin kwayoyin photon zuwa wuri mai nisa ba tare da aika photon ɗin kanta a sarari ba?
options: Ta amfani da haɗin batutuwan da aka riga aka raba, yin gwajin jihar Bell, da aika bitocin 2 na gargajiya don sake gina jihar
Ta hanyar canza photon zuwa igiyoyin sauti
Ta hanyar hako ƙaramin ramuwar ƙura ta iska
Ta hanyar matse photon a cikin lu'ulu'u
correctAnswer: Ta amfani da haɗin batutuwan da aka riga aka raba, yin gwajin jihar Bell, da aika bitocin 2 na gargajiya don sake gina jihar
explanation: Bennett da wasu sun nuna cewa auna yanayin haɗin qubit ɗin shigarwa da rabin EPR ɗaya yana rushe su duka, yana ba mai karɓa damar juya ɗayan qubit ɗin EPR ta hanyar umarnin gargajiya.

question: Me ya sa Erwin Schrödinger ya gabatar da shahararren gwajin tunaninsa da ke da alaka da kyanwa a cikin akwatin da aka rufe tare da guba mai ɗauke da radioactive (Kyanwar Schrödinger)?
options: Don nuna rashin ma’ana na amfani da hadewar quantum na Copenhagen a kan abubuwa masu girma na yau da kullum
Don tabbatar da cewa kyanwa na da rayuka tara
Don gwada matattarar iskar gas ta radioactive
Don ƙirƙirar kwantena masu aminci ga dabbobi
correctAnswer: Don nuna rashin ma’ana na amfani da hadewar quantum na Copenhagen a kan abubuwa masu girma na yau da kullum
explanation: Schrödinger ya nufa da wannan al'amari a matsayin suka: idan fassarar Copenhagen tana aiki ba tare da iyaka ba, kyanwa mai girma da ba a kallo ba dole ne a lokaci guda ta zama mati da rai, wanda ya saba wa tunanin jiki.

question: A cikin rikicin 'Abokin Wigner' na Eugene Wigner, me yasa rushewar aikin igiyar kwayoyin halitta ke zama na mutum ɗaya kuma dangane da mai lura?
options: Ga abokin da ke cikin dakin gwaji, yanayin yana rushewa yayin da ya gani, amma ga Wigner da ke jiran a waje, abokin da dakin gwaji suna cikin haɗewar haɗe-haɗe
Wigner yana fama da mantuwa
Dakin gwaji yana juyawa da saurin haske
Abokin yana saka tabarau na rana
correctAnswer: Ga abokin da ke cikin dakin gwaji, yanayin yana rushewa yayin da ya gani, amma ga Wigner da ke jiran a waje, abokin da dakin gwaji suna cikin haɗewar haɗe-haɗe
explanation: Wigner ya nuna cewa ka'idojin Copenhagen na yau da kullum ba su da iyaka ta ainihi ga rushewa: abin da ya rushe ya zama sakamako tabbatacce ga mai lura ɗaya shi ne yanayin haɗe-haɗe wanda bai rushe ba ga wani.

question: Ta yaya 'Fassarar Duniya da yawa' ta Hugh Everett ke warware matsalar aunawa a cikin ilmin lissafin quantum ba tare da buƙatar rugujewar aikin girgije ba?
options: Kowane aunawa na quantum yana raba duniya zuwa rassan juna da ba sa sadarwa waɗanda ke wakiltar kowace yiwuwar sakamako
Yana maye gurbin lantarki da ƙananan duniyoyi
Yana buƙatar masu kallo su yi zurfin tunani
Yana bayyana cewa ƙwayoyin halitta ba su wanzu
correctAnswer: Kowane aunawa na quantum yana raba duniya zuwa rassan juna da ba sa sadarwa waɗanda ke wakiltar kowace yiwuwar sakamako
explanation: Everett ya gabatar da cike da gwargwado na Schrödinger: maimakon rugujewar aikin girgije, aikin girgije na duniya yana ci gaba da rarrabewa, yana aiwatar da kowace yiwuwar quantum mai rashin haɗin guiwa a cikin gaskiyar duniya masu jere.

question: Me yasa abubuwan da za a gani da ido kamar kujeru da motoci ba sa nuna rikicewar igiyoyin quantum a cikin kwarewar yau da kullum ta ɗan adam (Quantum Decoherence)?
options: Harbin tarin kwayoyin haske da iska da ke kewaye da su cikin sauri yana lalata dacewar matakin quantum
Abubuwan da za a iya gani suna da caji na magnetic mai yawa sosai
Graviti yana dumama abubuwa har sai igiyoyin sun narke
Duniya na juyawa da sauri sosai
correctAnswer: Harbin tarin kwayoyin haske da iska da ke kewaye da su cikin sauri yana lalata dacewar matakin quantum
explanation: Ka'idar quantum decoherence (Zurek, Zeh) tana nuna cewa hulɗa da tafkunan zafi na muhalli yana zubar da bayanin matakin cikin 10^-20 na dakika, yana tilasta matrix ɗin ɗan nauyi zuwa kamannin yuwuwar kyan gaske.

question: A cikin Tasirin Aharonov-Bohm, ta yaya hasken lantarki na electron zai iya canza yanayin igiyar quantum ɗinsa yayin tafiya ta wurin da babu wani filin magnetic kwata-kwata?
options: Electron yana haɗawa kai tsaye da ƙarfin vector na magnetic A, wanda yake ci gaba da kasancewa ba sifili ba a wajen filin magnetic da aka kebe.
Electrons suna tsallaka ta cikin kernar magnetic.
Solenoidi yana girgiza tare da sauti.
Ƙasan duniya yana fitar da ions marasa tsari.
correctAnswer: Electron yana haɗawa kai tsaye da ƙarfin vector na magnetic A, wanda yake ci gaba da kasancewa ba sifili ba a wajen filin magnetic da aka kebe.
explanation: Ko da lokacin da filin magnetic B = curl(A) = 0, ƙarfin vector na magnetic A a kan tafiyar electron yana ba da gudummawa ga canjin phase ɗin da ba ya dogara da ma'auni wanda ya yi daidai da yanayin magnetic da aka kebe.

question: Me yasa juriya ta Hall a cikin Tasirin Hall na Quantum take daidai da tsauraran ƙididdiga zuwa madaidaitan matakai na h / (n * e^2)?
options: Abubuwan da ba sa canzawa na topological (lambobin Chern) suna kare tashoshin wucewar ƙarshen chiral daga duk wasu tarkace da kurakuran ƙira
Dakunan gwaje-gwaje suna daidaita kayan aiki zuwa madaidaitan ƙididdiga
Voltmeter suna zagaye lambobi ta atomatik
Nitrogen mai ruwa yana daskare lahani na jan karfe
correctAnswer: Abubuwan da ba sa canzawa na topological (lambobin Chern) suna kare tashoshin wucewar ƙarshen chiral daga duk wasu tarkace da kurakuran ƙira
explanation: Thouless, Kohmoto, Nightingale, da den Nijs (TKNN) sun nuna cewa jigilar Hall tana daidai da lambar Chern ta farko, wani adadi na topological da ba ya shan rauni daga karkatattu da tashin hankali.

question: Wadanne kwayoyin kusan kwayoyin da ba su da yawa suke bayyana a cikin Tasirin Hausar Quantum na Fractional waɗanda ke ɗauke da cajin lantarki na rabin kashi 1/3 ko 1/5 na lantarki?
options: Anyons: tarin tashin hankali na topological waɗanda electrons ke haɗewa da su zuwa ƙwarya na ƙarar ƙarfin lantarki wanda aka ƙididdige
Quarks kyauta suna zubowa daga kwayoyin atomic
Ramin baki mai kwayar halitta
Hadadden kwayoyin duhu na rashin bambanci
correctAnswer: Anyons: tarin tashin hankali na topological waɗanda electrons ke haɗewa da su zuwa ƙwarya na ƙarar ƙarfin lantarki wanda aka ƙididdige
