explanation: Robert Laughlin ya bayyana cewa haɗin lantarki na 2D a ƙarƙashin filayen ƙarfin ƙarfin ƙarfin ƙarfin lantarki yana haifar da ƙwararrun kwayoyin haɗin gwiwa tare da cajin fractional e/3 da kuma ƙididdigar haɗi na fractional (anyons).

question: Me ke faruwa lokacin da aka sanyaya iskar rubidium mai ruwa zuwa cikin biliyoyin digiri sama da sifili na ainihi don samar da Bose-Einstein Condensate (BEC)?
options: Girman burturuwar de Broglie na kwayoyin ya hade, wanda ke sa miliyoyin kwayoyin su shiga cikin mafi kankantar yanayin ƙwayoyin kuma suyi aiki a matsayin babban super-atom guda
Kwayoyin suna hade zuwa uranium mai nauyi
Lantarki suna dainawa daga juya har abada
Kwayoyin iskar sun kristallo zuwa lu'u-lu'u mai wuya
correctAnswer: Girman burturuwar de Broglie na kwayoyin ya hade, wanda ke sa miliyoyin kwayoyin su shiga cikin mafi kankantar yanayin ƙwayoyin kuma suyi aiki a matsayin babban super-atom guda
explanation: Lokacin da tsawon burturuwar de Broglie na zafi lambda_dB ya wuce nisan tsakanin kwayoyi, bosons suna shiga cikin yanayin ƙasa mai yawa, suna samar da aikin yanayin ragar guda daya mai daidaito.

question: Me yasa supercurrent ke gudana ci gaba ta hanyar shingen insulating mai kauri tsakanin superconductors guda biyu ba tare da an yi amfani da lantarki ba (DC Josephson Effect)?
options: Kungiyoyin Cooper na electrons suna yin tafiye-tafiye na quantum ta hanyar shingen saboda bambancin matakin macroscopic
Babban lantarki yana narkar da insulator
Electrons suna tsalle ta hanyar walƙiya mai zafi
Filayen maganadisu suna tura proton ta ciki
correctAnswer: Kungiyoyin Cooper na electrons suna yin tafiye-tafiye na quantum ta hanyar shingen saboda bambancin matakin macroscopic
explanation: Brian Josephson ya hango cewa daidaiton matakin macroscopic a fadin shinge yana ba da izin ga kungiyoyin Cooper su tafi ba tare da asara ba: I = I_c * sin(Delta phi).

question: Ta yaya wani kwayar alpha zai iya tserewa daga babban shingen wutar lantarki na Coulomb na kwayar halittar atom lokacin da karfin kuzarinsa na motsi yake kasa sosai da karfin da ake bukata na tserewa?
options: Ramin Quantum: aikin igiyar kwayar alpha yana shimfide ta cikin shingen yiwuwar iyakance, yana ba da damar yiwuwar wucewa ba tare da sifili ba
Graviton na nukiliya yana dagawa kwayar alpha
Electrons suna jan kwayar alpha zuwa waje
Nukiliya yana fashewa da injiniya
correctAnswer: Ramin Quantum: aikin igiyar kwayar alpha yana shimfide ta cikin shingen yiwuwar iyakance, yana ba da damar yiwuwar wucewa ba tare da sifili ba
explanation: George Gamow ya yi bayanin raguwar alpha ta hanyar ramin quantum: coefficient na wucewa T ~ exp(-2 * integral(sqrt(2m(V - E))) dx) yana ba da damar tserewa duk da cewa E < V_coulomb.

question: Me yasa gano Hawking Radiation da Stephen Hawking ya yi ke haifar da zurfin 'Black Hole Information Paradox'?
options: Radiyon thermal baya dauke da wani bayani game da abu da aka cinye, ma’ana cikakken ɓacewa zai saba wa ka’idar quantum unitarity
Ramin baki yana faɗaɗa har abada
Radiyon na sa taurari su yi daskarewa
Iyakokin abubuwan da suka faru suna dawo da lasers na gamma
correctAnswer: Radiyon thermal baya dauke da wani bayani game da abu da aka cinye, ma’ana cikakken ɓacewa zai saba wa ka’idar quantum unitarity
explanation: Ilmin quantum yana umurni cewa canjin yanayin quantum ya kasance daidai koda yaushe (bayanan ana adanawa). Cikakken ɓatar ramin baki cikin radiyon thermal zai canza yanayi masu tsafta zuwa yanayi masu cakuda, yana rushe bayanai.

question: Wane muhimmin tunanin lissafin sararin samaniya ne Holographic Principle (AdS/CFT correspondence) ke bayarwa?
options: Dukkan abubuwan da ke faruwa a cikin ƙwayar 3D na sararin lokaci za a iya bayyana su da lissafi a kan iyakarta 2D ta waje
Duniya wani tsarin kwamfuta ne da aka yi da gilashi
Duniyoyi takardun yanke ne na 2D
Haske wani ƙarya ne na gani
correctAnswer: Dukkan abubuwan da ke faruwa a cikin ƙwayar 3D na sararin lokaci za a iya bayyana su da lissafi a kan iyakarta 2D ta waje
explanation: Gerard 't Hooft, Leonard Susskind, da Juan Maldacena sun nuna cewa nauyin ƙwayoyin halitta a cikin babban Anti-de Sitter yana daidaita da tsarin filin conformal a kan iyakarta, yana daidaita entropy da fadin fuska.

question: Ta yaya ci-gaba na al'umma zai iya fitar da makamashi mai tsabta daga rami mai juyawa na Kerr (Tsarin Penrose) a hankali?
options: Ta hanyar jefa abu cikin ergosphere wanda ya rabu, yana tura makamashi mara kyau cikin ramin yayin da wani ɓangaren ya kubuta da karin makamashi
Ta hanyar huda bututun geothermal cikin iyakar abubuwan da ba su dawo ba (event horizon)
Ta hanyar haskaka manyan madubai don jefa nauyi
Ta hanyar ja ramin baƙar fata kusa da tauraro
correctAnswer: Ta hanyar jefa abu cikin ergosphere wanda ya rabu, yana tura makamashi mara kyau cikin ramin yayin da wani ɓangaren ya kubuta da karin makamashi
explanation: Roger Penrose ya nuna cewa a cikin ergosphere (waje da iyakar abubuwan da ba su dawo ba), ja-da-jawo na firam yana ba da damar orbit na makamashi mara kyau idan aka kwatanta da har abada, yana rage juyawar ramin baƙar fata kuma yana ƙara fitar da makamashi da yawa.

question: Me yasa agogon atom da aka sanya a saman tsauni mai tsawo ke buga lokaci cikin sauri idan aka kwatanta da agogon atom iri ɗaya a matakin teku (Ragewar Lokaci saboda Nauyi)?
options: Filayen nauyi masu ƙarfi a ƙananan tsayi suna rage gudun lokaci idan aka kwatanta da filayen da suka fi rauni a sama
Iskar tsauni tana da ƙarancin matsin lamba
Hasumiyar sararin samaniya tana bada kuzari ga kwayoyin cesium
Agogon tsaunin yana tafiya da sauri ta sarari
correctAnswer: Filayen nauyi masu ƙarfi a ƙananan tsayi suna rage gudun lokaci idan aka kwatanta da filayen da suka fi rauni a sama
explanation: Ka'idar Jimillar Dangantaka ta Einstein tana nuna cewa agogo a cikin nauyi mai zurfi yana tafiya a hankali: t_0 = t_f * √(1 - 2GM / (rc^2)). Gwajin Pound-Rebka ya tabbatar da wannan bambanci daidai.

question: Ta yaya gwajin Gravity Probe B na NASA ya tabbatar da tasirin 'Frame-Dragging' (Lense-Thirring) da Einstein ya hango a cikin Babban Ka'idar Juyin Halitta?
options: Ta hanyar auna ƙaramin motsin gyroscope da Earth ke haifarwa yayin ja da zaren lokaci da kanta ke yi
Ta hanyar auna lokacin fashewar laser da aka aika zuwa Wata
Ta hanyar lura da lanƙwasawar hasken rana
Ta hanyar jefa ƙwallayen bowling a cikin orbit
correctAnswer: Ta hanyar auna ƙaramin motsin gyroscope da Earth ke haifarwa yayin ja da zaren lokaci da kanta ke yi
explanation: Wani nauyi mai juyawa na ja sararin lokaci kewaye da kansa kamar zuma da aka motsa da cokali. Gyroscopes masu inganci sosai na Gravity Probe B sun auna matsawar frame-dragging na Duniya na miliyan 37 na arcseconds a kowace shekara.

question: Ta yaya LIGO ta gano raƙuman lanƙwasa da aka fitar daga rami bakar da suka haɗu miliyan 1.3 na hasken-shekara da suka wuce a 2015?
options: Ta hanyar gano canje-canjen tsokana na laser da suka yi ƙasa da 1/10,000 na diamita na proton a cikin hannayen vakiyum na kilomita 4
Ta hanyar rikodin raƙuman sauti da na’urorin ruwa na hydrophone
Ta hanyar bin diddigin saukar tauraron dan adam
Ta hanyar aunawa haɓakar zafin teku
correctAnswer: Ta hanyar gano canje-canjen tsokana na laser da suka yi ƙasa da 1/10,000 na diamita na proton a cikin hannayen vakiyum na kilomita 4
explanation: Raƙuman lanƙwasa suna canza ma’aunin sarari (Delta L / L ~ 10^-21). Masu binciken Michelson na LIGO sun gano wannan matsin ma’auni ta hanyar aunawa bambancin mataki tsakanin manyan hanyoyi biyu da aka raba ta hanyar laser.

question: Me yasa Matsalar Tsayayyen Kimiyyar Sararin Samaniya ake ɗaukarta a matsayin mafi munin hasashen ka’ida a tarihin ilmin lissafi na jikin duniya?
options: Ka'idar filin quantum tana hasashen ƙarfin makamashi mara komai na tazarar sifili wanda kimanin karfin sa ya fi girman da aka gani da nuni da girma fiye da oda 120
Gudun fadadawa ya wuce saurin haske da rashin iyaka
Taurari suna hade baya
Makamar duhu tana sanya taurari su zama kore
correctAnswer: Ka'idar filin quantum tana hasashen ƙarfin makamashi mara komai na tazarar sifili wanda kimanin karfin sa ya fi girman da aka gani da nuni da girma fiye da oda 120
explanation: Ƙididdigar ƙarfin makamashi na quantum vacuum zuwa matakin Planck yana ba da rho_vac ~ 10^112 erg/cm^3, yayin da lura da taurari ke auna rho_lambda ~ 10^-8 erg/cm^3, wani bambanci na 10^120.

question: Ta yaya ka'idar Fadada Sararin Samaniya ta Alan Guth ta warware 'Matsalar Iyakoki' na Bangon CMB (Cosmic Microwave Background)?
options: Ƙaramin tashin daɗi na fadada mai sauri ya shimfiɗa ƙaramin yanki da ke da alaƙa ta dalili a cikin daidaiton zafi zuwa ga dukkan sararin samaniyar da za a iya gani
Photon sun yi tafiya a fadin sararin samaniya da sauri mara iyaka
Ƙarfi na nauyi yana turawa kwayoyin a daidaitacce
Sararin samaniyar cike take da helium mai ruwa
correctAnswer: Ƙaramin tashin daɗi na fadada mai sauri ya shimfiɗa ƙaramin yanki da ke da alaƙa ta dalili a cikin daidaiton zafi zuwa ga dukkan sararin samaniyar da za a iya gani
explanation: Husin sararin samaniya suna da makamancin zafi (2.725 K) amma a yau ba su da alaƙa ta dalili. Fadada sararin samaniya tana bayanin yadda suka raba daidaiton zafi kafin su faɗaɗa da ninki 10^26.

question: A cikin Matsalar Rashin Daidaiton Baryon, me ya sa duniyarmu ta fi cike da abubuwa maimakon daidaitattun kashi-kashi na abubuwa da abubuwan antimatter?
options: Sharuddan Sakharov: Keta CP, keta adadin baryon, da fita daga daidaiton zafin jiki sun fi son ƙananan yawa na abubuwa (1 cikin biliyan)
Antimatter yana da ƙwayar nauyi mara kyau kuma ya fado
Antimatter ta ɓaci ta hanyar rami baki
Antimatter ba ta taɓa wanzuwa ba
correctAnswer: Sharuddan Sakharov: Keta CP, keta adadin baryon, da fita daga daidaiton zafin jiki sun fi son ƙananan yawa na abubuwa (1 cikin biliyan)
explanation: A lokacin farkon baryogenesis, don kowane kwayar antimatter miliyan 1,000,000,000 da suka ɓace tare da abubuwa, kwayoyin abubuwa miliyan 1,000,000,001 sun samuwa, suna barin ragowar abubuwa da ke samar da tauraronmu.

question: Me yasa Bullet Cluster (1E 0657-56) ake yawan yaba shi a matsayin tabbacin gwaji na ainihin Dark Matter?
options: Gravitational lensing yana nuna cewa cibiyar nauyi ta rabu da iskar gas mai zafi wanda ke fitar da X-ray bayan hatsarin sararin samaniya
Dark matter tana fitar da hasken kore mai kyalli
Teleskopoci sun ga inuwa na black dwarfs
Neutrinos sun tsaya a sifili
correctAnswer: Gravitational lensing yana nuna cewa cibiyar nauyi ta rabu da iskar gas mai zafi wanda ke fitar da X-ray bayan hatsarin sararin samaniya
explanation: Lokacin da kungiyoyi biyu suka hadu, iska ta baryonic na yau da kullum ta fuskanci jan lantarki kuma ta tsaya a tsakiya, yayin da dark matter mara haduwa ta wuce ba tare da cikas ba, tana dauke da mafi rinjaye nauyi na gravitational.

question: Ta yaya masu ilmin taurari da suka yi amfani da supernovae na Nau'in Ia a shekarar 1998 suka gano cewa faɗaɗawar sararin samaniya ba ta raguwa, a maimakon haka tana ƙaruwa?
options: Supernovae na Nau'in Ia da ke nesa sun kasance ƙasa da haske fiye da yadda aka hango don duniya mai raguwar faɗaɗawa, wanda Dark Energy ke haɓaka
Supernovae suna matsowa zuwa Ƙasa
Gurɓataccen ƙura na sararin samaniya ya sa taurari sun yi launin shunayya
Supernovae sun fashe sau biyu
correctAnswer: Supernovae na Nau'in Ia da ke nesa sun kasance ƙasa da haske fiye da yadda aka hango don duniya mai raguwar faɗaɗawa, wanda Dark Energy ke haɓaka
explanation: Perlmutter, Riess, da Schmidt sun auna fitilun da aka saba gani (Supernovae na Nau'in Ia). Ƙananan hasken da suka nuna a babban juyin z ya tabbatar cewa sararin samaniya yana ƙaruwa cikin saurin shekaru biliyan 5 da suka gabata.

question: Me yasa wata wata da ke zagaye kusa da duniyarta ta gida ke tarwatsewa zuwa tsarin zobe na tarin duwatsu (Iyakacin Roche)?
options: Ƙarfin jan hankali na ruwa daga duniyar gida ya wuce ƙarfin jan hankali na cikin wata
Farin jiki na iska yana fashe wata
Filayen maganadisu suna kore zuciyar ƙarfe na wata
Iskar rana tana tarwatsa ƙasa
correctAnswer: Ƙarfin jan hankali na ruwa daga duniyar gida ya wuce ƙarfin jan hankali na cikin wata
explanation: Ƙarfin jan hankali daban-daban a fadin diamita na wata ya rinjayi ƙarfin jan hankali na kanta: d = R_planet * (2 * rho_planet / rho_moon)^(1/3), yana tarwatsa shi zuwa zoben duniyoyi.

question: Wane al'amari na quantum ne ke hana tauraron farin dwarf rushewa ƙarƙashin ƙarfin nauyinsa mai yawa har zuwa 1.44 girman rana (Iyakar Chandrasekhar)?
options: Matsin lamba na degeneracy na electron da ka haddasa ta Ka'idar Warewar Pauli
Haɗin nukiliya na baƙin ƙarfe a cikin cibiyar tauraron
Ƙarfin juyawa na centrifugal
Matsin photon na zafi
correctAnswer: Matsin lamba na degeneracy na electron da ka haddasa ta Ka'idar Warewar Pauli
explanation: Electrons ba za su iya mamaye daidai matsayi na quantum ba. Matsi na electrons yana haifar da matsin lamba na degeneracy na quantum. A sama da 1.44 M_sun, electrons suna zama ultra-relativistic kuma ba za su iya jure rushewar nauyi ba.

question: Me ke faruwa da tauraron da ke cikin mutuwa wanda mass dinsa ya wuce iyakar Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff (TOV) na kusan 2.17 na mass ɗin rana?
options: Lalacewar ƙarfin haƙiƙa na neutron ya fi ƙarfin, yana haifar da rushewar ƙwayar cikin tauraron zuwa rami mai nauyin tauraron.
Yana maimaitawa cikin babban tauraron ja mai faɗaɗuwa.
Yana hucewa ya zama duniyar ƙarfe mai ƙarfi.
Yana canzawa zuwa cikakken hasken gamma.
correctAnswer: Lalacewar ƙarfin haƙiƙa na neutron ya fi ƙarfin, yana haifar da rushewar ƙwayar cikin tauraron zuwa rami mai nauyin tauraron.
explanation: Duk da cewa taurarin neutron suna samun goyon baya daga ƙarfin haƙiƙa na neutron da ƙarfi na nuclear, wuce iyakar TOV (~2.17 M_sun) ba ya barin wani ƙarfin ilmin halittu da aka sani don hana rushewa zuwa singularity.

question: Me yasa pulsars masu juyawa lokaci-lokaci suke fuskantar 'glitches' masu tsanani, inda saurin juyawarsu ya hanzarta kwatsam?
options: Vortices masu ruwa a cikin saman cikin star neutron suna cire haɗin su kuma suna canja angulu zuwa ga ƙashin ƙasa mai ƙarfi
Dutse-dutse masu zuwa suna karo da ƙwayoyin ƙarfe na ƙarfin maganadisu
Pulsar yana buga cikin gajimaren ƙura na taurari
Filayen maganadisu suna juyawa
correctAnswer: Vortices masu ruwa a cikin saman cikin star neutron suna cire haɗin su kuma suna canja angulu zuwa ga ƙashin ƙasa mai ƙarfi
explanation: Sauran ƙashin superfluid a ciki yana ɗauke da biliyoyin vortices da aka haɗa da lattices na nuclear. Lokacin da ƙashin ya rage saboda radiation, matsin lamba yana taruwa har sai vortices sun cire haɗin su cikin bala'i, suna hanzarta ƙashin.

question: Me ke faruwa idan 'starquake' ta fashe farar ƙarfe mai yawa sosai na Magnetar mai filin maganadisu na 10^11 Tesla?
options: Yana sakin gagarumar fashewar hasken gamma da X-rays wanda zai iya lalata saman ionosphere na Duniya daga cikin shekaru dubu goma na haske
Magnetar din ya fashe zuwa cikin makamashi mai duhu
Magnetar din ya zama ba a ganinsa ta radar
Yana ƙirƙirar sabon tsarin rana mai taurari
correctAnswer: Yana sakin gagarumar fashewar hasken gamma da X-rays wanda zai iya lalata saman ionosphere na Duniya daga cikin shekaru dubu goma na haske
explanation: Tsagewar milimita 1 a cikin farar Magnetar na karkatar da layukan filin maganadisu, yana sakin joules 10^39 na makamashi. A 2004, wani haske daga SGR 1806-20 (nisa shekaru 50,000 na haske) ya yi ionization ga yanayin Duniya.

question: Me yasa jiragen sama na taurarin masani wadanda ke fitowa daga ramukan bakin da suka fi yawa suna bayyana kamar suna tafiya a sararin sama da saurin haske (Apparent Superluminal Motion)?
options: Tsinkayar gani na kewayar gani da aka haifar saboda jirgin yana motsawa zuwa Duniya kusan da saurin haske, yana biye da fitowar photons dinsa
Kwayoyin Tachyon suna wuce saurin haske a cikin babu iska
Jan hankali na gravity yana turawa abu wuce c
Galaxies suna jan sarari tare da ramukkan cizon
correctAnswer: Tsinkayar gani na kewayar gani da aka haifar saboda jirgin yana motsawa zuwa Duniya kusan da saurin haske, yana biye da fitowar photons dinsa
explanation: Idan jirgi yana tafiya a kusurwar theta kusa da 0 zuwa layin hangenmu a v ~ c, bambancin lokaci tsakanin bugun da aka karba Delta t_obs = Delta t * (1 - beta * cos theta) yana matsawa da sauri, yana sa v_app ya bayyana > c.

question: Me yasa hasken huhu na kimiyar taurari mai nuna kai tsaye zuwa Duniya ke bayyana har zuwa sau 1,000 mafi haske fiye da huhu iri ɗaya da ke nuna baya?
options: Canjin Lorentz yana mayar da fitarwar photon cikin kunkuntar kwafin gaba da kuma inganta sauyawar launi (Doppler boosting)
Huhun da ke zuwa yana kona hydrogen mai tsabta
Huhun da ke dawowa yana shiga cikin nebula mai duhu
Gravitiy yana ƙara hasken kwafin da ke zuwa
correctAnswer: Canjin Lorentz yana mayar da fitarwar photon cikin kunkuntar kwafin gaba da kuma inganta sauyawar launi (Doppler boosting)
explanation: Sakamakon rashin daidaiton relativistik da Doppler shift, matakin hasken da aka lura da shi yana daidaita kamar S_obs = S_0 * delta^(3 + alpha), yana ƙara fitarwar haske zuwa ga mai ganewa yayin da yake rage hasken huhun da ke tafe.

question: Me yasa ƙananan ƙwayoyin muon da aka ƙirƙira ta hasken sararin samaniya a saman yanayi suke isa ga na'urorin gano ƙasa da yawa duk da cewa lokacin rayuwarsu a hutu yana da kankanta na microseconds 2.2 kawai?
options: Saurin Dangantaka na Musamman: jan lokacinsa yana faɗaɗa agogon cikin muon yayin da gajartar da tsawo yake rage tazarar yanayi daga hangen nesa na muon
Muons suna zamewa ƙasa a kan layukan filin lantarki
Hasken sararin samaniya yana turawa muons ƙasa kamar iska
Nitrogen na yanayi yana adana muons
correctAnswer: Saurin Dangantaka na Musamman: jan lokacinsa yana faɗaɗa agogon cikin muon yayin da gajartar da tsawo yake rage tazarar yanayi daga hangen nesa na muon
explanation: A v = 0.9997c, gamma ~ 40. Daga hangen nesa na Duniya, muon zai rayu sau 40 fiye da haka (~ microseconds 88); daga hangen nesa na muon, yanayin kilomita 10 ya matsa zuwa mita 250.

question: A cikin Rikicin Tagwaye na Kwarewar Musamman, me yasa ɗan tagwaye mai tafiya a sararin samaniya ya fi ƙaranci a shekaru fiye da ɗan tagwaye mai zama a duniya lokacin dawowa?
options: Ɗan tagwaye mai tafiya ya fuskanci hanzari na jiki da juyawa, wanda ya karya daidaiton tsarin motsi kuma ya canza tsarin tunani
Abincin jirgin sararin samaniya yana dauke da antioxidants
Tafiyar sararin samaniya yana sanyaya ƙwayoyin halittar ɗan adam
Duniya tana juyawa da sauri a kusa da Rana
correctAnswer: Ɗan tagwaye mai tafiya ya fuskanci hanzari na jiki da juyawa, wanda ya karya daidaiton tsarin motsi kuma ya canza tsarin tunani
explanation: Ɗan tagwaye mai tafiya yana canza tsarin motsi yayin rage gudu da hanzarta don dawowar tafiya. Rashin daidaito na hanyar duniya ta sarari-lokaci yana nuna ƙaramin jimlar lokaci mai kyau.

question: A cikin Rikicin Matakala (Barn-Pole Paradox), shin wata matakala mai tsawon mita 20 da ke motsi da kusan saurin haske zata iya shiga gaba ɗaya cikin ɗakin ajiyar mita 10 tare da duk ƙofofin rufe a lokaci guda?
options: Eh a tsarin ɗakin ajiyar saboda ragin Lorentz, amma a tsarin matakalarsu a'a inda rufewar ƙofofi ba lokaci guda bane
A'a, matakalar zata fashe idan ta taɓa iska
Eh, ƙofofi suna ɗaure haske a cikin madubai
A'a, katako baya raguwa
correctAnswer: Eh a tsarin ɗakin ajiyar saboda ragin Lorentz, amma a tsarin matakalarsu a'a inda rufewar ƙofofi ba lokaci guda bane
explanation: Dangantakar lokaci guda: ga ɗakin ajiyar, matakala zata ragu zuwa mita 8 kuma duk ƙofofin su rufe a lokaci guda. Ga matakala, ƙofofin su rufe a lokuta daban-daban.

question: A cikin Bell's Spaceship Paradox, jiragen sama guda biyu masu kama da juna suna hanzarta daidai, tare da zaren da ya yi rauni da aka shimfida tsakaninsu. Me ya sa zaren ya yage?
options: Nisan tsakanin jiragen na ƙaruwa a cikin wuraren hutun haɗin kai na nan take, yayin da zaren ke taƙaita bisa ga Lorentz
Gubar hayaki na narkar da fiber ɗin zaren
Ƙananan taurari suna yanke zaren
Ƙarfi na ja jiragen a juna
correctAnswer: Nisan tsakanin jiragen na ƙaruwa a cikin wuraren hutun haɗin kai na nan take, yayin da zaren ke taƙaita bisa ga Lorentz
explanation: A cikin wurin ƙaddamarwa, nisa ya kasance ɗaya, amma zaren yana ƙoƙarin taƙaita bisa Lorentz. A cikin wurin jiragen, lokaci-lokaci na relativistic yana sa jirgin gaban ya hanzarta da wuri, yana shimfiɗa da yaga zaren.

question: Wane rashin jituwa Paul Ehrenfest ya gano game da tsarin sararin samaniya na silinda mai ƙarfi da ke juyawa da sauri a cikin Musamman Dangantaka?
options: Ƙyamar waje tana ragewa da Lorentz yayin da radius na radial baya ragewa, yana tabbatar da cewa babu abubuwa masu tauri da za su iya wanzuwa a cikin dangantaka
Silinda ya koma ƙwallon ruwa
Friction da iska yana samar da antimatter
Cibiya yana tafasa ya zama tururi
correctAnswer: Ƙyamar waje tana ragewa da Lorentz yayin da radius na radial baya ragewa, yana tabbatar da cewa babu abubuwa masu tauri da za su iya wanzuwa a cikin dangantaka
explanation: Saboda motsi na tangential yana haifar da rage tsawo a duk faɗin ƙyamar waje (2*pi*r < na al'ada) yayin da radius r yake daidaituwa da motsi kuma baya shafar komai, tsarin sarari yana zama ba na Euclidean ba.

question: A cewar Tasirin Unruh, menene mai kallo da ke hanzarta ta cikin cikakken fanko na quantum yake gani maimakon sarari mai sanyi mara komai?
options: Wani dumi mai zafi na hasken jikin baki tare da yanayin zafi daidai da hanzararsu ta jiki
Kwayoyin kankara masu duhu baki
Gungumen tashin hankali na sauri fiye da sauti
Haske masu shuɗi na nauyi
correctAnswer: Wani dumi mai zafi na hasken jikin baki tare da yanayin zafi daidai da hanzararsu ta jiki
explanation: William Unruh ya nuna cewa na'urar bincike mai hanzari tana fuskantar iyakar abubuwan Rindler. Canjin fanko yana bayyana a matsayin ainihin kwayoyin zafi a yanayin zafi T = hbar * a / (2 * pi * c * k_B).

question: Wane mizanin asali Albert Einstein ya bayyana a matsayin 'tunanin farin ciki mafi girma na rayuwata' (Ka'idar Daidaito)?
options: Mai kallo wanda ke fadowa cikin filin nauyi ba shi da nauyi kwata-kwata, wanda yake sanya nauyi ya zama ba a iya bambance shi daga hanzari ɗaya mai daidaito
E = mc^2 yana bayyana bama-baman atomic
Haske ya ƙunshi fakitocin igiyoyi
Tafiya cikin lokaci zuwa baya ba zai yiwu ba
correctAnswer: Mai kallo wanda ke fadowa cikin filin nauyi ba shi da nauyi kwata-kwata, wanda yake sanya nauyi ya zama ba a iya bambance shi daga hanzari ɗaya mai daidaito
explanation: A cikin akwatin rufe, babu wani gwaji na cikin gida da zai iya bambance tsakanin tsayawa a saman duniya da yin hanzari na 9.8 m/s^2 ta cikin sararin samaniya babu kome, haɗa nauyi da yanayin sarari mai lanƙwasa.

question: Me yasa siginar radar da ke dawowa daga Venus ke ɗaukar ƙarin ɗanƙoƙin microseconds ɗari da ɗari lokacin da ta wuce kusa da saman Rana (Jinkirin Shapiro)?
options: Babbar nauyin Rana tana lankwasa da tsawaita sararin-lokaci, wanda ke ƙara tsawon hanyar geometric na siginar haske
Iskar Rana tana busar da fasikon radar baya
Tabon Rana suna shan igiyoyin rediyo
Venus tana rage gudu a lokacin rani
correctAnswer: Babbar nauyin Rana tana lankwasa da tsawaita sararin-lokaci, wanda ke ƙara tsawon hanyar geometric na siginar haske
explanation: Irwin Shapiro ya gabatar da gwaji na huɗu na General Relativity: yada photons ta cikin lankwasaccen sararin-lokaci kusa da wani nauyi yana haifar da jinkirin lokaci na lissafin logarithm.

question: Wane iyaka mafi girma na lissafin ilimin kimiyya game da yawan bayanai masu jiki aka bayyana ta hanyar Bekenstein Bound?
options: Adadin mafi yawa na yanayi ko bayanai da za a iya ɗauka a cikin wani yanki mai iyaka na sarari tare da ƙarfin makamashi mai iyaka
Mafi girman sararin ajiya na hard drive da ake sayarwa a manyan shaguna
Mafi yawan adadin lantarki a cikin tagulla
Mafi girman saurin sauti a cikin ƙarfe
correctAnswer: Adadin mafi yawa na yanayi ko bayanai da za a iya ɗauka a cikin wani yanki mai iyaka na sarari tare da ƙarfin makamashi mai iyaka
explanation: Jacob Bekenstein ya fitar da S <= 2 * pi * k * R * E / (hbar * c). Wuce wannan iyakar zai ba da damar karya Dokar Hanya ta Biyu ta Thermodynamics ta hanyar jefar da bayanai cikin ramin baƙi.

question: Me yasa kwaya dake cikin kwariyar quantum tana iya bayyana kamar tana ketare shingen nan nan da sauri fiye da haske (Sakamakon Hartman)?
options: Jinkirin rukuni yana zama mai 'yancin kai daga kaurin shinge ga shingunan da suka faɗi, wanda ke sa kololuwar raƙuman fitarwa da wuri ta hanyar sake fasalin raƙuman
Kwayar tana shiga duniya mai yawa
Shinge yana gudanar da lantarki nan take
Na'urori suna ƙidaya isowar photon ba daidai ba
correctAnswer: Jinkirin rukuni yana zama mai 'yancin kai daga kaurin shinge ga shingunan da suka faɗi, wanda ke sa kololuwar raƙuman fitarwa da wuri ta hanyar sake fasalin raƙuman
explanation: Thomas Hartman ya nuna a shekarar 1962 cewa lokacin tafiyar kwaryar yana kai kololuwa yayin da kauri ya karu. Fakit ɗin da ke fitowa ba ya tafiya sama da saurin haske, amma wani ɓangare ne da aka rage ƙarfi kuma aka sake fasalin gefen gaba.

question: Me yasa electron da aka harba tsakanin faranti biyu masu kwance da ba sa haskakawa ke fuskantar canje-canje a yawan sakin haske na kai tsaye (Tasirin Purcell)?
options: Canza yawan yanayin lantarki na cikin gida a kusa da kwayar halitta na hanzarta ko rage yawan sakin photon ɗinsa kai tsaye
Farantin suna dumama electron
Farantin suna toshe hasken cosmic
Electron yana rasa juyinsa
correctAnswer: Canza yawan yanayin lantarki na cikin gida a kusa da kwayar halitta na hanzarta ko rage yawan sakin photon ɗinsa kai tsaye
explanation: Edward Purcell ya gano cewa sakin haske na kai tsaye ba halayen kwayar halitta bane na asali, amma yana dogara da haɗin kwayar halitta da kwanten: F_p = 3/(4*pi^2) * (lambda/n)^3 * (Q/V).

question: Ta yaya photon guda daya da aka raba ta rabi-china mai azurfa zai iya ɗaukar duk hanyoyi biyun a lokaci guda, amma a gano shi a pixel ɗaya kawai mai mahalli a kan kyamarar CCD?
options: Lalacewar nau'in-gudun giciye: photon yana yaduwa a matsayin igiyar tsammanin ƙididdiga wadda ba ta cikin gida, amma aunawa na rushe ta zuwa mộtananan ƙwaya
Madubin yana ƙirƙirar kwafin photon ɗin ɗin
Pixel na kyamara yana adana ƙarfin sauti
Laser ɗin yana kashewa ta atomatik
correctAnswer: Lalacewar nau'in-gudun giciye: photon yana yaduwa a matsayin igiyar tsammanin ƙididdiga wadda ba ta cikin gida, amma aunawa na rushe ta zuwa mộtananan ƙwaya
explanation: Ƙa'idar Schrödinger na ci gaba da haɓaka fakitin igiyar sarari a duk hanyoyi biyu. Dokar Born tana nuna cewa haɗin gwiwa mara maimaituwa tare da mai gano mai mahalli yana rushe fakitin zuwa wani wuri.

question: Me yasa mai shakata kankara ke juyawa sosai sauri lokacin da ya jawo hannayensa masu tsawo cikin kirjinsa?
options: Adana Juyin Angular: rage girman juyin jiki na bukatar karfin juyi ya karu daidai gwargwado
Farfadowa da kankara ya ragu zuwa sifili
Kwayoyin tsokoki na hannu suna samar da wutar lantarki
Matsin iska yana turawa skater
correctAnswer: Adana Juyin Angular: rage girman juyin jiki na bukatar karfin juyi ya karu daidai gwargwado
explanation: Juyin angular L = I * omega ana adanawa idan babu torki na waje. Jawo hannaye ciki yana rage girman juyin inertia I = sum(m*r^2), yana tilasta saurin juyi omega ya karu.

question: Me yasa ƙafafun keke mai juyawa ke jure karkata gefe yayin da kake ƙoƙarin lanƙwasa aksarinsa yayin riƙe shi (Gyroscopic Precession)?
options: Amfani da ƙarfin waje yana haifar da canjin kuzarin kusurwa wanda yake da tsaye ga ƙarfin da kuma ɓangaren juyawa
Tayoyin roba suna jan kasa da caji mai tsayi
Iska a cikin bututu tana tauri
Fensirorin suna haifar da ɗaga magnetic
correctAnswer: Amfani da ƙarfin waje yana haifar da canjin kuzarin kusurwa wanda yake da tsaye ga ƙarfin da kuma ɓangaren juyawa
explanation: Gyroscopic torque tau = dL/dt = omega x L yana ƙayyade cewa ƙoƙarin karkatar da ƙafafun gefe yana haifar da ƙarfin martani mai kusurwa 90 daga mataki, yana samar da precession mai ɗorewa maimakon karkata.

question: Me yasa tsintsiya mai nauyi ko gyroscope ba ta faɗi kullum ba nan da nan, sai dai tana yawo a hankali cikin zagaye a kusa da axis na tsaye?
options: Matsi na nauyi da ke aiki a kan cibiyar da ta bambanta yana haifar da ci gaba da juyawar gyroscopic maimakon faɗuwa
Ƙasa tana jawo ƙafun a hankali ta hanyar ƙarfin magnet
Iskar centrifugal tana tura tsintsiya sama
Friction yana kaifi ƙafun
correctAnswer: Matsi na nauyi da ke aiki a kan cibiyar da ta bambanta yana haifar da ci gaba da juyawar gyroscopic maimakon faɗuwa
explanation: Ƙarfi na nauyi yana jan tsintsiya ƙasa tare da matsi tau = r x mg. Saboda tsintsiya tana da motsin lamba angular L, dL = tau * dt yana tilasta ƙafun juyawa don yin zagaye kamar kankara a kusa da axis na tsaye.

question: Me yasa ruwan da ke zubowa daga ramin bandaki na gida ba ya juyawa a hanyoyi daban-daban a Arewa da Kudu na duniya?
options: Hankali na Coriolis a ramin bandaki ya fi rauni sau miliyoyi fiye da ragowar jijjiga, rashin daidaiton kwantena, da kuma kwarara ruwan cikin rami
Kwaron na Equator yana toshe karfin Coriolis gaba daya
Ramuka suna samun lantarki daga masu gyaran famfo
Sabulu yana kawar da juyin Duniya
correctAnswer: Hankali na Coriolis a ramin bandaki ya fi rauni sau miliyoyi fiye da ragowar jijjiga, rashin daidaiton kwantena, da kuma kwarara ruwan cikin rami
explanation: Karfin Coriolis yana da muhimmanci ne kawai a manyan sikeli na duniyoyi (guguwa). A cikin bandaki, a_coriolis ~ 10^-5 m/s^2 ya rikide gaba daya ta yanayin farko na motsin juyawar ruwa.

question: Me yasa gajimaren gajimare na guguwar iska ke juyawa koyaushe a gaba-gaba a hagu a Arewa da a dama a Kudu?
options: Sakacin juyawar Coriolis na duniya yana karkatar da igiyoyin iska masu sauri zuwa dama a Arewacin duniya da zuwa hagu a Kudu kusa da cibiyoyin matsa lamba ƙasa
Guguwan iska suna bin kwararan lantarki na teku
Zafin rana yana tura gajimare zuwa yamma
Iska mai sauri tana dumama teku
correctAnswer: Sakacin juyawar Coriolis na duniya yana karkatar da igiyoyin iska masu sauri zuwa dama a Arewacin duniya da zuwa hagu a Kudu kusa da cibiyoyin matsa lamba ƙasa
explanation: Iska mai sauri tana zuwa tsakiyar ido mai matsa lamba ƙasa ana karkatarta zuwa dama ta hanyar hanzarin Coriolis a Arewacin duniya, yana haifar da zagayowar guguwar iska mai juyawa a gaba-gaba a hagu.

question: Me ya sa jirgin ruwa na tekun da ke tafiya da sauri a cikin tuddar rijiya mai ƙanƙanci da ƙanƙanci ke jan hankali sosai zuwa gefen rijiya (Tasirin Jan Banki)?
options: Ka'idar Bernoulli: ruwan da aka matsa tsakanin jikin jirgin da gefen rijiya yana hanzarta gudu, yana haifar da ƙarancin matsa lamba da ke jan jikin jirgin zuwa bakin ruwa
Baje kolin rijiya suna dauke da ajiye ƙarfe
Rufin fanfo yana dawo daga dutse
Laka tana haifar da jan hankali na lantarki
correctAnswer: Ka'idar Bernoulli: ruwan da aka matsa tsakanin jikin jirgin da gefen rijiya yana hanzarta gudu, yana haifar da ƙarancin matsa lamba da ke jan jikin jirgin zuwa bakin ruwa
explanation: Gudun ruwa da ya matse tsakanin jirgin da gefen rijiya yana ƙara saurin gudu (Tasirin Venturi). Ta hanyar ƙa'idar Bernoulli, wannan haɓakar saurin da ba daidai ba yana haifar da raguwa a matsa lamba da ke jan bayan jirgin zuwa gefen rijiya.

question: Me yasa manyan jiragen ruwan kwantena guda biyu da ke tafiya a layi ɗaya kuma kusa da juna a cikin ruwan zurfi suke jan juna ba tare da iya tserewa ba zuwa karo?
options: Ruwan da ke gudana ta cikin tazara mai ƙunci tsakanin hulls ɗin duka yana ƙara saurin, yana haifar da yankin shaƙar matsa lamba mai ƙananan ruwa.
Antanan rediyo suna jawo juna.
Injinan suna haifar da filayen maganadisu masu daidaita.
Girgiza yana laushi ruwan teku.
correctAnswer: Ruwan da ke gudana ta cikin tazara mai ƙunci tsakanin hulls ɗin duka yana ƙara saurin, yana haifar da yankin shaƙar matsa lamba mai ƙananan ruwa.
explanation: Tasirin Venturi tsakanin jiragen biyu yana ƙara saurin ruwa tsakanin su, yana rage matsin lamba na ruwa. Matsaƙar teku na waje yana tura duka jiragen cikin karo na gefe.

question: Me ya sa ƙwallon ping-pong mai juyawa da top-spin ke nutsewa ƙasa zuwa tebur cikin sauri fiye da yadda nauyi kadai zai nuna (Tasirin Magnus)?
options: Iska da ake jan sama tana motsawa a kan yanayin iska mai zuwa yayin da iska a ƙasa ke motsawa tare da shi, yana haifar da ƙarfin iska na ƙasa
Furfuran iska yana tura ƙwallon ƙasa
Ƙwallon hollow yana sanyaya
Top-spin yana cajin gwal ɗin filastik
correctAnswer: Iska da ake jan sama tana motsawa a kan yanayin iska mai zuwa yayin da iska a ƙasa ke motsawa tare da shi, yana haifar da ƙarfin iska na ƙasa
explanation: Top-spin yana jan iska gaba a saman saman, yana ƙirƙirar wuri na tsayawa sama da babban saurin a ƙasa. Ta hanyar tsarin Bernoulli, matsi mafi girma a sama yana ja ƙwallon ƙasa da ƙarfin Magnus F_M.

question: Me yasa ƙwallon golf ɗin da ke da ramuka ke tafiya kusan ninki biyu cikin iska fiye da ƙwallon da ta yi santsi gaba ɗaya da ke da nauyi da diamita iri ɗaya?
options: Ramuka suna haifar da yanayin iska mai rudani wanda ke manne wa ƙwallon na ɗan lokaci mai tsawo, yana rage jan hankalin iska mai ƙarfi sosai
Ramuka suna ajiye iska da aka matse
Filastik ɗin da ke da ramuka yana da nauyi ƙasa
Ƙwallayen da suka yi santsi suna haifar da gogayya na zafi
correctAnswer: Ramuka suna haifar da yanayin iska mai rudani wanda ke manne wa ƙwallon na ɗan lokaci mai tsawo, yana rage jan hankalin iska mai ƙarfi sosai
explanation: Yanayin iska mai rudani yana da ƙarfin juyi mafi girma kuma yana jure matsin lamba mara kyau fiye da yanayin laka mai layi, yana jinkirta rabuwa da iska kuma yana rage jan hankalin iska mai ƙarancin matsin lamba a bayan ƙwallon.

question: Me ya sa rafin ruwa daga famfon kicin ke jan cokali mara komai zuwa gare shi lokacin da ya taɓa baya mai lankwasa (Tasirin Coandă)?
options: Ƙarfafan gogayya na ruwa suna tilasta rafin ruwa ya bi saman mai lankwasa mai kumburi, suna karkatar da ruwan kuma suna haifar da jan hankali mai ƙarfi da ke hanawa
Cokali yana samun ƙarfin magnet ta ruwan famfo
Cajin tsaye yana jan cokali na ƙarfe
Ƙarfi na saman ruwa yana sanyaya cokali
correctAnswer: Ƙarfafan gogayya na ruwa suna tilasta rafin ruwa ya bi saman mai lankwasa mai kumburi, suna karkatar da ruwan kuma suna haifar da jan hankali mai ƙarfi da ke hanawa
explanation: Henri Coandă ya gano cewa jafi na ruwa yana manne wa saman mai lankwasa kusa saboda ƙaramin matsa lamba da ruwan da aka haɗa ya haifar, yana karkatar da kwarara kuma yana samar da ƙarfin tashi mai amsawa.

question: Yaya atomizer na turare ke fesawa ko carburetor na mota ke ɗaukar ruwa sama ta bututu ba tare da amfani da famfo na mekanikal ba (Tasirin Venturi)?
options: Iska da aka matsa ta cikin ƙunci mai ƙanƙanci tana hanzarta, tana haifar da ƙarancin matsin lamba na waje wanda ke jan ruwa sama ta bututu
Iska da aka matsa tana dumama ruwan har sai ya tafasa
Ƙarfin nauyi yana ja turaren sama
Jan ruwa ta capillary yana turare
correctAnswer: Iska da aka matsa ta cikin ƙunci mai ƙanƙanci tana hanzarta, tana haifar da ƙarancin matsin lamba na waje wanda ke jan ruwa sama ta bututu
explanation: Ruwa da ke gudana ta cikin bututu mai ƙunci yana ƙara saurin tafiyarta bisa ga ka'idar ci gaba, yana sa matsin lamba ya faɗi ƙasa da matsin lamba na yanayi kuma yana jan ruwa sama.

question: Me yasa kwayar ruwa ke yin tsalle, rawa, da rayuwa na mintuna a kan tukunya mai zafi sosai sama da 200°C maimakon ta yi tururi nan take (Tasirin Leidenfrost)?
options: Kashin ruwa na ƙasa yana yin tururi nan take zuwa kumfa mai hana zafi wanda ke hana haɗin kai kai tsaye da tukunyar
Ruwa tana tafasa zuwa gel mai sanyi a zafin da ya yi yawa
Karfe mai zafi yana tilasta ƙwayoyin ruwa ta hanyar maganadisu
Man tukunyar yana daskare kwayar ruwa
correctAnswer: Kashin ruwa na ƙasa yana yin tururi nan take zuwa kumfa mai hana zafi wanda ke hana haɗin kai kai tsaye da tukunyar
explanation: Fiye da matakin Leidenfrost, tafasasshen ƙasa da sauri yana ƙirƙirar fim ɗin tururi mai ƙananan yanayin jan zafi, wanda ke rufe sauran kwayar da zafi kuma yana kawar da gogayya.

question: A ƙarƙashin wasu yanayin gwaji na musamman, me ya sa kwandon ruwa mai dumi da aka bar a buɗe zai iya daskarewa ya zama kankara cikin sauri fiye da kwandon ruwa mai sanyi wanda yake daidai (Tasirin Mpemba)?
options: Ƙara saurin zufa yana rage nauyin ruwa, hanzarta motsin iska na convection, da saurin fitar da abubuwan da aka narke
Ruwan dumi yana dauke da ƙwayoyin ruwa masu sanyi da yawa
Zafi yana jan kankara daga bangon firinji
Ruwan sanyi yana faɗaɗa har sai ya keɓe kansa
correctAnswer: Ƙara saurin zufa yana rage nauyin ruwa, hanzarta motsin iska na convection, da saurin fitar da abubuwan da aka narke
explanation: Erasto Mpemba ya lura cewa hadewar zafi suna daskarewa da sauri. Hanyoyin da ke taimakawa sun haɗa da asarar nauyi mai yawa ta hanyar ƙonewa, isar da zafi ta hanyar motsi mai ƙarfi, da canjin hanyoyin haɗin gwiwar hydrogen.

question: Ta yaya ruwan distille mai tsarki sosai zai iya kasancewa cikin ruwa a -10°C ko -15°C ba tare da daskarewa ba (Supercooling)?
options: Ruwa na bukatar ƙwayar nucleation mai ƙanƙanta (ƙura ko ƙwayar kankara) don kunna canjin yanayin lattice na kristal
Ruwan distille baya da atoms na hydrogen
Sanyi mai tsanani yana mayar da ruwa ya zama ruwa nauyi
Ruwan tsarki yana da ƙarancin daskarewa sifili
correctAnswer: Ruwa na bukatar ƙwayar nucleation mai ƙanƙanta (ƙura ko ƙwayar kankara) don kunna canjin yanayin lattice na kristal
explanation: Daskarewa shine canjin yanayin mataki na farko wanda ke bukatar radius na nucleation mai mahimmanci don shawo kan hukuncin makamashi na saman. Ba tare da datti ba, nucleation na homogeneous yana faruwa ne kawai a kasa -48°C.

question: Wane irin abin mamaki na jiki yake faruwa a cikin karamar kumfa ta sautin ruwa mai ruguwa a cikin ruwa (Sonoluminescence)?
options: Raguwar adiabatic tana matsa iskar gas zuwa dubban yanayi na sama, tana haifar da zafin da ya fi saman Rana kuma tana fitar da walƙiya
Kwayoyin ruwa suna hade su zuwa plasma helium
Guraren sauti suna sake dawowa daga madubin kumfa
Kumfar tana haifar da tsananin wutan lantarki
correctAnswer: Raguwar adiabatic tana matsa iskar gas zuwa dubban yanayi na sama, tana haifar da zafin da ya fi saman Rana kuma tana fitar da walƙiya
explanation: Guraren sauti masu tsayawa suna tilastawa kumfar ta rugguja a saurin sama da na sauti. Girgizar muryoyi masu taruwa a siffa ta zagaye tana dumama iskar gas mai daraja da aka kulle fiye da 15,000 Kelvin, tana samar da ganowar photon cikin picosecond.

question: Me yasa wani ƙarar ƙarfe mai ƙarfi kuma mai lalata ke yin kururuwa ta cikin bututun ruwa na gida lokacin da aka rufe bawul mai sauri a nan da nan (Tasirin Water Hammer)?
options: Ruwan da ba za a iya matsawa ba wanda ke motsi yana tsayawa a nan da nan, yana canza kuzarin motsinsa zuwa wani mummunan girgiza mai matsa lamba wanda ke yawo gaba da baya
Bubbles na tururin ruwan tafasa suna fashewa a cikin bawul
Bututun suna faɗa daga girgizar zafi
Ruwa yana yin hulɗa ta sinadarai da tagulla
correctAnswer: Ruwan da ba za a iya matsawa ba wanda ke motsi yana tsayawa a nan da nan, yana canza kuzarin motsinsa zuwa wani mummunan girgiza mai matsa lamba wanda ke yawo gaba da baya
explanation: Hanzarin ruwa yana haifar da tashiwar matsa lamba ta Joukowsky Delta P = rho * c * Delta v. Wannan girgizar sauti tana tafiya da saurin sauti a cikin ruwa, tana girgiza bangon bututun cikin ƙarfi.

question: Me yasa wani lebur, siriri madauwari na ruwa ke yaduwa a fili daga famfon kicin da ke gudana sannan kuma nan take ya tashi ya zama wani babban zoben mai tsawo (Hydraulic Jump)?
options: Gudun layin ruwa mai sauri, supercritical laminar flow yana canzawa nan da nan zuwa ruwa mai zurfi da jinkiri subcritical yayin da inertia na ruwa ke mika wuya ga nauyi da matsin lamba na hydrostatic
Ruwa na hucewa da sauri a kan bakin karfe maras tsatsa
Surface tension na jawo zoben baya
Ramin wanke-wanke yana fitar da jinƙirar sauti
correctAnswer: Gudun layin ruwa mai sauri, supercritical laminar flow yana canzawa nan da nan zuwa ruwa mai zurfi da jinkiri subcritical yayin da inertia na ruwa ke mika wuya ga nauyi da matsin lamba na hydrostatic
explanation: Lambar Froude tana raguwa daga Fr > 1 (ruffin supercritical inda saurin guguwa ke kasa da gudun ruwa) zuwa Fr < 1 (subcritical). Wannan canjin yana haifar da tsayuwar rashin daidaito mai rarraba kuzari.

question: Me yasa ɗigon giya mai sanyi da ke zuba a cikin gilashin giya ke samar da ƙanƙara waɗanda ke hawa sama da ake kira 'Hawayen Giya' (Tasirin Marangoni)?
options: Tsuntsar giya yana ƙara ƙarfin fatar ruwa a cikin siririn fim ɗin, yana jan ruwa sama har sai nauyi ya tattara shi cikin ɗigon ruwa masu fadowa
Giya tana daskarewa cikin ƙwayoyin sukari
Ramukan gilashi suna turawa ruwa sama ta hanyar jan hankali
Yisti na giya yana yin fermentation a kan gilashi
correctAnswer: Tsuntsar giya yana ƙara ƙarfin fatar ruwa a cikin siririn fim ɗin, yana jan ruwa sama har sai nauyi ya tattara shi cikin ɗigon ruwa masu fadowa
explanation: Giya tana tsarkakewa da sauri fiye da ruwa a cikin siririn fim ɗin meniskus, yana haifar da bambanci a ƙarfin fatar ruwa. Ruwa yana gudana zuwa wuraren da ƙarfin fatar ruwa ya fi girma (matsi na Marangoni) a kan nauyi.

question: Ta yaya manyan itatuwan redwood za su iya tura ruwa sama da mita 100 zuwa cikin ganye lokacin da matsin iska na sararin samaniya zai iya ɗaga ruwa ne kawai har mita 10.3?
options: Ka'idar Haɗin-Tanse: hayaki a cikin ganye yana haifar da mummunan matsin lamba na ruwa, yana jan ginshiƙin ruwa mai ci gaba ƙarƙashin tashin hankali
Tushen itace suna aiki a matsayin famfo na inji mai matsin lamba mai ƙarfi
Ramin fata yana fadada kamar piston
Sukari na osmotik yana tura ruwan tsiro sama
correctAnswer: Ka'idar Haɗin-Tanse: hayaki a cikin ganye yana haifar da mummunan matsin lamba na ruwa, yana jan ginshiƙin ruwa mai ci gaba ƙarƙashin tashin hankali
explanation: Haɗin gwiwar hydrogen yana ba ruwa ƙarfin jan narkewa mai ban mamaki (~-20 MPa). Fitar da ruwa ta stomata yana haifar da matsin lamba mara kyau wanda ke ɗaga ginshiƙan xylem marasa yankewa zuwa tsayin daɗi na rufin itace.

question: Me yasa kowane Cheerio da ke iyo a cikin kwano na madara yake haɗuwa da kansa cikin ƙungiyoyi masu iyo (Tasirin Cheerio)?
options: Lanƙwasa meniskus: abubuwan da suke iyo suna lalata saman ruwa, suna sa su motsawa zuwa juna a kan layukan tashin hankali na buoyant
Farin madara yana aiki a matsayin manne na halitta
Ƙananan hatsi suna ɗauke da cajar lantarki masu karo da juna
Girgizar saman ruwa suna tura ƙananan abubuwa zuwa ciki
correctAnswer: Lanƙwasa meniskus: abubuwan da suke iyo suna lalata saman ruwa, suna sa su motsawa zuwa juna a kan layukan tashin hankali na buoyant
explanation: Ƙarfin ɗumamar ruwa suna ƙirƙirar meniski mai lanƙwashe a kusa da hatsi masu iyo. Abubuwan da ke jan ruwa suna tashi zuwa juna don rage jimlar ƙarfin nauyi da kuma ƙarfin saman haɗin ruwa.

question: Me yasa wani siririn kwarara na shamfu da aka zuba ko sabulun hannu na ruwa wani lokaci ke harbin wani ruwa mai tsalle zuwa sama daga kansa (Tasirin Kaye)?
options: Halayen rashin Newton masu rarrabuwa na shear suna ba da damar kwarara mai fadowa ta shimfiɗa a saman wani layer na iska da aka kama a kan tarin
Wutan lantarki na tsaye yana tura kwayoyin sabulu sama
Ayyukan sinadarai suna haifar da kumfa masu fadada
Shamfu yana dauke da micro-springs
correctAnswer: Halayen rashin Newton masu rarrabuwa na shear suna ba da damar kwarara mai fadowa ta shimfiɗa a saman wani layer na iska da aka kama a kan tarin
explanation: Alan Kaye ya gano cewa ruwa masu viscoelastic da ke rage shear suna samar da dimple a kan laka ta ruwa. Siririn fim ɗin iska yana yin lubrication ga ruwan, yana ba da damar kwarara mai zuwa ta iftawa da dawowa sama.

question: Me yasa maganin polymer mai viscoelastic ke hawa sama a kan sanda mai juyawa mai tsaye maimakon a jefar da shi zuwa waje ta hanyar karfin centrifugal (Illolin Weissenberg)?
options: Daidaitattun matsin lamba na elastic da aka haifar ta tsawon sarkar polymer suna samar da matsin hoop wanda ke matsa ruwa zuwa ciki da sama a kan sanda
Karfin centrifugal yana juyawa a cikin ruwan mai kauri
Firtan sanda yana dumama ruwa har sai ya tashi
Magnetic induction yana jan polymer
correctAnswer: Daidaitattun matsin lamba na elastic da aka haifar ta tsawon sarkar polymer suna samar da matsin hoop wanda ke matsa ruwa zuwa ciki da sama a kan sanda
explanation: Karl Weissenberg ya nuna cewa tsawaita dogon sarkar polymer yayin shearing yana shimfidawa su a layin yawo. Tensor ɗin matsin lamba na anisotropic da aka samu yana samar da ƙarfin ciki wanda ke tura ruwan sama a kan axis.

question: Me ya sa fenti mai kauri ke kwarara da laushi da sirara a ƙarƙashin goge mai fenti, amma nan da nan ya daskare kuma baya zubowa daga bango tsaye idan an dakatar da gogewa (Thixotropy)?
options: Matsin lamba na injin yana karyar da tsarin gel mai haɗin juna wanda za a iya dawo da shi, wanda ke sake taruwa cikin sauri zuwa tsarin dutsen lokacin hutu.
Gogewa na sa man fenti mai laushi yayi saurin ɓacewa.
Fenti yana yin sinadarin haɗi da iska ta cikin gida.
Jan hankali na dakile kauri na fenti.
correctAnswer: Matsin lamba na injin yana karyar da tsarin gel mai haɗin juna wanda za a iya dawo da shi, wanda ke sake taruwa cikin sauri zuwa tsarin dutsen lokacin hutu.
explanation: Ruwa mai thixotropic yana nuna rage kauri bisa lokaci. Ƙarfin gogewa yana lalata ƙananan tsari da ke da alaƙa da hydrogen a ciki, yana rage kauri; lokacin da ya huta, microstructure yana sake gini, yana hana zubowa.

question: Me yasa wani ferrofluid mai ɗauke da ƙarfe ke samar da jerin tsantsar ruwa mai kaifi kamar bera lokacin da aka fallasa shi ga filin ƙarfe na tsaye (Rosensweig Instability)?
options: Daidaiton mahimmanci tsakanin ƙarfin jiki na ƙarfe da ke ja ruwan a kan layin filin, ƙarfin saman da ke hana lalacewa, da nauyi.
Nanoparticles na ƙarfe suna daskarewa su zama allurai masu ƙarfi.
Filayen ƙarfe suna haifar da cajin lantarki.
Ferrofluid yana tafasa zuwa tururin ƙarfe.
correctAnswer: Daidaiton mahimmanci tsakanin ƙarfin jiki na ƙarfe da ke ja ruwan a kan layin filin, ƙarfin saman da ke hana lalacewa, da nauyi.
explanation: Ronald Rosensweig ya tabbatar cewa sama da wani iyaka na filin ƙarfe, saman lebur yana zama marar tabbas. Ana rage ƙarin wutar kyauta ta hanyar samar da jerin rarrabawar hexagonal na tsintsaye masu kaifi a layin filin.

question: Me yasa ƙaramin ƙarfen ƙarfe mai ɗorewa ke rasa ƙarfin ƙarfe gaba ɗaya kuma baya iya manne wa firiji lokacin da aka ɗora shi sama da 770°C (Zafin Curie)?
options: Girgizar zafi tana rinjayar haɗin musayar ƙarfin lantarki, tana sa daidaituwar ƙananan yankunan ƙarfe su zama bazuwar
Ƙarfe yana narkewa ya zama aluminum mara ƙarfe
Electron suna ƙonewa cikin wuta
Ƙarfin ƙarfe na pol ɗin suna kaucewa ta hanyar tsatsa
correctAnswer: Girgizar zafi tana rinjayar haɗin musayar ƙarfin lantarki, tana sa daidaituwar ƙananan yankunan ƙarfe su zama bazuwar
explanation: Pierre Curie ya nuna cewa ƙarfin zafi k_B * T ya wuce ƙarfin musayar lantarki da ke sa electron spins su kasance a layi ɗaya. Ƙarfin ƙarfe na kai tsaye yana raguwa zuwa sifili, yana shiga matakin paramagnetic.

question: Ta yaya thermocouple ke samar da ƙarfin lantarki lokacin da aka haɗa wayoyi biyu na ƙarfe daban-daban tare da haɗin su ajiye a yanayin zafin jiki daban-daban (Tasirin Seebeck)?
options: Masu ɗaukar caji (electrons ko ramuka) suna bazuwa daga haɗin mai zafi zuwa haɗin mai sanyi, suna haifar da bambancin ƙarfin lantarki na thermo
Zafi yana narkar da tagulla cikin ruwan batir
Karfe mai sanyi yana haifar da gogayya mai tsayi
Faɗaɗa zafi yana matse lantarki
correctAnswer: Masu ɗaukar caji (electrons ko ramuka) suna bazuwa daga haɗin mai zafi zuwa haɗin mai sanyi, suna haifar da bambancin ƙarfin lantarki na thermo
explanation: Thomas Johann Seebeck ya gano cewa bambancin zafin jiki nabla T yana motsa yaduwar daukacin zafi, yana haifar da filin lantarki E = -S * nabla T, inda S shine coefficient na Seebeck na kayan.

question: Ta yaya firiji mai amfani da Peltier mai ɗorewa zai iya daskare ɗigon ruwa a gefe ɗaya yayin da yake sakin zafi sosai a gefen dayan ta amfani da wutar lantarki kai tsaye kawai (Tasirin Peltier)?
options: Wucewar wutar lantarki ta haye haɗin semiconductors daban-daban tana ɗaukar ƙarfin zafi ta hanyar masu ɗaukar cajin daga gefe ɗaya zuwa ɗaya
Gas ɗin freon mai sanyaya yana shawagi ta igiyoyi
Baturan na ɗaukar ions ɗin zafi
Raɗin sauti yana sanyaya haɗin
correctAnswer: Wucewar wutar lantarki ta haye haɗin semiconductors daban-daban tana ɗaukar ƙarfin zafi ta hanyar masu ɗaukar cajin daga gefe ɗaya zuwa ɗaya
explanation: Jean Peltier ya nuna cewa wutar I tana tura electrons ta tsakanin tazara na semiconductor tana ɗaukar zafi a haɗin ɗaya (sanyaya) kuma tana sakin sa a haɗin dayan: Q_dot = (Pi_A - Pi_B) * I.

question: Ta yaya na’urar auna tasirin Hall ta yau da kullum ke auna karfin filin maganadisu ta amfani da karamin wutar lantarki?
options: Ƙarfin Lorentz yana karkatar da masu ɗauke da caji da ke wucewa zuwa ɗaya gefen na’urar, yana samar da ƙarfin lantarki na Hall da za a iya auna shi
Filayen maganadisu suna narke wayar tagulla
Maganadisu yana rage saurin haske
Electrons suna daina motsi gaba ɗaya
correctAnswer: Ƙarfin Lorentz yana karkatar da masu ɗauke da caji da ke wucewa zuwa ɗaya gefen na’urar, yana samar da ƙarfin lantarki na Hall da za a iya auna shi
explanation: Edwin Hall ya nuna cewa filin maganadisu B mai kusurwa na tsaye yana aiki da ƙarfin F = q(v x B) a kan cajin da ke gudana, yana tara caji a kan iyaka ɗaya har sai filin lantarki na kwance ya daidaita ƙarfin maganadisu.

question: Me ya sa gano Babban Maganetoresistance (GMR) a shekarar 1988 ya haifar da wani juyin juya halin girgiza a iyakar ajiyar diskin kwamfuta?
options: Matsalolin lantarki na canzawa sosai bisa la’akari da daidaiton juyawar electron ta hanyar safar gajerun nanometer na maganadisu da wadanda ba maganadisu ba
Ya maye gurbin farantin aluminium da gilashi
Ya rage yanayin zafin aiki na diskin
Ya kawar da kanin injin mekanikal na disk
correctAnswer: Matsalolin lantarki na canzawa sosai bisa la’akari da daidaiton juyawar electron ta hanyar safar gajerun nanometer na maganadisu da wadanda ba maganadisu ba
explanation: Albert Fert da Peter Grünberg sun gano cewa toshewar da ke dogara da juyawar ta hanyar safar gajerun yawa na multilayers yana haifar da raguwa mai girma a matsalolin lantarki lokacin da safar ferromagnetic ake jan hankali a layi daya.

question: Me yasa superconductar zafi mai yawa da aka sanya a saman madubin dindindin baya kawai jure shi, amma yana ci gaba da kasancewa daidaitacce a sararin sama a kowanne matsayi (Flux Pinning)?
options: Layukan filin maganadisu suna shiga ta cikin ƙananan tashoshin lahani (vortices) a cikin superconductors na Nau'i-II, suna tsayar da layukan flux maganadisu a wurin su
Cajin lantarki na tsaye yana manna madubin
Nitrogen mai sanyi yana ƙirƙirar kofuna masu jan hankali
Ƙarfi nauyi yana soke ta hanyar vakiyum
correctAnswer: Layukan filin maganadisu suna shiga ta cikin ƙananan tashoshin lahani (vortices) a cikin superconductors na Nau'i-II, suna tsayar da layukan flux maganadisu a wurin su
explanation: A cikin superconductors na Nau'i-II tsakanin H_c1 da H_c2, flux maganadisu yana shiga kamar Abrikosov vortices masu ƙayyade. Kokarin kayan abu yana tsayar da waɗannan cores na vortex, yana kulle rarrabuwa ta sarari da ƙarfi.

question: Ta yaya SQUID (Superconducting Quantum Interference Device) zai iya gano filayen maganadisu masu rauni sosai da sinapses ɗin kwakwalwar ɗan adam ke samarwa (10^-15 Tesla)?
options: Yana amfani da haɗin Josephson biyu masu layi a cikin madauwari mai superconducting inda rikicin matakin quantum ke canzawa sosai tare da ɓangarorin flux quanta
Yana ƙara sauti ta amfani da allurai na carbon
Yana auna lalacewar beta mai radioactive a cikin jini
Yana mayar da hasken microwave na cosmic
correctAnswer: Yana amfani da haɗin Josephson biyu masu layi a cikin madauwari mai superconducting inda rikicin matakin quantum ke canzawa sosai tare da ɓangarorin flux quanta
explanation: Flux ɗin maganadisu da ke shiga madauwari yana haifar da bambancin mataki Delta phi = 2*pi * Phi / Phi_0 a faɗin haɗin Josephson biyu, wanda ke haifar da yanayoyin oscillations na yanzu mai mahimmanci masu hankali ga 10^-18 Tesla.

question: A cewar Ka'idar BCS, ta yaya ƙwayoyin lantarki biyu masu ƙin juna waɗanda ke da caji mara kyau suke haɗuwa cikin 'Ƙungiyar Cooper' mai jan hankali a cikin babban mai sanyaya zafi mai ƙasa?
options: Wani ƙwayar lantarki da ke wucewa yana canza tsarin ƙarfe mai caji mai kyau, yana barin wani layin polarization mai kyau da ke jan hankalin ƙwayar lantarki ta biyu
Ƙarfin nukiliya masu ƙarfi suna cin nasara akan ƙin juna na Coulomb
Ƙwayoyin lantarki suna musayar hotunan lantarki masu juyi
Ƙarfin nauyi yana matse orbitals na ƙwayar lantarki
correctAnswer: Wani ƙwayar lantarki da ke wucewa yana canza tsarin ƙarfe mai caji mai kyau, yana barin wani layin polarization mai kyau da ke jan hankalin ƙwayar lantarki ta biyu
explanation: Bardeen, Cooper, da Schrieffer sun nuna cewa mu'amalar electron-phonon tana ƙirƙirar wani yanayi mai jan hankali tsakanin ƙwayoyin lantarki masu motsi da juyi masu akasin juna, suna ƙirƙirar ƙungiyoyin Cooper na bosonic da ke kondensa.

question: Me yasa matsawa ko dannawa na wutar lantarki mai kyau na quartz na yau da kullum yana haifar da caji mai girma na lantarki a fuskokinta (Tasirin Piezoelectric)?
options: Canjin yanayin injiniya yana matsar da ions na silicon masu kyau da oxygen masu kyau a cikin crystals da ba su da tsakiya, yana haifar da ƙwayar lantarki ta lantarki
Furfurewa da iska yana cajin dutse
Quartz yana adana wutar lantarki ta rana
Dannawa quartz yana murɗe ‘yan lantarki masu yawa
correctAnswer: Canjin yanayin injiniya yana matsar da ions na silicon masu kyau da oxygen masu kyau a cikin crystals da ba su da tsakiya, yana haifar da ƙwayar lantarki ta lantarki
explanation: Crystals da ba su da tsari mai juyawa (kamar alpha-quartz) suna samar da polarization na lantarki na maki P_i = d_ijk * sigma_jk lokacin da aka yi musu matsin lamba na injiniya, yana haifar da cajin fuska.

question: Me yasa goge bulo na roba da gashi na mutum da ƙarfi ke haifar da bulo ya manne sosai a saman rufin drywall mara caji na tsawan awanni (Tasirin Triboelectric)?
options: Goge saman yana canza lantarki daga gashi zuwa roba na bulo, kuma bulo mai caji mara kyau yana haifar da rarrabuwar ƙwayoyin da ba su da caji a rufin
Roba tana narkar da plaster na drywall
Goge yana dumama roba har sai ta narke
Gashi yana barin man mai manne
correctAnswer: Goge saman yana canza lantarki daga gashi zuwa roba na bulo, kuma bulo mai caji mara kyau yana haifar da rarrabuwar ƙwayoyin da ba su da caji a rufin
explanation: Saduwar gogewa tsakanin kayan da suke da ayyukan aiki daban-daban yana canza lantarki. Insulator mai caji yana haifar da cajin hoto a cikin rufin dielectric, wanda ke samar da ƙarfafa jan wutar lantarki.

question: Ta yaya ƙaramin mai ɗaga foil mai siffar kusurwa zai iya tashi cikin shiru a tsakiyar iska idan an haɗa shi da wutar lantarki mai ƙarfin volta 30,000 (Tasirin Biefeld-Brown)?
options: Fitarwar ion mai ƙarfin wutar lantarki mara daidaito yana ionizing kwayoyin iska da ke kewaye, kuma iska mai saurin motsi tana tura mai ɗaga ta hanyar musayar motsi.
Filayen rashin nauyi suna soke nauyin Duniya.
Wutar lantarki mai ƙarfi tana tura ƙwayoyin ƙarfe na Duniya.
Foil ɗin yana zama mai watsin wutar lantarki.
correctAnswer: Fitarwar ion mai ƙarfin wutar lantarki mara daidaito yana ionizing kwayoyin iska da ke kewaye, kuma iska mai saurin motsi tana tura mai ɗaga ta hanyar musayar motsi.
explanation: Wayar siriri mai kaifi tana haifar da filin lantarki mai ƙarfi wanda ke ionizing iska (fitarwar corona). Ions da aka hanzarta suna rikicewa da kwayoyin iska marasa kararrawa, suna haifar da 'iska ta ion' mai turawa ƙasa wanda ke tura mai ɗaga sama.

question: Me ya sa maciji gecko zai iya gudu a juyawa a saman gilashin da aka goge, ba tare da amfani da kowanne ruwan man shafawa mai ɗaure ba ko kofunan matsewa?
options: Miliyoyin setae masu kwayoyin halitta suna rarrabuwa zuwa biliyoyin spatulae masu girman nanoscale waɗanda ke haifar da ƙarfin rarrabewa na Van der Waals gaba ɗaya
Gecko yana amfani da riƙon lantarki na electrostatic
Kofunan matsewa ƙanana suna ƙirƙirar vacuum
Yatsun gecko suna sakin manne mai saurin bushewa
correctAnswer: Miliyoyin setae masu kwayoyin halitta suna rarrabuwa zuwa biliyoyin spatulae masu girman nanoscale waɗanda ke haifar da ƙarfin rarrabewa na Van der Waals gaba ɗaya
explanation: Yatsun gecko suna ɗauke da setae waɗanda ke reshe zuwa spatulae (~200 nm fadi). Kusantar da kwayoyin halitta tana amfani da ƙarfin lantarki na Van der Waals, wanda zai iya ɗaukar har zuwa 130 kg.

question: Me yasa ƙanƙananan ruwan sama ke samar da kusan ƙwallon lu'u-lu'u mai siffar sfera a kan ganyen lotus kuma su juyawa suna ɗauke da duk ƙazanta da su (Tasirin Lotus)?
options: Microscopic epidermal papillae da aka rufe da wax mai hana ruwa suna kama manyan ruwan iska a ƙarƙashin ruwan sama (matsayin danshi na Cassie-Baxter)
Ganyen lotus suna fitar da ruwa Teflon
Ganyen yana girgiza a mitocin ultrasonic
Ruwa yana yin hulɗa da sinadaran furotin na ganye
correctAnswer: Microscopic epidermal papillae da aka rufe da wax mai hana ruwa suna kama manyan ruwan iska a ƙarƙashin ruwan sama (matsayin danshi na Cassie-Baxter)
explanation: Samar da yanayin micro- da nano-textured yana kulle tabarau na iska a ƙarƙashin ruwan (matsayin Cassie-Baxter). Angulan tuntuɓa sun wuce digiri 160, suna ba da damar ruwan sama mai juyawa tarawa da ƙazanta ta hanyar mannewa a saman.

question: Me yasa fure dake hutawa a saman siriri mai kauri millimita 2 na silica Aerogel zai iya kasancewa ba a ƙone ba gaba ɗaya kuma sabo yayin da ake watsa wutar blowtorch mai zafin 1,000°C kai tsaye a ƙasa?
options: Skeleton na silica mai rami na Aerogel ya ƙunshi kashi 99.8 na iska, yana kulle iskar a cikin ramuka da suka fi ƙaramin hanyoyin tafiya na ƙwayoyin iska (Tasirin Knudsen)
Aerogel yana haskaka zafi kamar madubin azurfa
Gel ɗin yana shan photons na thermal ta hanyar photosynthesis
Zafin blowtorch ana juyawa zuwa lantarki
correctAnswer: Skeleton na silica mai rami na Aerogel ya ƙunshi kashi 99.8 na iska, yana kulle iskar a cikin ramuka da suka fi ƙaramin hanyoyin tafiya na ƙwayoyin iska (Tasirin Knudsen)
explanation: Tare da girman ramuka (~20 nm) da suka fi ƙaramin hanyar tafiya na ƙwayoyin iska (~70 nm), ƙwayoyin iskar ba za su iya karo don canja makamashin kinetic ba. Haɗe da tsarin silica mai lanƙwasa, isar zafi yana kusan ~0.015 W/mK.

question: Ta yaya wayar da aka lalata sosai, ta kumbura da aka yi daga Nitinol (hadadden nickel-da-titanium) zata iya dawowa nan da nan zuwa tsarin madaidaiciya na asali idan an saka ta cikin ruwan zafi?
options: Sauyin yanayi na thermoelastic mai iya juyawa daga martensitic zuwa austenitic a cikin yanayi mai ƙarfi yana dawo da tsarin crystal na zafin jiki mai yawa
Zafi yana narkar da murfin ƙarfe na waje
Ruwan zafi yana caji wayar da ions masu tuna siffa
Ruwan tafasasshe yana laushi matsalolin ciki
correctAnswer: Sauyin yanayi na thermoelastic mai iya juyawa daga martensitic zuwa austenitic a cikin yanayi mai ƙarfi yana dawo da tsarin crystal na zafin jiki mai yawa
explanation: Mangwaron Nitinol kasa da yanayin sauyawa yana daidaita nau'ikan martensite biyu ba tare da karya haɗin atomic ba. Dumama sama da A_f yana sauya lattic dinsa zuwa austenite na uwa, yana haifar da cikakken dawo da siffa.

question: Me yasa kyawawan fuka-fukan haske mai launin shuɗi na katuwar kifi Morpho ba su taɓa ɓatawa a cikin rana kamar launukan sinadarai ko fenti ba?
options: Launin ana samar da shi ta hanyar tsari na nanoscale: gine-ginen chitin na itacen Kirsimeti suna nuna duhun launin shuɗi a hankali
Fintin yana dauke da dye na ƙarfe cobalt na dindindin
Fuka-fukan katuwar kifi suna shan dukkan hasken gani sai dai shuɗi
Rana na caji fintin fuka-fukan da hasken shuɗi na bioluminescence
correctAnswer: Launin ana samar da shi ta hanyar tsari na nanoscale: gine-ginen chitin na itacen Kirsimeti suna nuna duhun launin shuɗi a hankali
explanation: Launin Morpho yana da tsari: ƙaramin kaho-kaho kamar bishiya na chitin yana ƙirƙirar yanayin dielectric na musaya. Hada-hadar da hankali yana ƙara hasken shuɗi na 450 nm, wanda ba ya raguwa sai dai idan an narke tsarin jiki.

question: Ta yaya kayan aikin haske na wucin gadi na Metamaterials ke karkatar da haske zuwa hanyar da ta saba gaba ɗaya daidai, suna ba da damar samun labulen ɓoyewa na ka'idar tunani?
options: Suna da ƙarfin wutar lantarki mara kyau (epsilon) da kuma ƙarfin shigar da maganadisu mara kyau (mu) lokaci guda, suna samar da lambar nuni mara kyau
Suna amfani da dubunnan ƙaramin madubi masu nuna laser
Suna sha haske sannan su sake fitar da igiyoyin rediyo
Suna dumama iska don ƙirƙirar duhu
correctAnswer: Suna da ƙarfin wutar lantarki mara kyau (epsilon) da kuma ƙarfin shigar da maganadisu mara kyau (mu) lokaci guda, suna samar da lambar nuni mara kyau
explanation: Victor Veselago ya yi hasashen cewa kayan da ke da lambar mara kyau (NIMs) suna juyar da dokar Snell: haske yana karkata zuwa gefen daidai na al'ada yayin refractor. Rarraba ƙaramin sarka da ba ta kai ragi ba suna jagorantar gungun raƙuman ruwa a hankali kewaye da abubuwa.

question: Me ya sa haske da ke tafiya a cikin kebul na gilashin fiber na gani ke ci gaba da kasancewa a ciki na kilomita ba tare da fito daga gefuna ba (Cikakken Mayar da Hasken Ciki)?
options: Matsayin shigarwa a iyakar gilashi-cladding ya fi kusurwar muhimmi, yana dawo da kashi 100 na haske cikin ciki
Wajen kebul ɗin an saka shi da madubai na aluminum foil
Fibers na gilashi suna sha duhun waje
Kebul ɗin fiber suna amfani da famfunan laser masu matsa lamba mai yawa
correctAnswer: Matsayin shigarwa a iyakar gilashi-cladding ya fi kusurwar muhimmi, yana dawo da kashi 100 na haske cikin ciki
explanation: Lokacin da haske ke tafiya daga ƙwayar core mai yawa (n1 mafi girma) zuwa cladding mai ƙarancin n (n2) a kusurwar theta > theta_c = arcsin(n2/n1), dokar Snell tana daidaita rashin watsawa gaba ɗaya, tana cimma cikakken mayar da hasken ciki ba tare da asarar dawowa ba.

question: Me yasa tabarau masu inuwa ke rage hasken walƙiya da ake gani daga hanya mai ruwa ko saman ruwa kusan gaba ɗaya?
options: Walƙiyar da ake tunawa mafi yawa tana da inuwa ta kwance, yayin da tabarau masu inuwa ke amfani da layukan watsa a tsaye don toshe ta
Tabarau suna duhu duk tsawon igiyoyin haske daidai
Lens ɗin suna ɗauke da ruwan sanyi mai gel
Gilashin inuwa yana mayar da hasken UV zuwa rana
correctAnswer: Walƙiyar da ake tunawa mafi yawa tana da inuwa ta kwance, yayin da tabarau masu inuwa ke amfani da layukan watsa a tsaye don toshe ta
explanation: Hasken da ke yin tunanin daga saman dielectric mai kwance kusa da kusurwar Brewster yawanci yana da s-inuwa (filin lantarki a layi da saman, wato, kwance). Tacewar inuwa ta tsaye tana zaɓan toshe wannan walƙiyar kwance.

question: Me ya sa kallon rubutu ta hanyar tsabta kristali mai bayyana na Iceland Spar calcite ke nuna hotuna biyu masu kama juna wadanda suka yi ninkuwa (Birefringence)?
options: Kristalin calcite yana da ƙarfin juyawa na anisotropic wanda ke raba hasken da ba a daidaita ba zuwa ƙwayoyin haske na al'ada da na musamman
Kristalin yana da madubin fashewa na ciki
Calcite tana fitar da photons na fatalwa
Idanun ɗan adam suna faɗaɗa a cikin calcite
correctAnswer: Kristalin calcite yana da ƙarfin juyawa na anisotropic wanda ke raba hasken da ba a daidaita ba zuwa ƙwayoyin haske na al'ada da na musamman
explanation: Kristalai na uniaxial suna nuna yawan iya lantarki dangane da hanya. Haske da ke shigowa yana rabuwa zuwa 'ƙwayar al'ada' wacce ke bin dokar Snell da 'ƙwayar musamman' mai gudun juyawa dangane da kusurwa, yana matsar da hotuna biyu.

question: Me yasa kyawawan launuka iri-iri na igiyoyi masu damuwa suke bayyana a cikin ma’aunin filastik mai haske idan aka duba tsakanin matattarar polarizing guda biyu (Photoelasticity)?
options: Damuwa na injiniya yana haifar da birefringence na wucin gadi, yana canza saurin matakin tsakanin abubuwan da ake da su na polarized
Filastik yana shan hasken ultraviolet
Matattarar da suka tsallaka suna haifar da igiyoyi na zafi
Wutar lantarki mai tsayayya tana ionizing filastik
correctAnswer: Damuwa na injiniya yana haifar da birefringence na wucin gadi, yana canza saurin matakin tsakanin abubuwan da ake da su na polarized
explanation: Brewster ya gano tasirin haske na damuwa: tensors na damuwa na injiniya suna haifar da anisotropy na gani a yankin bisa ga manyan damuwoyi (sigma_1 - sigma_2). Polarizers da suka tsallaka suna nuna wadannan jinkirin mataki a matsayin igiyoyi masu launi iri-iri.

question: Me ya sa wucewar hasken layi mai haske ta gilashi da aka sanya a cikin karfin maganadisu mai ƙarfi ke juyar da shafin daidaita haske (Tasirin Faraday)?
options: Filin maganadisu na raba matakan kuzarin kwayoyin (Tasirin Zeeman), wanda ke sa hasken da aka daidaita a hagu da dama ya yi tafiya da saurin mataki daban-daban
Filin maganadisu yana lanƙwasa gilashin a zahiri
Hasken yana zama mai ɗaukar lantarki
Foton suna karo da ions maganadisu
correctAnswer: Filin maganadisu na raba matakan kuzarin kwayoyin (Tasirin Zeeman), wanda ke sa hasken da aka daidaita a hagu da dama ya yi tafiya da saurin mataki daban-daban
explanation: Michael Faraday ya gano magneto-optics: filin maganadisu na tsaye B yana haifar da birefringence zagaye. Kusurwar juyawa ita ce theta = V * B * L, inda V shine dindindin Verdet.

question: Me ya sa allon nuni na gilashin ruwa (LCD) ke zama baki baki nan take idan ka kalli shi yayin da ka karkatar da kanka kana sanye da tabarau masu rarraba haske?
options: Matatar rarraba haske ta gaba na allon tana da kusurwa ta tsaye da matatar tabarau, wanda ke toshe dukkan hasken da ke wucewa
Allunan LCD na kashewa idan kamara ta kalle su
Gilashin da ke rarraba haske yana cinye cajin baturi na monitor
Tabarau suna mayar da hasken baya cikin allon
correctAnswer: Matatar rarraba haske ta gaba na allon tana da kusurwa ta tsaye da matatar tabarau, wanda ke toshe dukkan hasken da ke wucewa
explanation: Dokar Malus tana nuna yawan hasken da ya wucewa I = I_0 * cos^2(theta). Lokacin da axis na rarraba hasken tabarau ya juya digiri 90 dangane da rarraba hasken fitarwa na allo, cos(90) = 0 kuma watsawa tana raguwa zuwa sifili.

question: Ta yaya za a iya sanya lens ɗin gilashi ya zama mara ɗaukar haske gaba ɗaya ta amfani da wani siriri sosai na sinadarai (shawarar rushewa)?
options: Ana daidaita kaurin rufewar zuwa rubu'in tsayin igiyar haske, wanda ke sa haskoki daga saman da ƙasan su soke juna
Rufewar tana sha dukkan photonan da aka nuna
An yi rufewar sinadarai daga fentin baki
Rufewar tana mayar da gilashi ya zama lu'u-lu'u
correctAnswer: Ana daidaita kaurin rufewar zuwa rubu'in tsayin igiyar haske, wanda ke sa haskoki daga saman da ƙasan su soke juna
explanation: Rufewar mai kauri d = λ / (4 * n_film) tana haifar da bambancin tafiyar zagaye na rabin igiyar (canjin mataki na digiri 180). Ra’ayoyin da aka nuna biyu suna nuna juna ta hanyar rushewa, suna karkatar da makamashi zuwa watsawar kashi 100%.

question: Me ya sa na'urar kallo ta microscope da gilashin ido na yau da kullum ke kai iyakar ƙuduri da ba za a iya cim ma ba wanda yake kusan nanomita 200 (Iyakacin Yaduwar Abbe)?
options: Yaduwa: igiyoyin haske da ke wucewa ta rami mai iyaka sukan bazu, suna samar da faifai na Airy waɗanda ke gauraye idan sun fi kusa da lambdan / (2 * NA)
Gilashin lens yana narke ƙarƙashin fitilun microscope
Zafafan faranti na microscope suna girgiza daga sautin daki
Idanun ɗan adam ba su da isasshen ƙwayar gani
correctAnswer: Yaduwa: igiyoyin haske da ke wucewa ta rami mai iyaka sukan bazu, suna samar da faifai na Airy waɗanda ke gauraye idan sun fi kusa da lambdan / (2 * NA)
explanation: Ernst Abbe ya tabbatar cewa yaduwar igiyoyi tana saƙa ƙaramar nisan da za a iya bambanta d = lambda / (2 * n * sin alpha). Ba za a iya bambanta abubuwan da suka fi rabin tsawon igiyar haske mai gani ba ta amfani da na’urar gilashi mai nesa.

question: Ta yaya hangen nesa mai zurfi na STED (Lambar Kyautar Nobel ta Chemistry ta 2014) ya karya shingen natsuwar Abbe don ganin kwayoyin furotin ɗaya-ɗaya a cikin ƙwayoyin dake rayuwa?
options: Ta amfani da hasken laser mai fasalin donut don kashe walƙiya a kusa da wurin mayar da hankali, yana barin kawai ƙaramin ƙwayar nanometer da ke walƙiya.
Ta amfani da X-rays waɗanda ke lalata ƙwayar.
Ta kara girman allon na'ura mai dubawa ta dijital.
Ta sanyaya na'urar hangen nesa a cikin ruwa helium.
correctAnswer: Ta amfani da hasken laser mai fasalin donut don kashe walƙiya a kusa da wurin mayar da hankali, yana barin kawai ƙaramin ƙwayar nanometer da ke walƙiya.
explanation: Stefan Hell ya wuce iyakar Abbe ta amfani da tsarin dakatar da fitar da haske mai motsa jiki (STED). Hasken laser mai fasalin donut yana hana fitar da haske a gefuna, yana matse aikin walƙiya zuwa kusan 20 nm.

question: Me yasa agogon atomic a cikin tauraron dan adam na GPS ke karkatowa kusan microseconds 38 a kowace rana idan aka bar shi ba tare da gyara ba dangane da agogunan a saman ƙasa?
options: Musamman Dangantaka tana rage saurin agogon tauraron dan adam da microseconds 7 (sauri), yayin da Babban Dangantaka ke hanzarta su da microseconds 45 (raunin nauyi)
Iska ta rana tana tura lantarkin tauraron dan adam
Tauraron dan adam yana karewa daga lantarki
Ragowar hasken sararin samaniya yana rikitar da ƙididdigar cesium
correctAnswer: Musamman Dangantaka tana rage saurin agogon tauraron dan adam da microseconds 7 (sauri), yayin da Babban Dangantaka ke hanzarta su da microseconds 45 (raunin nauyi)
explanation: Dakatarwar lokaci na kinematic yana rage saurin agogon da ke motsi: -7 microseconds/ranar. Yanayin launin shuɗi na nauyi yana hanzarta agogon da ke tsayin sama: +45 microseconds/ranar. Jimillar karkata shine +38 microseconds/ranar, wanda ke haifar da kuskuren kewayawa na km 11 a kowace rana idan aka yi watsi da shi.

question: Me ya sa agogon kakanni mai jan hankalin ja da baya ke tafiya kaɗan a hankali idan an motsa shi daga Tushen Arewa zuwa daidaiton duniya?
options: Ƙasa tana da siffar ƙwallon oblate tare da mai bulging a daidaiton duniya da hanzarin centrifugal, wanda ke rage tasirin nauyin saman ƙasa g
Zafin daidaiton duniya yana narkar da haƙoran ƙarfe na gear
Danshi na yankin tropics yana ƙara nauyi ga pendulum
Filayen lantarki na daidaiton duniya suna toshe pendulum
correctAnswer: Ƙasa tana da siffar ƙwallon oblate tare da mai bulging a daidaiton duniya da hanzarin centrifugal, wanda ke rage tasirin nauyin saman ƙasa g
explanation: Lokaci T = 2*pi * sqrt(L / g). Juya ɗin Ƙasa yana haifar da raguwa centrifugal Delta g_cent ~ 0.034 m/s^2, kuma matakin teku na daidaituwa yana nesa da cibiyar Ƙasa da kilomita 21, wanda ke rage g da tsawaita lokaci na pendulum.

question: Me yasa agogon pendulum da ke rataye a bango guda ko bututun ƙungiyar da aka ɗora a cikin kaso ɗaya suke haɗuwa a hankali a cikin raɗaɗin su da lokaci (Haɗin Huygens)?
options: Ƙananan girgizar na’ura masu aukuwa ta hanyar bangon da ke goyi bayan suna haɗa masu oscillators, suna tura su cikin wani zagaye mai iyaka na anti-phase
Pendulums suna jan juna ta hanyar ƙarfin maganadisu

question: Me yasa madubin Kerr na ganike ke juyar da ja-gora na haske a cikin ruwa idan an kunna fannin lantarki mai ƙarfin gaske (Tasirin DC Kerr)?

question: Me ya sa Alan Turing ya tabbatar cewa lissafi ne ba zai yiwu a rubuta babban shirin kwamfuta da zai iya tantance ko kowanne shirin bazai gama gudana ba ko zai ci gaba da gudana har abada (Matsalar Tsayawa)?

explanation: Turing ya yi amfani da diagonalization na Cantor: a ce shirin H(P, i) yana yanke shawarar tsayawa. A gina shirin D wanda yake tsayawa idan H ya ce yana yin madauwari, kuma yana yin madauwari idan H ya ce yana tsayawa. Gudanar da D(D) yana haifar da rashin daidaituwa kai tsaye.

correctAnswer: Gwaje-gwaje na hakika sun nuna a'a: dole ne a koyi haɗa wakilcin taɓawa da hangen nesa ta hanyar kwarewar fahimta
explanation: Aikin Prakash ya gwada marasa ganewa tun haihuwa waɗanda aka dawo musu da hangen nesa ta hanyar tiyata. Marasa gani sun iya bambance sifofi da gani, amma sun kasa daidaita tunanin taɓawa zuwa sababbin hotunan gani ba tare da atisaye ba.

question: A cikin Paradox na Sorites (Paradox na Cunkoso), cire ƙwayar yashi guda daga cunkoso har yanzu yana barin cunkoso. Me yasa wannan yake haifar da matsala mai wahalar warwarewa a fannin hankali?

Cunkoson yana buƙatar daidai ƙwayoyi 10,000
correctAnswer: Sake amfani da wani hujja mai sauƙi da ba a sabani ba yana tilasta sakamako mai ban mamaki cewa ƙwayar yashi guda tana zama 'cunkoso' saboda iyakokin ma'anoni marasa tabbas
explanation: Wannan paradox yana nuna matsalar rashin bayyanawa a cikin ilmin mantiki na gargajiya: kalmomin harshe na dabi'a ('cunkoso', 'shanye gashi') ba sa da iyakoki masu tsabta, suna kalubalantar ka'idar bivalence da modus ponens.

question: Me ya sa fitattun rikice-rikicen Bertrand Russell game da 'tarin duk tarukan da ba sa ƙunsar kansu' ya girgiza tushen ilimin taruka?

Sifili ba a yarda da shi a matsayin lamba ta lissafi ba
correctAnswer: Idan tarin yana cikin kansa, yana karya ma'anarsa; idan bai kasance cikin kansa ba, dole ne ya kasance cikin kansa (R a R <=> R ba a R)

question: Me ya sa Rikicin Berry ('Ƙaramar lamba mai kyau da ba za a iya bayyana ta a ƙarƙashin kalmomi goma sha ɗaya ba') wani abin rikici ne da ke cin karo da kansa a cikin harshe?

question: Ta yaya Huƙuncin Diagonal na Georg Cantor ya tabbatar da cewa akwai adadin lambobi na gaske (decimals) da ya fi adadin dukkan lambobin kirga masu iyaka haɗe?
options: Ta hanyar ƙirƙirar sabon lamba mai ƙima wadda digit na nth ɗinta ya bambanta da digit na nth na nth lamba a kowace jerin da aka bayar, yana tabbatar da cewa lambobin gaske ba za a iya kirga su ba
Decimals suna da maki na decimal marasa iyaka
Lambobin kirga suna ƙarewa a biliyan ɗaya
Ma'auna ba za su iya auna rabon lambobi ba
correctAnswer: Ta hanyar ƙirƙirar sabon lamba mai ƙima wadda digit na nth ɗinta ya bambanta da digit na nth na nth lamba a kowace jerin da aka bayar, yana tabbatar da cewa lambobin gaske ba za a iya kirga su ba
explanation: Cantor ya ɗauka cewa akwai cikakken jerin lambobi masu gaske. Ta hanyar sauya digit na diagonal (misali idan d_nn = 1 a sa 2), ya ƙirƙiri lamba mai gaske wanda aka tabbatar cewa ba ya cikin jerin, yana tabbatar da |R| > |N|.

question: A cikin Babban Otal ɗin David Hilbert wanda ke da ɗaruruwan ɗakuna masu cike gaba ɗaya, ta yaya manaja zai iya sauƙaƙa masaukin baki ɗaya sabon bako ba tare da korar kowa ba?

Ta hanyar juya otal ɗin gaba ɗaya
correctAnswer: Ta hanyar matsar da bako dake ɗakin n zuwa ɗakin n + 1, wanda zai 'yantar da ɗakin 1 ga sabon bako
explanation: Hilbert ya nuna lissafin da ke ɓata hankali na lambobin transfinite: aleph_0 + 1 = aleph_0. Matsar da kowane mazaunin ɗaki zuwa n+1 yana 'yantar da ɗakin 1 yayin da kowa har yanzu yana da ɗaki na kansa.

question: Me yasa hasashen yanayin shekara mai tsawo fiye da kwanaki 10 zuwa 14 yake da wuya a asali, ko da da akwai supercomputers masu sauri har abada (Tasirin Butterfly)?
options: Halin Rikici Mai Tabbatarwa: tsarin yanayi marasa layi suna nuna dogaro sosai ga yanayin farko, inda kurakuran zagaye ƙanana suke ƙaruwa cikin sauri
Masu fan na kwamfuta suna tashin iska
Tacksonar yanayi suna karewa
Thermometers suna daskarewa a lokacin sanyi

explanation: Edward Lorenz ya gano cewa tsarin rikice-rikice suna da Lyapunov exponents masu kyau. Ƙananan damuwa Delta x_0 suna girma kamar Delta x_0 * exp(lambda * t), suna lalata iyakokin hasashe cikin sauri.

question: A cikin Matsalar Jiki Uku, me ya sa babu wata ƙa'idar lissafin lissafi ta gaba ɗaya wacce za ta iya hango daidai motsin jiki uku masu jan hankali da ke juyawa a kusa da juna?

explanation: Henri Poincaré ya tabbatar a shekarar 1887 cewa matsalar gaba ɗaya ta jiki uku ba ta da haɗin farko na lissafi sai dai makamashi, motsi, da motsin kusurwoyi, wanda ke haifar da gaurayen homoclinic da rikicin hankali.

question: Me ya sa Dokar Komawa ta Henri Poincaré ta dame masu ilimin yanayin zafi na gargajiya waɗanda suka yi imani da Dokar Zafi ta Biyu mai rashin dawowa?

Atoms suna ɓacewa cikin babu kome

explanation: Dokar Liouville tana tabbatar da adana girman wuri a cikin sararin matakin. Poincaré ya tabbatar da cewa kusan kowace hanya tana dawowa akai-akai kusa da wurinta na farko, wanda ke nufin kwai da ya karye zai sake haɗuwa da kansa cikin lokaci.

question: Ta yaya Rolf Landauer ya warware fitinar thermodynamics ta Demon na Maxwell (Ka'idar Landauer)?

question: Me ya sa ake ɗaukar ra'ayin 'Ganin Boltzmann' a matsayin reducio ad absurdum na wasu samfuran tashin hankali na kimiyyar sararin samaniya?

correctAnswer: Canjin zafi a cikin sararin da ke rushewa yana da yuwuwar kankare sosai don ƙirƙirar kwakwalwa guda ɗaya kawai mai kadaici tare da ƙwaƙwalwar da ba daidai ba fiye da ƙirƙirar dukkan sararin samaniya

question: Me ya sa gina igiyar Elevator ta Sararin Samaniya daga layin tsakiya na Duniya zuwa orbit na geostationary ya zama ba zai yiwu a zahiri tare da karfen ƙarfe mai ƙarfi na yau da kullum?

question: Me yasa Paradox ɗin Fitch na Iya-Sanwa ke nuna da hankali cewa idan duk gaskiya suna iya zama sanannu, to dole ne a riga an san kowace gaskiya a yanzu?

explanation: Frederic Fitch ya tabbatar cewa idan 'domin duk p: p -> Poss(Kp)', to sanya gaskiyar da ba a sani ba 'p kuma ba-Kp' yana haifar da ƙarshe mara yiyuwa cewa mutum zai iya sanin p kuma cewa bai san p ba.

question: Me yasa Ƙarƙashin Curry ke ba da damar mutum ya tabbatar da kowace bam-banci ta tunani (kamar 'Wata an yi shi da cuku mai kore') ta amfani da ambaton kai ba tare da kowace musanta ba?

question: Me ya sa masani falsafa G.E. Moore ya bayyana jimloli kamar 'Ana ruwan sama a waje, amma ban yarda da hakan ba' a matsayin babbar rashin fahimta (Matsalar Moore)?

question: Wane iyaka ne na asali akan harsunan tsari wanda Alfred Tarski ya kafa ta hanyar Ka'idar Rashin Iya Bayyana a 1936?

question: A cewar Ka'idar Rice a fannin kimiyyar kwamfuta, wane irin halayen ma'anar shirye-shiryen kwamfuta ne za a iya tantancewa ta hanyar algorithm?

question: Me ya sa Matsalar Sadarwa ta Emil Post (daidaita igiyoyin kalmomi na sama da na ƙasa a kan kananan bulo na domino) aka tabbatar da cewa ba a iya yanke hukunci ba?

question: Me yasa masanin lissafi Paul Erdős ya ce 'Lissafi bazai iya magance irin waɗannan matsalolin ba' lokacin da yake tattaunawa kan Hasashen Collatz (matsalar 3n + 1)?

question: Wane babban binciken dabi'ar jiki na duniya ne Mitchell Feigenbaum ya yi a shekarar 1978 dangane da canjin daga tsari zuwa ga hayaniya (Feigenbaum Constant delta = 4.6692016...)?

correctAnswer: Matsakaicin yanayin da kirtani na ninki biyu na lokaci ke haura zuwa hayaniya yana daidai gaba ɗaya a dukkan tsarin motsi na nonlinear a cikin yanayi
explanation: Feigenbaum ya tabbatar cewa rabo tsakanin jeri na lokaci na ninki biyu da juna (d_n - d_n-1) / (d_n+1 - d_n) yana kusantar delta = 4.6692016... ga kowace taswira ɗaya ta madaidaiciya mai ciki quadratic, yana nuna babban kasancewar universality.

question: Me yasa iyakar Saitin Mandelbrot—da aka ƙirƙira ta hanyar maimaita sauƙaƙan lissafin quadratic z = z^2 + c—ake ɗauka a matsayin mafi rikitarwa a cikin lissafi?

explanation: Maimaita z_(n+1) = z_n^2 + c don lambobi masu rikitarwa c yana gwada ko jerin yana ci gaba da kasancewa cikin iyaka. Shishikura ya tabbatar cewa iyakarta tana da Hausdorff dimension 2, tana ɗauke da ƙananan kwafi marasa iyaka na kanta da bambance-bambancen geometric mara iyaka.
