question: A cikin thermodynamics na kididdiga, ta yaya J. Willard Gibbs ya warware 'Gibbs Paradox' inda haɗa kwalabe biyu masu daidai na iskar gas mai kyau ya yi hasashen ƙaruwar entropy a ƙarya?
options: Ana ɗaukar ƙwayoyin gas ɗaya ne a asali marasa banbanci, wanda ke buƙatar raba girman sararin matakin da N! a cikin lissafin kimiyyar kididdiga

question: Wane irin sauyi mai tashin hankali na tsarin sarari-lokaci John Archibald Wheeler ya hango zai faru a matakin ƙarami na Planck (Quantum Foam)?

correctAnswer: Sarari-lokaci yana daina zama mai laushi da ci gaba, yana tafasa cikin kumfa mai rikici na quantum foam tare da ƙaramin kogon-wormhole da kumfa na topological
explanation: A matakan da suka kusa da tsayin Planck (1.6 x 10^-35 m) da lokacin Planck (5.4 x 10^-44 s), rashin tabbas na Heisenberg yana haifar da canje-canjen makamashi Delta E ~ hbar / Delta t da ke canza tsarin sarari-lokaci zuwa quantum foam mai rudani.

question: Me ya sa Tsayin Planck (1.616 x 10^-35 mita) ake ɗauka a matsayin mafi guntu nisan ma'ana a kimiyyar lissafi ta asali?
options: Bincikar nisan da ya fi ƙaramin Tsayin Planck yana buƙatar makamashi mai yawa sosai a cikin wuri guda har sai ya haifar da ragon baki na ƙanana
Kyakkyawan kallo na microscope ba zai iya mayar da hankali ga ƙaramin haske ba
Ma'aunai suna karyewa ƙarƙashin ƙarfin atoms ƙanana
Atoms suna narkewa a matakan da suka fi ƙanƙanta
correctAnswer: Bincikar nisan da ya fi ƙaramin Tsayin Planck yana buƙatar makamashi mai yawa sosai a cikin wuri guda har sai ya haifar da ragon baki na ƙanana
explanation: Don fayyace tsawon Delta x, photons suna buƙatar motsi p ~ hbar / Delta x. Matse wannan makamashi cikin Delta x yana ƙirƙirar radius na Schwarzschild r_s = 2GE/c^4 >= Delta x, wanda ke haifar da ragon baki da ke cinye aunawa.

question: Me yasa guguwar amo daga fashewar sauti na jirgin sama mai gudu fiye da sauti ke yaduwa ta cikin yanayi a matsayin kwallo mai kusurwa uku (Mach Cone) maimakon guguwar sauti mai zagaye?
options: Hada sauti mai zagaye da ake fitarwa a wurare masu jere a hanyar jirgi yana samar da murfin kusurwar kwallo
Injin jirgin sama na kona mai a cikin samfuran kusurwa uku
Matsi na iska yana samar da kristal kusurwa uku
Hancin jirgin yana turawa iska da lantarki
correctAnswer: Hada sauti mai zagaye da ake fitarwa a wurare masu jere a hanyar jirgi yana samar da murfin kusurwar kwallo
explanation: Lokacin da saurin jirgin v ya wuce saurin sauti c, fuskar guguwar sauti mai zagaye da aka fitar tana jinkiri. Murfin wadannan guguwar sauti masu zagaye yana samar da kwallo mai kusurwar rabin kusurwa sin(mu) = c/v = 1/M, inda rashin daidaito na matsi ke taruwa.

question: Me yasa wani abu mai gudu sosai da ke tafiya fiye da saurin haske a cikin ruwa ke fitar da wani haske na shuɗi mai ban tsoro (Hasken Cherenkov)?
options: Kwayar da aka caji ta fi saurin yanayin matakin haske a cikin sinadarin dielectric, tana haifar da igiyar girgizar gani kamar yadda hayaniyar sauti ke haifarwa
Ruwa yana rabuwa zuwa isotopes mai shuɗi na hydrogen
Friction da ruwa yana tafasa ƙwayoyin dake kewaye
Harbin yana nuna hasken teku mai zurfi
correctAnswer: Kwayar da aka caji ta fi saurin yanayin matakin haske a cikin sinadarin dielectric, tana haifar da igiyar girgizar gani kamar yadda hayaniyar sauti ke haifarwa
explanation: Duk da cewa c a cikin babu iska ba ya canzawa, haske a cikin ruwa yana tafiya a c/n ~ 0.75c. Kwayoyin da ke da caji da suka wuce c/n suna yin polarizing ga kwayoyin ruwa, suna haifar da tsayayyen girgizar lantarki mai daidaituwa wanda ke kai kololuwa a tsawon igiyoyi na shuɗi da UV.

question: Me yasa hasken X-ray mai ƙarfin gaske ko hasken gamma da ke wucewa ta cikin abu mai yawa ke fuskantar Bremsstrahlung ('Hasken Tsayawa')?
options: Ana rage saurin lantarki masu caji da ke motsi da sauri ta filin Coulomb na sinadaran nauyi, suna sakin ƙarfin kuzari na fiye da kima a matsayin photons
Lantarki na karo kai tsaye da neutrons
Sinadaran suna ɗaukar lantarki cikin orbit na nukiliya
Farfajiyar haske tana haifar da wutar zafi
correctAnswer: Ana rage saurin lantarki masu caji da ke motsi da sauri ta filin Coulomb na sinadaran nauyi, suna sakin ƙarfin kuzari na fiye da kima a matsayin photons
explanation: Tsarin Larmor yana nuna cewa kowace caji mai lantarki da aka hanzarta ko aka rage gudu yana fitar da wutar lantarki P = (q^2 * a^2) / (6*pi*epsilon_0*c^3). Lantarki da filayen Coulomb na nukiliya suka karkatar suna fitar da ci gaba da hasken X-ray Bremsstrahlung.

question: Me ya sa photon mai ƙarfin gamma zai iya ɓacewa gaba ɗaya ya kuma zama electron da positron kusa da nukiliyar kwayar halitta (Samuwar Ƙungiyar)?
options: Daidaiton ƙarfi da ƙwanƙwasa na Einstein (E = mc^2) yana ba da damar ƙarfi na photon wanda ya wuce 1.022 MeV ya canza zuwa nauyin hutu na kwayar halitta a cikin filin Coulomb
Photons suna rabuwa zuwa rabin ta hanyar injiniya
Nukiliyar kwayar halitta suna aiki a matsayin masana'antar kwayoyi
Gamma rays suna ɗauke da electrons da aka ƙulle
correctAnswer: Daidaiton ƙarfi da ƙwanƙwasa na Einstein (E = mc^2) yana ba da damar ƙarfi na photon wanda ya wuce 1.022 MeV ya canza zuwa nauyin hutu na kwayar halitta a cikin filin Coulomb
explanation: Ƙa'idar Dirac tana umartar cewa photon mai ƙarfi E >= 2 * m_e * c^2 (1.022 MeV) na iya canzawa zuwa electron da positron. Nukiliya da ke kallo tana ɗaukar motsin dawowa don tabbatar da bin dokokin adana.

question: Wane babban abin da ke faruwa a ilimin taurari lokacin da electron da positron suka hadu da juna a cikin sararin samaniya mai zurfi (Pair Annihilation)?
options: Dukkan kwayoyin halittar suna hallaka juna gaba daya, suna canza kashi 100 na nauyin su zuwa biyu gamma-ray photons na 511 keV da ke tashi a juna.
Suna hade su zama kwayar helium mara amfani da lantarki.
Suna rugurguje su zama rami mai baki mai ƙananan gaske.
Suna samar da kwayar lantarki mai dindindin.
correctAnswer: Dukkan kwayoyin halittar suna hallaka juna gaba daya, suna canza kashi 100 na nauyin su zuwa biyu gamma-ray photons na 511 keV da ke tashi a juna.
explanation: Saboda yawan lepton da daidaiton caji (+e da -e), jimlar nauyin kwayoyin ya canza zuwa radiation na lantarki ta hanyar E = mc^2. Adana momentum yana tilasta photon guda biyu na 511 keV su tashi a juna a hanyoyi masu kewayawa masu juna biyun.

question: Me yasa agogon atomic da ke kan jirgin sama mai sauri da ke tashi a gabas a duniya ke rasa lokaci, yayin da agogon da ya yi daidai da shi da ke tashi yamma ke samun kari a lokaci (Gwajin Hafele-Keating)?
options: Gaggawar kinematics tana ƙara zuwa gaggawar jujjuyawar ƙasa a gabas ga tashi na gabas kuma tana ragewa ga na yamma, yana tsara rarrabuwar lokaci na relativistic
Tafiyoyin gabas suna tashi cikin filin lantarki na rana
Tafiyoyin yamma suna tashi a gangaren kasa
Man jirgin sama yana fitar da ƙwayoyin rediyo
correctAnswer: Gaggawar kinematics tana ƙara zuwa gaggawar jujjuyawar ƙasa a gabas ga tashi na gabas kuma tana ragewa ga na yamma, yana tsara rarrabuwar lokaci na relativistic
explanation: A shekara ta 1971, Hafele da Keating sun tafi da agogon cesium a jiragen sama. Idan aka kwatanta da tsarin inertia na duniya wanda ba ya juyawa, gudun gabas shine v_rot + v_plane (babban rarrabuwar lokaci, agogon yana tafiya a hankali), yayin da na yamma shine v_rot - v_plane (agogon yana tafiya da sauri).

question: Me yasa mutum da yake kallon fitilar kayan ado ta fiber optic mai haske yake ganin hasken launuka masu kyalli ne kawai a kan ƙananan ƙarshen igiyoyin filastik mai bayyana?
options: Jimillar haske a ciki tana hana duk hasken fita daga cikin babban jigon mai santsi da bayyana, sai a fitar inda igiyoyin suka ƙare a ƙarshen da aka yanke
Ƙarshen suna dauke da ƙananan fitilun LED
Hasken yana tafiya cikin sauri a ƙarshen filastik
Filastik yana shan haske a gefe
correctAnswer: Jimillar haske a ciki tana hana duk hasken fita daga cikin babban jigon mai santsi da bayyana, sai a fitar inda igiyoyin suka ƙare a ƙarshen da aka yanke
explanation: Hasken da ya shiga daga tushe yana ci gaba da yin jimillar haske a cikin jagorar igiyoyi mai cylindrical dielectric. Fotons ba za su iya fita ba sai lokacin da yanayin iyaka ya canza a fuskar ƙarshen da aka yanke.

question: Me yasa jan hasken ilimin lissafin sararin samaniya da faɗin ƙasa yake haifarwa daban-daban sosai da tasirin Doppler na yau da kullum?
options: Jan hasken ilimin lissafin sararin samaniya yana tsawaita tsawon igiyar haske yayin da tsarin sarari kansa ke faɗaɗa a lokacin tafiya.
Tauraruwar duwatsu masu nisa suna motsawa ta sarari fiye da saurin haske.
Kudan sararin samaniya yana yayyafa igiyoyin shuɗi zuwa jan.
Ƙarfi yana rage saurin haske zuwa igiyoyin jan.
correctAnswer: Jan hasken ilimin lissafin sararin samaniya yana tsawaita tsawon igiyar haske yayin da tsarin sarari kansa ke faɗaɗa a lokacin tafiya.
explanation: Tasirin Doppler motsi ne na kinematic ta cikin sarari mai tsayayye. Jan hasken ilimin lissafin sararin samaniya z = (a_obs / a_emit) - 1 yana faruwa ne saboda faɗaɗa tsarin lokaci-sarari yana tsawaita tsawon igiyoyin photon da ke tafiya.

question: Me yasa Lurayen Rediyo na Gaggawa (FRBs) daga taurari masu nisa suke isa da frekansoshi masu yawa da ke kai tashoshin rediyo kafin frekansoshi masu ƙasa (Rarraba Plasma)?
options: Plasma mai ion a cikin sararin samaniya da tsakanin taurari yana rage saurin frekansoshi masu ƙasa fiye da masu yawa dangane da adadin electron da ke cikin ginshiƙi
Gujewar rediyo mai frekanso mai yawa tana da nauyi ƙasa a jiki
Gujewar mai frekanso mai ƙasa tana yin turjiya da duhun abu
Teleskopyi suna sarrafa sautin bass a hankali
correctAnswer: Plasma mai ion a cikin sararin samaniya da tsakanin taurari yana rage saurin frekansoshi masu ƙasa fiye da masu yawa dangane da adadin electron da ke cikin ginshiƙi
explanation: Jinkirin rarraba Delta t = 4.15 ms * DM * (nu_low^-2 - nu_high^-2). Electrons masu 'yanci a cikin plasma na tsakanin taurari suna haifar da saurin lokaci mai dangantaka da frekanso, wanda ke ba masu binciken taurari damar auna abubuwan cikin sararin samaniyar da ke tsakaninsu.

question: Ga wani mai kallo daga nesa, wani tauraron dan Adam da ya fada cikin rami mai nauyi sosai yana bayyana kamar ya daskare a bakin ramin har abada. Me tauraron dan Adam yake ji da gaske?
options: Tauraron dan Adam yana faduwa cikin sauki ta bakin rami a cikin wani lokaci na ainihi ba tare da daskarewa ba
Tauraron dan Adam yana dakatar da motsi a tsakiyar iska
Tauraron dan Adam yana tsalle daga bakin rami kamar roba
Tauraron dan Adam yana zama cikakkiyar makamashi duhu nan da nan
correctAnswer: Tauraron dan Adam yana faduwa cikin sauki ta bakin rami a cikin wani lokaci na ainihi ba tare da daskarewa ba
explanation: Lokacin tsari t yana karkata zuwa har abada a r = 2M ga masu kallo daga nesa saboda jan hankali na nauyi. A cikin lokacin ainihi na tauraron dan Adam mai tafiya tare da shi, ketare bakin rami yana tafiya lafiya ba tare da wani abin mamaki ba.

question: Wane irin abu mai hadakar taurari na ban mamaki ne Kip Thorne da Anna Żytkow suka gabatar (abu na Thorne-Żytkow)?
options: Tauraron ja mai girma wanda ya hadiye tauraron neutron mai nauyi, yana dauke da tauraron neutron a matsayin cibiyar tauraro mai aiki
Tauraro da aka yi daga lu'ulu'u mai daskarewa kawai
Rami baki da ke juyawa a cikin wata tauraruwa mai leƙa
Tauraro da ke hade da ido ta hanyar lantarki
correctAnswer: Tauraron ja mai girma wanda ya hadiye tauraron neutron mai nauyi, yana dauke da tauraron neutron a matsayin cibiyar tauraro mai aiki
explanation: Haduwar binary tana haifar da tauraron ja mai girma yana hadiye tauraron neutron abokinsa. Cibiyar neutron mai wariya tana samar da kuzarin nauyi ta hanyar nukleosintesis na rp, tana kwaikwayon tauraro mai girma tare da yanayin sinadarai na musamman.

question: A cikin ilimin taurari na tunani, menene 'Kugelblitz'?
options: Rami baki da aka ƙirƙira gaba ɗaya daga tarin kuzarin wutar lantarki mai ƙarfi (hasken wuta) maimakon abu
Wutar lantarki da aka daskare cikin helium mai ruwa
Makamin plasma da jiragen ruwa ke amfani da shi
Dutse mai ɗauke da uranium
correctAnswer: Rami baki da aka ƙirƙira gaba ɗaya daga tarin kuzarin wutar lantarki mai ƙarfi (hasken wuta) maimakon abu
explanation: A Cikakken Juyin Juya Hali na Gabaɗaya, kuzari yana lanƙwasa sarari-lokaci ta hanyar tensor ɗin damuwa-kuzari T_munu. Idan an mayar da hankali sosai wajen haske cikin ƙananan ƙuɓewa, yana makale haske cikin radius ɗin Schwarzschild na ƙarfin jan hankalin sa, yana ƙirƙirar Kugelblitz.

question: Me ya sa Albert Einstein ya yi ƙin ƙarfi ga ra'ayin 'Mass ɗin Relativistic' (ra'ayin cewa wani abu yana ƙara nauyi yayin da yake hanzarta)?
options: Mass abu ne mai adadi wanda ba ya canzawa; saurin motsi yana canza relativistic momentum da makamashi, ba mass ɗin da ke a huta ba m_0
Abubuwa masu motsi suna rasa atoms saboda gogayya
Sauri yana haifar da rashin nauyi
Auna mass yana sa ma'aunai su narke
correctAnswer: Mass abu ne mai adadi wanda ba ya canzawa; saurin motsi yana canza relativistic momentum da makamashi, ba mass ɗin da ke a huta ba m_0
explanation: Einstein ya rubuta cewa gabatar da mass ɗin relativistic m = gamma * m_0 yana da rikitarwa kuma ba tare da daidaito ba. Ilimin kimiyya na zamani yana ayyana mass kawai a matsayin mass ɗin huta mai ƙasa da canzawa m = sqrt(E^2 - p^2 c^2) / c^2.

question: Me yasa wata babbar taurari mai shiga tsakani ke ƙirƙirar cikakkiyar, haske mai walƙiya wanda ke zagaye kanta da ake kira 'Einstein Ring'?
options: Hasken baya, taurarin da ke a gaba a matsayin madubi, da Duniya suna cikin madaidaicin layi mai daidaito
Taurarin suna ƙone iskar hydrogen a cikin siffar zobe
Girman sararin samaniya yana samar da madubi mai zagaye
Jujjuyawar taurari tana tura taurari zuwa cikin halo
correctAnswer: Hasken baya, taurarin da ke a gaba a matsayin madubi, da Duniya suna cikin madaidaicin layi mai daidaito
explanation: Lensing na nauyi yana lanƙwasa haske a kusa da wani abu. Idan tushen haske, madubi, da mai kallo suna da layin gani guda ɗaya, daidaiton axial yana jan gungun gajimare na baya da aka lalata cikin zobe na Einstein mai radius na kusurwar theta_E.

question: Ta yaya masana taurari za su iya gano ƙasashe masu zaman kansu 'rogue' suna yawo a sararin samaniya mai duhu ba tare da tauraro mai masauki ba (Gravitational Microlensing)?
options: Ana daidaita ƙarfin nauyin ƙasar da ke yawo, yana mai da haske daga tauraron baya kamar gilashin binciken taurari
Ƙasar da ba ta da gida tana haskaka hasken taurari mai zurfi
Ƙasar tana fitar da sautin rediyo mai dauke da sinadarai na rediyoqin
Telfoskop suna bibiyar hanyoyin fitar iska na ƙasar
correctAnswer: Ana daidaita ƙarfin nauyin ƙasar da ke yawo, yana mai da haske daga tauraron baya kamar gilashin binciken taurari
explanation: Gravitational microlensing yana faruwa lokacin da wani abu mai ɗan ƙaramin haske ya wuce a gaban tauraron baya. Filin nauyinsa yana lanƙwasa hasken haske, yana samar da ɗan lokaci na ƙarfi mai daidaito a hasken taurarin da ake gani.

question: Menene ke bayyana iyakokin 'Hill Sphere' na wani taurari a cikin ilimin motsin jiki na sararin samaniya?
options: Yankin sarari dake kewaye da wani abu inda jan hankulsu na shi kansa ya fi karfi akan jan hankul na tauraron da yake kewaye da shi
Iyakacin yanayi tare da zurfin sarari
Nisan da filayen maganadisu na duniya suke karewa
Hanyar juyin duniyar tauraron dan adam mafi nesa
correctAnswer: Yankin sarari dake kewaye da wani abu inda jan hankulsu na shi kansa ya fi karfi akan jan hankul na tauraron da yake kewaye da shi
explanation: Radius na Hill sphere r_H = a * (1 - e) * (m / 3M)^(1/3) yana bayyana yankin da jan hankali ke da iko a kai. Watawakin da ke juyawa a wajen Hill sphere a ƙarshe suna cirewa saboda tasirin tashin hankali na rana.

question: Me ya sa Taurarin Trojan ke ci gaba da taruwa a 60 digiri gaba (L4) da 60 digiri baya (L5) na Jupiter ba tare da faɗawa cikin duniyar ko yin tashi ba?
options: Ƙarfin Coriolis a cikin tsarin tunanin mai juyawa yana daidaita hanyoyin zagaye kusa da maki Lagrange na daidai da juna daga tasirin nauyi
Jupiter yana jan taurari da igiyoyi na magnetic
Iskar rana tana makale taurari kan kankara na sarari
Cajin lantarki yana kore taurari
correctAnswer: Ƙarfin Coriolis a cikin tsarin tunanin mai juyawa yana daidaita hanyoyin zagaye kusa da maki Lagrange na daidai da juna daga tasirin nauyi
explanation: L4 da L5 su ne mafi girman yanayin yiwuwar a saman ƙimar yiwuwar tasiri. Hanzarin Coriolis yana daidaita saukar nauyi da centrifugal don dangantakar nauyi M1/M2 > 24.96, yana daure gungun Trojan a hanya mai motsi.

question: Me ya sa hasken rana ke dan lumshewa da kuma canza hanyoyin zagayowar ƙananan dutse masu juyawa a cikin shekaru miliyoyi (Tasirin Yarkovsky)?
options: Dutsen yana dumama a gefen rana na yamma kuma yana sake fitar da hasken infrared mai zafi tare da turawa ta hanya mai nuna hanya
Hasken rana yana fitar da lantarki daga dutsen
Iskar rana tana shafan saman dutsen ta hanyar lalata shi
Hasken rana mai ƙarfi yana narkar da ƙwayar ƙarfe na dutsen
correctAnswer: Dutsen yana dumama a gefen rana na yamma kuma yana sake fitar da hasken infrared mai zafi tare da turawa ta hanya mai nuna hanya
explanation: Sakamakon juriya ta thermal, mafi zafi a dutsen ba shine a lokacin rana na gida ba, amma a yammaci. Fitar da hasken infrared mai zafi da bai daidaita ba yana kawo ƙarfin martani gaba ɗaya, yana sauya babban kusurwar axis a cikin shekaru miliyoyi.

question: Me yasa harshen roka ke kunna wuta ke samar da ƙarin jimillar kuzarin motsi sosai lokacin da aka harba shi a periapsis (matsakaicin kusanci da saurin kewayawa mafi girma) fiye da a apoapsis (Tasirin Oberth)?
options: Kuzarin motsi da aka samu yana da alaƙa da saurin yanzu na abin hawa: Delta KE = m * v * Delta v + 0.5 * m * (Delta v)^2
Periapsis baya da juriya daga iska ta yanayi
Ƙarfin nauyin duniya yana aiki a matsayin man fetur na roka
Bakwai buɗaɗɗen roka suna faɗaɗa a saurin sama
correctAnswer: Kuzarin motsi da aka samu yana da alaƙa da saurin yanzu na abin hawa: Delta KE = m * v * Delta v + 0.5 * m * (Delta v)^2
explanation: Hermann Oberth ya gano cewa saboda kuzarin motsi yana da alaƙa da v^2, amfani da Delta v a babban saurin v yana canza ƙarfin mai sinadarai zuwa kuzarin motsi na abin hawa cikin inganci sosai.

question: Me ya sa karkatarwar tafiyar da ke raguwa ta ban mamaki na kayan aikin Pioneer 10 da 11 ta rikita masana lissafi na kimiyya har tsawon shekaru kafin a warware ta a 2012 (Abun Mamakin Pioneer)?
options: Radiyo mai zafi mara daidaito: zafin da ke fitowa daga janareto na radiyoisotop masu samar da wutar lantarki ya buga bayan farantin kara wutar, yana haifar da karamin karfin juyawa
Fita duhu na kayan halitta sun ja masu binciken
Matsakaicin karfin jan hankali na Newton G yana canzawa a sararin samaniya
Iskar yanayin taurari ta cika mai turawa kayan aikin
correctAnswer: Radiyo mai zafi mara daidaito: zafin da ke fitowa daga janareto na radiyoisotop masu samar da wutar lantarki ya buga bayan farantin kara wutar, yana haifar da karamin karfin juyawa
explanation: Slava Turyshev ya warware wannan abun mamaki: fitar da zafi maras daidaito daga akwatin lantarki da RTGs sun buga a kan antenna mai parabola, suna samar da saurin juyawa na photon na thermal wanda ba a tsara ba a_P = -(8.74 x 10^-10) m/s^2 zuwa ga Rana.

question: Yaya jirgin sama na sararin samaniya ke samun sauri mai yawa daga Slingshot na nauyi (Taimako na Nauyi) a zagaye da wani tauraro mai motsi ba tare da karya ka'idar kiyaye kuzarin ba?
options: Jirgin sama yana sata ƙananan kaso na babban juyin kogon tauraron a zagaye da Rana, yana ƙara saurin helisentrik na kansa
Filin lantarki na tauraron yana ƙin jirgin sama kamar bindigar layi
Jirgin sama yana tashi saboda gogewar iska
Fitilar rana suna kunna saura man fetur na roka
correctAnswer: Jirgin sama yana sata ƙananan kaso na babban juyin kogon tauraron a zagaye da Rana, yana ƙara saurin helisentrik na kansa
explanation: A cikin tsarin hutu na tauraron, haduwa tana da sassauci (saurin shiga = saurin fita). A cikin tsarin Rana, jirgin sama yana fita da v_final ~ v_initial + 2 * v_tauraro, yana cire kashi kaɗan sosai na kuzarin juyin tauraron.

question: Me ya sa masana kimiyyar roka Konstantin Tsiolkovsky ya kira shahararren tsarin roka na Delta v = v_e * ln(m_0 / m_f) a matsayin 'mulkin tsarin roka'?
options: Don ƙara nauyin kaya ko sauri, adadin man fetur da ake buƙata yana ƙaruwa da sauri, saboda roka dole ne ta ɗauki man fetur don ɗaga man fetur
Injinan roka suna yin zafi bayan mintuna 3
Tankunan man fetur suna yi waƙaƙƙen tsatsa a cikin vakiyum
Ƙarfin nauyi yana ƙaruwa da nauyin roka
correctAnswer: Don ƙara nauyin kaya ko sauri, adadin man fetur da ake buƙata yana ƙaruwa da sauri, saboda roka dole ne ta ɗauki man fetur don ɗaga man fetur
explanation: Saboda rabo na nauyi m_0 / m_f = exp(Delta v / v_e) yana kasancewa na exponential, samun saurin zagaye na orbita (~8 km/s) tare da roka na sinadarai (v_e ~ 3-4 km/s) yana buƙatar kusan 90% na nauyin abin hawa mai tashi ya zama man fetur tsayayye.

question: Me ya sa injunan ion na zurfin sararin samaniya ke bayar da turjiya mai laushi daidai da nauyin takarda guda, amma suna tura na'urorin bincike zuwa duniyoyi masu nisa fiye da roket na sinadarai?
options: Injunan ion suna samun ƙwarewar motsi musamman da saurin fitarwa (30 zuwa 50 km/s), suna aiki a kai a kai na tsawon shekaru.
Roket na sinadarai ba su halatta a cikin zurfin sararin samaniya ba.
Injunan ion suna amfani da bangarorin hasken rana don mayar da hasken rana.
Rikicin sararin samaniya yana narkar da iskar xenon.
correctAnswer: Injunan ion suna samun ƙwarewar motsi musamman da saurin fitarwa (30 zuwa 50 km/s), suna aiki a kai a kai na tsawon shekaru.
explanation: Duk da cewa turjiya F = m_dot * v_e yana da ƙanƙanta saboda ƙarancin yawan ƙarfin iskar m_dot, saurin fitarwa v_e yana da ninki 10 fiye da kona sinadarai. Kunna ba tare da tsayawa ba na awanni 10,000 yana tara babban jimillar Delta v.

question: Ta yaya Tafin Rana zai iya motsa jirgin sama zuwa sararin samaniya tsakanin taurari ba tare da ɗaukar ko ɗan famfo na mai a cikin jirgin ba?
options: Hasken photonu da ya dawo yana canja biyu daga ƙarfin motsi (p = 2E/c) zuwa tafin da ke haskaka ta hanyar matsa lamba na lantarki
Iskar rana tana busar da tafin kamar iskar teku a kan zane
Tafin yana haifar da walƙiya na lantarki
Hasken rana yana caji baturan rana don kunna fanfo
correctAnswer: Hasken photonu da ya dawo yana canja biyu daga ƙarfin motsi (p = 2E/c) zuwa tafin da ke haskaka ta hanyar matsa lamba na lantarki
explanation: Photons suna ɗauke da motsi p = E/c. Madubi mai haskaka sosai yana maido da photons, yana ba da motsi Delta p = 2 * E / c. Matsa lamba ta haske mai ci gaba (~9 micro-Newtons/m^2 kusa da Ƙasa) yana hanzarta jirgin sama a ci gaba.

question: Ta yaya tauraron dan adam na kasa da ke amfani da Adaptive Optics suka sami hoton hoto mai kaifi fiye da na Hubble Space Telescope?
options: Tauraron dan adam na laser yana auna karkataccen yanayin igiyar iska, kuma kwamfuta tana lanƙwasa madubi mai sassauci sau 1,000 a kowane dakika don soke girgiza iska
Tauraron dan adam na kasa suna amfani da manyan allunan kwamfuta
Injiniyoyi suna rufe rufin injin bincike a cikin vacuum
Girgizar iska tana tsayawa a tsakar dare
correctAnswer: Tauraron dan adam na laser yana auna karkataccen yanayin igiyar iska, kuma kwamfuta tana lanƙwasa madubi mai sassauci sau 1,000 a kowane dakika don soke girgiza iska
explanation: Girgizar yanayi tana rikita igiyoyin iska (Fried parameter r_0). Adaptive optics tana auna karkacewa ta amfani da tauraron jagorar laser na sodium kuma tana amfani da masu kunnawa na piezoelectric don lanƙwasa madubin siriri, don dawo da iyakar diffraction.

question: Ta yaya Kamfanin Talbijin na Event Horizon ya kama tarihin hoton kai tsaye na farko na ramin baƙar fata mai nauyi a cikin tauraron dan adam M87 a shekarar 2019?
options: Ta hanyar haɗa faranti na rediyo da aka daidaita a duk duniya ta amfani da Very Long Baseline Interferometry don ƙirƙirar babban murabba'in hangen nesa na duniya
Ta hanyar aika wani na'urar robot zuwa horizon na M87
Ta amfani da babban madubin laser na sararin samaniya
Ta auna X-rays daga gilashin fuska na 'yan sama jannati
correctAnswer: Ta hanyar haɗa faranti na rediyo da aka daidaita a duk duniya ta amfani da Very Long Baseline Interferometry don ƙirƙirar babban murabba'in hangen nesa na duniya
explanation: Ƙudurin kusurwa theta ~ lambda / D. Ta hanyar daidaita wuraren lura da rediyo a Hawaii, Chile, Turai, da Tudu na Kudu ta amfani da agogon atomic, EHT ta haɗa murabba'in gani D daidai da diamita na Duniya, tana warware 20 microarcseconds.

question: Yaya masana ilmin kimiyyar lissafi suka gano wani babban rami na mita 30 wanda ba a sani ba a cikin Babban Haikalin Giza a 2017 ba tare da huda dutse guda ba (Muon Tomography)?
options: Muons na hasken sararin samaniya suna wuce dutse amma suna sha daban-daban bisa nauyi; na'urorin gano abubuwa sun rubuta karin yawan muon da ke wuce ramin da babu komai
Ta hanyar aika raƙuman sauti ta cikin kabarin haikalin
Ta hanyar auna yanayin zafin ƙasa da kyamarori masu infrared
Ta hanyar tono gangaren boye da robobi
correctAnswer: Muons na hasken sararin samaniya suna wuce dutse amma suna sha daban-daban bisa nauyi; na'urorin gano abubuwa sun rubuta karin yawan muon da ke wuce ramin da babu komai
explanation: Muons da hasken sararin samaniya ke haifarwa suna shigar dutsen da ke da nisan ɗaruruwan mita. Fatar emulsion na nukiliya da masu bin sawu na scintillator sun auna raguwar muon a cikin hanya: rami marar komai yana bari muons da yawa su wuce, yana bayyana tsarin 3D ɗinsa.

question: Yaya binciken PET na likita (Positron Emission Tomography) yake gano ƙwayoyin cutar daji a cikin jikin ɗan adam da daidaito mai ƙarancin milimita?
options: Ana allurar mai saka alamar hayaki mai ƙwayar radiation wanda ke fitar da positrons waɗanda ke hallaka tare da electrons, suna sakin ginshiƙai biyu na gamma 511 keV a digiri 180 da ake gano a lokaci guda.
Lasers na X-ray suna kone ƙwayoyin cutar kai tsaye.
Filayen maganadisu suna juyar da atoms na ƙarfe a cikin ƙwayar cutar.
Crystal na ultrasound suna gano sautunan ƙwayar cutar.
correctAnswer: Ana allurar mai saka alamar hayaki mai ƙwayar radiation wanda ke fitar da positrons waɗanda ke hallaka tare da electrons, suna sakin ginshiƙai biyu na gamma 511 keV a digiri 180 da ake gano a lokaci guda.
explanation: Fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) yana taruwa a cikin ƙwayoyin cutar mai yawan glucose. Mutuwar positron beta+ tana haifar da e+ e- annihilation, tana harba ginshiƙai biyu na gamma na 511 keV waɗanda ake gano su a lokaci guda ta wata zoben zagaye, yana gano layin amsa.

question: Me yasa na'urar MRI ke yin karar mai ƙarfi sosai na bugawa da bam-bam yayin ɗaukar hoton kwakwalwa?
options: Ƙarfin Lorentz: manyan bugun lantarki suna canzawa ta cikin coils na gradient a cikin filin maganadisu na 3-Tesla suna sa coils su lankwasa a jiki kuma su buga a kan matattakarsu.
Kasusuwa na kwanyar majinyaci suna yin echo na sigina rediyo.
Helium ruwa yana tafasa zuwa kumfa na gas.
Antennas na rediyo suna yin walƙiya da kariya.
correctAnswer: Ƙarfin Lorentz: manyan bugun lantarki suna canzawa ta cikin coils na gradient a cikin filin maganadisu na 3-Tesla suna sa coils su lankwasa a jiki kuma su buga a kan matattakarsu.
explanation: Coils na gradient suna canza gradients na maganadisu cikin sauri don ƙirar sarari. Manyan currents (dari na amps) a cikin filin 3T mai ƙarfi suna samar da ƙarfi mai girma na oscillatory Lorentz (F = I * L x B), suna buga da ƙarfi mounts na coil a ƙarƙashin sauƙin sauti.

question: Ta yaya Hasken Wutar Lantarki na Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) zai iya sa yatsan mutum ya motsa ba tare da jin zafi ba ko kuma dakatar da magana na ɗan lokaci ba tare da taɓa kwakwalwa?
options: Ƙaddamarwar lantarki ta Faraday: an sanya na'urar maganadisu mai bugawa a kan gashin kai tana haifar da cewan lantarki a cikin ƙwayoyin kwakwalwa dake ƙasan fata
Wutar lantarki mai tsayi tana tsalle ta cikin gashin kai
Filayen maganadisu suna jan ƙarfe na jini zuwa yatsa
Hanyoyin sauti suna jituwa da ƙarshen jijiyoyi
correctAnswer: Ƙaddamarwar lantarki ta Faraday: an sanya na'urar maganadisu mai bugawa a kan gashin kai tana haifar da cewan lantarki a cikin ƙwayoyin kwakwalwa dake ƙasan fata
explanation: Na'urar maganadisu ta figure-8 tana buga filin 2-Tesla a cikin kusan microseconds 100. Ta bin Dokar Faraday curl(E) = -dB/dt, canjin saurin filin maganadisu yana haifar da filin lantarki a cikin kayan kwakwalwa, yana lalata membrane na axon na neurons kuma yana kunna action potentials.

question: Ta yaya juyin juya halin Optogenetics ke ba masu binciken kwakwalwa damar kunna wasu takamaiman tunani da halaye da kashe su ta amfani da bugun hasken laser shuɗi?
options: An saka tashoshin ion na opsin masu haske (Channelrhodopsin-2) a cikin wasu nau’ikan neurons ta hanyar gado, wanda ke sa su harba lokacin da aka haska su da shuɗin haske
Hasken yana kona mummunan tunani ta hanyar zafi
Laser shuɗi na dumama neurons don motsa masu aika saƙon sinadaran jinƙai
Photons suna maye gurbin ƙwayoyin jini a jijiyoyin kwakwalwa
correctAnswer: An saka tashoshin ion na opsin masu haske (Channelrhodopsin-2) a cikin wasu nau’ikan neurons ta hanyar gado, wanda ke sa su harba lokacin da aka haska su da shuɗin haske
explanation: Ed Boyden da Karl Deisseroth sun gabatar da kwayoyin ChR2 ta hanyar hanyoyin cutar. Hasken shuɗi (470 nm) yana buɗe tashar ion na opsin, yana haifar da saurin kwararar Na+ a ciki wanda ke depolarizing neuron ɗin da aka nufa cikin milliseconds.

question: Me ya sa gano cewa cututtukan jijiyoyin da ke haifar da mutuwa kamar Mad Cow da Kuru ana haifar da su ne ta hanyar Prions aka ɗauka a matsayin babban kuskure a ilimin kwayoyin halitta?
options: Prions su ne ƙwayoyin cuta masu yaduwa da ke ɗauke da sinadarin furotin da ya lalace kawai ba tare da DNA ko RNA ba
Prions su ne ƙwayoyin cuta na waje daga duwatsu masu saukar ƙasa
Cutar tana haifar da alluran gilashi ƙanana sosai
Cutar Mad Cow tana haifar da fungi masu cutarwa ta hanyar ƙwayar cuta
correctAnswer: Prions su ne ƙwayoyin cuta masu yaduwa da ke ɗauke da sinadarin furotin da ya lalace kawai ba tare da DNA ko RNA ba
explanation: Stanley Prusiner ya tabbatar da ka'idar furotin kawai. Furotin prion da suka lalace (PrPSc) suna aiki a matsayin samfuri wanda ke sa furotin na al'ada na ƙwayar (PrPC) su sake lanƙwasa zuwa tsarin amyloid β-sheet mai yaduwa ba tare da wani lambobin kwayar halitta ba.

question: Ta yaya ƙananan Tardigrades (Bear ɗin Ruwa) ke iya tsira daga bushewa gabaɗaya, rashin yanayi na sararin samaniya, da narke fiye da na mutane da dubban lokaci (Cryptobiosis)?
options: Suna maye gurbin ruwan jiki da wasu kwayoyin kariya na gilashin da ba su da tsari na musamman (TDPs), suna shiga cikin yanayin vitrified na dakatar da rai
Suna girma da fata nauyi na ƙarfe mai wuya na titanium
Suna rabuwa zuwa ƙwayoyin tsiro masu maimaituwa
Suna shan hasken cosmic a matsayin abinci
correctAnswer: Suna maye gurbin ruwan jiki da wasu kwayoyin kariya na gilashin da ba su da tsari na musamman (TDPs), suna shiga cikin yanayin vitrified na dakatar da rai
explanation: Tardigrades suna bayyana kwayoyin tardigrade-disordered (TDPs) da trehalose. Bushewa yana vitrify ciki na sel dinsu zuwa gilashin halittu, yana hana motsi da dakatar da ayyukan metabolism (tun state) har abada.

question: Me ya sa manyan ƙwayoyin bututu masu zaune a kusa da mafitsarin zafi na teku mai zurfi a tsayin mita 2,500 suke bunƙasa a cikin duhu cikakke ba tare da wani hasken rana ba?
options: Bakteriya masu haɗin gwiwar kemotroph suna ƙona guba hydrogen sulfide daga ramukan wuta don ƙirƙirar abubuwan gina jiki na halitta (Chemosynthesis)
Ciwon bututun na cin barayin kifi marasa rai kawai
Ramin dutsen mai fashewa na fitar da hasken ultraviolet don hotosintesis
Ciyawa suna shan ƙarfin zafin magma ta cikin huhu
correctAnswer: Bakteriya masu haɗin gwiwar kemotroph suna ƙona guba hydrogen sulfide daga ramukan wuta don ƙirƙirar abubuwan gina jiki na halitta (Chemosynthesis)
explanation: Riftia pachyptila ba su da tsarin narkar da abinci. Suna daukar biliyoyin kwayoyin cuta masu taimako a cikin wani sashen da ake kira trophosome wanda ke gyara carbon marar rayuwa ta hanyar kona sulfide: H2S + 2O2 -> SO4^2- + 2H+ + makamashi, suna tallafawa tsarin halittu ba tare da dogaro da hasken rana ba.

question: Me yasa mutum wanda ke da lalacewar hanyoyin semisirkular na kunne na ciki ke fuskantar vertigo mai tsanani kamar ɗakin yana juyawa duk lokacin da ya karkatar da kansa (BPPV)?
options: Kwayoyin otoconia na calcium carbonate da suka fita daga wurinsu suna yawo cikin ruwan hanyoyin semisirkular, suna karkatar da gashin sensory na kunne ba daidai ba tare da nauyi
Kunnen yana samun ƙananan ramuka
Hanyoyin jin kunne suna rasa dukkan wutar lantarki
Ciwon kunne yana toshe jini zuwa kwakwalwa
correctAnswer: Kwayoyin otoconia na calcium carbonate da suka fita daga wurinsu suna yawo cikin ruwan hanyoyin semisirkular, suna karkatar da gashin sensory na kunne ba daidai ba tare da nauyi
explanation: A cikin Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo, kwayoyin otoconia da suka rabu suna zaune a cikin hanyar semisirkular ta baya. Karkatar da kai yana haifar da ja-nauyi a cikin ruwan endolymph, karkatar da cupula, da kuma jin nistagmus na ƙarya.

question: Me yasa fasinja a cikin jirgin ruwa yake fuskantar rashin lafiya mai tsanani na seasickness ko da yake yana kwance gaba ɗaya ba motsi a cikin gadon cabin mai jin daɗi?
options: Ka’idar Rikicin Hankali: kayan da ke cikin kunne na vestibular suna nuna ci gaba da juyawa yayin da idanun ke ganin ɗakin cabin da ba ya motsi
Iskar cabin tana dauke da carbon monoxide
Girgizar teku na fitar da mitar sauti mai ƙasa
Ruwa teku yana haifar da tururin acid na ciki
correctAnswer: Ka’idar Rikicin Hankali: kayan da ke cikin kunne na vestibular suna nuna ci gaba da juyawa yayin da idanun ke ganin ɗakin cabin da ba ya motsi
explanation: Rashin lafiya saboda motsi na faruwa ne lokacin da canals na semicircular na vestibular suka gano hanzari, amma alamomin gani daga bangon cabin da aka gyara suna nuna babu motsi. Hankali yana fassara wannan rashin daidaito na jin daɗi a matsayin gani na neurotoxin, wanda ke haifar da amai.

question: Me ya sa shan manyan adadi na ruwan distill ɗin tsabta bayan ƙoƙari mai tsanani na motsa jiki zai iya zama mai haɗari (Gurbatar Ruwa / Hyponatremia)?
options: Matsanancin rage ƙarfin gishirin sodium na plasma na jini yana haifar da bambancin osmosis wanda ke tura ruwa cikin ƙwayoyin kwakwalwa, yana haifar da kumburin kwakwalwa mai haɗari
Ruwan distill yana lalata bangon ciki
Ruwan tsabta yana daskare a cikin jijiyoyin jini
Ruwa yana soke sinadaran narkar da abinci dindindin
correctAnswer: Matsanancin rage ƙarfin gishirin sodium na plasma na jini yana haifar da bambancin osmosis wanda ke tura ruwa cikin ƙwayoyin kwakwalwa, yana haifar da kumburin kwakwalwa mai haɗari
explanation: Shan ruwa mai rauni sosai yana rage sodium na serum ƙasa da 135 mEq/L. Matsin osmotic yana tura ruwan extracellular cikin ƙwayoyin ciki, yana kumbura neurons a cikin ƙwayar hankali mai wuya kuma yana haifar da herniation mai haɗari.

question: Me yasa tsayawa a kan matattarar hawa da ta karye ke ba mutum ɗan gajeren lokaci jin rashin daidaito, duk da sanin cewa ba ta motsi?
options: Cerebellum tana kunna shirin gyaran motsi na tsammani ba tare da sani ba bisa ga abubuwan gani da aka koya
Matakan matattarar suna da mai mai jan maganadisu
Karfen da ya karye yana canza filayen nauyi
Lantarki mai tsayuwa yana sanyaya amsoshin ƙafar hannu
correctAnswer: Cerebellum tana kunna shirin gyaran motsi na tsammani ba tare da sani ba bisa ga abubuwan gani da aka koya
explanation: Alamar 'lamari na matattarar da ta karye' tana nuna aikin motsi na atomatik: ganin matakin matattarar yana haifar da daidaiton postural na gaba-gaba wanda aka saba (tafi gaba don sanya dai-dai da saurin da ake tsammani), yana haifar da rashin jituwa a motsi.

question: Me yasa kamshin wani turare ko abincin yara ke ja hankalin tunanin baya na motsin zuciya nan take (Tasirin Proustian)?
options: Kwayar hancin na da alaƙa kai tsaye, ba tare da tsangwama ba, zuwa amygdala da hippocampus, yana kauce wa thalamus na fahimta
Ƙwayoyin turare suna narkewa cikin ruwan kashin baya na kwakwalwa
Gashin hanci na ɗauke da ƙwayoyin ƙwaƙwalwar halitta
Sinadaran turare suna aiki a matsayin guba ga jijiyoyi
correctAnswer: Kwayar hancin na da alaƙa kai tsaye, ba tare da tsangwama ba, zuwa amygdala da hippocampus, yana kauce wa thalamus na fahimta
explanation: Ba kamar sauran hankali (gani, taɓawa, jin sauti) waɗanda ke wucewa ta cibiyar thalamic ba, siginar hanci suna kaiwa kai tsaye zuwa tsarin limbic (amygdala don motsin zuciya, hippocampus don ƙwaƙwalwa), yana haifar da tunanin baya da nan take.

question: Me yasa mutum da ke riƙe gilashin abin sha mai sanyi ke ganin ɗan takarar aiki a matsayin mai sanyi, yayin da riƙe kofin abin sha mai dumi ke sa su ganin ɗan takarar a matsayin mai dumi da abin dogara?
options: Cognition na jiki: cibiyar insular tana sarrafa jin ɗumin jiki da kuma ɗumi na jin daɗin zamantakewa ta amfani da tsarin jijiyoyi masu rufewa guda ɗaya
Shan abin sha mai dumi yana ƙara matsin jini
Shan abin sha mai sanyi yana sanyaya ƙwanƙwasar murya
Kafein yana haifar da bin umarni ta hanyar hypnotic
correctAnswer: Cognition na jiki: cibiyar insular tana sarrafa jin ɗumin jiki da kuma ɗumi na jin daɗin zamantakewa ta amfani da tsarin jijiyoyi masu rufewa guda ɗaya
explanation: Lawrence Williams da John Bargh sun nuna embodied priming: dumin jiki yana motsa insula, yana shirya dumin zamantakewa da jin ƙauna a zuciya ba tare da sanin mutum ba.

question: Me ya sa mutum wanda ya shiga cikakkiyar kwarewar kwarewar hankali a cikin tankin ruwa mai gishiri mai zafin jiki, ba tare da haske ko sauti ba, yake fara ganin abubuwa masu ban mamaki a cikin mintuna 45?
options: Rashin samun abubuwan ji yana tilasta wa kwakwalwar gaba ta ƙara yawan hayaniyar ƙwaƙwalwar ciki na rashin waya don daidaita rashin samun abubuwan ji na waje
Ruwan gishiri na shiga ta cikin harsashen kunne
Duhu yana ƙone sandunan gani
Hankalin yana ƙarewa da iskar oxygen a cikin tankuna
correctAnswer: Rashin samun abubuwan ji yana tilasta wa kwakwalwar gaba ta ƙara yawan hayaniyar ƙwaƙwalwar ciki na rashin waya don daidaita rashin samun abubuwan ji na waje
explanation: Hankalin kwakwalwa na aiki ne mai hasashen abin da zai faru. Idan abubuwan shigar na waje suka ragu zuwa sifili, ana kara karfin aikin neurons. Sauye-sauyen ainihin yanayin kwakwalwa na yau da kullum ana fassara su a matsayin ainihin abubuwan jin dandano, wanda ke haifar da mafarki.

question: Me yasa maimaita faɗin wani kalma ta yau da kullum da kowa ya sani (kamar 'ƙofa' ko 'allu') sau 40 a fili ke sa kalmar ta zama kamar ba ta da ma’ana kwata-kwata (Cikakken gajiya na Ma'ana)?
options: Dogon lokaci na maimaita ƙarfafawa yana haifar da ƙuntatawar jijiyoyin kwakwalwa a cikin takamaiman wakilcin ma’ana na cortical, yana raba sauti daga ma’ana
Tsokokin harshe suna fuskantar gajiya na acid lactic
Kaddarorin murya suna canza sautin jinƙai
Ruwa laka yana wanke tunanin ɗanɗanon kalma
correctAnswer: Dogon lokaci na maimaita ƙarfafawa yana haifar da ƙuntatawar jijiyoyin kwakwalwa a cikin takamaiman wakilcin ma’ana na cortical, yana raba sauti daga ma’ana
explanation: Leon Jakobovits James ya tabbatar da cikakken gajiya na ma’ana: maimaitawa da ci gaba yana haifar da gajiya a cikin wasu tarin jijiyoyin kwakwalwa na cortical, yana rabawa fahimtar sautin furuci daga samun ma’ana na leksikal.

question: Me ya sa mutane da suke kallon allon talabijin mai hayaniya ko yanayin gajimari suke iya ganin fuskar mutum a fili cikin sauki, amma ba su cika ganin kayan aikin injiniya na bazuwar kamar toasters ba (Pareidolia)?
options: Rayuwar ci gaba ta sanya Fusiform Face Area cikin tsarin halitta don fifita samun kuskuren gaskiya na nunin fuska fiye da rashin gano fuska
Gajimare suna ɗauke da furotin na danshin fuska
An shirya pixels na talabijin da fuskar mutane
Rinjin ɗan adam yana da fasalin fuska
correctAnswer: Rayuwar ci gaba ta sanya Fusiform Face Area cikin tsarin halitta don fifita samun kuskuren gaskiya na nunin fuska fiye da rashin gano fuska
explanation: Ganin fuska yana dogara ne akan tsarin jijiyoyin da aka keɓe (FFA). Ka'idar sarrafa kuskure tana bayyana cewa kuskuren ganin gajimare a matsayin dan daba/mutum mai zuwa ba shi da wani tsada a cikin ci gaban halitta, yayin da rashin ganin fuska ta gaskiya na iya zama hatsari.

question: Me yasa karanta jerin kalmomi kamar [gadon, farkawa, gajiya, mafarki, hura hanci, bargo] ke sa kashi 80 cikin 100 na mutane su tuna karya cewa kalmar 'barci' tana cikin jerin (Illusion na DRM)?
options: Yaduwar fasaha a cikin hanyoyin tunanin ma'ana tana kunna muhimman kalmomi da ba a ambata waɗanda ke da alaƙa sosai
Jerin yana ɗauke da sauti na ƙasa a ƙasa
